chapters.title: Chapter 952 952: Fightning Xereth
paragraphs: *Swoosh... Swoosh...*
The two ancient beasts immediately moved in front of Zhang Fei. "You've finally reached this stage, kid."

"Yeah." Zhang Fei nodded at Tian Kui. "My journey isn't over yet, and the Paradise Realm is waiting for me. After this, I'll take them to the Star Tower, and I'll send one of my clones to the Sovereign Heaven Realm. Would you two like to join us in the tower?"
"No." Serpentera immediately refused. "Since the people in the tower come from the Paradise Realm, they will definitely recognize me and Old Kui's identities, and we will only bring harm to you."

Zhang Fei was aware of this situation and did not fully trust the people in the Star Tower; therefore, he decided against bringing Serpentera and Tian Kui to the tower. "Guys, I think I have one way to get rid of that demon, but I need the help of you two."
"Tell us."

"I will send you two to my beast space, but one of you must take me to Xereth's location first." Serpentera and Tian Kui exchanged confused glances, prompting Zhang Fei to explain to them. "By borrowing the power of you two, my strength will surpass that demon, and I am confident in defeating him."
"Send me there first."

Zhang Fei immediately sent Tian Kui into the beast space before activating the Soul Connect III, causing Serpentera's eyes to widen. "How did you do it, Kid? Your strength suddenly became on par with Old Kui's."

"I can't explain the details to you, but I was able to borrow all the power of the beasts inside my beast space, and that was the reason I was able to defeat those beast ancestors back then." Zhang Fei raised both hands and clenched his fists. "With this power, I am confident that I can defeat Xereth. However, I am worried that he will summon Taotie's avatar, and I will be the one to die if that happens."

Serpentera nodded in agreement. "Taotie's strength should be on par with the Five-Clawed Golden Dragon Emperor, so his strength is far above mine and Old Kui's. Even if he only sends his avatar, you still won't be able to defeat him. Moreover, his abilities are far more terrifying than you can imagine, and you will surely die if you fight him."

Zhang Fei sent all the women back to the training space along with his three clones, and he sent all the beasts back to the beast space. Meanwhile, his fifth clone went to another realm to meet Feng Xishui, and his third clone went to the Sovereign Heaven Realm.

In the training space, Zhang Fei's three clones did not dual cultivate with their partners, but instead, they started their training using level five of the gravity feature, which made the gravity thirty-two times heavier than in the outside world.
"Do you really want to face that demon now?" Serpentera asked in a serious tone.

Zhang Fei nodded at him. "The only danger left in the three mortal realms is Xereth, and we've let him roam free for too long. Therefore, I want to get rid of him as soon as possible, and I can focus on my personal affairs afterwards. If he really summons Taotie's avatar, I will immediately escape from that realm."

"In that case, I will take you to that realm now, and you can send me into your beast space afterwards." Serpentera immediately grabbed Zhang Fei's shoulder. "However, you must not force yourself, and you must escape if Xereth summons Taotie's avatar."
"Yeah."

Sometime later, the two of them had arrived in that realm, and Zhang Fei immediately sent Serpentera into the beast space before activating the Soul Link to borrow the power of all the beasts living in it. 'Can you measure my current strength, Mei?'

[Unfortunately, the system still doesn't have clear information about the strength of the Five Celestial Realms, but your strength should be several major stages above Xereth's, and you will have no difficulty defeating him.]

Zhang Fei gave a light nod and summoned the Demon Extermination Sword. He rubbed the blade of the sword and spoke to the two female spirits. "Hei'an and Guang'an, the enemy who destroyed your family is right in front of us now. I don't know if we will be able to kill Xereth today, but we will try to fight him now."
Zing... Zing... Zing...
Zhang Fei immediately used his senses, which had been strengthened by the power of the beasts, especially Serpentera and Tian Kui, to search for Xereth.
Once he found the demon, Zhang Fei canceled the Soul Link to prevent Xereth from escaping. He transformed into his demon form and disappeared from the spot.

Xereth, who was taking cover and meditating under the barrier, twitched his eyes, especially when he sensed Zhang Fei's presence. He opened his eyes and looked up at the sky, but his expression immediately changed as the barrier shattered into pieces.

Xereth immediately flew into the sky and took out his black scythe, but his eyes immediately fell on the Demon Extermination Sword in Zhang Fei's hand, making him realize his identity. "So, you are the brat who messed up my plans in the Blue Water Realm, and you are also the one who attacked me in secret in the Starry Sky Realm."
Zhang Fei said nothing and activated the Soul Link once again, shocking Xereth. He didn't give the demon a chance to escape, and he channeled his light element into his sword before attacking him.

'Fuck! How did his strength suddenly surpass mine?' Xereth tried to block his attack, but Zhang Fei instantly teleported behind him and stabbed his sword forward, which pierced straight through his back to the chest. "Gahh!"
Unfortunately, Xereth managed to shift a little, which caused Zhang Fei's attack to miss his vital organs.

Xereth swung his black scythe behind him, but Zhang Fei quickly pulled his sword out and teleported, causing his attack to strike empty air. 'What the hell is with his technique? Isn't that the technique of the heavenly fox?'
Just as Xereth was thinking that, Zhang Fei reappeared in front of him and swung his sword with great speed and precision, slashing his chest directly.

"Argh!" Xereth hurriedly flew away from him, but Zhang Fei disappeared from his sight once again. He used his darkness to protect himself, but he forgot that his enemy was also a demon, rendering his darkness useless against him.

Zhang Fei instantly appeared behind Xereth and swung his sword towards his neck, but a small darkness barrier suddenly appeared and blocked his attack. He quickly moved his target, slashed his arms, and severed both in a matter of seconds.
Splurt... Splurt...
Black blood gushed out from both of Xereth's severed arms, causing him to scream in pain. "Arghh!"

Zhang Fei immediately chased after Xereth, who was trying to escape from him. He frowned when he saw both of his arms grow back, as he never expected that the demon had the ability to regrow his severed limbs.
Zhang Fei teleported above Xereth and tried to slash at his neck once again, but another small darkness barrier protected his neck again, causing him to fail to land his attack.

Xereth took advantage of that to accelerate his speed, and he quickly flew very far away from Zhang Fei. Despite this, he repeatedly looked back, thinking of ways to escape. 'Heh! You are strong, but you will never be able to kill me as long as my head and body are still together!'
'So, his main weakness is his neck, huh? Otherwise, he wouldn't protect it that tightly, right?' Zhang Fei inwardly muttered as he thought of a way to behead Xereth.

[Master, this demon can indeed regenerate his body, but I believe his regeneration ability has a limit. Therefore, you must use your maximum speed and cut his body until he reaches his limit, and he will not be able to regenerate anymore.]

'Yeah, you're right.' Zhang Fei immediately activated all his elements, and he used all his techniques based on those elements. He summoned an annihilation flame, a hellflame frost lotus, a giant ice sword, a wind vortex, a giant light arrow, and a lightning tribulation, all of which attacked Xereth.
Xereth's expression changed to shock after he saw attacks from various different elements, but he quickly threw a few defensive artifacts to protect himself from Zhang Fei's attacks.

Unfortunately, Zhang Fei's current strength far surpassed Xereth's, and all his defensive artifacts began to crack, causing him to panic. 'Shit! I have no other choice! If I don't use it, I'll die by his hands!'

Zhang Fei, who wanted to attack Xereth immediately, stopped when he felt the powerful aura from the sky. He wasted no time in opening a portal and disappearing into it directly, especially since the demon had clearly summoned Taotie's avatar, causing all his attacks to disappear instantly.

In a few minutes, Taotie's avatar descended into that realm, forcing Xereth to kneel in mid-air. "Hmm? What happened to you? Why are you in a mess like this? I can feel that your strength is no more than ten percent."

"Master, there is a powerful demon brat in the three mortal realms, and the demon extermination sword is in his hand. He just attacked me, and I would have definitely died at his hand if I hadn't summoned your avatar." Taotie immediately read Xereth's memories, causing him to shiver in fear. "Apart from him, the Abyssal Leviathan Demon also came out of hiding some time ago, and there is another demon beast whose strength surpasses mine. Those two demon beasts always interfere with my plans and kill all my men, making me unable to carry out your duties."

"Hmm?" Taotie's expression turned serious as soon as he witnessed their battle just now, especially when he saw Zhang Fei use several different elements to attack Xereth. 'How is this possible? Since when did a living creature have so many elements? Moreover, he has light and darkness elements, as well as fire and ice elements.' "Who is that demon boy?"

Xereth shook his head at Taotie. "I don't have any information about him, but he's no ordinary demon, and he can also use the heavenly fox's abilities. Just before your avatar appeared, he escaped through a gate, just like the incident back then."

"I don't care how you do it; I want you to find out more detailed information about that demon brat, and you must capture him for me." Xereth wanted to refute Taotie, but the immortal beast glared at him fiercely. He immediately shot something into the demon's body, which made his strength fully recover. "I don't care if you die because I can send someone else to replace you, and I will kill you myself if you dare to summon my avatar for something useless again."

After he said that, Taotie disappeared from the demon's sight, and Xereth stood in the air rubbing his forehead. "Shit! All my plans are in disarray because of that little bastard and the two demon beasts! I'm sure the three of them are working together, and the two demon beasts are deliberately lending their strength to him. However, I'm confused about how they could do it, especially since I've never heard of anyone being able to borrow someone else's strength."
Xereth let out a heavy sigh and looked outside the realm, thinking of a way to find information about Zhang Fei.

"Where should I find that little bastard? I don't even know anything about his origin, so I have no clue how to find information about him." Xereth suddenly remembered their fight in the Starry Sky Realm. "He has connections with people from the Xianjin Realm, so they should know about his true identity. However, they must have prepared to welcome my arrival, and the two demon beasts will probably protect the people for him."

After he thought of some plans, Xereth immediately flew away to leave the realm. However, he suddenly summoned his black scythe and attacked the realm to vent his frustration, which caused great destruction to the realm. "After I get new subordinates, I will immediately attack the Xianjin Realm."

Meanwhile, Zhang Fei had arrived at the Phoenix Realm to pick up several people, and he went to the Xianjin Realm after sending Feng Xueying, Xian Lianghua, and Xue Jingling to the Nine Stars Realm, but he left Feng Shen there.

In the Xianjin Realm, Zhang Fei did not meet Zhe Wuming and the others, but instead, he summoned Serpentera and Tian Kui out of the beast space. He asked the two ancient demon beasts to protect the realm, especially since he had a hunch that Xereth would attack the realm.

Serpentera and Tian Kui immediately agreed with that, but they didn't expect that Zhang Fei still failed to defeat Xereth, even though he had borrowed the power of them and the beasts in the beast space.

After that, Zhang Fei went to several realms to pick up his acquaintances, and he took all of them to the Star Tower in the Nine Stars Realm. He did not forget the people from the Xian Imperial Sect, such as Ximen Chuixue and the others.
When they arrived there, Zhang Fei summoned everyone out of the training space because the rewards from the tower were valuable, so he wanted them to challenge the tower.

When the others began to test their strength on the stone obelisk, Zhang Fei led some of those who had already challenged the tower to enter it, especially since they no longer needed to test their strength.
As soon as they entered the tower, the old man and his three disciples immediately appeared in front of them, and their expressions became serious as soon as they detected Zhang Fei's cultivation.

The old man immediately spoke. "The last time we met was a little over two years ago, and your cultivation had just broken through to the Heaven Realm at that time, but you have already reached the 1-Moon Divine Transcend Realm now."

"Haha." Zhang Fei laughed at that. "Old Man, I got help from several people, including a great alchemist. If it weren't for them, I wouldn't have reached this stage today. By the way, I know the challenger limit is only one hundred, but I have brought dozens of people outside, and I hope you can let them in here if they can pass the strength test."
"You—"
"Mei'er." The old man stopped Hua Mei'er. "Are you that eager to go to our realm?"

Zhang Fei nodded at the old man. "My strength has already surpassed people in the three mortal realms, and my cultivation will be too slow if I continue to stay here, so my best choice is to go to the Paradise Realm as soon as possible."
"I see." The old man nodded in understanding. "All right, I will allow them to enter this tower if they pass the strength test."
"But, master—"
"I will bear the risk, Mei'er." Hua Mei'er looked annoyed because the old man kept giving special treatment to Zhang Fei.

Unlike her, Sima Yun and Helian Xun'er could understand their master's decision, especially since Zhang Fei's strength and progress were too terrifying even for cultivators from the Paradise Realm like them.

The old man waved his hand, and the situation on the first floor changed significantly. "I allow them to enter this tower, but I will not let them pass the tests easily, and they will have to struggle even harder to pass them."
"Hehe." Zhang Fei chuckled. "I have no problem with that, and they will definitely pass those tests."
"A braggart!" Hua Mei'er shouted at Zhang Fei, but her heart pounded as soon as he used his demon charm on her, making her panic and immediately disappear from there.
The old man raised his eyebrows slightly but didn't say anything about it. "I won't allow you to help them, and you can go directly to the second floor to undergo the tests there."

"Sure!" The old man and his two disciples immediately disappeared. Zhang Fei then turned to the others, such as Xian Changyue and a few others. "Let's go to the second floor and let them challenge the first floor themselves."
"Are you sure it's okay if we leave them?" Yun Xinyue asked him.
Zhang Fei nodded in response. "They've changed a lot in the past few years, so I believe they'll be fine."
- To Be Continued -

"Master, there is a powerful demon brat in the three mortal realms, and the demon extermination sword is in his hand.
He just attacked me, and I would have definitely died at his hand if I hadn't summoned your avatar." Taotie immediately read Xereth's memories, causing him to shiver in fear.
"Apart from him, the Abyssal Leviathan Demon also came out of hiding some time ago, and there is another demon beast whose strength surpasses mine.
Those two demon beasts always interfere with my plans and kill all my men, making me unable to carry out your duties."
"Hmm?" Taotie's expression turned serious as soon as he witnessed their battle just now, especially when he saw Zhang Fei use several different elements to attack Xereth. 'How is this possible?
Since when did a living creature have so many elements?
Moreover, he has light and darkness elements, as well as fire and ice elements.' "Who is that demon boy?"
Xereth shook his head at Taotie.
"I don't have any information about him, but he's no ordinary demon, and he can also use the heavenly fox's abilities.
Just before your avatar appeared, he escaped through a gate, just like the incident back then."

"I don't care how you do it; I want you to find out more detailed information about that demon brat, and you must capture him for me." Xereth wanted to refute Taotie, but the immortal beast glared at him fiercely.
He immediately shot something into the demon's body, which made his strength fully recover.
"I don't care if you die because I can send someone else to replace you, and I will kill you myself if you dare to summon my avatar for something useless again."
After he said that, Taotie disappeared from the demon's sight, and Xereth stood in the air rubbing his forehead.
"Shit!
All my plans are in disarray because of that little bastard and the two demon beasts!
I'm sure the three of them are working together, and the two demon beasts are deliberately lending their strength to him.
However, I'm confused about how they could do it, especially since I've never heard of anyone being able to borrow someone else's strength."
Xereth let out a heavy sigh and looked outside the realm, thinking of a way to find information about Zhang Fei.
"Where should I find that little bastard?
I don't even know anything about his origin, so I have no clue how to find information about him." Xereth suddenly remembered their fight in the Starry Sky Realm.
"He has connections with people from the Xianjin Realm, so they should know about his true identity.
However, they must have prepared to welcome my arrival, and the two demon beasts will probably protect the people for him."
After he thought of some plans, Xereth immediately flew away to leave the realm.
However, he suddenly summoned his black scythe and attacked the realm to vent his frustration, which caused great destruction to the realm.
"After I get new subordinates, I will immediately attack the Xianjin Realm."

Meanwhile, Zhang Fei had arrived at the Phoenix Realm to pick up several people, and he went to the Xianjin Realm after sending Feng Xueying, Xian Lianghua, and Xue Jingling to the Nine Stars Realm, but he left Feng Shen there.
In the Xianjin Realm, Zhang Fei did not meet Zhe Wuming and the others, but instead, he summoned Serpentera and Tian Kui out of the beast space.
He asked the two ancient demon beasts to protect the realm, especially since he had a hunch that Xereth would attack the realm.

Serpentera and Tian Kui immediately agreed with that, but they didn't expect that Zhang Fei still failed to defeat Xereth, even though he had borrowed the power of them and the beasts in the beast space.
After that, Zhang Fei went to several realms to pick up his acquaintances, and he took all of them to the Star Tower in the Nine Stars Realm.
He did not forget the people from the Xian Imperial Sect, such as Ximen Chuixue and the others.
When they arrived there, Zhang Fei summoned everyone out of the training space because the rewards from the tower were valuable, so he wanted them to challenge the tower.

When the others began to test their strength on the stone obelisk, Zhang Fei led some of those who had already challenged the tower to enter it, especially since they no longer needed to test their strength.
As soon as they entered the tower, the old man and his three disciples immediately appeared in front of them, and their expressions became serious as soon as they detected Zhang Fei's cultivation.
The old man immediately spoke.

"The last time we met was a little over two years ago, and your cultivation had just broken through to the Heaven Realm at that time, but you have already reached the 1-Moon Divine Transcend Realm now."
"Haha." Zhang Fei laughed at that.
"Old Man, I got help from several people, including a great alchemist.
If it weren't for them, I wouldn't have reached this stage today.
By the way, I know the challenger limit is only one hundred, but I have brought dozens of people outside, and I hope you can let them in here if they can pass the strength test."
"You—"
"Mei'er." The old man stopped Hua Mei'er.
"Are you that eager to go to our realm?"
Zhang Fei nodded at the old man.

"My strength has already surpassed people in the three mortal realms, and my cultivation will be too slow if I continue to stay here, so my best choice is to go to the Paradise Realm as soon as possible."
"I see." The old man nodded in understanding.
"All right, I will allow them to enter this tower if they pass the strength test."
"But, master—"
"I will bear the risk, Mei'er." Hua Mei'er looked annoyed because the old man kept giving special treatment to Zhang Fei.

Unlike her, Sima Yun and Helian Xun'er could understand their master's decision, especially since Zhang Fei's strength and progress were too terrifying even for cultivators from the Paradise Realm like them.
The old man waved his hand, and the situation on the first floor changed significantly.
"I allow them to enter this tower, but I will not let them pass the tests easily, and they will have to struggle even harder to pass them."
"Hehe." Zhang Fei chuckled.
"I have no problem with that, and they will definitely pass those tests."
"A braggart!" Hua Mei'er shouted at Zhang Fei, but her heart pounded as soon as he used his demon charm on her, making her panic and immediately disappear from there.
The old man raised his eyebrows slightly but didn't say anything about it.
"I won't allow you to help them, and you can go directly to the second floor to undergo the tests there."
"Sure!" The old man and his two disciples immediately disappeared.
Zhang Fei then turned to the others, such as Xian Changyue and a few others.
"Let's go to the second floor and let them challenge the first floor themselves."
"Are you sure it's okay if we leave them?" Yun Xinyue asked him.
Zhang Fei nodded in response.
"They've changed a lot in the past few years, so I believe they'll be fine."
- To Be Continued -

chapters.title: Chapter 953: The Tests
paragraphs: "Master! Please help me! That annoying brat used something against me!" Hua Mei'er immediately begged her master as soon as the old man and the other two returned.

With a soft sigh, the old man touched Hua Mei'er's forehead, instantly dispelling the effects of Zhang Fei's demon charm, causing her to exhale in relief. "His demon form has evolved again, and his abilities have become potent against you. Therefore, you should be careful in speaking, especially when you meet him again later."
"Master—"

"How can Zhang Fei's abilities affect Mei'er, Master?" Helian Xun'er doubtfully asked. "She is a soul cultivator, and her soul level has already reached the early stage of the Divine Soul Level, so her abilities should be useless against her."

"You're wrong about that, Xun'er. If Zhang Fei was an ordinary cultivator or demon, his demon abilities wouldn't be able to affect Mei'er." The three looked confused by that, so the old man immediately explained it to them. "You guys must remember that he is a soul cultivator, right?"
"Yes." The three nodded to the old man.

The old man immediately continued. "If I'm not mistaken, his soul power has already reached the early stage of the Ancestral Soul Level. If Mei'er's soul level had not reached that stage, she would not have been able to restrain herself and jump into his arms directly."
"Master! Don't scare me!" Hua Mei'er hugged herself tightly, and she shivered at the thought of such a thing happening to her.

"Our master didn't scare you." Sima Yun shook his head as he spoke. "I once met a demon cultivator, who also happened to be a soul cultivator. His abilities were far more terrifying than those of the demons in his race, and I nearly died at his hands because I mistakenly believed he was no different from the others. Since Zhang Fei's soul level had reached that stage, his demon abilities had definitely become stronger than the other lust demons."

"You're right, Yun'er." The old man replied with a nod. "Moreover, Zhang Fei is no longer a lust demon or lust demon lord, and I'm sure that he has already evolved into a transcendent lust demon. However, he doesn't seem to know yet that he can use his soul power and demon abilities simultaneously, and the effect of his abilities will be even more terrifying if he combines the two."
"Doesn't that mean that no one can escape the snare of Zhang Fei's demon abilities?" Helian Xun'er asked with a serious face.

The old man nodded at her. "If Zhang Fei uses his soul power to strengthen his demon abilities, I can say with certainty that both men and women will immediately succumb to their effects. Moreover, his soul level is still far from the peak, and his soul power will continue to increase over time. At that time, none of them will be able to withstand the effects of his abilities, including the senior cultivators in our realm."
"Ugh! I will never appear before that annoying brat again!" Hua Mei'er said with a pale face, and she left them directly.
"Haha." Helian Xun'er laughed at her antic. "Mei'er is so scared of Zhang Fei."

Sima Yun shrugged his shoulders. "Mei'er has always been confident in herself and her abilities, especially in the soul cultivation path. Unfortunately, she met her nemesis today, and Zhang Fei's abilities were too terrifying for her."
"I'm curious about Zhang Fei's progress, so let's watch them." The old man immediately waved his hand, creating several Qi screens to observe everyone.
When they arrived at the second floor, Zhang Fei saw five doors of different colors. "How many tests have you passed on this floor?"

"Only two tests, and we were short of people to face the third test. Fortunately, the tests did not start right away, and we could peek at them from the door, so we decided to retreat." Xian Changyue answered him.
Ximen Chuixue immediately pointed at the middle door. "Brother, we will face many horde beasts once we go through that door, and most of them are truly powerful."
"Beasts, huh?" Zhang Fei walked straight to the middle door and opened it, but he was greeted by loud roars from numerous beasts. "Tch! Do they think they can scare me with their shrill roars?"
"Hahaha." Yuan Luo laughed before speaking to him. "Brother, we haven't seen you fight for a long time, so I want to see your current abilities."

Ye Zhiqiu nodded in agreement with her. "Back then, your fighting abilities were already extraordinary, and it's been a few years since then, so I'm sure your fighting abilities have improved significantly by now."

"You two don't need to doubt my husband." Yuan Luo and Ye Zhiqiu looked at Bai Tian'er with strange looks because Zhang Fei repeatedly rejected her years ago, but they were already husband and wife now. "Those beasts are indeed powerful for us, but they are nothing in front of him. He can even defeat some mythical beasts at the 5-Divine Ascension Realm, let alone these weak beasts."
"Wow! You are really great, brother!" Yuan Luo exclaimed.

"Senior Sister, you're already a mother now, so you should stop acting like a little girl." Yuan Luo pouted her lips, but Zhang Fei immediately led them into the door and counted the number of beasts inside. "Hmm? Ten thousand beasts, huh?"
"Are you thinking about killing them all at once, husband?" Yun Xinyue asked him.

"We don't need to waste time with them, right?" Xian Changyue and the others could only shake their heads as they watched Zhang Fei fly high into the middle of the area. "The Ninth Heaven: Eternal Thunder Judgment!"

Ximen Chuixue and the disciples of the Xian Imperial Sect raised their eyebrows as the sky above them darkened, and lightning bolts began to strike there, but Xian Xianqin immediately explained to them about Zhang Fei's technique.
"Show off!" Xin Xianzi, the fairy, said it with a shake of her head.
Long Chen and Long Tian took a deep breath as they looked up at the sky. 'We are no longer his opponents.'
The old man, Helian Xun'er, and Sima Yun, who witnessed the event from the top floor of the tower, were also shocked by Zhang Fei's strength.

Zhang Fei did not stop there and used some of his other techniques, such as the hellflame frost lotus, the annihilation flame, and several others. Once all his techniques were ready, he locked his senses on all his targets and launched his attacks toward them.

In that instant, countless lightning bolts descended from the sky and attacked the beasts below them, killing quite a number of them. Zhang Fei swiftly unleashed his other attacks, triggering violent explosions and earthquakes that rippled far beyond the tower.
After the chaos ended, all the beasts in that area had perished. Not even their bodies were remains.

Zhang Fei immediately landed in front of Bai Tian'er and the others, looking at Ximen Chuixue and the others, who were stunned by his action. He just smiled at them, took Xian Xianqin and Yun Xinyue by the arm, and led them to leave the place. "Let's go! We will complete the next challenge."
Ximen Chuixue and the others let out a heavy sigh before following Zhang Fei and the others, but they were also excited about it because they believed he could help them pass the second floor easily.
Outside the tower, Hong Xinxin and everyone else had completed the test challenge, and none of them failed, especially after their rigorous training in the training space for the past few years.
When they arrived at the first floor, they were faced with ten different doors, which were different from the tests that Zhang Fei passed through years ago.
"These tests are different from what our husband told us." Liu Qingyu spoke as she looked at those doors.
Liu Hua nodded in agreement with her big sister. "These tests are different, but we won't let them stop us from catching up with our husband on the second floor."
"Let's go! We have to finish them quickly." Boitata directly led all of Zhang Fei's women, both his official and non-official harem members.
Yan Yinqing and everyone else also followed them, but they did not enter through the same door, and they divided their numbers into several groups to challenge different doors.
"Are the challenges at the Sun Tower the same as in this tower, Old Hun?" Lin Jingxia asked.

Hun Di shook his head. "Those people have complete control over the tower, and they can change all the tests as they please. We also encountered ten doors like this in the Sun Tower, but I'm sure the tests in this tower will be different compared to that time."
"Whatever tests come our way, we will definitely pass them." Feng Xueying spoke as she walked into one of the doors, followed by Hun Di, Lin Jingxia, and Xia Tian. "Let's go in."

On top of the tower, the old man, Sima Yun, and Helian Xun'er were amazed and shocked by the actions of Zhang Fei and everyone close to him, especially since the cultivation of most of his women was still in the ten mortal realms. The other people who had reached the Seven Divine Realms were also stronger than their expectation.

"Master, the strength of those people, especially Zhang Fei's wives, wasn't this strong when you let them train in the Soul Challenge back then." Sima Yun spoke with a frown. "If they were already this strong, all the tests in this tower were useless to them."

Helian Xun'er asked their master. "Are you going to lift all the restrictions, Master? I think they will pass all the tests in this tower, even though most of them are still in the ten mortal realms. However, the higher-ups will react strongly if they find out about these people, and they might eliminate them."

"You're right." The old man nodded to them. "These people's strength and speed have already far surpassed their level, but Zhang Fei's development is the most ridiculous. If you pay close attention to the power of his previous attacks, they are already on par with cultivators at the Celestial Lord Realm. I don't know how he managed to do it, but I'm sure that the strength that he showed earlier is definitely not his true strength."
"Does that mean Zhang Fei borrowed the strength of other people?"
"Yes."
"How did Zhang Fei manage to do that?"

"I don't know." The old man fell into thought as he kept observing Zhang Fei through the Qi screen. "With his current strength, it won't take him long to pass those tests on the second floor, and he can go to the third floor directly."
"Are you going to let Zhang Fei pass the tests with borrowed power, Master?"

The old man nodded at them. "There's no rule that prohibits participants from borrowing other people's power, right? Moreover, we can't prove that Zhang Fei borrowed other people's power, so I won't stop him, and I will do something to make things difficult for him, but I can only do it on the third floor."

Helian Xun'er then spoke. "Master, I want to see the maximum strength of these people, especially Zhang Fei's women. You must make the first-floor tests as hard as possible so we can gauge their true strength."
"All right."
In the meantime, Zhang Xiaolong [3] had already reached a point not far from the Sovereign Heaven Realm, but he was experiencing doubts about venturing into that realm.
In the end, Zhang Xiaolong [3] still decided to enter that realm, but two people immediately appeared in front of him, one old man and one woman. 'A female elf? Scan her, Mei.'
[Yes, Master.]
Name: Jia Yuyan
Race: Elf
Gender: Female
Cultivation: 5-Moon Divine Ascension Realm
Soul Cultivation: Saint Soul [Perfection Stage]
Elements:
- Light [Peak Stage]
- Wood [Peak Stage]
Elemental laws:
- Light [Perfection Stage]
- Wood [Perfection Stage]
Cores:
- Light [Peak Rank]
- Wood [Peak Rank]
Physique: Elf
Special Physique: Wood Spirit Nourishing Body
Special Bloodline: Immortal Treant Spirit
Partner: None
'What the fuck? Everything about her is perfect! She even has a special physique and bloodline.' Zhang Xiaolong [3] was shocked and muttered to himself inwardly.
[Master, try using your demon abilities on this woman; I'm sure they won't work on her.]

Zhang Xiaolong [3] tried to use his abilities, but Jia Yuyan showed no reaction. Instead, she smiled and spoke to him through telepathy. 'Don't waste your time, successor of the ten-tailed fox. Your lust demon abilities might have an effect on other people, but they are useless against me.'
'Haha.' Zhang Xiaolong [3] laughed awkwardly. 'Were you waiting for me? How did you know I would come today?'

Jia Yuyan nodded at him. 'I have been waiting for you for hundreds of thousands of years, and I know that you will come today for a reason, but I cannot tell you about it. I came here to warn you not to use all your strength to pass the tests to enter this realm, or you will face something you have never faced before, and it will bring trouble to yourself.'
'What do you mean by that?' Zhang Xiaolong [3] asked with a frown.

Jia Yuyan shook her head. 'Just listen to me, or you'll regret it. By the way, Tian Baixing and Tian Baitian are also in the testing ground, and they still haven't managed to complete the tests, even though it's been a little over two years since they started.'

Zhang Xiaolong [3] was surprised to hear that, and he didn't expect that Tian Baixing and Tian Baitian were also in that realm. Back then, he asked Tian Jiyuan and Tian Jianxia to search for their whereabouts, but the members of their race did not know them.

'I know you need their hearts to evolve into ten tails, but you can't do anything for now.' Zhang Xiaolong [3] frowned once again as soon as Jia Yuyan mentioned it. 'You haven't even evolved into nine tails, and you haven't found all the souls of the ten-tailed fox either, so you'd better forget about your intention to kill them. If you don't implant them in your body right after extraction, their hearts will rot, and you'll miss your chance to be a ten-tail. If the ten-tailed fox does not reappear in this universe, this universe will never find peace, and the situation will become more chaotic as time passes.'
Zhang Xiaolong [3] did not take Jia Yuyan's advice lightly, but he was also shocked and curious about how she could know that much. 'Are you a Seer?'

'I don't have that kind of power, and I know everything for a reason. All right, I won't say any more, and you can start taking your tests.' Jia Yuyan turned to the old man. "Mu Ling, lead this kid to the first test site."
"Yes, Master." After Jia Yuyan disappeared, Mu Ling then spoke to Zhang Xiaolong [3]. "Please follow me, young man."

Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately followed Mu Ling, but his mind was filled with many questions regarding Jia Yuyan and her true identity. 'Sigh! That woman is much more mysterious than Feng Yao! I'm sure she also has something to do with the Paradise Realm!'
[Forget her for now, Master. You should focus on completing those tests as soon as possible so you can take the Sky Flame sooner.]
'Yeah.'
Before long, they arrived in front of a stone obelisk, which surprised Zhang Xiaolong [3] because it was similar to the one at the Star Tower, with ten crystals embedded there.

Mu Ling immediately explained to him. "The first test is an aptitude test, and you only need to light up as many crystals as possible on this obelisk. If you can only light up less than five, you can't take the second test and must leave this realm."
Zhang Xiaolong [3] touched the stone obelisk directly. "Is there any special advantage if I can light up multiple crystals at once?"

"The crystals will determine your talents, so you will gain some advantages if you manage to light up as many of them as possible. But you must pass all the tests first, so the outcome is up to you. As soon as Mu Ling finished saying that, the ten crystals on the stone obelisk immediately lit up. "As expected."
Zhang Xiaolong [3] just smiled. "Please take me to the second test site."
"Follow me."

I don't know how he managed to do it, but I'm sure that the strength that he showed earlier is definitely not his true strength."
"Does that mean Zhang Fei borrowed the strength of other people?"
"Yes."
"How did Zhang Fei manage to do that?"
"I don't know." The old man fell into thought as he kept observing Zhang Fei through the Qi screen.
"With his current strength, it won't take him long to pass those tests on the second floor, and he can go to the third floor directly."
"Are you going to let Zhang Fei pass the tests with borrowed power, Master?"
The old man nodded at them.
"There's no rule that prohibits participants from borrowing other people's power, right?
Moreover, we can't prove that Zhang Fei borrowed other people's power, so I won't stop him, and I will do something to make things difficult for him, but I can only do it on the third floor."
Helian Xun'er then spoke.
"Master, I want to see the maximum strength of these people, especially Zhang Fei's women.
You must make the first-floor tests as hard as possible so we can gauge their true strength."
"All right."
In the meantime, Zhang Xiaolong [3] had already reached a point not far from the Sovereign Heaven Realm, but he was experiencing doubts about venturing into that realm.
In the end, Zhang Xiaolong [3] still decided to enter that realm, but two people immediately appeared in front of him, one old man and one woman. 'A female elf?
Scan her, Mei.'
[Yes, Master.]
Name: Jia Yuyan
Race: Elf
Gender: Female
Cultivation: 5-Moon Divine Ascension Realm
Soul Cultivation: Saint Soul [Perfection Stage]
Elements:
- Light [Peak Stage]
- Wood [Peak Stage]
Elemental laws:
- Light [Perfection Stage]
- Wood [Perfection Stage]
Cores:
- Light [Peak Rank]
- Wood [Peak Rank]
Physique: Elf
Special Physique: Wood Spirit Nourishing Body
Special Bloodline: Immortal Treant Spirit
Partner: None
'What the fuck?
Everything about her is perfect!
She even has a special physique and bloodline.' Zhang Xiaolong [3] was shocked and muttered to himself inwardly.
[Master, try using your demon abilities on this woman; I'm sure they won't work on her.]
Zhang Xiaolong [3] tried to use his abilities, but Jia Yuyan showed no reaction.
Instead, she smiled and spoke to him through telepathy. 'Don't waste your time, successor of the ten-tailed fox.
Your lust demon abilities might have an effect on other people, but they are useless against me.'
'Haha.' Zhang Xiaolong [3] laughed awkwardly. 'Were you waiting for me?
How did you know I would come today?'
Jia Yuyan nodded at him. 'I have been waiting for you for hundreds of thousands of years, and I know that you will come today for a reason, but I cannot tell you about it.
I came here to warn you not to use all your strength to pass the tests to enter this realm, or you will face something you have never faced before, and it will bring trouble to yourself.'
'What do you mean by that?' Zhang Xiaolong [3] asked with a frown.
Jia Yuyan shook her head. 'Just listen to me, or you'll regret it.
By the way, Tian Baixing and Tian Baitian are also in the testing ground, and they still haven't managed to complete the tests, even though it's been a little over two years since they started.'
Zhang Xiaolong [3] was surprised to hear that, and he didn't expect that Tian Baixing and Tian Baitian were also in that realm.
Back then, he asked Tian Jiyuan and Tian Jianxia to search for their whereabouts, but the members of their race did not know them.

'I know you need their hearts to evolve into ten tails, but you can't do anything for now.' Zhang Xiaolong [3] frowned once again as soon as Jia Yuyan mentioned it. 'You haven't even evolved into nine tails, and you haven't found all the souls of the ten-tailed fox either, so you'd better forget about your intention to kill them.
If you don't implant them in your body right after extraction, their hearts will rot, and you'll miss your chance to be a ten-tail.
If the ten-tailed fox does not reappear in this universe, this universe will never find peace, and the situation will become more chaotic as time passes.'
Zhang Xiaolong [3] did not take Jia Yuyan's advice lightly, but he was also shocked and curious about how she could know that much. 'Are you a Seer?'
'I don't have that kind of power, and I know everything for a reason.
All right, I won't say any more, and you can start taking your tests.' Jia Yuyan turned to the old man.
"Mu Ling, lead this kid to the first test site."
"Yes, Master." After Jia Yuyan disappeared, Mu Ling then spoke to Zhang Xiaolong [3].
"Please follow me, young man."
Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately followed Mu Ling, but his mind was filled with many questions regarding Jia Yuyan and her true identity. 'Sigh!
That woman is much more mysterious than Feng Yao!
I'm sure she also has something to do with the Paradise Realm!'
[Forget her for now, Master.
You should focus on completing those tests as soon as possible so you can take the Sky Flame sooner.]
'Yeah.'
Before long, they arrived in front of a stone obelisk, which surprised Zhang Xiaolong [3] because it was similar to the one at the Star Tower, with ten crystals embedded there.
Mu Ling immediately explained to him.
"The first test is an aptitude test, and you only need to light up as many crystals as possible on this obelisk.
If you can only light up less than five, you can't take the second test and must leave this realm."
Zhang Xiaolong [3] touched the stone obelisk directly.
"Is there any special advantage if I can light up multiple crystals at once?"
"The crystals will determine your talents, so you will gain some advantages if you manage to light up as many of them as possible.
But you must pass all the tests first, so the outcome is up to you.
As soon as Mu Ling finished saying that, the ten crystals on the stone obelisk immediately lit up.
"As expected."
Zhang Xiaolong [3] just smiled.
"Please take me to the second test site."
"Follow me."

chapters.title: Chapter 954: Indestructible Vajra Immortal Body
paragraphs: Mu Ling had already brought Zhang Xiaolong [3] to a tall red gate. "This is the Sovereign Gate, where you will undergo three tests: the mind and heart test, the body test, and the soul test. Are you ready?"

"Yes." Mu Ling opened the gate, prompting Zhang Xiaolong [3] to enter immediately and behold an unusual sight. He shook his head slightly because everything in front of him was clearly an illusion. 'It's funny because can control illusions, but they want to test my mind and heart with illusions.'

Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately activated the illusion negation ability, causing the scene in front of him to disappear by itself. Thereafter, he used his illusion manipulation ability to retaliate against the person who used the illusion, making that person scream hysterically.

After the illusion disappeared, Zhang Xiaolong [3] felt a strong downward pull, but it was meaningless because the gravity in that place was only ten times heavier, especially since he himself had already adapted to sixteen times heavier gravity. Moreover, three of his five clones were still training at thirty-two times heavier gravity, which made the gravity there seem insignificant to him.

Instead of flaunting his speed, Zhang Xiaolong [3] strolled around the place at a relaxed pace. Just as he was enjoying himself, he received a powerful soul attack that went straight to his soul, but Nalan Yushu immediately returned the soul attack to its owner. 'Hish! You don't have to do that, you know?'
'Hehehe!' Nalan Yushu giggled. 'The people in this realm are too arrogant with their abilities, so I want to teach them a little lesson, Master.'

'All right, you don't have to interfere in the next tests, or those people will be suspicious of me.' Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately left the room, surprising Mu Ling, who was waiting for him outside. "Please lead me to the third test location."
"How did you manage to complete all three tests in such a short time?" Mu Ling curiously asked.

Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately took out the 5000-pound hammer and handed it to the old man, but Mu Ling right away fell to the floor as soon as he received it, causing him to stare at him in shock. "First, the weight of this hammer is 5000 pounds, and the gravity inside is not that heavy. Second, the illusion shown to me was just an ordinary illusion, and I have long thought my father was dead. Third, I am a soul cultivator with my soul level already reaching the ancestral level, and I have the best soul cultivation master in this universe."
"Who is your master?"
"The Soul Emperor, Hun Di." Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately took out the hammer and put it away. "Therefore, the three tests just now were of no use to me, and I was able to pass them easily."

Mu Ling immediately led Zhang Xiaolong [3] to the third test site, which was a floating library. The library itself was enormous, with many tall bookshelves all around, and he saw thousands of people seriously studying their chosen techniques.

Mu Ling immediately explained the test details to Zhang Xiaolong [3]. "You can choose one technique that interests you the most, and you have a day to study and master that technique. If you fail to do so, that technique will disappear from your mind, and you will fail this test."
"What is the highest grade of all the techniques in this library?" Zhang Xiaolong [3] asked as he observed those bookshelves.

"Can you see those transparent barriers?" Zhang Xiaolong [3] nodded to Mu Ling. "Each barrier indicates the grade of all the techniques in that area, and you can search for a technique with a higher grade each time you pass through that barrier. The best grade techniques are immortal, and you can find them after you pass the last barrier."

"Eh?" Zhang Xiaolong [3] turned to Mu Ling in shock, especially since he only had one immortal-grade technique, which was the Yin-Yang Fire Art. Moreover, he found it in the Star Tower, but that tower had a direct connection to the Paradise Realm. "Do you really have immortal-grade techniques?"

Mu Ling nodded at him. "We possess one immortal-grade technique for each category, including ordinary cultivation, soul cultivation, body cultivation, and others. However, I don't recommend you choose the immortal-grade technique because one day won't be enough to learn it, let alone master it."
"Have you ever heard of the towers located in the middle realms?"

"Have you ever challenged one of those towers?" Zhang Xiaolong [3] told Mu Ling about the Sun Tower in the Blossom Heaven Realm. "Actually, some members of various clans in this realm traveled to one of those towers about two years ago. If I'm not mistaken, it's the Moon Tower in the Frozen Moon Realm."

Zhang Xiaolong [3] naturally knew about it because Yuan Tianling was with them, but he sighed heavily because two years had passed so quickly, especially since he had been focusing on his seclusion. "I'll start now."

"All right." Mu Ling immediately frowned as Zhang Xiaolong [3] flew so fast, and he had already passed several barriers in a matter of seconds. 'His speed is truly astonishing for a cultivator at his level! Does he really want to risk his chances by forcing himself to learn an immortal-grade technique?'
A while later, Mu Ling saw that Zhang Xiaolong [3] had already passed the last barrier, making him sigh in disappointment that he had been too ambitious to learn something beyond his capabilities.
Unfortunately, Mu Ling did not know anything about Zhang Xiaolong [3], and neither did he know that he had studied the Immortal Yin-Yang Fire Art for less than a day.

On the top floor, Zhang Xiaolong [3] saw that there were only ten technique books, all of which were immortal grades. "Where did they get these technique books? Even people from the Xianjin Realm don't have an immortal-grade technique, but they have this many."

"Did you come from the Xianjin Realm?" Zhang Xiaolong [3] was startled hearing that, and he immediately turned to the woman who owned the voice. "My name is Shangguan Yan from the Shangguan Clan, and I am responsible for taking care of this library."
'Scan her, Mei.'
[Yes.]
Name: Shangguan Yan
Race: Froststream Swan
Rank: Divine Beast
Gender: Female
Cultivation: 5-Moon Divine Ascension Realm
Soul Cultivation: Saint Soul [Perfection Stage]
Element:
- Ice [Peak Stage]
Elemental law:
- Ice [Perfection Stage]
Core:
- Ice [Peak Rank]
Physique: Swan Beast
Special Physique: Ice Bone Physique
Special Bloodline: Glacial Serpent
Partner: None
'A swan beast, huh? Ice bone physique?'

[According to the system, the Ice Bone Physique is a rare elemental body constitution in which the bones are naturally infused with ancient ice essence from birth. This physique makes its owner no less cold than the ice phoenix, and its owner's mastery of the ice element is very high.]
'I see.' Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately cupped his hands to the woman. "My name is Zhang Xiaolong, and I indeed come from the Xianjin Realm."

Shangguan Yan nodded in understanding. "I didn't expect you to come from that realm, especially since you are clearly a mythical beast. However, I can't recognize the identity of your beast, but I can sense that you also have some other beast bloodlines."

"You're not wrong about that, but I prefer not to reveal my beast identity, Senior." Shangguan Yan raised his eyebrows slightly in response to Zhang Xiaolong [3]. "After all, my cultivation is still at the 1-Moon Divine Transcend Realm, and people will hunt me down if they know that I am a weak mythical beast."

Shangguan Yan nodded in understanding. "Do you really want to try learning one of these techniques? If you fail the test this time, then you will never be able to enter this realm in your entire life. Therefore, you must think things through carefully and not waste your only chance."

"Since this is my only chance, I want to try to get the best results, and my choice is to learn one of these techniques." Zhang Xiaolong [3] then looked at the ten books again. "However, I am in a dilemma as to which one I should learn, especially since I studied almost all paths of cultivation."
"Oh?" Shangguan Yan was surprised by that. "Even though you study many cultivation paths, you definitely choose the one that you focus on, right?"

Zhang Xiaolong [3] was at a loss to answer her, especially since he was focusing himself on everything. "I am a soul cultivator, but I already have some good techniques taught by my master. I am also a sword cultivator, but my sword skills are average, so I considered selecting this particular sword technique. However, I am also a body cultivator, and I feel that my body strength is still lacking, so I am in a dilemma to choose one of them."
"What else have you learned besides these three?"

"Dual cultivation, alchemy, blacksmithing, and formation array." Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s answer left Shangguan Yan dumbfounded. "I already have good techniques for those four, so I'm not interested in techniques from those four areas."

Shangguan Yan returned to her senses and took one of the books before handing it to Zhang Xiaolong [3]. "Since you are a dual cultivator, alchemist, and blacksmith, this body cultivation technique is your best choice. Unfortunately, this body technique has no connection to any element, so it cannot increase your fire element."
"I don't think it's a big deal." Zhang Xiaolong [3] received the book and read the title. "Indestructible Vajra Immortal Body."
Shangguan Yan nodded at him. "Only two people have ever mastered the Indestructible Vajra Immortal Body, one of whom is Tian Kongquan, a founding father of this realm."
"Oh?" Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately opened the technique and asked Mei to record everything.

Shangguan Yan immediately spoke again. "In his era, Tian Kongquan was the best cultivator, and no one could match his physical strength because of this technique. Unfortunately, his cultivation was stuck in the Divine Ascension Realm, and he died due to the exhaustion of his lifespan. If only he could break through to a higher stage, he would still be alive now, and he would be unrivaled."

'Even if he could do it, he would never be the strongest in this universe; even Huo Ling could defeat him in a matter of seconds.' Zhang Xiaolong [3] then asked her. "Can I read all of these technique books first before I choose the right one for me?"

"Yes." Shangguan Yan was not worried about it because she believed that Zhang Xiaolong [3] would not be able to understand all of them just by briefly reading them, and he would not be able to remember anything if he failed his test. "However, your time has started since you stepped into this library, so you cannot read them for too long, and you must quickly decide which technique you want to learn."
"I understand, Senior." Once Shangguan Yan returned to her place, Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately moved to read the other nine books, and Mei quickly recorded them all in the system.

After Mei recorded them all, Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately searched for a place to study the Indestructible Vajra Immortal Body. In the training space, Zhang Fei [1], Feltia [2], and Zhang Fei [4] immediately stopped their training. Instead, they activated the comprehension feature to study the body cultivation technique.
'This technique has seven stages, huh?' Zhang Xiaolong [3] muttered to himself as he read the explanation of each stage.
[Bronze Skin Stage makes the skin become tougher, common weapons leave no mark, and pain resistance will increase by 20%.]
[Iron Bone Stage tempers the bone with divine Qi and thunder to become harder than steel. Strength and durability increase by 50%.]
[Golden Blood Stage: The blood is rich with life force and regeneration essence. The bleeding ceases rapidly, and wounds close within moments. Poison resistance will increase by 50%]
[Diamond Flesh Stage: Flesh, muscles, and internal organs achieve near-immortality. Physical resistance rivals that of ancient divine beasts.]
[Immortal Core Marrow Stage: Transforms the marrow into immortal jade marrow, producing boundless qi. Qi recovery and stamina regeneration become near-instant.]

[Vajra Soul Fusion Stage: The soul fuses with the indestructible body, forming a unified divine being. The body deflects or absorbs soul attacks. The user can remain conscious even if decapitated or dismembered.]
[Indestructible Immortal Body Stage: The user achieves true immortality of body; he or she can regenerate even from ashes, as long as a sliver of soul remains.]

'Hmm?' Zhang Xiaolong [3] raised an eyebrow after reading everything. 'Why do I feel that the technique's effects are too exaggerated? If Tian Kongquan really had mastered this technique, he shouldn't have died, right?'

[Master, Tian Kongquan probably hadn't reached the peak of this technique, so he died once his lifespan ran out. By the way, you don't need to think about the dead because you don't have much time, and you won't be able to get the Sky Flame if you can't enter this realm.]
'Yeah, you're right.' Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately closed his eyes and focused on studying the technique.
Meanwhile, several people were sitting together, and their gazes were focused on the Qi screen in front of them, which showed Zhang Xiaolong [3], who was studying his chosen technique.

Jia Yuyan massaged her forehead as she looked at the several people present at the scene, especially Leng Hua. 'I already warned him to restrain himself back, but he didn't listen to me, and he deliberately showed off his abilities from the start.'
"Since when was there a kid as talented as him out there?" In a low voice, Leng Hua questioned the others, but his eyes brimmed with killing intent, undoubtedly aimed at Zhang Xiaolong [3].

Unlike her father, Leng Xueyan stared at the screen with a strange feeling, and she could immediately recognize Zhang Xiaolong [3]. She did not recognize him because of their fight in the Phoenix Realm, but she could recognize him because he had repeatedly used his dream manipulation ability, which had now evolved into his dream lordship ability, to meet her in her dreams for almost two years. 'How did this guy appear in this realm? All this time I thought I was just dreaming about him, but he turned out to be a real person, and he is in front of me now.'

Qing Huang immediately asked Leng Hua back. "Have you forgotten about that female phoenix who suddenly appeared in our realm years ago? We have locked ourselves in our realm for too long, and we have almost no information about other realms. Moreover, much time has passed, so I think it is natural that there are some outstanding talents like them out there."
"Tch." Leng Hua gritted his teeth and looked at his daughter. "What happened to you? Do you know this brat?"
"No." Leng Xueyan denied it while maintaining a flat expression. "You know that I have never liked men, and I have almost never left our realm, so how could I know him?"
Leng Hua only nodded to Leng Xueyan, but he did not believe her so easily, and he was sure that she was hiding something from him. "What do you think about this brat, Jingxuan?"

"This kid possesses exceptional talent; however, he is still quite impulsive and lacks the ability to exercise restraint." Jia Yuyan and a few others nodded in agreement with Tian Jingxuan. "His body cultivation level should still be around level six, but his raw strength has already surpassed that stage; otherwise, he wouldn't be able to lift the 5000-pound hammer like a normal hammer. Moreover, he is also an expert soul cultivator, and his master, Hun Di, is the best in that field."
"Do you think he will pass all the tests?"

Tian Jingxuan shook his head in response to Jia Yuyan. "I'm not sure about that, especially since he overestimated himself by choosing that immortal-grade technique. If he had another grade of technique, he might have passed the third test easily. Even if he passes the test this time, the battle still awaits him, and he will face so many cultivators who are much stronger than him in that test."
"Father, can I test this kid's fighting skills?" A young man with a simple appearance asked Tian Jingxuan. "We are both body cultivators, so I want to know which of us is stronger in raw strength."

Tian Jingxuan immediately nodded to his son. "If he passes the third test, you can try to face him, Jiantang. However, I don't want you to participate in the first stage; instead, you can fight him in the last stage."
"I understand, Father." Tian Jiantang replied with a nod.
