"In his era, Tian Kongquan was the best cultivator, and no one could match his physical strength because of this technique.
Unfortunately, his cultivation was stuck in the Divine Ascension Realm, and he died due to the exhaustion of his lifespan.
If only he could break through to a higher stage, he would still be alive now, and he would be unrivaled."
'Even if he could do it, he would never be the strongest in this universe; even Huo Ling could defeat him in a matter of seconds.' Zhang Xiaolong [3] then asked her.
"Can I read all of these technique books first before I choose the right one for me?"

"Yes." Shangguan Yan was not worried about it because she believed that Zhang Xiaolong [3] would not be able to understand all of them just by briefly reading them, and he would not be able to remember anything if he failed his test.
"However, your time has started since you stepped into this library, so you cannot read them for too long, and you must quickly decide which technique you want to learn."
"I understand, Senior." Once Shangguan Yan returned to her place, Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately moved to read the other nine books, and Mei quickly recorded them all in the system.
After Mei recorded them all, Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately searched for a place to study the Indestructible Vajra Immortal Body.
In the training space, Zhang Fei [1], Feltia [2], and Zhang Fei [4] immediately stopped their training.
Instead, they activated the comprehension feature to study the body cultivation technique.
'This technique has seven stages, huh?' Zhang Xiaolong [3] muttered to himself as he read the explanation of each stage.
[Bronze Skin Stage makes the skin become tougher, common weapons leave no mark, and pain resistance will increase by 20%.]
[Iron Bone Stage tempers the bone with divine Qi and thunder to become harder than steel.
Strength and durability increase by 50%.]
[Golden Blood Stage: The blood is rich with life force and regeneration essence.
The bleeding ceases rapidly, and wounds close within moments.
Poison resistance will increase by 50%]
[Diamond Flesh Stage: Flesh, muscles, and internal organs achieve near-immortality.
Physical resistance rivals that of ancient divine beasts.]
[Immortal Core Marrow Stage: Transforms the marrow into immortal jade marrow, producing boundless qi.
Qi recovery and stamina regeneration become near-instant.]
[Vajra Soul Fusion Stage: The soul fuses with the indestructible body, forming a unified divine being.
The body deflects or absorbs soul attacks.
The user can remain conscious even if decapitated or dismembered.]
[Indestructible Immortal Body Stage: The user achieves true immortality of body; he or she can regenerate even from ashes, as long as a sliver of soul remains.]
'Hmm?' Zhang Xiaolong [3] raised an eyebrow after reading everything. 'Why do I feel that the technique's effects are too exaggerated?
If Tian Kongquan really had mastered this technique, he shouldn't have died, right?'
[Master, Tian Kongquan probably hadn't reached the peak of this technique, so he died once his lifespan ran out.
By the way, you don't need to think about the dead because you don't have much time, and you won't be able to get the Sky Flame if you can't enter this realm.]
'Yeah, you're right.' Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately closed his eyes and focused on studying the technique.
Meanwhile, several people were sitting together, and their gazes were focused on the Qi screen in front of them, which showed Zhang Xiaolong [3], who was studying his chosen technique.

Jia Yuyan massaged her forehead as she looked at the several people present at the scene, especially Leng Hua. 'I already warned him to restrain himself back, but he didn't listen to me, and he deliberately showed off his abilities from the start.'
"Since when was there a kid as talented as him out there?" In a low voice, Leng Hua questioned the others, but his eyes brimmed with killing intent, undoubtedly aimed at Zhang Xiaolong [3].
Unlike her father, Leng Xueyan stared at the screen with a strange feeling, and she could immediately recognize Zhang Xiaolong [3].

She did not recognize him because of their fight in the Phoenix Realm, but she could recognize him because he had repeatedly used his dream manipulation ability, which had now evolved into his dream lordship ability, to meet her in her dreams for almost two years. 'How did this guy appear in this realm?
All this time I thought I was just dreaming about him, but he turned out to be a real person, and he is in front of me now.'
Qing Huang immediately asked Leng Hua back.
"Have you forgotten about that female phoenix who suddenly appeared in our realm years ago?
We have locked ourselves in our realm for too long, and we have almost no information about other realms.
Moreover, much time has passed, so I think it is natural that there are some outstanding talents like them out there."
"Tch." Leng Hua gritted his teeth and looked at his daughter.
"What happened to you?
Do you know this brat?"
"No." Leng Xueyan denied it while maintaining a flat expression.
"You know that I have never liked men, and I have almost never left our realm, so how could I know him?"
Leng Hua only nodded to Leng Xueyan, but he did not believe her so easily, and he was sure that she was hiding something from him.
"What do you think about this brat, Jingxuan?"
"This kid possesses exceptional talent; however, he is still quite impulsive and lacks the ability to exercise restraint." Jia Yuyan and a few others nodded in agreement with Tian Jingxuan.
"His body cultivation level should still be around level six, but his raw strength has already surpassed that stage; otherwise, he wouldn't be able to lift the 5000-pound hammer like a normal hammer.
Moreover, he is also an expert soul cultivator, and his master, Hun Di, is the best in that field."
"Do you think he will pass all the tests?"
Tian Jingxuan shook his head in response to Jia Yuyan.
"I'm not sure about that, especially since he overestimated himself by choosing that immortal-grade technique.
If he had another grade of technique, he might have passed the third test easily.
Even if he passes the test this time, the battle still awaits him, and he will face so many cultivators who are much stronger than him in that test."
"Father, can I test this kid's fighting skills?" A young man with a simple appearance asked Tian Jingxuan.
"We are both body cultivators, so I want to know which of us is stronger in raw strength."
Tian Jingxuan immediately nodded to his son.
"If he passes the third test, you can try to face him, Jiantang.
However, I don't want you to participate in the first stage; instead, you can fight him in the last stage."
"I understand, Father." Tian Jiantang replied with a nod.

chapters.title: Chapter 955: The Golden Vajra
paragraphs: In the Star Tower, Zhang Fei and the others had already completed several other challenges on the second floor, and they only had one last challenge left.

On the first floor, several groups containing all of Zhang Fei's women and his closest people also had no difficulty completing some of the challenges, especially since there were too many strong cultivators in their groups. Even if female beasts like Huli Zhishen and the others did not help them, those challenges still did not pose any significant difficulty to Liu Qingyu and the others, especially since they had trained so hard in the past few years.

All groups that included cultivators from the Nine Stars Realm and the Xianjin Realm completed those challenges much more smoothly; some of them had already challenged the tower in the past, while others had taken on the Sun Tower.
Their speed in completing the challenges made the old man and his three disciples sigh continuously, especially since those challenges did not have any significant effect on them.
"Master, they will complete the challenge on the second floor soon." Sima Yun spoke.
"Yes." The old man rubbed his beard while watching them. "I'm really curious about how Zhang Fei managed to improve himself so much in just a few years, but I'm sure he won't be willing to tell me."

"With his current cultivation, Zhang Fei should only be able to challenge this tower up to the fifth floor, right, master?" The old man nodded to Helian Xun'er. "However, his strength has far surpassed his level, so it's useless to put restrictions on him. Instead, let him test his limits on all the floors, and we can see how strong he is then."
"Hey! Are you crazy, Xun'er?" Hua Mei'er asked in a high voice. "If the higher-ups knew that our master did that, they would immediately withdraw him from this tower, and they would also punish him."
"You're just a coward."
"You—"

"I agree with Xun'er." Hua Mei'er frowned at Sima Yun. "I hate to admit it, but talents like Zhang Fei are extremely rare, and he will waste his talent if he stays in the three mortal realms for an extended period. After all, the higher-ups sent all the towers to this realm to find talents like him, and he is the best of all these people. However, we should first discuss this matter with our sect master; I believe he will agree to it and will defend our master if others become angry with him. Unfortunately, he will not necessarily join our sect, and he might accept offers from sects that are better than ours."

"You're right." Helian Xun'er agreed with Sima Yun. "There are only two possibilities that will happen if the higher-ups find out about Zhang Fei. Some of them will definitely scramble to recruit him, and others will probably kill him."
"Mei'er, I want you to contact your big sister." Hua Mei'er and the others turned to the old man in surprise. "Tell her to see Sect Master Luo about Zhang Fei."
"Huh?" Hua Mei'er was shocked by that. "Why is that, Master? Why do you want to tell Sect Master Luo about Zhang Fei?"
"Just do what I say."

Hua Mei'er turned to Sima Yun and Helian Xun'er, but both of them shook their heads at her because they also didn't know the old man's reasons. She sighed softly and took out a device; she immediately contacted her sister and conveyed his orders to her. "My sister will meet Sect Master Luo now, Master."
"That's good." The old man gave a light nod.
"Does Sect Master Luo know Zhang Fei, Master? How is that even possible?" Helian Xun'er questioned him.
The old man sighed softly. "When Zhang Fei challenged the soul challenge back then, he asked me about a woman named Luo Yunxiao."
"Huh?" The three were shocked by that.

"Do you remember when I asked you about Sect Master Luo's children, Mei'er?" Hua Mei'er nodded to the old man. "Back then, I asked you that because of Zhang Fei's question, but I never knew that Sect Master Luo had a daughter before you told me. Initially, I believed they merely shared the same name; however, this kid appeared eager to go to our realm, leading me to consider that the two women might actually be the same person."

"Do you really think Sect Master Luo's daughter is the same woman Zhang Fei asked you about, Master?" Hua Mei'er doubtfully asked, especially since Luo Yunxiao never left her sect, let alone left their realm.
The old man did not nod or shake his head. "This matter is still just my guess. We will get the answer if Sect Master Luo comes here or sends someone to confirm it, so we can only wait for now."

"Master, if Zhang Fei really knew his daughter, I'm sure Sect Master Luo would never hand her over to another sect, and he would definitely take her to the Immortal Lotus Sanctuary." The old man came to the same realization as Sima Yun. "This way, we will lose our chance to recruit a talent as good as him, so I think it will be a loss for us."

The old man immediately spoke. "Yun'er, our sect is indeed big and powerful, but please keep in mind that there are still too many sects that are much stronger than ours. Even if we manage to recruit Zhang Fei, we won't be able to keep him from the eyes of the people, and his presence in our sect might bring us great trouble."

"I agree with you, Master." Hua Mei'er spoke while nodding. "Moreover, I don't like a pervert like Zhang Fei, and he will use his abilities on me again if I meet him. Therefore, it would be better if he joined another sect, and I will never meet him again."

Helian Xun'er and Sima Yun could only shake their heads at Hua Mei'er's words, but the old man actually laughed at that. "If you had not behaved in that manner, Zhang Fei would not have acted toward you in such a way, would he?"
"Humph." Hua Mei'er snorted softly.

"Unlike our sect, the Immortal Lotus Sanctuary is one of the major sects in our realm, and not many cultivators dare to attack them directly. If Zhang Fei really knows Luo Yunxiao, then the sect is the best place for him, and he can cultivate in peace there." The old man paused for a while before continuing. "If he continues to develop at this rate, we might hear his name from all corners of our realm in the future, and he might even stand above those old cultivators."

"Impossible!" Sima Yun immediately refuted. "Master, I admit that Zhang Fei's talent is indeed extraordinary, but you forget that there are many ancient cultivators who live in hiding. They reached the pinnacle long ago, so I don't believe he will be able to stand above them."

"Yun'er, nothing is impossible in cultivation, but not all cultivators have the talent and opportunity to reach the peak. Those ancient cultivators may have reached the pinnacle now, but they can never improve further because they are already satisfied with their achievements. As for Zhang Fei, he is still in his twenties, and he has only cultivated for about three years. He has already reached the Transcend Divine Realm, which is unattainable even for geniuses in our realm." The old man then asked him. "Can you reach the same stage in just three years?"
Sima Yun shut his mouth tightly. 'Tch! Master, you insulted me on purpose! You know it took me a hundred years to reach the Seven Divine Realms, but you compare me to a monster like Zhang Fei.'
"Pfft! Hahaha." Helian Xun'er and Hua Mei'er laughed at his expression.
Hua Mei'er suddenly received a message and immediately listened to it. "Master, Sect Master Luo will bring Luo Yunxiao over."

Not only was the old man surprised by that, but so were Sima Yun and Helian Xun'er. "It seems that my guess was right; Zhang Fei and Luo Yunxiao do know each other. Otherwise, Sect Master Luo would not take the risk to bring his daughter, whom he had hidden for so long, out into the public."
"I'm really curious about their relationship, Master."
"We'll know the answer soon, Xun'er.
"Yes, Master."

The time passed quickly, and the day had changed again. Zhang Xiaolong [3] was still focused on studying the Indestructible Vajra Immortal Body technique, but he had not shown any progress, making Tian Jingxuan and the others believe that he had wasted his only chance to enter their realm.

Even so, all the senior cultivators of the realm were still patiently waiting for Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s results, with the exception of one person, Leng Hua. The old man hoped that he would fail and get kicked out from their realm so he could make a move to capture him.
Tian Jingxuan let out a disappointed sigh. "This kid overestimated himself, and his failure is inevitable."
"Why are you in such a hurry?" Tian Jingxuan turned to Jia Yuyan. "He still has a few hours before the time limit, so we have to wait until the time is up."

"Hahaha." Leng Hua suddenly laughed loudly as he stood up. "You are too stupid to not be able to see his failure! He was doomed to fail ever since he chose the Indestructible Vajra Immortal Body technique! No one has learned that technique since my ancestor and Tian Kongquan, so your hopes for him are futile!"
Jia Yuyan responded casually. "If you are tired of waiting, you can leave this place."
"Heh!" Leng Hua snorted and hurriedly left the room, as did several other cultivators.
Only Tian Jingxuan, Tian Jiantang, Jia Yuyan, Leng Xueyan, and a few others remained, waiting for Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s final result.
Sometime later, Tian Jiantang suddenly pointed at the Qi screen. "Look at him, Father! Isn't the golden shadow covering his body proof that he has mastered the basics of the technique?"
"Yes." Tian Jingxuan nodded to his son. "The golden shadow is the vajra, which only appears after he masters the technique's first stage."
"It seems we have found an interesting young man, Jingxuan." Tian Jingxuan nodded approvingly to Qing Huang. "However, he still has to go through several more tests, and I hope he can pass them all."
Tian Jingxuan once again nodded. "If this kid successfully passes all the tests, I will take him as my direct disciple, and I will teach him some techniques from my Tian Clan."

"Hey! Don't be selfish, Jingxuan!" Tian Jingxuan turned into another old man named Shi Yan from the Shi Clan. "My Shi Clan is also one of the founders of this realm, and I also want this kid to become my direct disciple."
"Hahaha!" Qing Huang laughed. "My Qing Clan also wants this kid!"

Jia Yuyan shook her head at them. "Rather than the three of you quarreling with each other, let's wait for this kid to complete all his tests first. After that, the three of you can offer him to become your direct disciple and let him choose between you."
"I agree with Yuyan!"
"Me too."
Tian Jingxuan also nodded in agreement. "All right, we will let him choose between our three clans, but you two better not sulk at me if he chooses my Tian Clan."
"Do you think we are little kids?" Shi Yan and Qing Huang both asked the same question simultaneously.
Jian Yuyan laughed and spoke. "See? The way you two act now is no different from little kids."
"Humph!" Both old men snorted at Jia Yuyan.
Tian Jingxuan turned to his son. "You can go to the battle test side."
"Yes, Father." Tian Jiantang immediately stood up and left the room.
Meanwhile, Leng Xueyan sat quietly and continued to watch Zhang Xiaolong [3] through the Qi screen. 'I must meet him once he completes all the tests to warn him about my father.'

Shangguan Yan stood stunned in her spot as she looked at the golden vajra that enveloped Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s body. 'This kid! How could he have mastered that technique in less than a day? For the past hundreds of years, no one has ever succeeded in learning that technique, and the younger generation of our realm has no interest in it due to the failure of their seniors.'

Shangguan Yan immediately approached Zhang Xiaolong [3], who still had his eyes closed even though he had successfully learned the technique. Gradually, the vajra covering his body became brighter, and its form became clearer.

However, the vajra slowly disappeared, and it disappeared completely before Zhang Xiaolong [3] opened his eyes. 'Phew! This technique is much more difficult than the Yin-Yang Fire Art of the same grade! If I didn't have my clones and the training space, I wouldn't have managed to master it so quickly.'
[Moreover, you still have nine other immortal techniques, Master. If you can successfully learn them, they will be useful to you when you go to the Paradise Realm.]

'You are right, but I will not learn them now, especially since I am still in this realm. Moreover, I want to adapt to the level of fifth gravity sooner, so my other clones should focus on that for now.' Zhang Xiaolong [3] then stood up and faced Shangguan Yan, who was looking at him suspiciously. "Why are you looking at me like that, Senior?"

"Do you want to join my Shangguan Clan?" Zhang Xiaolong [3] was surprised by Shangguan Yan's offer. "My Shangguan Clan is not as big as the Tian or other clans, but my clan is still one of the founders of this realm, and I can help you a lot in your cultivation."

Zhang Xiaolong [3] scratched his head and replied. "We can't do that now, right, Senior? Even though I managed to pass this third test, I still have to pass several other tests, and I won't necessarily be able to pass them all."

"Yes." Shangguan Yan nodded at him. "I don't know about your strength yet, but your comprehension in learning the Indestructible Vajra Immortal Body technique convinces me that you will be able to pass the other tests. Therefore, I offer this opportunity to you, and I hope you are willing to consider it."

"Thank you for your confidence in me, Senior." Zhang Xiaolong [3] sincerely spoke. "Senior, I am basically a dual cultivator, so I don't think you will be able to help me. However, I will definitely consider your offer, and I will try hard to pass the other tests."
Shangguan Yan nodded her head repeatedly. "You can go now, and Mu Ling will take you to the location of the battle test."
"Yes, Senior."
Shangguan Yan continued to stare at Zhang Xiaolong [3], who was floating down. 'A dual cultivator, huh? What can I do to bring him into my Shangguan Clan?'

Mu Ling was speechless as Zhang Xiaolong [3] arrived in front of him, especially since he himself knew about the Indestructible Vajra Immortal Body technique. He did not expect that he would choose that technique and successfully master the initial stage in less than a day.
Mu Ling immediately led Zhang Xiaolong [3] to the next test site. "In the battle test, you will face many cultivators for ten rounds, and their strength will increase with each round."
"Do you know where the two ancestors of the Heavenly Fox are?"

Mu Ling nodded at Zhang Xiaolong [3]. "Tian Baitian and Tian Baixing are in front of the fifth test location, and they still don't dare to take the test, even though they've been there for about half a year."

"Oh?" Zhang Xiaolong [3] himself already knew about the fifth test, which was the karmic test, where cultivators had to face a series of lightning tribulations depending on their karma. 'They seem afraid of facing their karma, huh?'

Before long, they had arrived at the battle test location, and dozens of people immediately appeared as soon as Zhang Xiaolong [3] set foot inside. 'Divine Expansion Realm cultivators, huh? They seem to be deliberately increasing the difficulty of this test in order to stop me! Back then, Senior Xia told me that my opponent's strength would only be one minor stage higher, but they sent cultivators with a cultivation level one major stage higher.'
[Are you going to show off your power here, Master?]
'Do you think I need to do that, Mei?' Zhang Xiaolong [3] asked with a smirk as he took out the moonlit whisper sword. "Let's start."

Sometime later, Tian Jiantang suddenly pointed at the Qi screen.
"Look at him, Father!
Isn't the golden shadow covering his body proof that he has mastered the basics of the technique?"
"Yes." Tian Jingxuan nodded to his son.
"The golden shadow is the vajra, which only appears after he masters the technique's first stage."
"It seems we have found an interesting young man, Jingxuan." Tian Jingxuan nodded approvingly to Qing Huang.
"However, he still has to go through several more tests, and I hope he can pass them all."
Tian Jingxuan once again nodded.
"If this kid successfully passes all the tests, I will take him as my direct disciple, and I will teach him some techniques from my Tian Clan."
"Hey!
Don't be selfish, Jingxuan!" Tian Jingxuan turned into another old man named Shi Yan from the Shi Clan.
"My Shi Clan is also one of the founders of this realm, and I also want this kid to become my direct disciple."
"Hahaha!" Qing Huang laughed.
"My Qing Clan also wants this kid!"
Jia Yuyan shook her head at them.
"Rather than the three of you quarreling with each other, let's wait for this kid to complete all his tests first.
After that, the three of you can offer him to become your direct disciple and let him choose between you."
"I agree with Yuyan!"
"Me too."
Tian Jingxuan also nodded in agreement.
"All right, we will let him choose between our three clans, but you two better not sulk at me if he chooses my Tian Clan."
"Do you think we are little kids?" Shi Yan and Qing Huang both asked the same question simultaneously.
Jian Yuyan laughed and spoke.
"See?
The way you two act now is no different from little kids."
"Humph!" Both old men snorted at Jia Yuyan.
Tian Jingxuan turned to his son.
"You can go to the battle test side."
"Yes, Father." Tian Jiantang immediately stood up and left the room.
Meanwhile, Leng Xueyan sat quietly and continued to watch Zhang Xiaolong [3] through the Qi screen. 'I must meet him once he completes all the tests to warn him about my father.'
Shangguan Yan stood stunned in her spot as she looked at the golden vajra that enveloped Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s body. 'This kid!
How could he have mastered that technique in less than a day?
For the past hundreds of years, no one has ever succeeded in learning that technique, and the younger generation of our realm has no interest in it due to the failure of their seniors.'
Shangguan Yan immediately approached Zhang Xiaolong [3], who still had his eyes closed even though he had successfully learned the technique.
Gradually, the vajra covering his body became brighter, and its form became clearer.
However, the vajra slowly disappeared, and it disappeared completely before Zhang Xiaolong [3] opened his eyes. 'Phew!
This technique is much more difficult than the Yin-Yang Fire Art of the same grade!
If I didn't have my clones and the training space, I wouldn't have managed to master it so quickly.'
[Moreover, you still have nine other immortal techniques, Master.
If you can successfully learn them, they will be useful to you when you go to the Paradise Realm.]
'You are right, but I will not learn them now, especially since I am still in this realm.

Moreover, I want to adapt to the level of fifth gravity sooner, so my other clones should focus on that for now.' Zhang Xiaolong [3] then stood up and faced Shangguan Yan, who was looking at him suspiciously.
"Why are you looking at me like that, Senior?"
"Do you want to join my Shangguan Clan?" Zhang Xiaolong [3] was surprised by Shangguan Yan's offer.
"My Shangguan Clan is not as big as the Tian or other clans, but my clan is still one of the founders of this realm, and I can help you a lot in your cultivation."
Zhang Xiaolong [3] scratched his head and replied.
"We can't do that now, right, Senior?
Even though I managed to pass this third test, I still have to pass several other tests, and I won't necessarily be able to pass them all."
"Yes." Shangguan Yan nodded at him.
"I don't know about your strength yet, but your comprehension in learning the Indestructible Vajra Immortal Body technique convinces me that you will be able to pass the other tests.
Therefore, I offer this opportunity to you, and I hope you are willing to consider it."
"Thank you for your confidence in me, Senior." Zhang Xiaolong [3] sincerely spoke.
"Senior, I am basically a dual cultivator, so I don't think you will be able to help me.
However, I will definitely consider your offer, and I will try hard to pass the other tests."
Shangguan Yan nodded her head repeatedly.
"You can go now, and Mu Ling will take you to the location of the battle test."
"Yes, Senior."
Shangguan Yan continued to stare at Zhang Xiaolong [3], who was floating down. 'A dual cultivator, huh?
What can I do to bring him into my Shangguan Clan?'
Mu Ling was speechless as Zhang Xiaolong [3] arrived in front of him, especially since he himself knew about the Indestructible Vajra Immortal Body technique.
He did not expect that he would choose that technique and successfully master the initial stage in less than a day.
Mu Ling immediately led Zhang Xiaolong [3] to the next test site.
"In the battle test, you will face many cultivators for ten rounds, and their strength will increase with each round."
"Do you know where the two ancestors of the Heavenly Fox are?"
Mu Ling nodded at Zhang Xiaolong [3].
"Tian Baitian and Tian Baixing are in front of the fifth test location, and they still don't dare to take the test, even though they've been there for about half a year."

"Oh?" Zhang Xiaolong [3] himself already knew about the fifth test, which was the karmic test, where cultivators had to face a series of lightning tribulations depending on their karma. 'They seem afraid of facing their karma, huh?'
Before long, they had arrived at the battle test location, and dozens of people immediately appeared as soon as Zhang Xiaolong [3] set foot inside. 'Divine Expansion Realm cultivators, huh?
They seem to be deliberately increasing the difficulty of this test in order to stop me!
Back then, Senior Xia told me that my opponent's strength would only be one minor stage higher, but they sent cultivators with a cultivation level one major stage higher.'
[Are you going to show off your power here, Master?]
'Do you think I need to do that, Mei?' Zhang Xiaolong [3] asked with a smirk as he took out the moonlit whisper sword.
"Let's start."

chapters.title: Chapter 956: Battle Tests
paragraphs: Leng Hua, who had just arrived at his Leng Clan, was furious after hearing the news of Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s success in learning the Indestructible Vajra Immortal Body technique. "How could that kid do it in less than a day? I have studied that technique for thousands of years, but I have never managed to master even the initial stage, and I finally gave up on learning it."
A young man suddenly appeared behind Leng Hua and knelt down directly on one knee. "Is there a task for me, Master?"
"Go to the battle test site and capture the brat who is undergoing the test." Leng Hua's order confused the young man. "Bring him to me alive, or you will die."
"Yes, Master."

Leng Hua looked into the distance with narrowed eyes. "No matter the cost, I must get that kid, and I will force him to teach me the method so I can master that technique. If I succeed in doing so, I can take over this realm from the hands of Tian Jingxuan and his Tian Clan."

Zhang Xiaolong [3] walked into the middle of the encirclement of the cultivators. He looked at them one by one before speaking to them. "I don't mean to be disrespectful to you guys, but I would rather not waste my time in this place."
"Stop talking and fighting us."
"Yeah! Fight us!

"As you wish." Four golden mirrors suddenly appeared and circled Zhang Xiaolong [3], confusing the cultivators. Without saying anything else, he immediately moved to attack one of them, but he did not use his full speed.

The person immediately moved to attack Zhang Xiaolong [3] first, and several others also moved to attack him as well. Although the fight was unequal and unfair, they had no other choice but to gang up on him, especially since their leader had assigned them to eliminate everyone who tried to enter their realm.

Zhang Xiaolong [3] smirked in response to their actions, but he had no intention of attacking them. Instead, he allowed them to attack him, especially since he wanted to try out the fifth move of the Reversal Mirror technique that he got from Shang Ziyuan.
As soon as their attacks reached Zhang Xiaolong [3], the four golden mirrors immediately glowed, and they groaned in pain after being hit by their own attacks.
"Arghh!"
"Shit!"
"Damn it!"
The cultivators immediately jumped away from Zhang Xiaolong [3], but he swiftly dashed towards one of them and gave him a kick to the stomach, slamming him into the wall. "Guah!"
Bam

The man fell to the floor and held his stomach. 'Shit! His kick seemed to have no power, but the impact was really painful! What kind of mirror technique is that? My attack was reversed on me when I almost landed my attack on him.'
Seeing that, the other cultivators did not immediately attack Zhang Xiaolong [3]; instead, they circled him to find a way to attack him while thinking about his mirror technique.
"Second Heaven: Violet Lightning Spear." Dozens of violet spears made of lightning appeared above Zhang Xiaolong [3], and he launched them toward those cultivators.
"Dodge!" One of the cultivators shouted to his comrades as he himself tried to dodge the lightning spears, but one of the spears immediately chased him and electrocuted him. "Arghh!"
The other cultivators also suffered the same fate as that person, and they were also electrocuted by those lightning spears. "Gahhh!"

All the cultivators immediately fell to the floor, and their bodies convulsed repeatedly due to the shocks from Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s lightning spears. They looked up as soon as they sensed his other technique, and dozens of other lightning spears had appeared above him.
"Stop! You win!" One of them shouted to Zhang Xiaolong [3].

"That's good." Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately canceled his technique and walked towards the next room, where dozens of other cultivators were waiting for him for the second stage of the battle test. However, he did not cancel the Reversal Mirror technique. 'Hmm? Those people are really annoying! They are not fair to me, but at least they still haven't sent any cultivators in the Divine Manifestation Realms and above!'

Those people remained silent and directly attacked Zhang Xiaolong [3], but the four golden mirrors immediately reversed their attacks based on the strength they used, causing them to experience pain from their own strikes.

Similar to their friends in the previous room, those cultivators refrained from attacking Zhang Xiaolong [3] with close-range attacks after the mirrors reflected their attacks back at them. Instead, some of them tried to attack him using long-range attacks, but the mirrors still reacted and reversed the attacks back at their owners, causing them to suffer pain once again.

'Hahaha! Shang Ziyuan is indeed a genius! Her mirror technique is truly awesome!' Zhang Xiaolong [3] then tried using another technique, and a giant golden palm appeared above the room, covering the entire area. In that instant, a powerful pressure pressed down on the cultivators from above, forcing them to kneel on the floor with pale faces.
'Shit! How can he suppress us like this with his cultivation only at the 1-Moon Divine Transcend Realm?'
Zhang Xiaolong [3] shook his head at them. "Please give up. Otherwise, I will drop this technique on you all, and you guys will suffer quite severe injuries from it."
Those people exchanged glances for a moment before nodding to Zhang Xiaolong [3]. "Go to the next room."

"Thank you." Xiaolong [3] went straight to the third room, where tens of cultivators at the Divine Manifestation Realm were already waiting for him. 'Tch! They ended up sending cultivators at this stage, but I won't bother with them.'

Once again, Zhang Xiaolong [3] relied on the Reversal Mirror technique, which caused the cultivators to hesitate in approaching him due to the reflecting effect of the four golden mirrors. He also used several techniques from the Nine Heavens Lightning Art to attack them, including the Ninth Heaven: Eternal Thunder Judgment.

In just a few minutes, Zhang Xiaolong [3] had already passed the third and fourth stages of the battle test, and he immediately rushed to the fifth room, where many cultivators at the Divine Fusion Realm were waiting for him.

Unlike his battles in the previous four rooms, Zhang Xiaolong [3] did not only rely on his two previous techniques, but he also used several other ones, such as his soul technique, the Annihilation Flame, several techniques of his own creation, and some of his demon abilities.
Even so, Zhang Xiaolong [3] still restrained himself from using his full speed, especially since he was sure that he would meet cultivators with levels far above his own soon.

Jia Yuyan inwardly sighed in relief as she watched Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s battle test from the Qi screen. 'It seems I worried too much about him, and he's been holding himself back since the first fight started. If he didn't do that, he should have entered the tenth stage by now.'
"Hey, Jingxuan! I think we shouldn't fight over this kid, and we can take him as our direct disciple." Shi Yan expressed his opinion while looking at Zhang Xiaolong [3].
Qing Huang nodded in agreement with him. "This kid is a monster, and we won't be able to handle him alone. Therefore, we have to handle him together, which will benefit our three clans."

"My Li Clan will join you guys." Qing Huang and Shi Yan turned to the old woman who had just said that. "I didn't say anything before because I wanted to see this kid's fighting ability first, and his fighting ability is truly impressive. The most intriguing thing is his mirror technique, especially since it can reflect both close-range and long-range attacks. In my entire life, I have never seen such a technique before; even reflection artifacts can't be used continuously like his technique, and they will be destroyed after reflecting two or three enemy attacks."
"You are right, Li Zixun." Another old woman suddenly spoke. "I don't know where this kid got his technique, but I'm sure it's not a low-grade one, and it's probably a divine grade or above."
"Are you sure his technique is a divine grade or above, Chi Yuexin?" Li Zixun doubtfully asked.
Chi Yuexin nodded. "His technique is at least a divine grade."

"Master, I once met someone who had that technique when I was wandering outside the realm." They immediately looked at a young woman behind Chi Yuexin. "I met a woman named Shang Ziyuan in the Void Heaven Realm when I was searching for the Alchemy Goddess a few years ago, and Senior Brother Xiao Feng tried to get close to her, which irritated her. When they fought, she used the same technique as this kid, and she fought him while reversing his attack."
"Did you also fight Shang Ziyuan, Wenren Yue?" Chi Yuexin asked her.
Wenren Yue shook her head. "I didn't want to interfere with Senior Brother Xiao's business, so I just watched their fight from afar, and he ended up being heavily injured by his own technique."
"Do you know where Shang Ziyuan comes from?" Li Zixun asked.

Wenren Yue told them straightaway. "After I helped Senior Brother Xiao, I managed to meet the Alchemy Goddess, and she told me that Shang Ziyuan came from the Shang Clan in the Red Sun Realm. According to her, she was a genius cultivator of her generation, and she created many extraordinary techniques that became her signature , one of which was the mirror technique."

Wenren Yue's answer shocked all of them, and Tian Jingxuan spoke to the others. "If Shang Ziyuan could create a divine-grade technique from scratch, that means she is indeed a genius cultivator. Even my ancestor, Tian Kongquan, was unable to create a divine-grade technique. All the techniques we have now are inherited from the past before the universe wall separated the three realms from the realm beyond, including the ten immortal-grade techniques."

"Do you think we should try to meet Shang Ziyuan?" Qing Huang asked the others. "If she is so talented, we should recruit her to join us, and we will give her an exception not to go through those tests."

"I think that's a good idea." Shi Yan spoke, nodding his head. "If we can persuade Shang Ziyuan and give her good resources, she will definitely be willing to help us create many new techniques, and she might be able to create new immortal-grade techniques that are suitable for us in the future."

Li Zixun nodded her head in agreement. "Even though we have the ten immortal-grade techniques, almost none of us have managed to learn any of them. If Shang Ziyuan helps us create immortal-grade techniques according to our wishes, we will definitely become stronger, and we will not have to fear anyone anymore."
"Haha." Chi Yuexin softly laughed. "Even if we don't have immortal-grade techniques, no one from the three realms will dare to fight us. They can't even find our realm, remember?"

"You're not wrong about that, Old Chi." Qing Huang then turned to the mountain. "Have you forgotten about the existence of the realm beyond? Have you forgotten about that female phoenix? She could even infiltrate our realm without us knowing, remember? Since she could open the portal to the realm beyond so easily, I'm afraid that people from that realm will descend upon our realm in the future, and we won't be able to deal with them if that happens."

Chi Yuexin and the others' expressions turned serious after Qing Huang mentioned that, but Li Zixun immediately spoke to them. "I'm also worried about that, but we all know that no cultivators from that realm have ever descended here since the two realms separated from each other."

"Zixun, you have forgotten Xereth." Li Zixun frowned at Jia Yuyan directly. "There's a possibility that the demon has gone to the realm beyond before, or his presence wouldn't make the people of the Xianjin Realm anxious, right?"
Li Zixun nodded in agreement after she remembered the story from Yuan Tiancheng and the others about Xereth. "Do you think that demon can find our realm and attack us?"

"All possibilities exist, so we must remain vigilant." They nodded in agreement to Jia Yuyan, who immediately continued. "I think it's okay if we go to Shang Ziyuan and try to persuade her to join us, but we can't force him to join us."
"Why is that?"

"Him." Jia Yuyan pointed to Zhang Xiaolong [3] on the Qi screen. "Since this kid can use Shang Ziyuan's technique, I'm sure they have a special relationship. If we force her, we might lose the opportunity to recruit him."

"I think you're wrong about that, Senior Jia." Jia Yuyan turned to Wenren Yue. "According to the information I've heard, Shang Ziyuan doesn't like men, and she only likes women, so I don't think she has that kind of relationship with this kid."

Jia Yuyan nodded in understanding. "Whether they have a special relationship or not, we must never force Shang Ziyuan to join us. She may be a genius at creating techniques, but this kid is a genius in many ways, so we shouldn't waste the opportunity to recruit him."

"I agree with you, Yuyan." Tian Jingxuan then spoke to Li Zixun and Chi Yexin. "If Little Yue's information is true that Shang Ziyuan is only interested in women, I and the others will not be able to meet her. Therefore, I want you two to go to the Red Sun Realm using our fastest flying artifact, and you can try to tempt her using the best resources we have."

"In that case, Zixun and I will prepare everything now, and we will go to the Red Sun Realm afterward." Chi Yuexin and Li Zixun immediately stood up from their chairs. "Yue, you should come with us, especially since you have met Shang Ziyuan before."
"Yes, Master."
"Hmm?" Tian Jingxuan and the others suddenly heard Zhang Xiaolong [3] shout inside the Qi screen, and they saw that he had already reached the ninth room.

"What the fuck? How could he be there already?" Shi Yan screamed in shock. "We've been deliberately making things difficult for him, but he still managed to pass the first eight stages of the battle test so quickly."

"This kid doesn't use any tricks at all, and he only utilizes his speed, raw strength, and a few others, including his mirror technique." Jia Yuyan suddenly raised her eyebrows after she saw a shadow not far from Zhang Xiaolong [3]. "Leng Hua sent someone to do something to him."
"Hmm?" Tian Jingxuan narrowed his eyes and contacted someone directly to stop Leng Hua's subordinate. "What does that kid mean by asking that? Does he have a powerful beast contract by his side?"
"I think so." Jia Yuyan nodded at him. "Since this kid's next opponents are cultivators at the Divine Ascendant Realm, I think we should allow him to summon his contract beast."

Tian Jingxuan immediately agreed with her. "We deliberately made things difficult for him by giving him many opponents that were much stronger than him, so I will allow him to use the help of his contract beast."

In the battle test, Zhang Xiaolong [3] smiled in satisfaction after he got the agreement, and he immediately summoned Long Jiuxiao out of the beast space, which shocked Tian Jinguxan and the others. 'Ha ha ha! They don't know that I have several powerful beasts by my side!'
Unlike him, Long Jiuxiao wore a gloomy look, especially since Zhang Xiaolong [3] treated him as his beast contract.

Long Jiuxiao frowned when he felt the presence of Leng Hua's subordinate, but Zhang Xiaolong [3] shook his head casually and walked toward the ninth room. "Forget about him and help me defeat the people inside."
Leng Hua's subordinate immediately moved to capture Zhang Xiaolong [3], but a shadow moved first and knocked him unconscious, and the shadow carried him away from that place.

'As expected! The higher-ups of this realm send his or her subordinate to stop that guy.' Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately led Long Jiuxiao into the room in front of them, and the presence of the dragon ancestor caused the cultivators inside to tremble. "Fight or give up; the choice is yours."

"If we can persuade Shang Ziyuan and give her good resources, she will definitely be willing to help us create many new techniques, and she might be able to create new immortal-grade techniques that are suitable for us in the future."
Li Zixun nodded her head in agreement.
"Even though we have the ten immortal-grade techniques, almost none of us have managed to learn any of them.
If Shang Ziyuan helps us create immortal-grade techniques according to our wishes, we will definitely become stronger, and we will not have to fear anyone anymore."
"Haha." Chi Yuexin softly laughed.
"Even if we don't have immortal-grade techniques, no one from the three realms will dare to fight us.
They can't even find our realm, remember?"
"You're not wrong about that, Old Chi." Qing Huang then turned to the mountain.
"Have you forgotten about the existence of the realm beyond?
Have you forgotten about that female phoenix?
She could even infiltrate our realm without us knowing, remember?

Since she could open the portal to the realm beyond so easily, I'm afraid that people from that realm will descend upon our realm in the future, and we won't be able to deal with them if that happens."
Chi Yuexin and the others' expressions turned serious after Qing Huang mentioned that, but Li Zixun immediately spoke to them.
"I'm also worried about that, but we all know that no cultivators from that realm have ever descended here since the two realms separated from each other."
"Zixun, you have forgotten Xereth." Li Zixun frowned at Jia Yuyan directly.
"There's a possibility that the demon has gone to the realm beyond before, or his presence wouldn't make the people of the Xianjin Realm anxious, right?"
Li Zixun nodded in agreement after she remembered the story from Yuan Tiancheng and the others about Xereth.
"Do you think that demon can find our realm and attack us?"
"All possibilities exist, so we must remain vigilant." They nodded in agreement to Jia Yuyan, who immediately continued.
"I think it's okay if we go to Shang Ziyuan and try to persuade her to join us, but we can't force him to join us."
"Why is that?"
"Him." Jia Yuyan pointed to Zhang Xiaolong [3] on the Qi screen.
"Since this kid can use Shang Ziyuan's technique, I'm sure they have a special relationship.
If we force her, we might lose the opportunity to recruit him."
"I think you're wrong about that, Senior Jia." Jia Yuyan turned to Wenren Yue.
"According to the information I've heard, Shang Ziyuan doesn't like men, and she only likes women, so I don't think she has that kind of relationship with this kid."
Jia Yuyan nodded in understanding.
"Whether they have a special relationship or not, we must never force Shang Ziyuan to join us.
She may be a genius at creating techniques, but this kid is a genius in many ways, so we shouldn't waste the opportunity to recruit him."
"I agree with you, Yuyan." Tian Jingxuan then spoke to Li Zixun and Chi Yexin.
"If Little Yue's information is true that Shang Ziyuan is only interested in women, I and the others will not be able to meet her.
Therefore, I want you two to go to the Red Sun Realm using our fastest flying artifact, and you can try to tempt her using the best resources we have."
"In that case, Zixun and I will prepare everything now, and we will go to the Red Sun Realm afterward." Chi Yuexin and Li Zixun immediately stood up from their chairs.
"Yue, you should come with us, especially since you have met Shang Ziyuan before."
"Yes, Master."
"Hmm?" Tian Jingxuan and the others suddenly heard Zhang Xiaolong [3] shout inside the Qi screen, and they saw that he had already reached the ninth room.
"What the fuck?
How could he be there already?" Shi Yan screamed in shock.
"We've been deliberately making things difficult for him, but he still managed to pass the first eight stages of the battle test so quickly."

"This kid doesn't use any tricks at all, and he only utilizes his speed, raw strength, and a few others, including his mirror technique." Jia Yuyan suddenly raised her eyebrows after she saw a shadow not far from Zhang Xiaolong [3].
"Leng Hua sent someone to do something to him."
"Hmm?" Tian Jingxuan narrowed his eyes and contacted someone directly to stop Leng Hua's subordinate.
"What does that kid mean by asking that?
Does he have a powerful beast contract by his side?"
"I think so." Jia Yuyan nodded at him.
"Since this kid's next opponents are cultivators at the Divine Ascendant Realm, I think we should allow him to summon his contract beast."
Tian Jingxuan immediately agreed with her.
"We deliberately made things difficult for him by giving him many opponents that were much stronger than him, so I will allow him to use the help of his contract beast."

In the battle test, Zhang Xiaolong [3] smiled in satisfaction after he got the agreement, and he immediately summoned Long Jiuxiao out of the beast space, which shocked Tian Jinguxan and the others. 'Ha ha ha!
They don't know that I have several powerful beasts by my side!'
Unlike him, Long Jiuxiao wore a gloomy look, especially since Zhang Xiaolong [3] treated him as his beast contract.
Long Jiuxiao frowned when he felt the presence of Leng Hua's subordinate, but Zhang Xiaolong [3] shook his head casually and walked toward the ninth room.
"Forget about him and help me defeat the people inside."
Leng Hua's subordinate immediately moved to capture Zhang Xiaolong [3], but a shadow moved first and knocked him unconscious, and the shadow carried him away from that place.
'As expected!

The higher-ups of this realm send his or her subordinate to stop that guy.' Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately led Long Jiuxiao into the room in front of them, and the presence of the dragon ancestor caused the cultivators inside to tremble.
"Fight or give up; the choice is yours."

chapters.title: Chapter 957: Strength And Speed
paragraphs: 'This guy is truly shameless! How can we possibly fight a dragon with strength equal to our leader?' Those cultivators grumbled in their hearts, but they suddenly heard Tian Jingxuan's voice in their minds, and they immediately rushed out of the room.

Zhang Xiaolong [3] smiled amusedly as he patted Long Jiuxiao's shoulder. "I should have summoned you earlier so I wouldn't have had to fight them. especially since they were scared of you and fled immediately."
'This bastard! I am the mighty sky dragon, but he treats me like his pet.' Zhang Xiaolong [3] rushed to the last room, forcing Long Jiuxiao to follow him.

When they arrived at the last room, Zhang Xiaolong [3] only saw two men standing in the middle of the room, and their cultivation was at the 1-Moon Divine Ascension Realm. Although the two of them saw Long Jiuxian, they did not run away like the cultivators in the next room.

"Junior brother, you can send your contract beast back, and we will fight one on one without using cultivation." Tian Jiantang calmly spoke. "Oh, I apologize for not introducing myself earlier; my name is Tian Jiantiang from the Tian Clan."

Long Jiuxiao was furious that Tian Jiantang had referred to him as a contract beast, but Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately sent him back into the beast space. "The Tian Clan, huh? So you are a direct descendant of Tian Kongquan, eh?"
"Oh?" Tian Jiantang was surprised by that. "How did you know the name of my ancestor? In fact, he was the main founder of this realm, but he died long ago."
"I know it." Zhang Xiaolong [3] replied with a nod. "I heard about your ancestor from someone very close to him, but that person is no longer around."
"Please tell me the identity of that person."

"Qing Peng." Tian Jiantang and the other man were shocked to hear that name from Zhang Xiaolong [3], especially since they knew that he was Tian Kongquan's beast contract. "It's up to you whether you want to believe me or not, but I met him once about a year and a half ago. So, who is your friend?"

"My name is Qing Yun from the Qing Clan, and I would like to test your skills in a spar. I won't fight you now, especially since Brother Jiantang is eager to spar with you." Qing Yun then went to the side of the room and leaned against the wall.
"Hmm?" Zhang Xiaolong [3] looked at the two of them alternately. "Why are you two so eager to spar with me?"
Tian Jiantang answered him first. "We are both body cultivators, and I want to test the difference in our body strength."
Zhang Xiaolong [3] looked at Qing Yun, who immediately answered. "I am a speed cultivator, and I am interested in competing in speed with you."
"I see." Zhang Xiaolong [3] nodded in understanding before speaking to Tian Jiantiang. "I am also curious about your body strength, so let's start sparring to prove who is the strongest among us."
"Let's do it." Tian Jiantang dashed forward and launched his fist at him, but Zhang Xiaolong [3] did not dodge it and punched his fist directly, knocking him back.
Tian Jiantang was genuinely shocked by the clash of their fists, realizing that Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s punch was so powerful it pushed him back, leaving his hand feeling numb.

Qing Yun, who was leaning on the side, was also shocked after Zhang Xiaolong [3] knocked Tian Jiantang back. Moreover, he didn't move an inch from his spot, and he still looked so relaxed after being hit by his best friend's attack. 'This kid! How strong is his fist strength? I've experienced the effects of Jiantang's blow in the past, and it left me bedridden for a week, but this kid doesn't seem to feel anything from their clash.'

'His body is truly strong! All these years, only my father could knock me back this far; not even Uncle Qing and the others could do it.' Just as Tian Jiantang was thinking that, Zhang Xiaolong [3] suddenly moved in front of him, which shocked him and Qing Yun once again.
Zhang Xiaolong [3] didn't give Tian Jiantang a chance to dodge, and he immediately threw a fist towards his face, forcing him to protect it by crossing his arms in front of him.
"Gah!" Tian Jiantang screamed as he staggered several steps back, but Zhang Xiaolong [3] quickly launched another punch at him, which he immediately countered with his full-power punch.

Tian Jiantang attempted to block Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s punch, but it sent him staggering backwards once more, nearly causing him to fall to the ground. He stomped his right leg back to support his body, but his hand was getting more and more numb from the collision of their fists just now.

'There's no way I'm going to lose to him in a physical contest.' Unfortunately, Tian Jiantang didn't know Zhang Xiaolong [3], and he didn't know that he had already mastered his three body cultivation techniques to the peak level.
Tian Jiantang was also unaware that Zhang Xiaolong [3] possessed both beast and demon forms, which allowed him to surpass the physical strength of any human cultivator, including him and his father.
Zhang Xiaolong [3] jumped back and spoke to him. "I don't mean to belittle you, but you are not my match in a contest of physical strength, so I think we should stop our sparring."
"Yeah." Tian Jiantang felt no shame in admitting Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s superiority. "How did you train your body to be this strong? Even if you spar with my father, I'm sure you'll emerge victorious."

"I tempered my body using lightning tribulation and some other methods." Tian Jiantang looked shocked when he heard the lightning tribulation from Zhang Xiaolong [3]. "Whether you believe it or not, the heavens have repeatedly attempted to kill me, and I've faced my lightning tribulation hundreds or even thousands of times."
Tian Jiantang stared at Zhang Xiaolong [3] for some time before sighing heavily. "How many living creatures have you killed?"
"Guess it yourself." Zhang Xiaolong [3] replied with a faint smile.
Tian Jiantang immediately realized that Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s body count was already too numerous if the heavens wanted to kill him because of his bad karma.
Zhang Xiaolong [3] then said to Qing Yun. "Let's do it."
"Let's use our highest speed." Qing Yun said this before moving in front of Zhang Xiaolong [3]. "I will chase you for two hours, and I will admit defeat if I cannot catch you by then."
"Sure." Qing Yun was shocked when Zhang Xiaolong [3] disappeared from his sight, but he immediately chased after him at full speed without using any techniques.

Tian Jiantang immediately moved to the side of the room so as not to disturb the two, and he tried to follow the movements of Zhang Xiaolong [3] and Qing Yun. Unfortunately, their speed was much faster than his, and his eyes were completely unable to follow their movements, leaving him to sigh helplessly. 'Qing Yun's speed is second to none in this realm, and only Uncle Qing can surpass him, but that kid's speed seems to be as fast as his.'

Qing Yun, who was trying to catch up to Zhang Xiaolong [3], was also shocked by his speed. He felt that he was always a step behind him, and he always failed to catch him, even though the distance between them was only a few inches away. 'This is unbelievable!' How could a cultivator at his level surpass my speed? I've long been accustomed to ten times heavier gravity, but this kid repeatedly accelerates his speed every time I almost catch him.'

Qing Yun was unaware that Zhang Xiaolong, who was accustomed to sixteen times heavier gravity, could easily handle ten times heavier gravity. Moreover, three of the other five clones were training with thirty-two times heavier gravity, which also had an effect on him, especially since they were basically one.

Qing Yun immediately used his technique to increase his speed, and he kept trying to catch Zhang Xiaolong [3] as soon as possible. Despite this, he still couldn't do it, but instead, he was shocked when he touched his shoulder before disappearing again.
To increase his speed even faster, Qing Yun took off his cloth before removing some of the iron weights that weighed his body down, and he also used his wind element for that.

Unlike Qing Yun, Zhang Xiaolong [3] had not used his movement or boost techniques to increase his speed. Instead, he used his body modification ability to reduce his body weight, which made his body extremely light and allowed him to move much faster without using anything.

'Shit! What really happened? Why can I never get close to this kid? I've let go of the iron weights that burdened my body before, and I've also used my boost technique and wind element, but I feel that this kid is so far out of my reach.' Qing Yun kept running behind Zhang Xiaolong [3] with one hand stretched forward, but he repeatedly failed to grab him. 'Damn it! He hasn't even used any techniques, but his speed has already surpassed my top speed! Even my father's speed is still not as fast as his.'
[Master, you are toying with this guy!]

'Haha!' Zhang Xiaolong [3] turned to Qing Yun, who was working hard to catch him. 'This guy is too proud of his speed, and he is disappointed if I don't fight him half-heartedly, so I will play along with his game until he is satisfied.'
Crack... Crack...

Qing Huang squeezed the armrest of his chair until it broke, and the muscles on his face bulged out as he watched his grandson compete with Zhang Xiaolong [3]. His blood boiled, and he was keen to join them to catch him, but he held himself back. "Unbelievable!"
"What happened between them, Old Qing?" Shi Yan asked, as he could not follow the movements of the two people.

Qing Huang inhaled and exhaled a few times before answering him. "That kid's speed has far surpassed Yun'er's, even though he didn't use any techniques! My grandson already used his techniques and wind element, but he was always lagging behind him! In fact, I'm not sure if I can catch that kid, especially since his speed is ridiculously fast!"

"This kid is really a monster, huh?" Shi Yan muttered with a serious face. "Jiantang is the best body cultivator in his generation, but that kid can force him to surrender in just a few clashes. Little Yun is also the fastest in his generation, but he can't match his speed."
Qing Huang nodded her head strongly. "No matter what the price, we must convince this kid to join our realm, and we must make him feel as comfortable as possible in staying here."
"You're right." Shi Yan nodded in agreement.

In contrast, Jia Yuyan rested her chin on her hand while intently watching Zhang Xiaolong [3], genuinely curious about his speed training methods. 'No wonder his physique is strong since he is also a beast and a demon, but his speed is almost like teleportation, and he keeps toying with Qing Yun.'

Leng Xueyan also observed Zhang Xiaolong [3] with a serious expression, but her gaze also looked gentle at the same time. 'Who exactly are you? How can you continue appearing in my dreams? I'm sure we've never met before, but I've been dreaming about you for almost two years now, and you even did that kind of thing to me repeatedly in my dreams. I always thought that you were just my unreal fantasy, but you existed before my eyes, making me eager to hug you tightly in my arms.'
"Do we need to stop his tests?" Tian Jingxuan suddenly asked them.

Jia Yuyan immediately rejected him. "Regardless of the final result, we will accept him into our realm, but we don't need to stop his tests, and I want to see his ability to face the last three tests, especially the Dao test."
"I agree with Yuyan, Jingxuan."
"Me too."
"Count me in." Tian Jingxuan and the others turned to Leng Xueyan, who had been silent ever since. "Why are you all looking at me like that?"
"Nothing."

"This kid's talent far surpasses my useless disciples, who have fled to the Moon Tower! I sent them to retrieve the Earth Flame, but they returned empty-handed, and they fled without taking responsibility for their failure." Tian Jingxuan and the others chose not to respond to Leng Xueyan, which irritated her. "When they return to this realm, I will give them the most severe punishment!"
"Whatever."

After they played cat and mouse for two hours, Qing Yun finally gave up and admitted defeat to Zhang Xiaolong [3], especially since his Qi was getting thinner because he was forcing himself to use his top speed. "How did you train your speed to be this fast?"
Bam

Zhang Xiaolong [3] threw the 5000-pound hammer onto the floor, which shocked Qing Yun. Tian Jiantang immediately moved to their side and raised the hammer. "The weight of this hammer is 5000 pounds, so your iron weight is still too light compared to this."
"5000 pounds?"
"Yes." Zhang Xiaolong [3] nodded at him. "Unlike you, who are a pure speed cultivator, I am a body cultivator, and I am used to carrying this hammer whenever I train, which affects my speed."

Qing Yun nodded in understanding. "I thought my iron weights were already very heavy, and people thought I was crazy to train with them. However, you are crazier than me, especially since you carry such a heavy hammer when you train."

"Haha." Zhang Xiaolong [3] laughed at that. "The fastest way to train our physical strength and speed is to lift as heavy a weight as possible. Actually, I intend to forge a hammer that is much heavier than this, but I don't have the materials right now."
"Eh?" Qing Yun and Tian Jiantang looked at him in surprise. "Are you also a blacksmith?"

"Isn't that obvious?" Zhang Xiaolong [3] asked back with a smile. "The main reason I became a body cultivator is my dream of becoming a blacksmith, especially since the price of high-grade equipment is costly. Unlike the two of you, I do not have a large clan to support my development, so I must work hard to meet all my needs."

Tian Jiantang then spoke to him. "If you want to forge a hammer heavier than this one, I have some materials you can use to forge it. However, you must first complete the remaining tests, and I will give them to you after you succeed."

"All right, I will go to the next room, and I will meet you after I finish the tests." Zhang Xiaolong [3] then spoke to Qing Yun. "If you like, you can use my hammer to practice, especially since I no longer need it."

"Thank you." Qing Yun released a soft sigh as he looked at Zhang Xiaolong [3], who had already moved to the exit. "That kid is really awesome, Jiantang. His cultivation level is far below us, but he managed to beat us both in areas that we have always been proud of."
Tian Jiantang helped Qing Yun up. "If his cultivation reaches our level in the future, I think it will be our turn to catch up to him."

"That's right." Qing Yun replied with a nod. "Our sparring with him just now has opened my eyes, and I want to change myself to be as good as him. Therefore, I need your help to learn the body cultivation path, or else I will fall even further behind him in terms of speed."

"You can go to my Tian Clan if you really are keen to learn to be a body cultivator, but you also have to teach me about speed cultivation." Qing Yun nodded to Tian Jiantang, and the two left the place directly.
Mu Ling had already escorted Zhang Xiaolong [3] to the fifth test location, only to meet two furious gazes.
"Hehe." Zhang Xiaolong [3] chuckled at their reactions. "I've wanted to meet you two for a long time, but I didn't expect to meet you guys here, Tian Baitian and Tian Baixing."
To Be Continued -
