Leng Xueyan also observed Zhang Xiaolong [3] with a serious expression, but her gaze also looked gentle at the same time. 'Who exactly are you?
How can you continue appearing in my dreams?
I'm sure we've never met before, but I've been dreaming about you for almost two years now, and you even did that kind of thing to me repeatedly in my dreams.
I always thought that you were just my unreal fantasy, but you existed before my eyes, making me eager to hug you tightly in my arms.'
"Do we need to stop his tests?" Tian Jingxuan suddenly asked them.
Jia Yuyan immediately rejected him.
"Regardless of the final result, we will accept him into our realm, but we don't need to stop his tests, and I want to see his ability to face the last three tests, especially the Dao test."
"I agree with Yuyan, Jingxuan."
"Me too."
"Count me in." Tian Jingxuan and the others turned to Leng Xueyan, who had been silent ever since.
"Why are you all looking at me like that?"
"Nothing."
"This kid's talent far surpasses my useless disciples, who have fled to the Moon Tower!

I sent them to retrieve the Earth Flame, but they returned empty-handed, and they fled without taking responsibility for their failure." Tian Jingxuan and the others chose not to respond to Leng Xueyan, which irritated her.
"When they return to this realm, I will give them the most severe punishment!"
"Whatever."

After they played cat and mouse for two hours, Qing Yun finally gave up and admitted defeat to Zhang Xiaolong [3], especially since his Qi was getting thinner because he was forcing himself to use his top speed.
"How did you train your speed to be this fast?"
Bam
Zhang Xiaolong [3] threw the 5000-pound hammer onto the floor, which shocked Qing Yun.
Tian Jiantang immediately moved to their side and raised the hammer.
"The weight of this hammer is 5000 pounds, so your iron weight is still too light compared to this."
"5000 pounds?"
"Yes." Zhang Xiaolong [3] nodded at him.
"Unlike you, who are a pure speed cultivator, I am a body cultivator, and I am used to carrying this hammer whenever I train, which affects my speed."
Qing Yun nodded in understanding.
"I thought my iron weights were already very heavy, and people thought I was crazy to train with them.
However, you are crazier than me, especially since you carry such a heavy hammer when you train."
"Haha." Zhang Xiaolong [3] laughed at that.
"The fastest way to train our physical strength and speed is to lift as heavy a weight as possible.
Actually, I intend to forge a hammer that is much heavier than this, but I don't have the materials right now."
"Eh?" Qing Yun and Tian Jiantang looked at him in surprise.
"Are you also a blacksmith?"
"Isn't that obvious?" Zhang Xiaolong [3] asked back with a smile.
"The main reason I became a body cultivator is my dream of becoming a blacksmith, especially since the price of high-grade equipment is costly.
Unlike the two of you, I do not have a large clan to support my development, so I must work hard to meet all my needs."
Tian Jiantang then spoke to him.
"If you want to forge a hammer heavier than this one, I have some materials you can use to forge it.
However, you must first complete the remaining tests, and I will give them to you after you succeed."
"All right, I will go to the next room, and I will meet you after I finish the tests." Zhang Xiaolong [3] then spoke to Qing Yun.
"If you like, you can use my hammer to practice, especially since I no longer need it."
"Thank you." Qing Yun released a soft sigh as he looked at Zhang Xiaolong [3], who had already moved to the exit.
"That kid is really awesome, Jiantang.
His cultivation level is far below us, but he managed to beat us both in areas that we have always been proud of."
Tian Jiantang helped Qing Yun up.
"If his cultivation reaches our level in the future, I think it will be our turn to catch up to him."
"That's right." Qing Yun replied with a nod.
"Our sparring with him just now has opened my eyes, and I want to change myself to be as good as him.
Therefore, I need your help to learn the body cultivation path, or else I will fall even further behind him in terms of speed."

"You can go to my Tian Clan if you really are keen to learn to be a body cultivator, but you also have to teach me about speed cultivation." Qing Yun nodded to Tian Jiantang, and the two left the place directly.
Mu Ling had already escorted Zhang Xiaolong [3] to the fifth test location, only to meet two furious gazes.
"Hehe." Zhang Xiaolong [3] chuckled at their reactions.
"I've wanted to meet you two for a long time, but I didn't expect to meet you guys here, Tian Baitian and Tian Baixing."
To Be Continued -

chapters.title: Chapter 958: Karmic Test
paragraphs: "You—" Tian Batian fell to the ground as soon as Mu Tian activated the restrictions on the testing ground. "Ugh—"

"This testing ground is our sacred place, and I will not allow you all to make a scene here. If you want to fight with him, you can follow him inside, and our rules will not stop you from fighting." Mu Ling then asked Zhang Xiaolong [3]. "Do you experience any problems with them?"

"They sent their younger generation to kill me several times, but they underestimated me too much. Some of them fell into my hands and became my servants." Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately walked into the fifth testing ground. "If you two feel great, you guys can follow me inside, and we will fight inside there."
"Wait a minute, I haven't—."
"No need." Zhang Xiaolong [3] interrupted Mu Lin. "Whatever test I will face next, I will definitely do well."

"That kid is overconfident with himself! The next test is his karma, and he will face many lightning tribulations if his bad karma is too heavy." Mu Ling let out a soft sigh as he removed the restrictions from Tian Baitian. "You two have been here for so long, so it's time for you to continue your test. Otherwise, my leader will kick you two out of our realm, and you will never be able to enter it for the rest of your lives."

After Mu Lin left, Tian Baixing immediately helped Tian Baitian up. "Brother, this is our chance to get rid of that brat, and we will use him to evolve into the ten tails. Thereafter, no one will be able to defeat us anymore, and we will destroy anyone who dares to stand in our way, including Xereth."
"Yeah." Tian Baitian gave a light nod. "Let's go inside; we will wait for that brat to weaken from his test, and we will ambush him afterward."
"Let's go."

As Tian Baitian and Tian Baixing entered the room, they found it extremely dark inside, with countless flashes of lightning above them. They saw Zhang Xiaolong [3] floating in the air with Lei Que and Long Jishan.
"Heh!" Tian Baitian snorted at that. "Does he think he can face such powerful lightning tribulations just like that?"

"Rather than thinking about him, we should think about our lightning tribulations first." Tian Baixing then pointed to the sky. "See? Our lightning tribulations are starting to appear, and yours is no less powerful than that brat's."
"Let's go there." Tian Baitian immediately flew up high and sat cross-legged under his lightning tribulation.
Tian Baixing followed her brother, but she was much more relaxed because her lightning tribulation was not as powerful as Tian Baitian's or Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s lightning tribulation.
"This kid's lightning tribulation is so terrifying; I have never met such a powerful one in my entire life." Shi Yan spoke as he shivered, imagining himself in Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s position.

Qing Hun nodded in agreement. "The two heavenly foxes are much older than this kid, and they are also famous, but their lightning tribulation pales in comparison to him. If I think about it, only Leng Hua has experienced a lightning tribulation as powerful as his in the past."

"You are right, Old Qing." They turned to Shangguan Yan, who had just arrived. "Leng Hua is the most evil among us, and he has done many evil things in the past, so his lightning tribulations are very powerful. If he did not have his lightning defensive artifact, he would have died long ago."

Leng Xueyan frowned upon hearing Shangguan Yan talk about her father like that, but she said nothing and focused on watching Zhang Xiaolong [3] through the Qi screen. Her hands clasped together in worry. 'You must pass your lightning tribulation, okay?'
Tian Jingxuan was not interested in talking about Leng Hua, and he asked his son, who had just arrived with Qing Yun. "What do you think of this kid, Jiantang and Little Yun?"
"Impressive, outstanding, and talented."
"He is the fastest cultivator I have ever met, and I will probably need a few hundred years to reach his current speed."
Tian Jingxuan nodded in agreement with the two. "Do you two want to learn from him about the body cultivation and speed cultivation paths?"
"Yes, Father."
"Yes, Uncle Tian."

"Haha." Qing Huang laughed, walked to the middle of the two young men, and patted their shoulders. "You two are the best young generation in our realm, especially since you are not ashamed to admit your defeat and weakness. As we taught you, there are still skies above other skies. The world of cultivation is also the same, and there are many hidden dragons in it, including this kid. As long as you two are never ashamed to admit your weaknesses, I believe you will continue to develop and become even better, and the future of our realm is in your hands."
"I understand, Uncle Qing."
"I understand, Grandpa."

"That's good." Qing Huang nodded in satisfaction. "In fact, we have already decided to accept this kid into our realm regardless of his test results, and you two can learn a lot from him about both paths of cultivation."
Tian Jiantang and Qing Yun were surprised to hear that, but they were also pleased in their hearts, especially since they could still spar with Zhang Xiaolong [3] again to improve themselves.

"Old Qing is right; we have already decided to accept this kid in our realm." Tian Jingxuan confirmed. "However, I am curious about the enmity between him and the two heavenly foxes, especially since they seem so eager to attack him, especially Tian Baitian."

"That kid is a heavenly fox." Tian Jingxuan and the others immediately turned to Jia Yuyan in shock. "That kid is really a heavenly fox, but he is not part of their race, and he was born in the lower realms."
"How do you know so much about this kid, Yuyan?" Shangguan Yan curiously asked.

Jia Yuyan shook her head at him. "Sorry, I can't tell you the truth because of my promise to my master, but I have told you the truth that this kid is a heavenly fox. In fact, he is also a demon, but he—"
"Are you fucking kidding me?" Shi Yan asked in a high pitch. "How can this kid be a human, a beast, and a demon?"

Tian Jingxuan and the others were also shocked by Jia Yuyan's revelation, especially since they couldn't detect Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s beast and demon aura. "Please tell us everything you know about this kid, Yuyan."

"Do you guys remember the legend of the ten-tailed fox?" They nodded to Jia Yuyan. "Before he died, he split himself into two, who were Tian Baitian and Tian Baixing. However, he did not pass on all his power to them; instead, he divided it into several and hid it in various realms across the universe."
"Why is that? Aren't Tian Baitian and Tian Baixing his direct descendants?"

"I don't know for sure why the ten-tailed fox did that, but I suspect that he thought he was not strong enough to pacify this universe. He wanted his successor to surpass him and become the strongest in this universe; only then could that successor bring peace back to it." Tian Jingxuan and the others exchanged glances after Jia Yuyan said that, especially since they themselves had always hoped for a safe and peaceful life, but they knew that it would never come true. "In fact, the ten-tailed fox left behind a writing about his successor, but no humans or demons know about it, and only the natural and beast races know about it."
"What is the content of the writing left by the ten-tailed fox?"

Jia Yuyan waved her hand, and a Qi screen appeared in front of them, but there was only a stone monument with a statue of a ten-tailed fox on it. They could see that there was writing in front of the stone monument, but they could not read it. "The writing was written by the ten-tailed fox himself: One day in the future, the ten-tailed fox will return to this universe once again. However, he is more than a heavenly fox because he is also a human and a demon, and he is destined to become the peacemaker. When he evolves into a ten-tailed fox, he will gain immense power to bring peace between humans, demons, beasts, and natural races."
"So, Zhang Xiaolong [3] is the ten-tailed fox's successor?"

"Yes." Jia Yuyan nodded at them. "Honestly, I have heard about this kid from the other natural races scattered across the various realms, and I have always been waiting for his arrival. In fact, he has a relationship with the female phoenix, and her true name is Feng Yao, the princess of the Phoenix Race. The two phoenixes with her are Feng Tian and Feng Jiu, the emperor and the empress of their race."
"Why did you hide everything from us, Yuyan?" Tian Jingxuan asked seriously. "Back then, I asked if you recognized them, but you said you didn't."

"Him." They looked at Zhang Xiaolong [3], who had already begun undergoing his lightning tribulation, but it was like a child's toy to him, and it had no significant impact on him, which shocked them. "At first, I thought he was still weak because the information I got said his cultivation was still at the Earth Realm, but I didn't expect that he would successfully reach the Divine Transcend Realm in a little over three years, and he forced the dragon ancestor to become his contact beast."
"What? Are you trying to fool us? How could he possibly reach the Divine Transcend Realm in a little over three years?"

Jian Yuyan shook her head. "I didn't mean to fool you guys, okay? The first time I heard of him was a little over three years ago, and his cultivation had only reached the Body Realm at that time. Since then, I have been following his progress, and he reached the Earth Realm about two years and eight months ago. A little over two years ago, he went to the Evergreen Spirit Haven Realm, and his cultivation had already reached the Heaven Realm."
"Absurd! His cultivation speed is simply absurd!" Tian Jingxuan and the others nodded in agreement with Qing Hong.

"His cultivation had only reached the Heaven Realm at that time, but he managed to defeat Da Xiongmao and the others, even though their cultivation had already reached the Divine Ascension Realm." Everyone's jaws dropped after Jia Yuyan said that. "I myself was shocked after I heard the news, but I thought his current strength was still lacking, so I haven't told you anything about him. I heard that he disappeared shortly after, and he has only appeared a few times since then. I was initially confused as to how he could have disappeared, but he suddenly appeared in our realm with his cultivation already reaching the 1-Moon Divine Transcend Realm, which made me think that he had entered seclusion for the past two years."

"I think the same as you." Shangguan Yan spoke, nodding her head. "By the way, this kid told me that he is basically a dual cultivator, and a dual cultivator can indeed cultivate faster than normal cultivators like us. However, I think his cultivation speed is still absurd, and he might use something to speed up his cultivation."

"You're not wrong about that, Yan." Jia Yuyan then took out some pills and showed them to Shangguan Yan and the others, causing their eyes to widen, especially after they recognized the pills' grade. "As you can guess, that kid is an excellent alchemist, and he concocted these pills."
Shangguan Yan and the others immediately took the pills from Jia Yuyan's hands. "Where did you get them?"

Jia Yuyan immediately explained it to them. "He opened alchemy shops in several realms, and one of them is located in the Evergreen Spirit Raven Realm. I got them from the natural races in that realm, and their effects far surpass all the pills in our realm. However, their prices are quite exorbitant; a set of his basic pills costs ten million blue jewels."
"Fuck! Ten million jewels for five pills is no different from extortion!" Shi Yan shouted loudly.
"Hehehe." Jia Yuyan giggled. "Old Shi, you haven't swallowed his pills yet, and you'll change your mind after swallowing them."
"Are their effects worth their price?" Shi Yan asked doubtfully.
Jia Yuyan immediately took out several bottles containing Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s basic pills. "I've bought them for all of you, but you have to pay me their price."
"Tch!" Shi Yan threw a bag containing ten million blue jewels, and he took one of the bottles before swallowing the pills in one go.

Tian Jingxuan and the others were not in a hurry to swallow those pills, and they chose to wait for Shi Yan to experience their effects first so they could be more confident in deciding to swallow them.

After they waited for some time, Shi Yan had already opened his eyes and released his full strength, surprising all of them. "Incredible! My Qi absorption rate has increased quite a bit; my dantian and bones have also become stronger. My meridians have become much smoother and cleaner, as well as my soul! Ten million blue jewels are definitely cheap compared to their effects!"

After hearing that, Tian Jingxuan and the others immediately paid Jia Yuyan the price of the pills, and they hurriedly swallowed them, making the female elf smile in amusement because of their actions.
Jia Yuyan then asked Leng Xueyan. "Don't you want to swallow these pills?"

"Naturally, I want to swallow them." Leng Xueyan paid Jia Yuyan and took a bottle of pills. "However, I am an alchemist, and I am more curious about how he can concoct such pills. The effects of his pills are much stronger than mine, and I can't recognize the ingredients he used to concoct them."

"Oh, that's right! I forgot that you're an alchemist." Jia Yuyan said with a nod. "I heard that he once challenged one of the towers, and he probably got their recipes from the tower. I hope you don't tell your father about him; otherwise, he will become more eager to take action against him, and as a result, he will be the one who loses if that happens."
"I know." Leng Xueyan immediately closed her eyes and swallowed the pills.

Jia Yuyan observed Leng Xueyan for a while before turning her gaze to Zhang Xiaolong [3] through the Qi screen. 'Did something happen to her? Earlier, I noticed that she kept staring at this kid, and her gaze toward him was different from how she usually looks at others. She wasn't cold as usual, and her gaze was so gentle when looking at him, she even seemed worried that he would fail his tests.'

Not only did Jia Yuyan notice the changes in Leng Xueyan, but Shi Yan also felt a striking change from her. However, he said nothing and sat on the chair silently, watching the lightning bolts strike Zhang Xiaolong [3] nonstop. "Hey, Yuyan! This kid seems to have a lightning element in his body; he has also learned the lightning element law and lightning body cultivation technique."
"Isn't that obvious?" Jia Yuyan asked him back. "During his battle tests, this kid repeatedly used lightning techniques, and he wouldn't be able to use them without lightning elements, right?"
"Yeah, you're right."

Jia Yuyan then continued. "His lightning element has clearly reached the peak stage, as well as his lightning elemental law and lightning body cultivation technique. His lightning tribulation became so powerful due to his bad karma, but he seems to have gotten used to it, so we don't need to worry about him."

"The hardest of all the tests is the seventh test, which is the Dao Test." Jia Yuyan nodded in agreement to Shi Yan. "Since he came from outside our realm, he might have difficulty comprehending the Dao."
Despite this, Jia Yuyan seemed confident about Zhang Xiaolong [3]. "Don't worry, this kid will make it through everything."
"I hope so."
Sometime later, Tian Jingxuan and the others had finished absorbing the pills, and their expressions were of joy after they felt the changes in their bodies.
"Hey, look! The two foxes seem to want to do something to that kid." Qing Huang suddenly spoke, pointing his finger at the Qi screen.
Jian Yuyan immediately spoke. "We don't need to interfere in their problems. I believe he can handle them, and we just need to watch from here."

"Where did you get them?"
Jia Yuyan immediately explained it to them.
"He opened alchemy shops in several realms, and one of them is located in the Evergreen Spirit Raven Realm.
I got them from the natural races in that realm, and their effects far surpass all the pills in our realm.
However, their prices are quite exorbitant; a set of his basic pills costs ten million blue jewels."
"Fuck!
Ten million jewels for five pills is no different from extortion!" Shi Yan shouted loudly.
"Hehehe." Jia Yuyan giggled.
"Old Shi, you haven't swallowed his pills yet, and you'll change your mind after swallowing them."
"Are their effects worth their price?" Shi Yan asked doubtfully.
Jia Yuyan immediately took out several bottles containing Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s basic pills.
"I've bought them for all of you, but you have to pay me their price."
"Tch!" Shi Yan threw a bag containing ten million blue jewels, and he took one of the bottles before swallowing the pills in one go.

Tian Jingxuan and the others were not in a hurry to swallow those pills, and they chose to wait for Shi Yan to experience their effects first so they could be more confident in deciding to swallow them.
After they waited for some time, Shi Yan had already opened his eyes and released his full strength, surprising all of them.
"Incredible!
My Qi absorption rate has increased quite a bit; my dantian and bones have also become stronger.
My meridians have become much smoother and cleaner, as well as my soul!
Ten million blue jewels are definitely cheap compared to their effects!"

After hearing that, Tian Jingxuan and the others immediately paid Jia Yuyan the price of the pills, and they hurriedly swallowed them, making the female elf smile in amusement because of their actions.
Jia Yuyan then asked Leng Xueyan.
"Don't you want to swallow these pills?"
"Naturally, I want to swallow them." Leng Xueyan paid Jia Yuyan and took a bottle of pills.
"However, I am an alchemist, and I am more curious about how he can concoct such pills.
The effects of his pills are much stronger than mine, and I can't recognize the ingredients he used to concoct them."
"Oh, that's right!
I forgot that you're an alchemist." Jia Yuyan said with a nod.
"I heard that he once challenged one of the towers, and he probably got their recipes from the tower.
I hope you don't tell your father about him; otherwise, he will become more eager to take action against him, and as a result, he will be the one who loses if that happens."
"I know." Leng Xueyan immediately closed her eyes and swallowed the pills.
Jia Yuyan observed Leng Xueyan for a while before turning her gaze to Zhang Xiaolong [3] through the Qi screen. 'Did something happen to her?
Earlier, I noticed that she kept staring at this kid, and her gaze toward him was different from how she usually looks at others.
She wasn't cold as usual, and her gaze was so gentle when looking at him, she even seemed worried that he would fail his tests.'
Not only did Jia Yuyan notice the changes in Leng Xueyan, but Shi Yan also felt a striking change from her.
However, he said nothing and sat on the chair silently, watching the lightning bolts strike Zhang Xiaolong [3] nonstop.
"Hey, Yuyan!
This kid seems to have a lightning element in his body; he has also learned the lightning element law and lightning body cultivation technique."
"Isn't that obvious?" Jia Yuyan asked him back.
"During his battle tests, this kid repeatedly used lightning techniques, and he wouldn't be able to use them without lightning elements, right?"
"Yeah, you're right."
Jia Yuyan then continued.
"His lightning element has clearly reached the peak stage, as well as his lightning elemental law and lightning body cultivation technique.
His lightning tribulation became so powerful due to his bad karma, but he seems to have gotten used to it, so we don't need to worry about him."
"The hardest of all the tests is the seventh test, which is the Dao Test." Jia Yuyan nodded in agreement to Shi Yan.
"Since he came from outside our realm, he might have difficulty comprehending the Dao."
Despite this, Jia Yuyan seemed confident about Zhang Xiaolong [3].
"Don't worry, this kid will make it through everything."
"I hope so."
Sometime later, Tian Jingxuan and the others had finished absorbing the pills, and their expressions were of joy after they felt the changes in their bodies.
"Hey, look!
The two foxes seem to want to do something to that kid." Qing Huang suddenly spoke, pointing his finger at the Qi screen.
Jian Yuyan immediately spoke.
"We don't need to interfere in their problems.
I believe he can handle them, and we just need to watch from here."

chapters.title: Chapter 959: Fighting Two Foxes
paragraphs: Focused on facing his lightning tribulations, Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately opened his eyes upon sensing the movement of the two heavenly foxes. However, a domain quickly enveloped him, and it knocked Lei Que and Long Jishan away from him.
"A domain, huh?" Zhang Xiaolong [3] muttered as he looked back at Tian Baitian. "You two have lost your patience and want to kill me now, eh?"
*Zap... Zap... Zap...*

Several lightning bolts suddenly descended and struck the three of them directly, but Zhang Xiaolong [3] remained relaxed after being hit by their attacks, unlike Tian Baitian, who appeared to be in pain.
On the other hand, Tian Baixing had no trouble dealing with those lightning bolts, especially since her lightning tribulation wasn't as powerful as Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s and Tian Baitian's.

"Haha." Zhang Xiaolong [3] laughed at Tian Baitian's expression. "Instead of thinking about me, you should focus on your lightning tribulation. Otherwise, you will be seriously injured by those lightning bolts, and you won't be able to defeat me."
"Heh!" Tian Baitian sneered in response, but his injuries immediately recovered on their own, surprising Zhang Xiaolong [3]. "I'm not as weak and pathetic as a heretic fox like you."

"Who's weak and pathetic? You talk about yourself, right?" Zhang Xiaolong [3] responded with a shrug. "I didn't even experience the slightest pain, even though my lightning tribulation was much stronger than yours, so I didn't need to bother using my healing abilities like you."
"Bastard!" Tian Baitian furiously shouted.
"Wait a minute, brother." Tian Baixing immediately stopped his brother. "You've already trapped him, so don't fall for his taunts. We'll kill him together."
Tian Baitian nodded in agreement. "Let's kill him!"

"Hahaha." Zhang Xiaolong [3] laughed at them as he activated the soul link, and he then opened both his palms before using his two ultimate techniques. The hellflame frost lotus instantly appeared in his right palm, and the annihilation flame in his left palm.
Tian Baitian and Tian Baixing were shocked when they felt the power of Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s aura, making them immediately realize that his strength was already on par with or even surpassing theirs.
"Do you think this domain can lock me up?" Zhang Xiaolong [3] threw the hellflame frost lotus toward Tian Baitian and Tian Baixing, and he threw the annihilation flame toward the domain.
"Dodge, Brother!" Tian Baixing shouted as she flew away to the left, and Tian Baitian immediately followed his sister by flying away to the right.
However, Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s hellflame frost lotus changed course and chased after Tian Baitian, who tried to counter it with a sonic attack. "Divine Howl!"

Unfortunately, Tian Baitian's sonic attack could not stop the hellflame frost lotus, and his attack froze as soon as it collided with it. He immediately fled, especially since the lightning bolts from his lightning tribulation descended once again. 'Shit! What kind of technique is that? How could it freeze my sonic attack?'

On the other hand, Tian Baixing tried to stop Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s annihilation from destroying his brother's domain by using various techniques, but his techniques did not slow down and continued to advance upwards.
Tian Baixing quickly transformed into her complete fox form and opened her mouth wide. "Heaven-Forged Foxflame!"

A fox-shaped white flame that came out of Tian Baixing's mouth shot toward the annihilation flame, but Zhang Xiaolong [3] was not worried about it. He smirked slightly and teleported above the female fox, but her nine tails, which had turned sharp like spearheads, suddenly attacked him with lightning speed.

Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately teleported again to avoid Tian Baixing's attack, but he was quite surprised by the speed of her attack. 'If I didn't have my teleportation and speed, I wouldn't have had time to avoid her tails, and they would have definitely penetrated my body.'

Tian Baixing was also shocked that Zhang Xiaolong [3] was able to avoid her attack, and she was even more shocked when her white flame disappeared after coming into contact with his annihilation flame. 'What the hell? How can his flame overcome my flame?'

Zhang Xiaolong [3] looked up as the lightning bolts from his lightning tribulation descended, but he immediately dealt with them and absorbed them. At the same time, his annihilation flame struck Tian Baixing's domain.
*Boom*
A loud explosion rang out as Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s annihilation flame hit Tian Baitian's domain, causing it to crack in many areas before shattering into pieces.

"Cough... Cough..." Tian Baitian coughed out blood as his domain shattered, but he didn't have an opportunity to think about it because the hellflame frost lotus was still chasing him, and all his techniques couldn't eliminate it. "Baixing! Help me to stop this weird lotus!"

Tian Baixing flew towards her brother, but several wind arrows suddenly shot towards her at high speed, forcing her to dodge them. Zhang Xiaolong [3] instantly appeared behind her with the moonlit whisper sword in his hand, and he immediately thrust it towards her. However, his attack was thwarted by her tails, which transformed into shields and reflected his attack.
Zhang Xiaolong [3] rolled back several times before stabilizing himself, and he looked at Tian Baixing in shock. 'She has an ability to reflect enemy attacks, huh?'

Mei immediately reminded Zhang Xiaolong [3]. [Master, don't forget that Tian Baitian and Tian Baixing are halves of the ten-tailed fox, and they must have inherited all of his abilities. Unfortunately, we don't have much information about him or his abilities, and the system cannot detect their status, so you should not underestimate them and be careful in your fight with them.]

Zhang Xiaolong [3] responded with a slight nod, but he immediately frowned as soon as Tian Baixing destroyed his hellflame frost lotus using her white fox flame. 'Her white flame is really strange; it can't destroy my annihilation flame, but it can destroy my hellflame frost lotus.'
"Are you okay, Brother?" Tian Baixing asked Tian Baitian as she kept monitoring Zhang Xiaolong [3].
Tian Baitian wiped the blood from his mouth. "That bastard's flame is not an ordinary flame, but I sense some other flames inside it."
"Other flames?"
"Yes." Tian Baitian immediately told his sister. "He has at least seven flames, some of which are phoenix, vermilion, dragon, and golden crow flames."

"What?" Tian Baitian exclaimed in shock as she stared at Zhang Xiaolong [3], and the smile on his face proved Tian Baitian's words. "Doesn't that mean he has phoenix, vermilion, dragon, and golden crow bloodlines?"

"Yes." Tian Baitian nodded at her. "I don't know where he got those bloodlines from, but your white flame will never win against his combined flames due to his golden crow flame. I am also unable to use my severing domain any longer, as I risk injury if he manages to break it again."
Tian Baixing's expression turned serious as she thought of another way to defeat Zhang Xiaolong [3]. "Let me try using my domain."
"Do it." Tian Baitian immediately agreed.
Zhang Xiaolong [3] raised an eyebrow slightly as Tian Baixing used her domain, and a transparent pink dome enveloped the entire area. "Hahaha! Bewitchment domain, huh?"
Tian Baixing frowned after hearing Zhang Xiaolong [3] speak, which meant that her domain had no effect on him. 'How is this possible? Why isn't he affected by my bewitchment?'

Zhang Xiaolong [3] suddenly got a voice transmission from Jia Yuyan, who told him that the other higher-ups already knew his identity as a demon. He sighed in his heart because he would rather not show his demon identity to the people in the realm, but the female elf told them about it.

"You two are too old, and you've gone senile now." Zhang Xiaolong [3] instantly transformed into his transcendent lust demon form, causing both foxes to frown. "Do you think your bewitchment will be useful against a lust demon like me?"
'Shit!' Tian Baitian and Tian Baixing inwardly cursed.

Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately used his lust manipulation, causing pink gas to emit from his body and quickly spread to fill the entire area. However, the results were not as he expected, especially since Tian Baixing and Tian Baitian's bodies were enveloped by a white aura, blocking his pink gas. 'Fuck! Our abilities counter each other! If it's like this, I have no other choice but to fight them at close range, but I have to be careful with that female fox's reflection ability.'

Tian Baitian and Tian Baixing also realized this, making them think twice about attacking Zhang Xiaolong [3] from a distance. However, they also did not dare to rashly approach him, mainly due to his powerful lightning tribulation that was still ongoing.
Since her domain was useless, Tian Baixing immediately canceled it, as did Zhang Xiaolong [3], who canceled his lust manipulation.

The three of them were hesitant to attack one another, instead focusing on finding ways to outsmart each other. However, Zhang Xiaolong [3] suddenly opened his mouth wide, unleashing the demon king's roar, followed by the demon corruption.
*Roar*
Tian Baitian and Tian Baixing were unfazed by Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s demon roar, and the darkness that emerged from his demon corruption also could not reach them.

They immediately retaliated against Zhang Xiaolong [3], with Tian Baixing shooting several of her white flames at him and Tian Baitian using a strange technique. A white fox head appeared in front of the male fox, and it immediately devoured the darkness before disappearing again.

Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately countered Tian Baixing's attack using his flames, causing her flames to disappear instantly. He was curious about the technique used by Tian Baitian, especially since no cultivator had ever managed to overcome his demon corruption.
"Fox Mirage Veil." Tian Baixing muttered softly.
Tian Baixing also muttered a technique. "Fox Battle Avatar."
Zhang Xiaolong [3] trembled slightly when the effects of Tian Baixing's technique hit him, but his negate illusion immediately moved and dispelled her illusion, shocking the female fox once again.

Zhang Xiaolong [3] frowned when he saw a divine projection of a nine-tailed fox appear above Tian Baitian, and he could feel that it was powerful. 'Tch! This guy is also a soul cultivator, and his soul level is far above Master Hun's!'

[Master, Tian Baitian and Tian Baixing have lived for too long, and they should be the oldest living beings still existing in the three mortal realms; thus, it is natural that the power of their souls is extremely powerful. Unfortunately, they are trapped in the three mortal realms and do not know the way to the Paradise Realm, or else they would have reached the peak of the Five Celestial Realms long ago.]

'Yeah.' Zhang Xiaolong [3] took a deep breath before extending his hand upwards, welcoming and absorbing the lightning bolts. Thereafter, he used the reversal mirror technique to guard against the two foxes' sudden attack. 'Do you have any ideas on how to defeat them, Mei?'

[Unfortunately, I can't think of anything, Master. All your demon abilities are useless against them, and their abilities also make it difficult for you to approach them. Since Tian Baitian is a soul cultivator, your soul technique will also be ineffective against them. In my opinion, the only way for you to defeat them is to ask for help from Ma Kuangyu or Nalan Yushu, but the cultivators in this realm will know of their existence.]

Zhang Xiaolong [3] was still wary of the cultivators of that realm, so he would rather not use all his trump cards, and he wanted to save them for emergency situations. He then tried to use the abyssal lightning tribulation, but it was too weak against Tian Baitian and Tian Baixing, and they could destroy it easily. 'Shit! I thought I could beat them, but they were able to counter all my abilities. Moreover, the female fox could reflect my other techniques, and I would be injured by my own attacks if she reflected them.'
Far ahead of Zhang Xiaolong [3], Tian Baitian and Tian Baixing were also continuously discussing how to defeat him as soon as possible, but his golden crow flame frightened them.

'What should we do now, Brother?' Tian Baixing asked. 'The majority of my abilities are related to charm and illusion, but they are useless against him. If I attack him up close, his golden crow flame will injure me, and it will be difficult for me to recover.'

'Let me try it.' Tian Baitian immediately used a soul attack through the nine-tailed fox's avatar to attack Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s soul, but Ma Kuangyu and Nalan Yushu right away blocked it. 'Shit! This bastard is a soul cultivator like me, and he has strong soul protection. What if we use the two techniques? If we use them, our strength will surpass the limitations of the three mortal realms, and we will be able to defeat him.'

'Have you forgotten the consequences when we used them last time?' Tian Baitian shook his head at Tian Baixing. 'The Bloodline Awakening can temporarily massively boost our strength, speed, charm, and soul attacks. However, we can only use it for ten minutes, and this brat's speed appears to be much faster than ours. If we use the Fox God's Wrath, our berserk state will make us lose control of our minds, and it will also significantly weaken us once the effect wears off. If we fail to kill him before the effect wears off, we will be the ones to die by his hands.'
Tian Baitian released a heavy sigh. 'Let's try fighting him at close range, but you have to keep reflecting his attacks, and you only need to avoid his golden crow flame.'

'All right, let's do it.' Tian Baixing immediately agreed with Tian Baitian, but Zhang Xiaolong [3] suddenly summoned Long Jiuxiao, which shocked them. 'What the hell? Isn't he the ancestor of the dragon clan? How could he be with this kid?'
Zhang Xiaolong [3] didn't stop there, and he summoned Huli Jinhu, Wang Yitao, and Dai Yishu, which further shocked Tian Baitian and Tian Baixing. "You guys must help me to fight them."
Although the four beast ancestors did not want to help Zhang Xiaolong [3], they could do nothing to refute his order with his slave mark in their souls.
"Heavenly Fox's ancestors, huh?" Dai Yishu muttered to himself as he looked at Tian Baitian and Tian Baixing.
Wang Yitao immediately spoke. "Old Jinhu, you can handle them yourself, right?"
"No." Huli Jinhu shook his head. "They are much stronger than me, and that female fox has some unique abilities on her tails, one of which can reflect our attacks back at us.
"So, we can't use our techniques to fight her, right?" Wang Yitao asked.
Huli Jinhu shook his head before explaining. "She can also reflect physical attacks, so it's very difficult to fight her, especially with her high speed."
"Does Tian Baitian also have the ability to reflect enemy attacks?" Long Jiuxiao asked.

"Only Tian Baixing can do it." The two heavenly foxes frowned as they listened to Huli Jinhu and the others' conversation. "Old Long, you are the sky dragon; I think you are the only one who can deal with her. Meanwhile, Old Wang, Old Dai, and I will deal with Tian Baitian."

"Hey! I can't possibly deal with her alone if she can reflect my attacks, and one of you must help me deal with her." Long Jiuxiao immediately looked at Wang Yitao. "You should join me and use your defense to protect me, Old Wang."
"All right." Wang Yitao immediately agreed with that. "Let's do it then."
Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately warned Long Jiuxiao and Wang Yitao. "That female fox has charm and illusion abilities, so you two must be wary of her attacks."
"Let's go!" The four beasts moved to attack Tian Baixing and Tian Baitian, but the two immediately teleported away from them.
However, Zhang Xiaolong [3] suddenly teleported above the male fox with the annihilation flame in his hand, and he slammed it against Tian Baitian's back. "Argh!"

"Brother!" Tian Baixing whipped her nine tails toward Zhang Xiaolong [3], but he nimbly avoided them. She then supported Tian Baitian and teleported him several times before using her bewitchment domain to prevent the four ancestors from approaching them.

Far ahead of Zhang Xiaolong [3], Tian Baitian and Tian Baixing were also continuously discussing how to defeat him as soon as possible, but his golden crow flame frightened them.
'What should we do now, Brother?' Tian Baixing asked. 'The majority of my abilities are related to charm and illusion, but they are useless against him.

'Let me try it.' Tian Baitian immediately used a soul attack through the nine-tailed fox's avatar to attack Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s soul, but Ma Kuangyu and Nalan Yushu right away blocked it. 'Shit!

Zhang Xiaolong [3] didn't stop there, and he summoned Huli Jinhu, Wang Yitao, and Dai Yishu, which further shocked Tian Baitian and Tian Baixing.

Although the four beast ancestors did not want to help Zhang Xiaolong [3], they could do nothing to refute his order with his slave mark in their souls.

"Old Jinhu, you can handle them yourself, right?"

"They are much stronger than me, and that female fox has some unique abilities on her tails, one of which can reflect our attacks back at us.
"So, we can't use our techniques to fight her, right?" Wang Yitao asked.

"She can also reflect physical attacks, so it's very difficult to fight her, especially with her high speed."

"All right." Wang Yitao immediately agreed with that.
"Let's do it then."

"Over there, Master." Lei pointed at the black clouds above them. "The formation is an ancient formation, and you won't be able to stop it, let alone destroy it."

Nalan Yushu immediately spoke into Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s mind. 'Master, you will never win against them with your current abilities, so please let me help you. I will control that female fox for you, and you can beat up the male fox to your heart's content.'

Zhang Xiaolong [3] nodded in understanding. "Force her to release her soul, Yushu."

Tian Baitian immediately moved to stop Zhang Xiaolong [3], but Huli Jinshu and the three beast ancestors quickly moved to attack him, forcing him to retreat while counterattacking the four of them. "Bastard! I'll kill you all!"

"You bastard!" Tian Baitian thrust his right claw toward Zhang Xiaolong [3], who immediately countered it with a powerful fist, causing both of them to be knocked backwards. 'Shit! His body is really strong!'
Zhang Xiaolong [3] waved his hand slightly. "Ever since I became a body cultivator and reached my level, you were the first beast who could knock me back, and you weren't even injured by my attack."
"I will kill you today!" Tian Baitian furiously shouted and shot flaming tail fragments upwards, which immediately shot down like meteors toward Zhang Xiaolong [3]. "Flaming Starfall!"
Zhang Xiaolong [3] just smiled at Tian Baitian's attacks, and he effortlessly dodged them before charging towards the male fox. "Long-range attacks are useless against me."
"Nine-Tail Dance!" Tian Baitian's nine tails immediately turned sharp and attacked Zhang Xiaolong [3] like dancing, forcing him to take out the moonlit whisper sword to fend them off.

Even though his nine tails were hit by Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s sword repeatedly, Tian Baitian did not appear to be in the slightest pain. Instead, his nine tails moved faster in attacking him, and a divine projection of a nine-tailed fox appeared above him after he used the Fox Battle Avatar once again.
Unlike before, Tian Baitian's divine avatar did not use a soul attack to attack Zhang Xiaolong [3], but the avatar's nine tails quickly extended into a formation and enclosed him within them.
"Stellar Flame Formation!" After Tian Baitian shouted that, white flames quickly burned Zhang Xiaolong [3], who was inside the cage of his avatar's nine tails. "Die, you heretic fox!"

"Hahaha!" Zhang Xiaolong [3] laughed loudly at that, and his body was quickly enveloped by several different flames. "You senile old fox! You already know I have the golden crow flame, but you still think your white flame can kill me."
Zhang Xiaolong [3] shot his flames toward the divine projection of the nine-tailed fox and destroyed it, causing Tian Baitian to vomit blood from his mouth.
However, Tian Baitian's injury recovered by itself, and he flew away from Zhang Xiaolong [3], who stood in his spot with a relaxed smile. 'Shit! His golden crow flame is indeed terrifying.'
"Hmm?" Zhang Xiaolong [3] raised an eyebrow as Tian Baitian's nine tails merged into one, and its size became extremely large. 'Doesn't he have other abilities besides using his nine tails?'
Tian Baitian suddenly extended his two fox claws, powered by his qi. He then slashed his claws and thrust his tail toward Zhang Xiaolong [3]. "Sky-Piercing Fox Claws! Tail Lance!"

Zhang Xiaolong [3] let out a soft sigh and dodged all of Tian Baitian's attacks, but he did not forget to strike back at the male fox. Even so, their attacks had difficulty hitting each other, especially since the male fox used his tail as a shield, making their fight very boring for Nalan Yushu and the senior cultivators, who were watching them.

Unlike them, Tian Baixing is worried about her brother's situation, but Nalan Yushu's pressure on her soul is simply too strong, and she can't break free from her restrictions, let alone help Tian Baitian.

Zhang Xiaolong [3] decided to use his absolute condition to enhance his speed and raw strength, and he attacked Tian Baitian more intensely, but it did not change the situation because the male fox also used a similar ability to increase his speed and repeatedly teleported away to avoid his fatal attacks.

As their fight becomes more intense, their lightning tribulations suddenly disappear, signaling the end of their fifth test. A powerful pressure suddenly pressed down from above them, forcing Zhang Xiaolong [3] and Tian Baitian to stop their fight in a stalemate.
Mu Ling, who was previously waiting outside, immediately entered the room and shook his head at the chaos they had caused there. "Stop your fight and go to the next test room."
Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately stored the moonlit whisper sword and asked Nalan Yushu to enter his soul sea again. He then landed in front of Mu Ling. "Let's go there."
"Yes." Mu Ling immediately led Zhang Xiaolong [3] away, but he glanced several times at Tian Baitian, who looked furious. 'What a stupid fox.'
Meanwhile, Tian Baixing approached her brother after Nalan Yushu's restriction disappeared from her soul. "Are you okay, Brother?"

"Release your soul! I will examine it." Tian Baixing nodded and released her soul for her brother's examination, but Tian Baitian did not find any abnormalities in it. Nevertheless, he planted his soul mark into her soul before asking her to return it to her body. "I don't know what technique he used on you just now, but I saw him replicate your soul and merge your soul replica with his. Therefore, I intentionally implanted my soul mark into your soul, and I will help you fight him back if he tries to control you."

Tian Baixing nodded in understanding before speaking to him. "Brother, I don't know the identity of that woman, but her soul is truly powerful, and my soul is greatly suppressed by her soul power. If my guess is correct, her soul power should have reached the immortal soul level, which means she is not a cultivator from the three mortal realms but from the realm beyond."

"Yes." Tian Baitian nodded in agreement. "Even though I didn't come into direct contact with her soul, I could already feel that her soul power had surpassed mine. If that woman had helped him restrain me, I would have died at his hands by now. However, I don't understand how that bastard could have such a strong woman by his side, and he could even subdue the four ancestors of the four beast clans."

Tian Baixing was also confused by Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s reasons for not doing anything to her, even though she was already under Nalan Yushu's control. "What do you think the reason he didn't attack me was? He could have killed me, and he could have asked that woman to control you afterwards. That way, he wouldn't have had to fight a pointless battle with you, and we would have both died by his hands."

"Hmm?" Tian Baitian raised his eyebrows in confusion. "I don't know the reason he didn't ask the woman to do it to us, but we should avoid him for now, just in case he changes his mind and asks the woman to do something to us."
Tian Baixing nodded her head slightly. "Let's wait for him to pass the next test first, and we will take the test after him."
"Yeah." Tian Batian and Tian Baixing immediately left the room and went to the next room, but they kept their distance from Zhang Xiaolong [3].

"Hahaha!" Zhang Xiaolong [3] laughed loudly at that, and his body was quickly enveloped by several different flames.
"You senile old fox!
You already know I have the golden crow flame, but you still think your white flame can kill me."
Zhang Xiaolong [3] shot his flames toward the divine projection of the nine-tailed fox and destroyed it, causing Tian Baitian to vomit blood from his mouth.
However, Tian Baitian's injury recovered by itself, and he flew away from Zhang Xiaolong [3], who stood in his spot with a relaxed smile. 'Shit!
His golden crow flame is indeed terrifying.'
"Hmm?" Zhang Xiaolong [3] raised an eyebrow as Tian Baitian's nine tails merged into one, and its size became extremely large. 'Doesn't he have other abilities besides using his nine tails?'
Tian Baitian suddenly extended his two fox claws, powered by his qi.
He then slashed his claws and thrust his tail toward Zhang Xiaolong [3].
"Sky-Piercing Fox Claws!
Tail Lance!"
Zhang Xiaolong [3] let out a soft sigh and dodged all of Tian Baitian's attacks, but he did not forget to strike back at the male fox.

Even so, their attacks had difficulty hitting each other, especially since the male fox used his tail as a shield, making their fight very boring for Nalan Yushu and the senior cultivators, who were watching them.

Unlike them, Tian Baixing is worried about her brother's situation, but Nalan Yushu's pressure on her soul is simply too strong, and she can't break free from her restrictions, let alone help Tian Baitian.

Zhang Xiaolong [3] decided to use his absolute condition to enhance his speed and raw strength, and he attacked Tian Baitian more intensely, but it did not change the situation because the male fox also used a similar ability to increase his speed and repeatedly teleported away to avoid his fatal attacks.
As their fight becomes more intense, their lightning tribulations suddenly disappear, signaling the end of their fifth test.
A powerful pressure suddenly pressed down from above them, forcing Zhang Xiaolong [3] and Tian Baitian to stop their fight in a stalemate.
Mu Ling, who was previously waiting outside, immediately entered the room and shook his head at the chaos they had caused there.
"Stop your fight and go to the next test room."
Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately stored the moonlit whisper sword and asked Nalan Yushu to enter his soul sea again.
He then landed in front of Mu Ling.
"Let's go there."
"Yes." Mu Ling immediately led Zhang Xiaolong [3] away, but he glanced several times at Tian Baitian, who looked furious. 'What a stupid fox.'
Meanwhile, Tian Baixing approached her brother after Nalan Yushu's restriction disappeared from her soul.
"Are you okay, Brother?"
"Release your soul!
I will examine it." Tian Baixing nodded and released her soul for her brother's examination, but Tian Baitian did not find any abnormalities in it.
Nevertheless, he planted his soul mark into her soul before asking her to return it to her body.
"I don't know what technique he used on you just now, but I saw him replicate your soul and merge your soul replica with his.
Therefore, I intentionally implanted my soul mark into your soul, and I will help you fight him back if he tries to control you."
Tian Baixing nodded in understanding before speaking to him.
"Brother, I don't know the identity of that woman, but her soul is truly powerful, and my soul is greatly suppressed by her soul power.
If my guess is correct, her soul power should have reached the immortal soul level, which means she is not a cultivator from the three mortal realms but from the realm beyond."
"Yes." Tian Baitian nodded in agreement.
"Even though I didn't come into direct contact with her soul, I could already feel that her soul power had surpassed mine.
If that woman had helped him restrain me, I would have died at his hands by now.
However, I don't understand how that bastard could have such a strong woman by his side, and he could even subdue the four ancestors of the four beast clans."
Tian Baixing was also confused by Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s reasons for not doing anything to her, even though she was already under Nalan Yushu's control.
"What do you think the reason he didn't attack me was?
He could have killed me, and he could have asked that woman to control you afterwards.
That way, he wouldn't have had to fight a pointless battle with you, and we would have both died by his hands."
"Hmm?" Tian Baitian raised his eyebrows in confusion.
"I don't know the reason he didn't ask the woman to do it to us, but we should avoid him for now, just in case he changes his mind and asks the woman to do something to us."
Tian Baixing nodded her head slightly.
"Let's wait for him to pass the next test first, and we will take the test after him."
"Yeah." Tian Batian and Tian Baixing immediately left the room and went to the next room, but they kept their distance from Zhang Xiaolong [3].

chapters.title: Chapter 961: Loyalty And Righteousness
paragraphs: "Didn't you want to defeat them? Why are you holding back against Tian Baitian?" Mu Ling suddenly asked.

Zhang Xiaolong [3] shook his head in response. "I do want to defeat them, but your master said that it's not the time yet. Moreover, I don't have information about all of their abilities yet, so I want to know everything first, and their abilities are far beyond my expectations, especially Tian Baixing."
"How did you know that Senior Jia is my master?" Mu Lin asked with a hint of surprise.

"Even though you used the transformation technique to transform yourself into a human, your beast scent is still strong, and my sense of smell is much stronger than you imagine." Zhang Xiaolong [3] then looked at Mu Ling. "Moreover, you are so respectful toward Jia Yuyan, so it's not difficult for me to guess that you are her contract beast, right, Willow-Whisker Elk?"

Mu Ling released a soft sigh as he nodded. "Senior Jia saved my life from other beasts when I was little, but I have nothing valuable to repay her kindness. Therefore, I decided to become her contracted beast, and I have followed her ever since."

"Here." Mu Ling looked at him in confusion, but Zhang Xiaolong [3] grabbed his hand and passed the pill bottle to him. "I don't know where Jia Yuyan got my basic pills from, but I'm sure she gave you a set. The pills in this bottle are only useful for beasts like us, but I never intended to sell them in my shop, so no beast can get them without going through me. I don't know you, but I can see your loyalty to her. For me, loyalty is everything, so I gave them to you."
Mu Lin immediately received the bottle before asking again. "How can you be sure that I am loyal to Senior Jia?"

"Let's just say I have the ability to look into the souls of others to find out their dark secrets." Mu Ling looked incredulous about it, but Zhang Xiaolong [3] did not explain further and quickened his pace toward the next test room.

Before long, they had arrived at the sixth test site, and Mu Ling immediately informed Zhang Xiaolong [3]. "The sixth test is the loyalty and righteousness test; you will face random challenges in this test. I cannot explain to you in more detail, but I think you will have no difficulty passing this test. After this, you will undergo the last test, which is the Dao Test."
"Yeah." Zhang Xiaolong [3] then spoke. "Honestly, I've heard about all the tests in this realm from one of my fathers-in-law, who has passed them all and lived in it for hundreds of years."
"Oh? Who is your father-in-law?"
"Xia Tian."
Mu Ling was a little surprised to hear the name. "You're right, Xia Tian did live here for several hundred years, but he finally left after he read all the records in our library."

"Haha." Zhang Xiaolong [3] laughed softly. "My father-in-law is different from us, and he doesn't like to stay in one place his entire life. Instead, he prefers to go on adventures, mainly because he wants to uncover all the mysteries hidden in this universe."
"I know." Mu Ling replied with a nod. "My master likes Xia Tian because they share the same hobby, but she doesn't like to explore the universe by herself, and she explores it through many people."
"Hmm?" Zhang Xiaolong [3] raised an eyebrow upon hearing that. "Does that mean Jia Yuyan knows everything about me from other natural races spread across various realms?"

"Yes." Mu Ling revealed this information as instructed by Jia Yuyan. "My master has known about you since your first appearance in the Sky Jade Realm, and he has been following your progress ever since. He knows a lot about all your actions, from your actions in that realm, the Netherworld Realm, and various other realms."
"Where did Jia Yuyan get my pills from?"
"My master bought them from the natural races in the Evergreen Spirit Haven Realm."

Zhang Xiaolong [3] nodded in understanding, but he was curious about Jia Yuyan's reason for monitoring him for so long, and most importantly, he never knew that she had been doing so since he first appeared in the Sky Jade Realm. 'What exactly does she want from me? Or rather, what does the person behind her want from me? I'm sure she watched me all that time not because of her wishes, and I'm certain there was someone else behind her. Moreover, she possesses extensive knowledge about the ten-tailed fox, including the specific conditions required for my evolution into the ten tails.'
"Hey." Mu Ling patted Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s shoulder, waking him from his thoughts. "Trust me, my master has no ill intentions toward you, and she only wants to help you."
"Who exactly is Jia Yuyan? What can she do for me?"
Mu Ling shook her head at him. "I don't know what my master can do for you, but I can tell you that she is the leader of all the natural races in the three mortal realms."
"Huh?" Zhang Xiaolong [3] stared at Mu Ling in shock. "Are you serious about that? Is Jia Yuan really the leader of all the natural races in the three mortal realms?"

"I don't need to lie to you, right?" Zhang Xiaolong [3] remained skeptical about that, so Mu Ling told him something else. "In fact, there are several leaders of the natural races in this realm, and my master is one of them. However, the others almost never come to the surface, and my master represents them to communicate with the human cultivators in this realm."
"Are natural races one of the founding fathers of this realm?"

"Yes." Mu Ling nodded at him. "There are several clans of the human race, and they are the Tian, Leng, Shangguan, Qing, and Shi Clans. My master's ancestor is one of the founding fathers of this realm, along with several representatives of the natural and beast races."

"I see." Zhang Xiaolong [3] himself had heard about the five human clans from Yuan Tianling, but she never mentioned the founding fathers of the natural and beast races. "I want to talk to Jia Yuyan later, but I will finish the last two tests first."
"All right, I will tell my master about it."

Not long after Zhang Xiaolong [3] entered the room for the next test, Tian Baitian and Tian Baixing arrived in front of it, but they did not immediately enter it and waited for him to finish his test.

Mu Ling did not say anything to the two heavenly foxes, but he felt sorry for them in his heart, especially since they were destined to be the stepping stones for Zhang Xiaolong [3] to evolve into the ten tails.
Mu Ling then sat cross-legged, ignoring the two heavenly foxes, and swallowed Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s beast pills.

Inside the room, Zhang Xiaolong [3] saw an old man sitting cross-legged in the middle of the room, but he immediately realized that he was not a real person, and he was just a projection of something.
When the old man opened his eyes, Zhang Xiaolong [3] could feel that the place had become so quiet that he could hear his breathing clearly, and the entire area was filled with sparkling stars.
"What is loyalty?"
"Loyalty is a commitment to someone or something; it is often expressed through support, trust, and faithfulness even when it's difficult or inconvenient."
"What does loyalty consist of?"
"Choice and consistency! Loyalty is not blind obedience but a conscious alignment of one's actions with one's values or relationships."
"To whom should we be loyal?"
"To ourselves and to all those who are loyal to us."
"Are you a loyal person?"

"Depends." The old man's eyes glowed as he stared at Zhang Xiaolong [3], who immediately continued. "A person cannot judge their loyalty, and a person's loyalty depends on the opinions of others. Loyalty cannot be shown through words, and loyalty can only be judged by actions, so only others can judge whether a person is loyal or not. I can say that I am a loyal person, but others may not necessarily think the same, and vice versa; people can say they are loyal, but they are not necessarily loyal in my eyes."
"How many women are there by your side?"
"Dozens."
"You're not a loyal person, so—"

"Who are you to say I am disloyal?" Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately refuted the old man. "You don't know me or all of my women, so your assumption about me being disloyal is unfounded. A man's loyalty is determined by how he treats women, not by how many he has. I love all my women, and I always keep them by my side. I always treat them fairly and equally, and we always help each other and grow strong together."
The old man fell silent for quite a while, but he kept staring at Zhang Xiaolong [3]. "Show me the proof."
"How?"
"Imagine your relationship with all of them."

Zhang Xiaolong [3] momentarily raised his eyebrows before imagining all his women, but he only imagined a situation where they were relaxing and gathering together as a big family. After all, he knew that the senior cultivators of that realm were monitoring him, and he didn't want them to see his intimate activities with them. Many images gradually appeared on the ceiling of the room, showing his relationships with all his women.

The images that appeared in the room shocked Jia Yuyan and the senior cultivators who were watching Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s test from another place; they didn't expect that the number of women would be so numerous, but they finally realized the reason behind his absurd cultivation speed. Unfortunately, they only guessed half right, especially since they didn't know about his other advantages, including his godly cheat in the form of a system.
The old man looked at all the pictures before removing them, and he immediately asked the next question. "What is righteousness?"
'Phew.' Zhang Xiaolong [3] sighed inwardly before responding. "Righteousness is the quality of being morally right, just, or virtuous according to a particular standard of ethics, law, or truth."
"Describe it."

Zhang Xiaolong [3] frowned. "We must uphold our principles by doing what is right, even when it is difficult or unpopular. We must uphold justice and integrity. We must act with honesty, compassion, and moral courage. It involves living in harmony with moral or spiritual principles. True righteousness is not self-righteousness, which is arrogance or superiority. True righteousness is humble and principled."
"Are you someone who upholds righteousness?"

"Depends." The old man squinted his eyes in response to Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s answer. "If they uphold righteousness, I will be the same as them. If they uphold evil and wickedness, I will be more evil and wicked than them. If you think my answer is wrong, then you are not worthy to be a cultivator and live in a cultivation world filled with countless cruel cultivators. Blind righteousness will only cause us and everyone around us to suffer, so we have to behave appropriately depending on the situation in front of us, good or bad. If you forgive evil, they will repay you cruelly, and we must exterminate them before it's too late."
"What is good or evil?"

Zhang Xiaolong [3] felt that all the old man's questions were too ridiculous. "Isn't that easy? Good is anything that has a positive impact on our lives and those around us, such as helping us grow, giving us many benefits, and so on. Evil is anything that has a negative impact on us, such as loss, harm, injury, or even death."
"You passed."
The old man immediately closed his eyes again, causing Zhang Xiaolong [3] to shake his head and swiftly leave the room. 'What a useless test.'

An old man suddenly appeared in the room, but he was a real person, unlike the previous one. He waved his hand, and all of Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s memories appeared before him. "He's an interesting young man; it's no wonder all these women are happy with him, even though they have to share him with many others. I wonder what the higher-ups have in mind; why are they so eager to recruit him? They even ordered me to pass him regardless of his answers."
The old man released a soft sigh, dispelled all those images, and disappeared from that place.
Zhang Xiaolong [3] smiled faintly as he looked at Tian Baitian and Tian Baixing, but he paid them no attention and went with Mu Ling to undergo the final and most difficult test.
After they left, Tian Baitian and Tian Baixing immediately entered the room together, and they started their test together.
Before long, Mu Ling brought Zhang Xiaolong [3] to a location that was different from the previous tests; it was a field filled with various types of beasts and colorful plants.

"The final test is the Dao test." Zhang Xiaolong [3] nodded to Mu Ling and floated to the center of the area. "Will he pass this test? If he can successfully comprehend the Dao, he will become an even better cultivator, and all his abilities will also increase significantly. Additionally, understanding the Dao will smooth his future on his path of cultivation, and it will be easier for him to break through."
Up in the sky, Zhang Xiaolong [3] had already closed his eyes and calmed his mind about all matters, waiting for the upcoming test.
"Do you think this kid will succeed in comprehending the Dao?" Shangguan Yan asked the others.

Qing Huang shook his head slightly. "His belief in loyalty and righteousness is indeed good, but the Dao is the most difficult thing to comprehend. Even so, I am confident that he will be able to comprehend the Dao, especially after witnessing him master the immortal-grade technique in less than a day; however, it will take him a very long time to achieve this."

"I agree with you, Old Qing." Shi Yan said with a nod. "Back then, it took me a hundred years to comprehend the Dao, but this kid is different from me with my low comprehension. None of us have ever succeeded in learning that immortal-grade technique, but he has proven his high comprehension by successfully learning it. Therefore, I believe he will succeed in comprehending the Dao, even if it takes him a long time to do so."

Tian Jingxuan looked at Zhang Xiaolong [3] through the Qi screen with a gaze full of doubt. "Let's wait for his result, but I sincerely hope that he will succeed in comprehending the Dao, which will be very useful for his future."

Leng Xueyan looked as doubtful as Tian Jingxuan, but she also hoped that Zhang Xiaolong [3] would succeed in the last test. 'Prove to me that you are a special young man by successfully comprehending the Dao.'

Unlike them, Jia Yuyan did not seem the least bit worried about Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s situation, and she fully believed that he would succeed in comprehending the Dao. 'Kid, you are destined to be the peacemaker, so I believe you will not fail this test.'
Meanwhile, three people were standing in front of a portal: a middle-aged man, a middle-aged woman, and a 'young man'.

A middle-aged man standing not far from them immediately spoke to them. "Sect Master Luo and Madam Huang, this portal will take the three of you to the Star Tower. However, you should suppress your strength first, especially since the tower is located on a planet in the middle realms of the three mortal realms."

"We know." Luo Fenghan, Huang Xiaoyi, and the 'young man' immediately suppressed their cultivation using special artifacts. Thereafter, the three of them walked into the portal after the middle-aged man activated it.

"Who is that young man? Why is he with them? As far as I remember, their two sons are Luo Zhenyu and Luo Jiaxuan, and I've never heard of them having a third son." The middle-aged man wondered to himself.
Within a few minutes, the three had arrived at the top floor of the Star Tower, and the old man brought his three disciples to greet them. "Welcome to the tower, Sect Master Luo and Madam Huang."
"Where is Zhang Fei?" The young man, who was actually Luo Yunxiao in disguise, immediately asked the old man a question.

Zhang Xiaolong [3] smiled faintly as he looked at Tian Baitian and Tian Baixing, but he paid them no attention and went with Mu Ling to undergo the final and most difficult test.
After they left, Tian Baitian and Tian Baixing immediately entered the room together, and they started their test together.
Before long, Mu Ling brought Zhang Xiaolong [3] to a location that was different from the previous tests; it was a field filled with various types of beasts and colorful plants.
"The final test is the Dao test." Zhang Xiaolong [3] nodded to Mu Ling and floated to the center of the area.
"Will he pass this test?
If he can successfully comprehend the Dao, he will become an even better cultivator, and all his abilities will also increase significantly.
Additionally, understanding the Dao will smooth his future on his path of cultivation, and it will be easier for him to break through."
Up in the sky, Zhang Xiaolong [3] had already closed his eyes and calmed his mind about all matters, waiting for the upcoming test.
"Do you think this kid will succeed in comprehending the Dao?" Shangguan Yan asked the others.
Qing Huang shook his head slightly.
"His belief in loyalty and righteousness is indeed good, but the Dao is the most difficult thing to comprehend.

Even so, I am confident that he will be able to comprehend the Dao, especially after witnessing him master the immortal-grade technique in less than a day; however, it will take him a very long time to achieve this."
"I agree with you, Old Qing." Shi Yan said with a nod.
"Back then, it took me a hundred years to comprehend the Dao, but this kid is different from me with my low comprehension.
None of us have ever succeeded in learning that immortal-grade technique, but he has proven his high comprehension by successfully learning it.
Therefore, I believe he will succeed in comprehending the Dao, even if it takes him a long time to do so."
Tian Jingxuan looked at Zhang Xiaolong [3] through the Qi screen with a gaze full of doubt.
"Let's wait for his result, but I sincerely hope that he will succeed in comprehending the Dao, which will be very useful for his future."

Leng Xueyan looked as doubtful as Tian Jingxuan, but she also hoped that Zhang Xiaolong [3] would succeed in the last test. 'Prove to me that you are a special young man by successfully comprehending the Dao.'

Unlike them, Jia Yuyan did not seem the least bit worried about Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s situation, and she fully believed that he would succeed in comprehending the Dao. 'Kid, you are destined to be the peacemaker, so I believe you will not fail this test.'
Meanwhile, three people were standing in front of a portal: a middle-aged man, a middle-aged woman, and a 'young man'.
A middle-aged man standing not far from them immediately spoke to them.
"Sect Master Luo and Madam Huang, this portal will take the three of you to the Star Tower.
However, you should suppress your strength first, especially since the tower is located on a planet in the middle realms of the three mortal realms."
"We know." Luo Fenghan, Huang Xiaoyi, and the 'young man' immediately suppressed their cultivation using special artifacts.
Thereafter, the three of them walked into the portal after the middle-aged man activated it.
"Who is that young man?
Why is he with them?
As far as I remember, their two sons are Luo Zhenyu and Luo Jiaxuan, and I've never heard of them having a third son." The middle-aged man wondered to himself.
Within a few minutes, the three had arrived at the top floor of the Star Tower, and the old man brought his three disciples to greet them.
"Welcome to the tower, Sect Master Luo and Madam Huang."
"Where is Zhang Fei?" The young man, who was actually Luo Yunxiao in disguise, immediately asked the old man a question.

chapters.title: Chapter 962: Reunion
paragraphs: 'She really knows that kid, huh?' The old man and his three disciples quietly expressed their thoughts to each other. "Young Miss Luo, Zhang Fei and some of his friends are currently facing the final challenge on the second floor, but they will finish soon."
"Be patient, Yunxiao." Luo Fenghan patted his daughter's shoulder. "Let us see them, Old Wan Jiang."
Wan Jiang nodded and led Luo Fenghan and his family to his private quarters in the tower, followed by Hua Mei'er and the other two.
When they arrived there, Wan Jiang displayed the Qi screen, which showed the progress of Zhang Fei and the others.
"Who are the women on Zhang Fei's side?"

"Most of them are his wives, Mother." Huang Xiaoyi turned to Luo Yunxiao, who was looking at Zhang Fei with a longing gaze. "Sister Feng Yao told me their names are Xian Xianqin, Xian Changyue, Yun Xinyue, and Bai Tian'er. He still has many other women, but I don't understand why he doesn't bring them with him."

Huang Xiaoyi sighed in her heart; she still found it difficult to believe that Zhang Fei had so many women by his side. Even though her daughter already knew this fact, she still insisted on meeting him, and her feelings for him did not change at all.

Luo Fenghan, aware of his wife's feelings, immediately rubbed her back. 'I myself don't want our daughter to share a husband with multiple women, but she has made her choice, and she will never change her mind again.'
'I know.' Huang Xiaoyi replied with a soft sigh.

"Young Miss Luo, Zhang Fei actually brought all his women and closest people to this tower. However, they have never challenged this tower before, so they have to start from the first floor." Wan Jiang then displayed the activities of the people who were undergoing all the challenges on the first floor.

"Hmm?" Luo Fenghan and Huang Xiaoyi were surprised once they recognized the identities of several women on the first floor. "How can there be so many female mythical beasts by his side? They come from the vermilion, phoenix, dark phoenix, golden fox, nian, and azure emperor roc races. Moreover, there are still several female demon beasts among them, and three of them are not ordinary ones but ancient ones."
"Ancient demon beasts?" Wan Jiang and his three disciples were shocked when they heard that.

Luo Fenghan pointed to Ru Xue, Zhang Lin, and Zhang Lingxue. "The white-haired woman has the celestial demon bloodline, but she is also a light dragon. The young woman with fin ears has the abyssal leviathan demon beast bloodline, but she also has the water dragon bloodline. As for the woman with dark red hair, she is a mixed breed of the phoenix and the devourer demon beast."
"Didn't the leviathan dragon and the devouring demon beast become extinct a long time ago, husband? How could those two women possibly have their bloodlines?" Huang Xiaoyi asked in confusion.

Luo Fenghan shook his head. "I myself am confused as to how they can have both bloodlines, but the most confusing thing is the bloodline of the three mythical beasts in their bodies. We both know that those mythical beasts hate those demon beasts, so there's no way they would produce mixed offspring."

"One of them is Zhang Lin." Luo Fenghan and Huang Xiaoyi turned to Luo Yunxiao in shock because they recognized her as someone who was born human. "I don't know how she managed to transform into a mixture of the abyssal leviathan demon beast and the water dragon, but her transformation is definitely not an ordinary thing."
"Did Feng Yao tell you anything about it?"

"No." Luo Yunxiao shook her head at her mother. "We don't need to think about that, and we'll get the answer after we meet Zhang Fei. By the way, the other two women are Ru Xue and Zhang Lingxue, and Ru Xue became his first woman because of an accident."
"What did you mean by an accident?"

Luo Yunxiao nodded. "Ru Xue was with Zhang Fei when he awakened his lust demon bloodline for the first time, and he unknowingly used his abilities on her, which made them involved in such a relationship."
"I see." Luo Fengyan nodded in understanding. "Not only Zhang Fei, but all these people have surpassed cultivators at their level, especially their speed."

"1-Moon Divine Transcend Realm, huh?" Huang Xiaoyi muttered as she nodded. "Zhang Fei's progress is truly terrifying; not even dual cultivators in our domain can match him. When she visited us, Feng Yao said his cultivation had only broken through the Heaven Realm, and two years had passed in the three mortal realms, but he had already reached this stage."

"Haha." Luo Fengyan laughed at that. "The dual cultivators in our domain don't have as many women as Zhang Fei, right? Moreover, Feng Yao told us that he is an alchemist, and he has many pills that don't even exist in our realm, so it's natural that they can't match his cultivation speed."
"They're done." Luo Yunxiao's expression turned impatient. "Senior Wan, please take me to see them."

Wan Jiang turned to Luo Fenghan, who nodded at him. He immediately took the three of them to the second floor of the tower, followed by Helian Xun'er, who was curious about Zhang Fei and Luo Yunxiao's relationship.
