'Phew! I can finally clear the second floor.' Zhang Fei sighed in relief, only to find himself and the others abruptly ejected from the challenge location.

Zhang Fei froze in place as soon as they appeared on the second floor, and his gaze was only focused on the three people who were so familiar to him, even though he had not seen them for twelve years.

"Hmm?" Although they had never met Luo Yunxiao before, Xian Xianqin, Xian Changyue, Yun Xinyue, and Bai Tian'er could immediately guess her identity from Zhang Fei's reaction. However, they were jealous of her beauty, especially since she truly was beautiful like a goddess, even though she had not swallowed the two beauty pills.
'Who is that woman? Why is Brother Fei reacting like this after seeing her?' Yuan Luo whispered her question to the four women.
On the other hand, Xin Xianzi, Ximen Chuixue, and the others were more curious about Luo Yunxiao's cultivation, especially since they could feel that he was truly powerful and far surpassed them.
'She is Zhang Fei's childhood lover, Luo Yunxiao.'
'Oh?' Yuan Luo stared at Luo Yunxiao with repeated blinks. 'This guy is always lucky with women! He even had a goddess as his childhood lover.'
"Yunxiao." Zhang Fei called out softly while stupidly staring at her.
"Fei." Luo Yunxiao moved in front of Zhang Fei, hugged him tightly, and unconsciously cried. "I... I have waited hundreds of years for this day, and we finally met again."

Seeing Luo Yunxiao like that, Xian Xianqin and the others immediately moved away from them, giving them time to vent their longing. Moreover, most of them already knew about the difference in time flow between the three mortal realms and the Paradise Realm, so they knew that she had waited too long to be able to meet Zhang Fei again.

Zhang Fei wrapped his arms around Luo Yunxiao's head and waist, and he hugged her without being able to say anything because he was still shocked by her sudden appearance. He felt the warmth of her body and enjoyed her soft scent, making him realize that the woman in his arms was real. "Yunxiao, I missed you."

"Mhmm." Luo Yunxiao tightened her embrace on Zhang Fei as if afraid that he would disappear. "I missed you too, Fei. I'm sorry I left without saying goodbye, and I'm sorry I asked my father to seal your memories of me."

Zhang Fei inwardly sighed. "Although I am disappointed by all that, I am no longer a weak child; I have understood many things since becoming a cultivator, and I know you had your reasons for your actions back then. I wanted to meet you again, and I thought it would take me a long time to do that, but you suddenly appeared here today, which surprised me."

"Hehe." Luo Yunxiao giggled. "Hua Mei'er contacted her sister, who happened to be my sect sister. She told me that you were in this tower, and I immediately asked my parents to bring me here to meet you."
"I'm glad to see you again." Zhang Fei then looked at Luo Fenghan and Huang Xiaoyi, who were walking towards them. "Long time no see, Uncle Luo and Aunt Huang."
"Long time no see, Zhang Fei." Huang Xiaoyi nodded in response.

Luo Fenghan immediately spoke to Zhang Fei. "Please forgive me; I was forced to do that to you because I thought you would never be able to become a cultivator, especially since there is no Qi on Earth. You will suffer if you keep remembering my daughter, so I had to do that to you back then."

"You don't have to apologize to me, Uncle Luo." Zhang Fei shook his head at Luo Fenghan. "I thoroughly understand why you did that to me, and I never blamed you for it. To be honest, I myself never imagined that I would become a cultivator in my entire life, but that accident that day drastically changed my life, and here I am looking for a way to go to the Heaven Realm."

Luo Fenghan was slightly relieved to hear that. "I've heard a lot about you from Feng Yao and her parents, and I'm truly satisfied with your progress. Three years may be slow for ordinary people, but it's very fast for us cultivators. I've never met a cultivator who could reach the Seven Divine Realms in three years except for my daughter."
"Oh?" Zhang Fei was surprised and looked at Luo Yunxiao, who smiled to herself. "How long did it take you to reach the Seven Divine Realms in the past?"
"A year." Luo Yunxiao's answer almost caused Zhang Fei and the others to fall to the floor, especially since reaching the Seven Divine Realms in a year was impossible.
Zhang Fei released a heavy sigh. "I thought that I was a genius, but you are much more of a genius than me, Yunxiao."

"You are mistaken about that, Fei." Luo Yunxiao withdrew her arms from Zhang Fei's body and cupped his face. "Unlike you, I cultivate using the Celestial Qi, which is much better than the normal or Divine Qi. Moreover, you don't have strong backers like me, and I also enjoy the many high-quality cultivation resources there. If we both cultivate and use the same resources, I believe you will far surpass me."

"There are no ifs in life, right?" Zhang Fei then caressed Luo Yunxiao's cheeks. "I am indeed far behind you now, but I will never give up. I will work harder to pursue my cultivation, and I will definitely surpass you one day."
Luo Yunxiao nodded with a smile. "You have been smart and diligent since you were little, and I believe you will be able to surpass me one day."

"If you want to surpass my daughter, you can't continue to stay in the three mortal realms." Zhang Fei looked at Huang Xiaoyi directly. "Your cultivation speed is indeed outstanding, but Yunxiao will continue to be far ahead of you. Therefore, you should go to our realm as soon as possible, especially since it is the true cultivation world, where many peak cultivators gather."

Zhang Fei nodded at her. "I myself had planned to go to the Paradise Realm as soon as possible, Aunt Huang. However, I still have to pass the trials of this tower before I can go there, so I have to make Yunxiao wait for me a little longer."
"Then—"

"No." Zhang Fei immediately rejected Huang Xiaoyi. "Aunt Huang, I get your wishes, but there are so many people on my side, and we aren't ready to enter that realm. If we go there now, we can only hide like rabbits, and I don't want that to happen."

"Zhang Fei is right, wife." Luo Fengyan put his arm around Huang Xiaoyi's shoulder. "The best teacher for us cultivators is experience, so I want him to reach our realm with his ability even if our daughter has to wait for him a little longer."
"But—"

"It's okay, Mother." Luo Yunxiao interrupted and turned to Huang Xiaoyi. "I've waited for hundreds of years to meet Zhang Fei again, so I don't mind waiting for him a little longer. With his current cultivation speed, I'm sure I won't have to wait too long. He's strong enough now, and he will become even stronger when he reaches our realm in the future, but he can only do that by facing many real challenges."
Huang Xiaoyi could only sigh as they were all too stubborn. "If you think so, I won't force Zhang Fei to go with us."
"Yes." Luo Yunxiao then turned to Zhang Fei. "You won't keep me waiting too long, right?"

Zhang Fei nodded at her. "For now, I don't have much business in the three mortal realms, so I can fully focus on my cultivation. Moreover, I have some secrets that have helped me all this time, and I also have all my women by my side, so I won't keep you waiting too long."

"Speaking of your women, how many are there now?" Luo Yunxiao curiously asked, especially since two years had passed in the three mortal realms since she last met Feng Yao, making her think that their numbers had increased again.
"Haha." Zhang Fei laughed while scratching his head, but then he asked Wan Jiang a question. "Can you send us to another place, Old Man?"
Wan Jiang nodded at him. "I will move all of them to a place, and you guys can chat comfortably there."
After Zhang Fei told him the identities of all his women and main family, Wan Jiang moved all of them to a special place inside the tower, and he himself returned to his private quarters.
Everyone appeared confused by the sudden change in location, but a few gasped upon seeing Luo Fenghan, Huang Xiaoyi, and Luo Yunxiao.
"Uncle Luo? Aunt Huang? Luo Yunxiao? Are these really you guys? Are my eyes not lying to me?" Zhang Lin called them one by one.
"Hehe." Luo Yunxiao giggled. "Long time no see, Zhang Lin."

Luo Fenghan and Huang Xiaoyi nodded to Zhang Lin, who immediately ran over before jumping to hug Luo Yunxiao. "Wow! I missed you! At that time, you all left without revealing the truth, and I believed you were simply relocating to another country, but it turns out you actually moved to a realm beyond our reach!"

"Please forgive me for not telling you the truth." Luo Yunxiao said apologetically as she hugged Zhang Lin, but then she looked at the other three women. "Grandma Chen! Aunt Qing! Zhang Yue! I missed you all."
Zhang Lin released Luo Yunxiao from her embrace as soon as the three women arrived by their side, and the three of them took turns hugging her.
Zhang Chen rubbed Luo Yunxiao's cheeks. "The last time I saw you, you were only ten years old, but you have become such a beautiful, mature woman, and you are older than me now."
"Hahaha." Luo Yunxiao laughed in embarrassment. "Age is just a number for us cultivators, and you will always be my grandma, Grandma Chen."

Zhang Chen smiled upon hearing that and looked at Luo Yunxiao's parents, who looked awkward toward her. "Why are you two acting like this now? I'm different from the old me, so I understand why you just left without telling us the truth back then."

"Phew." Luo Fengyan exhaled softly. "Aunt Chen, we left because my enemies discovered our location, and the Earth would be in danger if they went there. Therefore, I decided to bring them back to our realm, and they ambushed us once we arrived there. Fortunately, many of my acquaintances came to help, or else we wouldn't be able to meet again now."
"Who are your enemies, Uncle Luo?"

"I've waited for hundreds of years to meet Zhang Fei again, so I don't mind waiting for him a little longer.
With his current cultivation speed, I'm sure I won't have to wait too long.
He's strong enough now, and he will become even stronger when he reaches our realm in the future, but he can only do that by facing many real challenges."
Huang Xiaoyi could only sigh as they were all too stubborn.
"If you think so, I won't force Zhang Fei to go with us."
"Yes." Luo Yunxiao then turned to Zhang Fei.
"You won't keep me waiting too long, right?"
Zhang Fei nodded at her.
"For now, I don't have much business in the three mortal realms, so I can fully focus on my cultivation.
Moreover, I have some secrets that have helped me all this time, and I also have all my women by my side, so I won't keep you waiting too long."

"Speaking of your women, how many are there now?" Luo Yunxiao curiously asked, especially since two years had passed in the three mortal realms since she last met Feng Yao, making her think that their numbers had increased again.
"Haha." Zhang Fei laughed while scratching his head, but then he asked Wan Jiang a question.
"Can you send us to another place, Old Man?"
Wan Jiang nodded at him.
"I will move all of them to a place, and you guys can chat comfortably there."
After Zhang Fei told him the identities of all his women and main family, Wan Jiang moved all of them to a special place inside the tower, and he himself returned to his private quarters.
Everyone appeared confused by the sudden change in location, but a few gasped upon seeing Luo Fenghan, Huang Xiaoyi, and Luo Yunxiao.
"Uncle Luo?
Aunt Huang?
Luo Yunxiao?
Are these really you guys?
Are my eyes not lying to me?" Zhang Lin called them one by one.
"Hehe." Luo Yunxiao giggled.
"Long time no see, Zhang Lin."
Luo Fenghan and Huang Xiaoyi nodded to Zhang Lin, who immediately ran over before jumping to hug Luo Yunxiao.
"Wow!
I missed you!
At that time, you all left without revealing the truth, and I believed you were simply relocating to another country, but it turns out you actually moved to a realm beyond our reach!"
"Please forgive me for not telling you the truth." Luo Yunxiao said apologetically as she hugged Zhang Lin, but then she looked at the other three women.
"Grandma Chen!
Aunt Qing!
Zhang Yue!
I missed you all."
Zhang Lin released Luo Yunxiao from her embrace as soon as the three women arrived by their side, and the three of them took turns hugging her.
Zhang Chen rubbed Luo Yunxiao's cheeks.
"The last time I saw you, you were only ten years old, but you have become such a beautiful, mature woman, and you are older than me now."
"Hahaha." Luo Yunxiao laughed in embarrassment.
"Age is just a number for us cultivators, and you will always be my grandma, Grandma Chen."
Zhang Chen smiled upon hearing that and looked at Luo Yunxiao's parents, who looked awkward toward her.
"Why are you two acting like this now?
I'm different from the old me, so I understand why you just left without telling us the truth back then."
"Phew." Luo Fengyan exhaled softly.
"Aunt Chen, we left because my enemies discovered our location, and the Earth would be in danger if they went there.
Therefore, I decided to bring them back to our realm, and they ambushed us once we arrived there.
Fortunately, many of my acquaintances came to help, or else we wouldn't be able to meet again now."
"Who are your enemies, Uncle Luo?"

chapters.title: Chapter 963: The Fox's Third Soul
paragraphs: Luo Fenghan shook his head in refusal. "Due to the difference in time flow, we don't have much time to waste, so we won't talk about it now. Moreover, you won't be able to do anything to help us with your current strength; we'll talk about it when you ascend to the Paradise Realm and arrive at our Immortal Lotus Sanctuary."
"I understand, Uncle Luo." Zhang Fei then introduced all his women to Luo Yunxiao and her parents.

Unlike Luo Yunxiao, Luo Fenghan and Huang Xiaoyi were shocked once Zhang Fei revealed that Qing Yi, Zhang Yue, and Zhang Lin were his wives. They were even more shocked when he told them that he was the one who turned his little sister, Ru Xue, and Zhang Lingxue from humans into ancient demon beasts.

Zhang Fei did not explain to them in too much detail, and he also did not show the science capsule to the three of them, especially since he still harbored many doubts about Wan Jiang and his three disciples.
Zhang Fei told them about his five clones, and he also told them about the women who were his main harem and the clones' partners, which shocked Luo Fenghan and Huang Xiaoyi further.

Luo Fenghan and Huang Xiaoyi finally understood that Zhang Fei's absurd cultivation speed was due to his many partners and five clones. They believed his speed would increase significantly once he ascended to the Paradise Realm.

Luo Fenghan and Huang Xiaoyi were shocked once again, especially when Zhang Fei told them that his fifth clone was going to various realms, from the lower to the upper ones, to collect cultivation resources by opening shops in all of them. 'This kid! How far ahead has he thought? The three mortal realms are not as big as the Paradise Realm, but the distance between all the realms is still too far for normal cultivators. If he controls the alchemy market in all realms, he can get unlimited resources from the residents.'
"Zhang Fei, I want you to use your fox form and release aura."
"Hmm?" Zhang Fei looked at Luo Yunxiao in confusion.

After she activated a soundproof artifact, Luo Yunxiao immediately explained to Zhang Fei about her conversation with Feng Yao a few years ago. "My special physique is the Heaven-Earth Reversal Physique, and it once belonged to a primordial beast who was none other than the Ten-Tailed Fox, Hu Tianlang."

"What?" Not only was Zhang Fei shocked to hear Luo Yunxiao's revelation, but Luo Fenghan and Huang Xiaoyi were also shocked to hear it because their daughter had never told them anything about it. "Are you serious about that?"

"Yes." Luo Yunxiao nodded at Zhang Fei. "According to Sister Feng Yao, one of the ten-tailed fox's souls is sealed inside my physique, and only his successor can awaken it, which is you. Therefore, use your fox form and release your aura now, and your soul will be even stronger after you obtain his third soul."

Zhang Fei hurriedly transformed into his complete fox form with eight tails dancing behind him, which amazed Luo Fengyan and his family. He then released his heavenly fox aura and enveloped Luo Yunxiao with it, causing her body to glow white.

A few moments later, a light shot out from Luo Yunxiao's body, and it turned into a gigantic, white, ten-tailed fox. Even though they had heard many things about the fox, they were all still shocked to see Hu Tianlang's soul form.
Hu Tianlang looked at Zhang Fei with a satisfied nod. {You have obtained my lust and proud soul, and you seem to have met my evil soul.}

"Yes." Zhang Fei returned to his human form and spoke to him. "I have met your evil soul, which you deliberately sealed in that place. At first, I thought about absorbing him, but I canceled my intention because he was still too strong for the current me. So which emotion does this soul of yours represent?"
{This soul is not a soul born from one emotion, but this one is my benevolence soul.}
Zhang Fei's eyes lit up after he heard that, and he quickly released his soul. "Does this mean I can merge with your evil soul after your benevolent soul merges with mine?"

{I can't be sure of that, and you can try to meet my evil soul after our souls merge together. If you feel ready to merge with my evil soul, you can absorb it directly, but you should not force yourself if you are not ready to do so. Otherwise, my evil soul will take control of your body, and no one can stop him from wreaking havoc on the three mortal realms.}

"I understand." Zhang Fei then asked him. "How did your past physique fall into Luo Yunxiao's hands? If your physique had become hers and merged with her body, I would never have been able to become the complete ten-tailed fox, right?"

{You're wrong about that.} Hu Tianlang shook his head. {I don't know how my old physique fell into the hands of this little girl, but it has nothing to do with whether you can evolve into ten tails or not, and you can still evolve into ten tails after you fulfill all the conditions that have been conveyed by my lust soul. My Heaven-Earth Reversal Physique is overpowered, and it allows me to manipulate yin and yang as I please with it. However, it is not the strongest in this universe, and there is one physique that surpasses it.}
Zhang Fei and the others looked at Hu Tianlang seriously after he said that. "What is the name of that physique?"
{In this universe, there are many types of special physiques, but there are only ten that can help the owner defy the heavens, one of which is my Heaven-Earth Reversal Physique.}
"What are the ten physiques?"
{1. Primal Origin Physique.
2. Heaven-Earth Reversal Physique.
3. Immortal Reincarnation Physique.
4. Myriad Dao Physique.
5. Immortal Sacred Physique.
6. Yin-Yang Devouring Physique.
7. Universe Tree Physique.
8. Heavenly Calamity Physique.
9. Ancestral Battle Saint Physique.
Void Emperor Physique.}

"Primal Origin Physique, huh?" Zhang Fei knew the other physiques were extraordinary, but he was only interested in the strongest one. "Do you know the ability of that physique? Do you know where it is?"

{According to the legend, the owner of the Primal Origin Physique will possess the ability to control everything in this universe, such as time, life, death, Yin, Yang, and many more. However, no one has ever seen it or met its owner, including the primordials. In fact, the primordial genesis beast, the primordial nihility beast, and I have searched for that physique in the past. Unfortunately, we never found any clues about it, so I don't know for sure about the truth of its abilities or its location.}

"The Primal Origin Physique is real, and it is hidden in a sacred place." Hu Tianlang and Zhang Fei turned to Luo Yunxiao immediately. "I heard about this from Sister Feng Yao, and she owned the third strongest physique, the Immortal Reincarnation Physique."

"Hmm? Are you sure about that, Yunxiao?" Zhang Fei looked doubtful when he heard Luo Yunxiao say that Feng Yao had the Immortal Reincarnation Physique, especially since the system did not detect the existence of that special physique in her body.

Luo Fenghan spoke to Zhang Fei right away. "Feng Yao is not an ordinary cultivator, and she has been reincarnated too many times. One of her reincarnations is the Flame Spirit Empress, Huo Yanling. She lived during my grandfather's era, and she was the ruler of the Blazing Nirvana Domain. Even the five-clawed golden dragon emperor, Long Wuzhao, did not dare to go against her, especially since she has complete control of the fire element."

"Empress Huo Yanling not only has complete control of the fire element, but she also has many abilities that have made her name feared by all cultivators in the Paradise Realm since several eras ago. Since ancient times, the ten demon gods were mighty, but they would run away like frightened rabbits once they met her." Unlike Zhang Fei, who had long suspected that Feng Yao had an unusual identity because of Huo Ling by her side, Zhang Chen and the others were completely shocked after Huang Xiaoyi said all that.

Hun Tianlang then spoke again. {I don't know about all of her reincarnations, but the first owner of the Immortal Reincarnation Body was a female primordial named Shen Yuanzhi, and she was no less powerful than me or the other primordials in the past. With her physique, she has the ability to continuously reincarnate while retaining all her memories and abilities, and she will remain powerful even if she is reincarnated again and again.}

"Feng Yao is the reincarnation of a primordial, huh? No wonder she knows so many secret things in this universe." Zhang Fei then asked Luo Yunxiao. "Did she tell you where the Primal Origin Physique is?"

Luo Yunxiao nodded at Zhang Fei. "Sister Feng Yao told me that the Primal Origin Physique is in a place called the Epoch of Time, where time has no effect, waiting for its rightful owner to take it. However, she does not know who the person who is destined to have the physique is, especially since it has been hidden there since the universe was created."
"Do you know anything about the Epoch of Time, Old Fox?"
Hun Tianlang shook his head in response. {I'm a primordial, but I've never heard of that place before.}
"Hmm?" Zhang Fei frowned at that. "Since a primordial like you didn't know about that place, Feng Yao's true identity shouldn't be a primordial, and she might have existed before the primordials."
{I think the same as you, but I have never heard of living beings that existed before the primordials. If you want to know the truth, you just need to meet her, right?}

Zhang Fei smiled bitterly at that because Feng Yao had always been secretive, and she was never willing to tell him things that were beyond his reach. "Forget about her, and let's merge our souls, Old Fox."

Hun Tianlang nodded to him before darting into his soul, and Zhang Fei immediately sat down cross-legged to begin the process of merging their souls. In a few minutes, his body floated into midair, and a bright white aura enveloped him, dazzling everyone present at that place.
Luo Yunxiao smiled as she kept looking at Zhang Fei. 'The ten-tailed fox's soul power is very high, so its soul power should increase significantly after their souls merge into one.'

Meanwhile, Luo Fenghan grabbed his wife's hand and spoke to her. 'Wife, this kid does have many women by his side, and our daughter has to share him with them, but I think he is the right man for her.'

'Yes.' Huang Xiaoyi replied with a nod. 'Even though I don't like the fact that our daughter has to share him with many women, I have to admit that he is the most suitable man for her. His future is very bright and long, and I believe he will be able to protect our daughter.'

Luo Fenghan then spoke to his daughter. "Yunxiao, I know you still want to be with Zhang Fei, but we have to return to our realm after this, and you can wait for him to come pick you up in our domain."
"Yes, Father." Luo Yunxiao immediately agreed. "No matter how long I have to wait for him, I will continue to wait for him to pick me up, and I will go with him then."

Zhang Chen smiled upon hearing that from Luo Yunxiao and then grabbed her hand. "Don't worry, okay? If Fei'er dares to slack his ass off, I'll scold him every day so he won't keep you waiting too long."
"Ha ha." Luo Yunxiao giggled as she hugged Zhang Chen. "Thank you, Grandma Chen."
A while later, the white light covering Zhang Fei's body had disappeared, and he immediately landed in front of them.
[Ding]
[The host obtained a portion of the ten-tailed fox's soul power.]
[The host's soul power level has increased to the perfection stage of the ancestral soul level.]

'Perfection stage, huh? The old fox's soul power this time is much greater than the previous two.' Zhang Fei immediately opened his eyes, pulled Luo Yunxiao into his arms, and gave him a deep kiss for quite a while. He then cupped her face and rubbed her cheeks. "Your arrival has brought significant changes to my soul power, and I am more prepared to face the old fox's evil soul. I promise I will cultivate more diligently, and I will pick you up at the Immortal Lotus Sanctuary once I ascend to the Paradise Realm. At that time, I will take you to my side, and we will never be apart again."
"Yeah." Luo Yunxiao pecked Zhang Fei's lips and removed the barrier. "We must return to our realm now, and I will always await your arrival in our domain."

"I won't let you wait for me for too long." Zhang Fei remembered an item and took it out immediately before handing it to Luo Fenghan, who shocked him and his wife. "If danger threatens Yunxiao, you can go to the Dragon-Soaring Divine Domain and show this token to Long Wuzhao; I'm sure he will be willing to help you if you tell him you got it from me."
"Where did you get this token?" Luo Fenghan asked as he accepted the token.

Zhang Fei immediately explained, "Long Wuzhao sent a female celestial dragon named Tianshi Shengjie to look for me, and she left this token for me. Additionally, I have met Long Wuzhao's golden avatar and had extensive conversations with him; he even invited me to meet him in his realm after I ascend to the Paradise Realm."

"I see." Luo Fenghan nodded in understanding, but he was still shocked to hear that Zhang Fei had met Long Wuzhao's avatar. "Since everything is done, I will bring them back to our realm, and you must try hard to go there as soon as possible."
"I will." Zhang Fei then gave them a few bottles of his pills, such as his basic pills, the two beauty pills, and some other pills.

Thereafter, Luo Fenghan asked Wan Jiang to take him and his family back to the upper floor, and the three of them immediately returned to the Paradise Realm. The old man sent all of Zhang Fei's family and women back to their previous location; he also sent him and several of his women to the second floor, where Ximen Chuixue and the others were waiting for them.

Since they had completed all the challenges on the second floor, Zhang Fei immediately led them to the third floor, and they right away began to undergo all the challenges on that floor. However, his previous encounter with Luo Yunxiao made him impatient, and he forced himself to complete all the challenges as soon as possible, making it difficult for the others to keep up with his pace.
Zhang Fei [1] had already reached the easternmost region of the Natural Race Kingdom in the Seven Stars Realm, and he swiftly dived to the sea's depths to reach the underwater city.
Within a few minutes, Zhang Fei [1] had arrived there, and the two female undines immediately went to meet him after they sensed his presence.

"Oh?" The two female undines were shocked after she sensed her cultivation, and Aqua spoke to him. "I haven't seen you for two and a half years, and your cultivation has already reached the 1-Moon Divine Transcend Realm. May I ask what brings you here unexpectedly? Are you going to do something about the ten-tailed fox's evil soul?"

Zhang Fei [1] nodded in response. "I have no other business here besides my business with the ten-tailed fox's evil soul, so I came for him. After I absorb him, I will take Jui Shui with me, and I can send you two to the upper realms if you wish."

"No." Aqua immediately refused. "I am the leader of this city, and I don't have a successor yet, so I can't go anywhere for now. However, you can take Yuhe with you, and the upper realms will help her cultivation improve faster."
"I see." Zhang Fei [1] asked Yuhe. "Do you want to go to the upper realms?"
"I have acknowledged you as my master, so I will follow your plan." Yuhe's answer made Zhang Fei [1] sigh softly. "Are you also going to take Sabina and the others there?"
"I'll send you guys to the Evergreen Spirit Haven Realm, but first I must handle that evil soul." Zhang Fei [1] then walked toward the city's secret place. "Let's go there now."

"We must return to our realm now, and I will always await your arrival in our domain."
"I won't let you wait for me for too long." Zhang Fei remembered an item and took it out immediately before handing it to Luo Fenghan, who shocked him and his wife.
"If danger threatens Yunxiao, you can go to the Dragon-Soaring Divine Domain and show this token to Long Wuzhao; I'm sure he will be willing to help you if you tell him you got it from me."
"Where did you get this token?" Luo Fenghan asked as he accepted the token.
Zhang Fei immediately explained, "Long Wuzhao sent a female celestial dragon named Tianshi Shengjie to look for me, and she left this token for me.
Additionally, I have met Long Wuzhao's golden avatar and had extensive conversations with him; he even invited me to meet him in his realm after I ascend to the Paradise Realm."
"I see." Luo Fenghan nodded in understanding, but he was still shocked to hear that Zhang Fei had met Long Wuzhao's avatar.
"Since everything is done, I will bring them back to our realm, and you must try hard to go there as soon as possible."
"I will." Zhang Fei then gave them a few bottles of his pills, such as his basic pills, the two beauty pills, and some other pills.
Thereafter, Luo Fenghan asked Wan Jiang to take him and his family back to the upper floor, and the three of them immediately returned to the Paradise Realm.

The old man sent all of Zhang Fei's family and women back to their previous location; he also sent him and several of his women to the second floor, where Ximen Chuixue and the others were waiting for them.
Since they had completed all the challenges on the second floor, Zhang Fei immediately led them to the third floor, and they right away began to undergo all the challenges on that floor.

However, his previous encounter with Luo Yunxiao made him impatient, and he forced himself to complete all the challenges as soon as possible, making it difficult for the others to keep up with his pace.
Zhang Fei [1] had already reached the easternmost region of the Natural Race Kingdom in the Seven Stars Realm, and he swiftly dived to the sea's depths to reach the underwater city.
Within a few minutes, Zhang Fei [1] had arrived there, and the two female undines immediately went to meet him after they sensed his presence.
"Oh?" The two female undines were shocked after she sensed her cultivation, and Aqua spoke to him.
"I haven't seen you for two and a half years, and your cultivation has already reached the 1-Moon Divine Transcend Realm.
May I ask what brings you here unexpectedly?
Are you going to do something about the ten-tailed fox's evil soul?"
Zhang Fei [1] nodded in response.
"I have no other business here besides my business with the ten-tailed fox's evil soul, so I came for him.
After I absorb him, I will take Jui Shui with me, and I can send you two to the upper realms if you wish."
"No." Aqua immediately refused.
"I am the leader of this city, and I don't have a successor yet, so I can't go anywhere for now.
However, you can take Yuhe with you, and the upper realms will help her cultivation improve faster."
"I see." Zhang Fei [1] asked Yuhe.
"Do you want to go to the upper realms?"
"I have acknowledged you as my master, so I will follow your plan." Yuhe's answer made Zhang Fei [1] sigh softly.
"Are you also going to take Sabina and the others there?"
"I'll send you guys to the Evergreen Spirit Haven Realm, but first I must handle that evil soul." Zhang Fei [1] then walked toward the city's secret place.
"Let's go there now."

chapters.title: Chapter 964: Face The Fox's Evil Soul
paragraphs: *Nom... Nom...*

Xuanyuan Yue sat in front of the monitor as she watched Zhang Fei [1]'s movements. "What is he thinking? Is he really ready to absorb the ten-tailed fox's evil soul? Most importantly, what is Feng Yao's true identity? I originally thought that she was a member of that race, but I didn't expect that she had such a physique that allowed her to reincarnate again and again. His conversation with Luo Yunxiao and Hu Tianlang earlier proved that my initial guess was wrong, and her existence should be higher than the primordials."
"Yue'er."
Xuanyuan Yue froze for a moment before looking back, precisely at a young woman with the appearance of a goddess.

The woman has a flawless complexion that radiates ethereal beauty. Her almond-shaped eyes are large and expressive, shimmering with a cool, icy blue. She wore a semi-translucent dress that highlighted her graceful bust.
"Mother!" Xuanyuan Yue jumped to the woman and hugged her. "Why did you come here all of a sudden? Where is Aunt Huang? Why didn't she come back here?"
The woman smiled amusedly, seeing her adult daughter still acting childishly. "Your father heard of your actions years ago, and he punished Sister Huang for helping you revive that kid."
"How... how did my father know about that?" Xuanyuan Xue asked stutteringly, and her body shivered from the cold. 'Ugh! My father will definitely punish me!'

"Did you forget that your father can read everyone's memories?" Xuanyuan Yue shook her head at her mother. "Sister Huang was the strongest in our universe in the past, but she is no longer your father's match, and he punished her because of you."
Xuanyuan Xue covered up and rubbed her face. "Ugh! My father is a cheater! He shouldn't use his abilities carelessly!"

"Haha." The woman softly laughed before bringing Xuanyuan Yue back to the front of the monitor. "Is this little boy from back then? Your father asked me to come here to check on him. He hopes your item doesn't fall into the wrong hands, or it will be a disaster for this universe."

"Yes." Xuanyuan Yue nodded at her mother. "His name is Zhang Fei, and I have been monitoring him since that day, Mother. He is no different from my father, and they are both perverts! However, the number of his women is still far below my father, who has thousands of women by his side."

The woman released a soft sigh as she listened to her daughter. "Even though your father had thousands of women by his side, he never neglected anyone. Since you and your siblings were small, he has always accompanied you all, right?"

"Well, that's true." Xuanyuan Yue replied with a nod. "Even though they were both born and grew up in the modern world, Zhang Fei was much better than my perverted father. He was never acting soft from the start, and he was never merciful to his enemies. He never hesitated to kill those who deserved to be killed, and he would take advantage of those who could be used."

"I see." The woman nodded in understanding. "Your father grew up without a father, and your grandmother raised him by herself since he was born. He knew nothing about the world of cultivation at that time, and he would never have known about it if it weren't for your other aunt, so he embarked on his path of cultivation too late."

"Tch! You always defend my father's weaknesses, Mother!" Xuanyuan Yue protested. "Just like my father, Zhang Fei never knew about the world of cultivation before I accidentally killed him, and he would never have known about it if I hadn't given that thing to him. However, he walked his cultivation path much earlier than my father, and he had already encountered strong cultivators since he arrived in the Sky Jade Realm. He did not have a strong protector to protect himself like my father, and he had to do whatever it took to protect himself. Fortunately, he had a strong stance and determination, and he always used his brain, unlike my father."
The woman turned to Xuanyuan Yue and raised her eyebrows. "Why do you talk about your father like that?"

"Aren't my words true?" Xuanyuan Yue refuted with pursed lips. "Do you think my father would still be alive if my aunt hadn't protected him at the beginning of his cultivation path? All of you always said that my father was smart and great, but he never used his brain when he first became a cultivator, and he relied too much on my aunt to deal with cultivators who were stronger than him. They told me that he was afraid of you when they told him about you, and he chose to hide from you, right?"

The woman nodded to Xuanyuan Yue. "You're right, your father did rely too much on your aunt back then. He was so afraid of me back then, but he never stopped working hard, and he continued to grow as time went by. In the end, he managed to reach my level and surpass me, and I have never stopped trying to catch up to him since then. Unfortunately, I was never able to reach his level, especially since he was the strongest in our universe."
'My mother is no different than a lovebird whenever we talk about my father!' Xuanyuan Yue inwardly grumbled.
"Hmm?" The woman frowned as she watched Zhang Fei [1] arrive at the underwater city's secret place. "What does he want to do?"

"He seems to want to absorb the ten-tailed fox's evil soul, Mother." The woman turned to Xuanyuan Yue with a look asking for an explanation, prompting her to explain everything to her mother. "Honestly, I still didn't expect that my actions at that time would cause a series of chain effects, and Zhang Fei was destined to become the peacemaker of this universe according to the writing."

"Show me the writing." Xuanyuan Yue showed the ten-tailed fox's writing to her mother, who immediately read it seriously. "A human, a heavenly fox, and a demon, huh? This is the reason your father asked you not to interfere in the affairs of other universes, but you did it by killing and resurrecting him, and you even gave him the results of your research."

Xuanyuan Yue smiled bitterly. "Don't keep blaming me, Mother. I didn't expect that I would accidentally kill him, so I asked Aunt Huang to revive him, and I gave it to him as a token of my apology. Moreover, I have been monitoring him for years, and he is not a bad person. Furthermore, this universe is indeed chaotic and needs a savior to fix everything, and he is destined to be one."

"Sigh." The woman let out a soft sigh. "Let's see if he will succeed in absorbing and controlling that evil soul. If he succeeds, it will be a strength for him, but it will be a disaster if he fails."
"I have witnessed many of his actions, so I believe he will succeed."
"Let's see it."
Jui Shui was surprised by Zhang Fei [1]'s arrival, especially since he had not come to see him again since he forcefully contracted him two and a half years ago.
"Open your mouth." Jui Shui was confused by that, but he did so anyway, and Zhang Fei [1] immediately threw the beast pills into his mouth. "Swallow them now, and I will go see the evil soul."
"Yes, Master."
"You two wait here." Aqua and Yuhe nodded to Zhang Fei [1], who immediately entered the secret place.
"Hmm?" The evil soul narrowed his eyes as soon as Zhang Fei [1] arrived before him. "I see, you've already got my benevolent soul, huh? Do you think you can absorb me with just that?"

"Whether I can do it or not, we'll never know until I try, right?" Zhang Fei [1] immediately released his soul, which shocked the evil soul. "Back then, my soul level had just broken through to the early stage of Earthly Soul Level, but I am different now, and my soul level has already reached the perfection stage of Ancestral Soul Level. Since you are a soul, you should be able to sense the true power of my soul, right?"

The evil soul nodded to Zhang Fei [1]. "I don't know how you did it, but your soul power is already equivalent to the soul venerate level. Unfortunately, you are too naive if you think that is enough to subdue and absorb me, and I will immediately take over your body once you absorb my soul."

"Is that so?" The evil soul frowned as soon as Zhang Fei [1] summoned Ma Kuangyu and Nalan Yushu out of his soul sea. "If I were alone, I probably wouldn't be able to absorb you, but I have them by my side, and they are much stronger than an incomplete soul like you."
"You—" The evil soul had not finished speaking; Nalan Yushu and Ma Kuangyu had already charged towards him, causing him to let out a furious roar. "You bastard! Face me yourself!"
"Aren't you naive?" Zhang Fei [1] casually responded. "Nothing is fair in the world of cultivation, and I will use everything in my possession to take you down and absorb you!"
"Master! I will possess this fox's soul now." Nalan Yushu immediately entered the ten-tailed fox's evil soul, and it was not difficult for her to weaken him by devouring his soul power.

Meanwhile, Ma Kuangyu waved his hand, and several soul chains emerged from his sleeves, which directly chained the ten-tailed fox's evil soul. He muttered something and drew the evil soul's power into his soul, making him grow even more furious.

"Let me go, you bastard!" Zhang Fei [1]'s soul quickly solidified before separating from his body, and his soul directly beat the ten-tailed fox's evil soul with full power after drawing the power from all the white lotuses within it. "Arghhh!"
Zhang Fei [1] used his light element and summoned the light female, and she showered the ten-tailed fox's evil soul with light attacks, which pierced his soul repeatedly.

The ten-tailed fox's evil soul, already weakened from being sealed there for so long, became even weaker with successive attacks from Zhang Fei [1], Ma Kuangyu, and Nalan Yuxhu, and slowly faded away. "You cheated!"

"So what? Winning is winning no matter how you achieve it!" Zhang Fei [1] summoned the demon extermination sword, channeled his light element and elemental law into it, and thrust it toward the ten-tailed fox's evil soul.
"Arghhh!" The ten-tailed fox's evil soul released a groan full of pain as Zhang Fei [1] light element flowed through his soul. "Stop! Stop it!"
"Give up and I'll stop!"
"You bastard! Arghh!"
"Wrong answer." Zhang Fei [1] channeled more of his light element into the ten-tailed fox's evil soul, as did the light female figure behind him, who continued to fire the light element at him.

A few hours later, the ten-tailed fox's evil soul had weakened significantly, as evidenced by his soul being almost transparent. Zhang Fei [1], Ma Kuangyu, and Nalan Yushu immediately stopped their actions, or he would have completely disappeared.

Zhang Fei [1] returned the demon extermination sword to his body and approached the ten-tailed fox's evil soul, which was still glaring at him fiercely despite being much weaker than before. "There's no point in you looking at me like this because your fate is already sealed, and your soul will become nutrition for mine."
"I will control you and kill everyone around you." The ten-tailed fox's evil soul threatened him.

"Unfortunately, you don't have the chance to do that." Zhang Fei [1] immediately used his soul manipulation and replicated the ten-tailed fox's evil soul before merging it with his. "This way, I have complete control over you, and you will never be able to control me."

Ma Kuangyu immediately pulled his soul chains back before breaking the chains binding the ten-tailed fox's evil soul. "Kid, prepare to break through to the Saint Soul Level, and your soul sea will probably evolve into the soul world after you absorb his soul."
"Yeah." Zhang Fei [1] immediately sat cross-legged as Nalan Yushu helped him merge their souls together by controlling the ten-tailed fox's evil soul. "Let's do it, Yushu."
"What do you think about Zhang Fei, Mother?" Xuanyuan Yue asked.
"This kid is indeed much better than your father, and he is decisive in making decisions." The woman then asked her. "Who are those two souls? Where did he meet them?"

"Hmm?" Xuanyuan Yue looked at the screen and explained it to her mother. "Nalan Yushu is the soul of a soul-devouring demon, and Ma Kuangyu is the soul of a human cultivator. Both of them are from the Paradise Realm, and Zhang Fei met them in the Star Tower."
"The Paradise Realm?"

"Yes." Xuanyuan Xue nodded. "The Paradise Realm is the supreme realm of this universe, at least that's what the inhabitants of this universe think about it. However, they don't know that there are still other realms above it, including this one."
"This one should be the primordial realm of this universe, right?"
"Haha." Xuanyuan Yue chuckled. "This one is indeed the ruins of the primordial realm of this universe, and it is almost the same as the primordial realm of our universe."
The woman nodded in understanding. "Just like our universe, this kid's universe seems to have also suffered severe damage in the past, and the effects are still continuing to this day."

"You're wrong about that, Mother." The woman turned to Xuanyuan Yue. "This universe did suffer severe damage in the past, but its condition is still much better than our universe. Many primordials still exist in this universe, including the two primordial beasts."
"Oh?" The woman was surprised to hear that, and Xuanyuan Yue immediately displayed many pictures. "Are they the primordials of this universe?"

Xuanyuan Yue nodded at her. "They are indeed the primordials, but they have long entered hibernation because this universe can no longer accommodate their power. If they wake up now, the laws in this universe will collapse, and it will cease to exist. Unlike them, the Primordial Genesis Beast and the Primordial Nihility Beast remain awake, even though they do not make any significant movements."
"Hmm?" The woman seriously observed the two primordial beasts. "This universe seems to be stronger than ours, especially since there is only one primordial beast in our universe."

"I have realized that since I arrived in this universe, and I decided to stay here to research the true strength of this universe. If my guess is correct, I might be able to do something to strengthen our universe, and my father will no longer need to be bound to our universe." The woman let out a soft sigh and rubbed her daughter's head, but Xuanyuan Yue immediately brought up Feng Yao's image. "Do you see anything different about her, Mother? I have a lot of information about her, but all of it shows that she is not an ordinary human, and she might be an existence far superior to the primordials."
"An existence that surpasses the primordials?" The woman asked with a frown.

"Yes." Xuanyuan Yue immediately showed her mother all the information she had about Feng Yao, including the information she had obtained from Zhang Fei's previous conversation with Luo Yunxiao and Hu Tianlang. "Try reading and listening to all this information, and I'm sure you'll think the same as I do about her, Mother."

The woman spent some time reading and listening to all the information about Feng Yao, and everything really shocked her. "There is no existence like her in our universe, and she seems to be a really special existence from this universe."
"Hehe! I'm right, right?"
The woman nodded. "Do you know where Feng Yao is now? If you can find her, we will go see her, and I will talk to her myself."
"There." Xuanyuan Yue pointed at the screen. "Feng Yao is in the Flame Spirit Citadel now."
"Let's go meet her, Yue."

"Oh?" The woman was surprised to hear that, and Xuanyuan Yue immediately displayed many pictures.
"Are they the primordials of this universe?"
Xuanyuan Yue nodded at her.
"They are indeed the primordials, but they have long entered hibernation because this universe can no longer accommodate their power.
If they wake up now, the laws in this universe will collapse, and it will cease to exist.
Unlike them, the Primordial Genesis Beast and the Primordial Nihility Beast remain awake, even though they do not make any significant movements."
"Hmm?" The woman seriously observed the two primordial beasts.
"This universe seems to be stronger than ours, especially since there is only one primordial beast in our universe."
"I have realized that since I arrived in this universe, and I decided to stay here to research the true strength of this universe.

If my guess is correct, I might be able to do something to strengthen our universe, and my father will no longer need to be bound to our universe." The woman let out a soft sigh and rubbed her daughter's head, but Xuanyuan Yue immediately brought up Feng Yao's image.
"Do you see anything different about her, Mother?
I have a lot of information about her, but all of it shows that she is not an ordinary human, and she might be an existence far superior to the primordials."
"An existence that surpasses the primordials?" The woman asked with a frown.

"Yes." Xuanyuan Yue immediately showed her mother all the information she had about Feng Yao, including the information she had obtained from Zhang Fei's previous conversation with Luo Yunxiao and Hu Tianlang.
"Try reading and listening to all this information, and I'm sure you'll think the same as I do about her, Mother."
The woman spent some time reading and listening to all the information about Feng Yao, and everything really shocked her.
"There is no existence like her in our universe, and she seems to be a really special existence from this universe."
"Hehe!
I'm right, right?"
The woman nodded.
"Do you know where Feng Yao is now?
If you can find her, we will go see her, and I will talk to her myself."
"There." Xuanyuan Yue pointed at the screen.
"Feng Yao is in the Flame Spirit Citadel now."
"Let's go meet her, Yue."

[The system has been revamped and upgraded to level 7.]

- New materials are available in the alchemist and blacksmith shops.
- New pills are available in the pill shop.
[The training space has been upgraded to level 4.]
The environment control feature has been added, which allows the owner to adjust the training space according to his cultivation needs.
- The time-flow feature has been accelerated to four times faster. While previously this feature did not affect lifespan, it now affects the lifespan of everyone living within it.
[The Yin-Yang Space has been upgraded.]
- Five new vacant rooms are now available.
- Qi production is doubled.
[Quest feature has been upgraded.]

The appearance of a series of notifications surprised Zhang Fei [1], but he immediately ignored them because he was approaching the final process of fusing his soul with the ten-tailed fox's evil soul.
After another day, the ten-tailed fox's evil soul finally disappeared after fusing with Zhang Fei [1]'s soul.
[Ding]
[The host obtained half of the ten-tailed fox's soul power.]
[The host's soul power level has increased to the perfection stage of the saint soul level.]

Zhang Fei [1] suddenly felt a tremendous turbulence in his soul sea. Just as Ma Kuangyu had said before, his soul sea began to undergo changes after he finished absorbing the ten-tailed fox's evil soul.
Zhang Fei [1] immediately brought Ma Kuangyu and Nalan Yushu back into his soul sea, and they saw that the situation inside was very chaotic. "How should I turn my soul sea into a soul world?"

"Haha." Nalan Yushu giggled. "That's easy, Master. First, you must stabilize and refine your soul sea. Second, create the soul pillars, which are the foundation for your soul world. Third, create the firmament. Once everything is done, your soul sea will transform into a soul world."

"Even if you successfully form your soul world, you cannot bring other living beings into it yet." Zhang Fei [1] turned to Ma Kuangyu, asking for a more detailed explanation. "When a soul world is born, it is still in its infant stage, and you must nourish it with many things. You can use your soul power, soul items, other living beings' souls, and many more. Your soul world will expand by itself, and the sky will be the first to form, followed by earth, water, air, day, and night. However, you must understand the most vital thing first, which is the laws of the world. The world would be chaotic without them, and they regulate everything in it to make it balanced and habitable."
"The laws?"

"The law of space, the law of gravity, the law of death, the law of birth, the law of rebirth, and many others." After hearing all that from Ma Kuangyu, Zhang Fei [1] sighed heavily. "Haha! I understand that you are disappointed due to the complexity, but that is the reality. Many soul cultivators in the Paradise Realm have succeeded in creating their own soul worlds, but they are still unable to bring other living creatures to live in their worlds, including those who have cultivated for millions of years."
"Master, do it now, or your soul sea will become even more chaotic, and you will suffer severe injury to your soul." Nalan Yushu warned Zhang Fei [1].
"All right." Zhang Fei [1] immediately floated in the air, closed his eyes, and tried to follow the guidance of the two people.
Nalan Yushu looked at Zhang Fei [1]. "Do you think he'll succeed in one try?"

"No." Ma Kuangyu shook his head at her. "This kid indeed has extraordinary comprehension, and he can understand various things faster than anyone else. However, turning our soul sea into a soul world is not an easy matter, and many of them failed repeatedly before succeeding in doing so."

Nalan Yushu nodded her head repeatedly. "Thanks to the ten-tailed fox's benevolent and evil souls, his soul level broke through several stages at once in a day, and he has already surpassed his master now. Unfortunately, it is not enough to fight against the soul cultivators in the Paradise Realm, especially since most of them have already reached the Divine Soul Level."

"That's right." Ma Kuangyu replied with a soft sigh. "Breaking through from the ancestral soul level to the saint soul level should have taken thousands of years, but he managed to achieve it because of those two souls. In my opinion, it will be a loss for him, and he will have considerable difficulty when he forms his divine soul in the future."
Meanwhile, Xuanyuan Yue and her mother had arrived at the Flame Spirit Citadel, but they were surprised to find Feng Yao waiting for them there.
"Why do people from another universe like you two come to my universe?" Feng Yao's question shocked Xuanyuan Yue and her mother.
Xuanyuan Yue immediately asked. "How did you know that we came from another universe?"

"The first reason is because the Qi in both of your bodies is different from the Qi in this universe, and the second reason is Zhang Fei." Xuanyuan Yue inwardly grumbled at Feng Yao's second reason. "To be frank, I am furious about your actions toward him; however, I also feel fortunate that you took those actions, little girl."

"Haha." Xuanyuan Yue laughed awkwardly at that. "I accidentally killed Zhang Fei, and I just wanted to repay him for my mistakes. However, I did not expect that my actions at that time would trigger a series of chain events, which also brought significant changes to this universe."
Feng Yao released a soft sigh. "Everything has happened, and it is also useful for this universe, so I will let you go this time."

"Phew." Xuanyuan Yue exhaled in relief as she patted her chest. "At first, I thought you were a member of that race, but I just got some new information about you, including your old identity as the primordial named Shen Yuanzhi. From there, I realized that my guess was wrong, and your existence should be higher than the primordials."
"Oh?" Feng Yao raised her eyebrows. "So, you've been spying on Zhang Fei all this time, huh?"

"Yes." Xuanyuan Yue did not hide it. "I spied on Zhang Fei not because I wanted to know his personal affairs, but because he had my research results in his body, and I did not want him to use them for evil. If he uses it for evil purposes, I will immediately withdraw it from him."

Feng Yao nodded in understanding. "Everything that belongs to Zhang Fei is your creation, such as his training space, Yin-Yang Space, and many others. Besides, there is something else inside his body that prevents me from examining him, right?"
"Hehehe." Xuanyuan Yue laughed while sticking out her tongue.
Feng Yao then spoke again. "You're right, my existence is indeed higher than the primordials, but I won't tell you anything, especially since it could affect the future of this universe."
"Cheapskate!" Xuanyuan Yue pursed her lips.
"Hehe." Feng Yao chuckled before looking at the other woman. "Do you have any questions for me?"

The woman immediately introduced herself to Feng Yao before conveying the purpose of her visit. "I would like to ask you how you managed to escape the shackles of this universe. My husband is shackled by our universe, and he cannot escape from it, making him unable to leave his place."

"You are mistaken; I have not yet escaped the shackles of this universe." Feng Yao's answer confused the two women. "If I had escaped the shackles, I wouldn't be here now, and I wouldn't have been reincarnated over and over again to find the right person to help me escape the shackles. If your daughter had not come to my universe and done all that to Zhang Fei, I would have continued to reincarnate until that person appeared. Unfortunately, he was not ready to help me, so I had to wait for a long time."
"What should Zhang Fei do to help you to break free from the shackles of this universe?" The woman asked.
Feng Yao shook her head. "I can't be sure about that yet, and I have to wait for Zhang Fei to reach the Five Celestial Realms first."

"I see." The woman sighed in disappointment after hearing that. "I hope you are willing to share the method if you have found one, and I will try it to free my husband from the shackles of our universe."
Feng Yao did not immediately give the woman an answer and thought for a while. "How did you two come to this universe?"

"Me." Feng Yao raised an eyebrow at Xuanyuan Yue. "My father has an artifact that allows him to travel to other universes, but only he can use it. Therefore, I created a flying artifact using the basic principles of that artifact, and it took me ten thousand years to successfully create it."
"How many other universes are there besides our two?"

"Too many that I can't remember their number, but you don't need to mind them, especially since they don't have the ability to go to other universes like me." Feng Yao was surprised by that, and Xuanyuan Yue told her something else. "I have gone to several other universes to find a way to free my father from the shackles of our universe, but unfortunately, I have not managed to find a way for him. Initially, I was not sure whether Zhang Fei would be able to break free from the shackles of the universe in the future, but after observing him for more than three years, I am confident that he will be able to do so. Therefore, I will continue to monitor him, and I will meet him after he succeeds in doing so."

Feng Yao then warned Xuanyuan Yue. "I don't mind if you do that, but I hope you don't meddle in Zhang Fei's life again. If you do anything else, I'm afraid his future will change once again, and we will never find a way to break free from the shackles of the universe."
"I know." Xuanyuan Yue nodded in understanding and then asked a question. "So, what is your true identity?"

"Why are you so curious about my identity?" Feng Yao smiled as she responded, which annoyed Xuanyuan Yue. "Since you keep monitoring Zhang Fei, you will know my identity in the future. Therefore, you just need to be patient until the time comes, and you will know everything then."

Xuanyuan Yue sighed heavily because Feng Yao was too secretive, but she then spoke to her mother. "Let's go back, Mother. If Zhang Fei manages to find a way to escape the shackles of this universe, I will tell you right away so you and the others can free my father from that place."
"Thank you for your time, and we will leave now." The woman spoke to Feng Yao.
"Don't mind it." After the two women disappeared from the place, Huo Ling immediately appeared by Feng Yao's side. "What do you think of them?"

"That woman's husband should be the ruler of their universe, and his existence should be equal to yours, Master." Huo Ling then asked her. "Do you really believe that Zhang Fei can help you break free from the shackles? What will happen to this universe if you disappear?"

"Hmm?" Feng Yao looked up at the sky and thought about that. "Zhang Fei can't do it now, but I believe that he can do it in the future. When he reaches the peak of cultivation in the future, this universe will probably change a lot, and many outstanding cultivators will appear by then, so I believe that this universe will be fine without me. Moreover, it is still too early to talk about this matter because I still haven't made a decision about my future, and the future is still very long."

Huo Ling exhaled deeply before embracing Feng Yao. "Do you have the heart to leave me alone? We have been together for several lifetimes, and you have become an important part of my life. The thought of you disappearing forever has always scared me, and I don't know whether I can accept it or not."

"Why are you being sentimental now?" Feng Yao then pulled Huo Ling onto her lap and gave her a brief kiss. "Honestly, I can't bear to leave you alone, but you've known my destiny since the day we met, and my destiny began to move since Zhang Fei died three years ago. The stronger he became, the closer my destiny came to reality. My fate will be fulfilled when he reaches the top of this universe, and we will have to separate at that time."

Huo Ling felt sad and hugged Feng Yao tighter. "That's why I hate him so much! If he wasn't born in this universe, your destiny would never have moved. If you disappeared later, it would be his fault, and I will never forgive him."
"I'm sorry, Huo Ling." Feng Yao could only say that as she embraced the fire spirit, who began to sob in her arms.

Days passed quickly, and a week had already passed in the Three Mortal Realms. Aqua and Yuhe, who had been waiting for a long time in front of the underwater city's secret place, decided to check inside, especially since Zhang Fei [1] still hadn't come out from there.
The two female undines exchanged confused glances upon seeing Zhang Fei [1] sitting motionless, and they speculated that he was battling the ten-tailed fox's evil soul in his soul sea.
"What do you think happened to him, Sister Aqua?" Yuhe asked her question while walking closer to Zhang Fei [1].

Aqua also approached Zhang Fei [1] and observed him. "I don't know for sure, but I believe that nothing bad happened to him, especially since he looks so calm now. If the evil soul influenced him, I'm sure he wouldn't be this calm, and he would have already wreaked havoc in this city."
"Yeah, you're right." Yuhe nodded in agreement. "Since he's fine, you can go back to your place and take care of other things, and I'll wait for him to wake up here."

"You can contact me if there are any changes to him, and I'll come here right away." Thereafter, Aqua immediately left the place, and Yuhe sat a little away from Zhang Fei [1], waiting for him to wake up.
Jia Yuyan and the others continued to monitor Zhang Xiaolong [3] from the Qi screen in the Sovereign Heaven Realm, but he showed no progress in the Dao test.

Leng Hua had joined them, but he wore an angry expression because his subordinate had not returned for a week. He was sure that Tian Jingxuan had disrupted his plan to capture Zhang Xiaolong [3], but he did not ask him anything, especially since the other clans seemed to support him.

Leng Hua asked his daughter about their situation, but Leng Xueyan only answered with a few words, and she was more focused on observing Zhang Xiaolong [3], which irritated him. 'What really happened to her? After she disappeared that time, her attitude changed quite significantly, and she seemed to really care about this kid.'
"Hey! Look! His Dao test is finally starting!" Shi Yan suddenly shouted.
Jia Yuyan nodded in agreement with him. "However, this is just the beginning, and he will undergo the true Dao test soon."
"Do you think he will succeed, Yuyan?" Shangguan Yan asked.
Jia Yuyan shook her head. "We just have to wait and see whether he will succeed or not."
