chapters.title: Chapter 966: The Dao Test
paragraphs: Even though his eyes were closed, Zhang Xiaolong [3] could feel the changes in his surroundings. He could feel the emptiness and silence enveloping him, which made his mind, heart, and soul extremely calm.
Mu Ling, who was waiting in the distance, continued to watch Zhang Xiaolong [3] seriously.

’He’s finally started! I hope you can make good use of this opportunity, kid.’ Mu Ling turned his head when he heard two footsteps, and he saw Tian Baitian and Tian Baixing walking towards him. ’Heh! It took them a week to pass the loyalty and righteousness test! If they are like this, there’s no way they can comprehend the Dao.’
Tian Baitian and Tian Baixing ignored Mu Ling and stood a short distance away from him, glaring at Zhang Xiaolong, who was sitting in mid-air with calm expressions on his face.
’Brother, he seems to be starting his final test.’ Tian Baixing whispered.
Tian Baitian nodded in understanding as he stole a glance at Mu Ling. ’What do you think if we attack that brat when his test has already started?’

’Are you serious about that?’ Tian Baixing asked with a frown. ’If we do that, the people from this realm will expel us, and our efforts in the past two years will end in vain. Moreover, you should remember that there are strong restrictions in the entire test area, and this guy will immediately activate them to stop us.’
Tian Baitian let out a heavy sigh as he nodded. ’Forget it, we’ll take care of this kid after we finish the last test, and no one will stop us anymore at that time.’
Rumble... Rumble...
The sky above the area suddenly rumbled, and a pillar of light descended from it, enveloping Zhang Xiaolong.
"What Is the Dao?"

That question only appeared in Zhang Xiaolong [3]’s mind. ’The Dao is the path! It cannot be fully defined because it’s beyond words or concepts! It is the origin of all things and the natural order of existence! It is the fundamental law of existence and the path of cultivation! It is the truth that governs the universe!’
"What in this universe embodies the Dao?
’Everything! Life, death, sky, earth, time, elements, emotions, heart, and even the sword have the Dao!’
"Why seek the Dao?"
’The Dao brings enlightenment, insight, and power. Cultivators seek it to comprehend and master it to achieve transcendence and immortality.’
"How to Understand the Dao?"

’Meditate to comprehend their Dao! Enlightenment may come through nature, life experiences, or insight in battle! Near-death experiences, tragedies, or emotional breakthroughs may spark Dao comprehension!’
"How to master the Dao?"

Zhang Xiaolong [3] thought for some time before giving his answer. ’A cultivator needs the Dao Heart to master the Dao, which is their mental clarity and resolve regarding their Dao! If your Dao Heart is unstable or impure, you’ll likely fail and even face Qi deviation or death!’
"What is the Dao Heart?"
’The Dao Heart is the core of a cultivator’s will. The faith in one path. The stability of a person’s heart. A freedom from doubt, fear, and regret.’
"How to attain the Dao Heart?"
’The Dao Heart can be achieved through many things.’
"What is the hardest thing to achieve the Dao Heart?"
’Overcome our inner demons, such as guilt, fear, regret, desire, and weakness. One must confront and overcome them in order to achieve heart stability; only then can we achieve the Dao Heart.’
"What can damage and destroy the Dao Heart?"
’Extreme emotions like obsession, hatred, or excessive attachment to something can corrupt the Dao Heart, which will ultimately destroy it.’
"How to forge the Dao Heart to attain the Dao?"
’Like forging an equipment, the Dao Heart can be tempered through various things, such as experience, pain, loss, fear, betrayal, loneliness, fear, and many more.’
"What is your Dao?"
’I am the path! I am the Dao!’
After Zhang Xiaolong [3] said that, many illusions appeared in his mind. He momentarily frowned, but his negate illusion ability immediately kicked in and negated them.

After the illusion disappeared, many things that Zhang Xiaolong [3] desired appeared in his mind, tempting him to take them. Naturally, he knew that it was just a temptation to test his resolve, and he did nothing.

Next, many naked women appeared around him, and many of them were women he really wanted, including Feng Yao. They surrounded him, cared for him, hugged him, and kissed him. However, such things would never work against him, especially with so many women by his side, most of whom possessed peerless beauty.

A few minutes later, the women disappeared by themselves, and the sky above the area quickly darkened. Zhang Xiaolong [3] could feel the immense pressure coming from the sky, but he was not the least bit worried about it because it was still weaker than the pressure he experienced when he broke through to the Seven Divine Realm.
Mu Ling, Tian Baitian, and Tian Baixing were shocked when a large, golden lightning spear descended from the sky.
’This kid only needs to pass this tribulation to complete his Dao test.’ Mu Ling inwardly muttered with a satisfied smile on his face.
’Hahaha!’ Tian Baitian laughed triumphantly in his heart. ’Kill him for me! I don’t need to bother killing him, and I will extract his bloodline to evolve into ten tails!’
Unlike his brother, Tian Baixing was confident that Zhang Xiaolong [3] would succeed, especially after witnessing the lightning tribulations they faced during the karmic test. ’Can I pass this test?’
*Rumble...Rumble...*
*Swoosh*

The lightning spear shot down toward Zhang Xiaolong [3], who immediately activated his lightning element and elemental law to counter it, causing the two to collide in midair and produce a loud explosion.
*Boom*

After the effects of the explosion disappeared, the pillar of light that enveloped Zhang Xiaolong [3] became brighter, and he felt something he had never experienced before, which made him much calmer than usual.
[Ding]
[The host successfully formed the Dao Heart, allowing the host to embark on a journey to understand the Dao.]

Zhang Xiaolong [3] breathed a sigh of relief and opened his eyes. He looked up at the sky with a calm but firm gaze, and his body exuded a gentle and calming aura, unlike his usual fierce and bloody aura. He raised both hands, clenched his fists, and felt the changes. "So, this is my initial path to comprehending the true dao, huh? Which dao should I comprehend first?"
[What else, Master? You are originally a dual cultivator, so you should try to comprehend the dao of dual cultivation first.]

’Hahaha!’ Zhang Xiaolong [3] laughed inwardly upon hearing that. ’The dao of dual cultivation shouldn’t be too difficult, right? In fact, I have long understood it, but not all dual cultivators can understand the true essence of the dual cultivation, and many of them misunderstand it. Dual cultivation is not merely about physical intimacy, but it is more about the balance of yin and yang, body and soul, desire and transcendence.’
[Since when do you understand that, Master?]

’Ever since I studied the Forbidden Lotus Codex and mastered the Lotus Ascension Art. Otherwise, I wouldn’t have been able to form so many white lotuses in my soul, especially since that technique basically uses principles from the Dao of the dual cultivation.’ Zhang Xiaolong [3]’s answer made Mei speechless. ’The dao of dual cultivation is to unite and balance the two different forces, Yin and Yang. True dual cultivators must resonate spiritually, not just physically, with their partners. After all, the dual cultivation path is a mutual path, like your gain and pain are mine, and we will grow together.’

"Congratulations." Zhang Xiaolong [3] turned to Mu Ling, who immediately handed him a plaque. "You have successfully passed the Dao test, and this is the end of it. From now on, you are a member of our realm, and you can come and go whenever you want. Our leaders are already waiting for you elsewhere, so I will take you to them now."
"All right." Zhang Xiaolong [3] glanced briefly at Tian Baitian and Tian Baixing before flying away following Mu Ling.
"That bastard! I didn’t expect him to survive and successfully comprehend the dao!" Tian Baitian shouted angrily, and he immediately went to the center of the area to undergo his test.
Unlike her brother, Tian Baixing was in no hurry to undergo her test, and she chose to sit at the edge of the area to prepare herself, especially since she did not have the confidence to pass it.
Before long, they had arrived at the place where the leaders of the Sovereign Heaven Realm were gathered together, but Zhang Xiaolong [3] frowned as soon as he felt the hostility from Leng Hua.
Since Yuan Tianling had told him about the old man, Zhang Xiaolong [3] could immediately recognize him, and he was sure that Leng Hua was the one who sent people to do something to him a week ago.

Zhang Xiaolong [3] paid no attention to Leng Hua and instead stole a glance at Leng Xueyan, who looked awkward while gazing at him. I’ve come to see her in her dreams in recent years, and she must be shocked to know that I’m a real person.’

Jia Yuyan immediately approached Zhang Xiaolong [3] and spoke to him. "As I expected, you successfully passed all the tests, including the Dao test. Moreover, you completed them all in just a few days, which is the best record so far."
"You know that I have a lot of questions for you, right?"
"Yes." Jia Yuyan nodded in response. "You can come to the eastern forest whenever you want, and I will answer all your questions then."
"All right, I’ll see you soon." Zhang Xiaolong [3] then turned to Shangguan Yan, who was walking towards him. "Pardon me, but I’m still undecided about your offer."

Shangguan Yan nodded in understanding. "I’m not in a hurry about your decision, so you can take your time to think things over while enjoying your new life in our realm. Once you’ve decided, you can meet me at my Shangguan Clan, and we’ll talk more then."
"Yes." Zhang Xiaolong [3] nodded at her.

Shi Yan, Qing Huang, and Tian Jingxuan approached Zhang Xiaolong [3]. "Kid, there are several sects in our realm, and you can join one of them if you are interested. However, the three of us want to take you as our disciple, and we hope that you will not reject our wishes."
Leng Hua frowned after Tian Jingxuan said that, and he immediately spoke to Zhang Xiaolong [3]. "Hey, kid! I also want to recruit you as my disciple, and I don’t want to hear any rejection from you."

"Do you think I would accept a request from someone who previously tried to harm me, Senior?" Leng Hua frowned deeper after Zhang Xiaolong [3] mentioned that. "I was indeed focused on dealing with my lightning tribulations at that time, but I could sense someone sneaking up on me and trying to attack me. Luckily, someone stopped him in advance, or he would have died by my hands."
"You—" Leng Hua stopped speaking as soon as Zhang Xiaolong [3] released his aura. ’How is this possible? How can his aura match mine?’

Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately spoke again. "Senior, I may be younger and weaker than you, but I will not be afraid of you because I have fought with many senior cultivators with strength equal to yours, and I managed to defeat them all."

Leng Hua narrowed his fierce eyes in response, but Tian Jingxuan and the others immediately prepared to stop him if he suddenly made a move. He snorted at them before leaving the room, but he sent a voice message to Leng Xueyan to bring Zhang Xiaolong [3] to their clan no matter what.

"Hahaha!" Shi Yan suddenly laughed and patted Zhang Xiaolong [3]’s shoulder. "Old Leng didn’t witness it when you went through the battle test a week ago, so he doesn’t know anything about your true strength. I know you’re strong, but you should still be careful of him because he’s a vengeful person, and no one in the younger generation has ever dared to challenge him before."

"Old Shi is right, Kid." Qing Huang said this while stroking his long beard. "Since you’ve challenged Old Leng like that, I’m sure he’ll make a move on you sooner or later, and he won’t hesitate to use all kinds of underhanded means to fulfill his ambitions. Therefore, you must always be on guard against him, or you’ll suffer if you let your guard down."

Tian Jingxuan then spoke to him. "Welcome to our realm, and I hope you can think about our previous offer. Once you have decided, you can meet us here again, and the three of us will train you very well."
"Thank you for your offer and advice, seniors." Zhang Xiaolong [3] said this while cupping his hands to them. "I will definitely think about your offer well."

Tian Jingxuan and the others nodded at him. "We still have a lot to talk to you about, but you have just gone through a series of tiring tests, so Jiantang and Little Yun will take you somewhere else to rest."

"Thank you." Thereafter, Tian Jiantang and Qing Yun led Zhang Xiaolong [3] to leave that place and took him away to his new residence in that realm. He did not forget to send a voice message to Leng Xueyan. ’Senior, if you are so curious about me, you can meet me at my residence tonight.’
Leng Xueyan raised her eyebrows slightly after hearing that, but she immediately replied to him. ’All right, I will meet you tonight.’
On the way, Tian Jiantang and Qing Yun explained many things to Zhang Xiaolong [3], especially about the sects and clans in that realm.
However, Zhang Xiaolong [3] did not come to that realm to join any of the sects or clans, so he was not interested in them. "Can you guys tell me about the Sky Flame?"
"Oh?" Both men were surprised by the question, and Tian Jiantang then asked Zhang Xiaolong [3] about it. "Did you come to this realm because of the Sky Flame?"

"Yes." Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately admitted it. "I’m a fire cultivator by nature, and I heard from my father-in-law that the Sky Flame is here. I hope to get a little of the flame to strengthen my fire element."

"I see." Tian Jiantang nodded in understanding and pointed in the distance. "The Sky Flame is in that area, and all fire cultivators are free to go there. However, not all fire cultivators can approach the Sky Flame because it possesses a spirit that will reject anyone deemed unworthy. If you attempt to approach the flame forcefully after being rejected by the spirit, it will immediately attack you with great strength. Therefore, exercise caution when attempting this, as it could result in serious injury."
Zhang Xiaolong [3] turned towards the direction while nodding. "Thank you for your advice, Brother."
"Brother, how about we have another spar tomorrow?" Qing Yun suddenly asked.
Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately refused, especially since he already had other plans. "I’m sorry, Brother. I wanted to get a full rest for tomorrow, but we can do that the day after tomorrow."
"All right, we will do it the day after tomorrow."

Before long, they had arrived in front of a residence that was not too big but not too small either, and it was quite luxurious. On his map, Zhang Xiaolong [3] could see that there were two maids inside. Meanwhile, two male guards were stationed in front of the building, and they possessed a high level of cultivation at the 5-Moon Divine Transformation Realm. ’Such strong cultivators were assigned to be guards, huh?’

Tian Jiantang spoke immediately. "Brother, this residence will be your personal residence, and they will serve all your needs. So you only need to order them if you need anything, and they will bring it to you."

"Actually, this residence is too much, but I will accept your kindness." After Tian Jiantang and Qing Yun left, Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately entered the residence, where the two maids greeted him. "What are the names of you two?"
The older maid immediately introduced herself. "My name is Qing Dongya, Young Master."
"My name is Tian Yiyuan, Young Master." The younger maid introduced herself.

’Two people from the Tian and Qing Clans, huh?’ Zhang Xiaolong [3] muttered to himself. "My name is Zhang Xiaolong, and you two don’t need to address me as a young master. By the way, I’m going to rest now, and I don’t want any disturbances."
"Yes, Young Master." Zhang Xiaolong [3] could only sigh and leave the two women straightaway.

paragraphs: "There are no more daily quests before I ascend to the Paradise Realm, huh? Although they waste my time, their rewards are quite useful, so it’s really a shame." Zhang Xiaolong [3] lay on his bed, reading every change in the system. One of his clones, who was training in the training space, immediately went to the healing chamber to check.

To Zhang Xiaolong [3]’s surprise, the healing chamber contained many modern pieces of equipment that were far more advanced than those found in the hospitals of the Xianjin Realm, and its healing effects were also significantly faster.

"The healing chamber is a perfect addition, and I can recover faster if I experience injuries from training or my lightning tribulation." Zhang Xiaolong [3] read the next one. "The increase in the capacity of the Qi storage is not significant, as it is only twenty million, and the Qi I need is much more than that. Nevertheless, I believe it is still useful, and I can utilize the qi stored within it as a backup in case I exhaust my qi in the Yin-Yang Space."
[Master, the system has upgraded the Yin-Yang Space, and you can add five new prisoners there. Moreover, their Qi production will double, so I think you will never run out of spare Qi.]

Then, Zhang Xiaolong [3] checked the other shops, and he found many blueprints in the blacksmith shop, most of which were divine grade. As for the divine-grade equipment in the shop, their prices are simply exorbitant, and the cheapest one costs tens of millions of purple jewels.

In the alchemy shop, Zhang Xiaolong [3] found many new alchemy recipes, and they were different from the new pills in the pill shop. Zhang Xiaolong [3] sighed in disappointment at this, but he turned excited after reading the list of new pills in the pill shop, all of which were useful for him and all his women. Zhang Xiaolong [3] was satisfied with the environment control feature of the training space, so he could train in the most extreme places to temper himself. However, the changes to the time flow made him consider moving his women, family members, and friends to the outside world, especially since they will age quickly due to the four-times faster time flow.

[Master, you can see your lifespan and other people now.]
"Oh? Show it to me, Mei."
[Yes.]
[Status]
Name: Zhang Fei

Mei, please show me the lifespan for each level of cultivation.’

No wonder Senior Xia said that people in this realm can live that long. Is the system able to calculate the lifespan of cultivators in the Five Celestial Realms, Mei?"

[Not yet, Master. Perhaps you should ascend to the Paradise Realm first, and the system might update it then. Since the cultivators at the Divine Ascension Realm can live for a million years or more, I think the cultivators at the Five Celestial Realms can live for tens of millions or even hundreds of millions of years.]

"Yeah, you’re right." Zhang Xiaolong [3] suddenly smiled to himself, especially since his first clone had finished transforming his soul sea into a tiny soul world, which made his soul power increase quite significantly. He then sat down by the bed and summoned the spirit of the Earth Flame, Huo Diqiu, out of his soul world. "Can you feel the presence of the spirit of the Sky Flame?"
"Hehehe." Huo Diqiu laughed at that. "That’s a trivial matter for me, Master. Do you want me to go see the spirit now?"

"Yes." Zhang Xiaolong [3] nodded at him. "If possible, I want you to go meet that spirit and talk to him about me, but you must be careful of the people from this realm, especially since they will capture you if they notice your presence."
"All right! I’m going to meet that spirit now, and I’ll definitely be careful." Huo Diqiu immediately dashed away through the window.
Knock... Knock...
"Young master, I have prepared bathwater for you."

"Honestly, you two don’t have to go through the trouble of doing such a thing for me, and you guys can stop addressing me as a young master, especially since I’m not the young master of any clan."
Qing Dongya shook her head in rejection. "You are an important guest in this realm, and our ancestor has ordered us to serve all your needs, Young Master."
"Let us do our duty, or they will punish us, Young Master." Tian Yiyuan spoke with her gentle voice.
"All right, you two can do whatever they tell you." Tian Yiyuan and Qing Dongya then led Zhang Xiaolong [3] to the bathing place.

"Oh?" Zhang Xiaolong [3] was a little surprised when they arrived there because the bathing place was more like a hot spring, and there was something underneath that kept the water boiling. "You two can go now, and I’ll soak myself."

’He has such a monstrous thing!’ Tian Yiyuan and Qing Dongya exclaimed in shock, but they were confused because Zhang Xiaolong [3] did not glance at them. ’Are we not attractive in his eyes? We heard that he was a dual cultivator, and our ancestor ordered us to serve him because of that, but he just ignored us.’

Zhang Fei [1] floated with a satisfied smile inside his tiny soul world. Although it was still tiny, he could continue to expand it, and he was determined to do so as soon as possible. "Can I use the souls of ordinary beasts, demons, and demon beasts to expand this tiny world?"

"Yes, you can use them, Master." Nalan Yushu responded by nodding. "However, you should not use those with low levels because their souls are too weak, and you should look for those with high levels."
"I got it." Zhang Fei [1] exhaled softly. "I’ll go out now."
"Yes."
After Zhang Fei [1] disappeared, Nalan Yushu immediately posed a question to Ma Kuangyu. "How long do you think it will take him to make this tiny soul world into a true world that is habitable?"

"I can’t be certain about it." Ma Kuangyu looked around the area. "Even though it is still in the infant stage, this tiny soul world is much stronger than the usual ones, and he will probably need much more resources to develop it. Once this tiny soul world turns into a true soul world, there will be no soul cultivator who can fight against him. At that time, he will become the strongest soul cultivator, even in the Paradise Realm."

"Hey, old ma! Have you ever thought anything about a soul world?" Ma Kuangyu turned to Nalan Yushu with a questioning look. "As you know, a soul cultivator can create and bring other living beings into his or her soul world, and I heard that a soul world can turn into a soul universe. This fact led me to consider an absurd hypothesis, which might actually be a reality."
"Do you think that we live in a soul cultivator’s soul world?" Ma Kuangyu responded in a serious tone.

Nalan Yushu nodded in response. "I know my hypothesis is quite crazy, but I think other cultivators, especially those soul cultivators, must have thought the same as me. What do you think would happen if my hypothesis turned out to be a fact and our universe resides in the soul of an extremely powerful soul cultivator?"

"Hmm?" Ma Kuangyu frowned deeply after hearing that. "Your hypothesis does sound crazy, but I agree with you, and such a thing could be the truth. Unfortunately, we don’t have the ability to uncover the truth, but I believe that kid might be able to do it one day in the future, so we just have to wait for him to become the best of the best."

"You’re right." Nalan Yushu nodded in agreement. "The first time I met him at the Star Tower, I doubted his abilities, but now I believe that he can do such a thing. Unfortunately, he still has a long and rocky road to go on to become the best of the best, and we will no longer be able to help him once he ascends to our realm."
Ma Kuanyu let out a soft sigh after Nalan Yushu mentioned that. "I hope Zhang Fei will ascend to our realm soon so I can reshape my body, and I will take revenge on those traitors."
"Hehe." Nalan Yushu chuckled. "Just like you, I also can’t wait to reshape my body, and I will kill that bastard who killed and imprisoned my soul in the Star Tower."
"Who was the person who killed you?"
"A female winged race named Tian Qiye." Thereafter, Ma Kuangyu and Nalan Yushu shared stories about their past, especially about their deaths and grudges.
"Did you wait long?" Zhang Fei [1] asked Yuhe as he stood up.
"A week." Yuhe replied as she shook her head. "Are we leaving now?"
"Yes." Zhang Fei [1] then led Yuhe to leave the secret place, and he first sent the nine-headed serpent beast into the beast space before they went to meet Aqua.

After they said goodbye to Aqua, Zhang Fei [1] took Yuhe to the Natural Race Kingdom to meet the other Natural Race members, such as Sabina, Oliver, and the others. He then sent them away to the Evergreen Spirit Haven Realm, and he ordered Da Xiongmao to give them the best residence there.
Just as he wanted to leave the place, Zhang Fei [1] sensed Xian Jinglan’s movements, and he immediately went to the palace to meet the elf princess.

"Eh?" Xian Jinglan was surprised by the sudden appearance of Zhang Fei [1], but she immediately went into shock as soon as she detected his cultivation, causing her to sigh heavily. "I was in seclusion for two and a half years, and my cultivation only broke through one stage to the 5-Moon Divine Transcend Realm. Yet, you broke through from the Earth Realm to the Divine Transcend Realm, which made me disappointed with my own progress."

"Haha." Zhang Fei [1] laughed awkwardly. "Why should you be disappointed with your progress? You are an ordinary cultivator, and I am a dual cultivator. Unlike you, I have dozens of women helping me, and I also get a lot of help from others, so you don’t need to be disappointed. Your parents are at the Star Tower with the others now, and they should have almost finished the first floor, so I think you can wait for them on the second floor."
"What about you? Have you challenged the second floor?" Xian Jinglan curiously asked.
Zhang Fei [1] nodded at her. "My real body, Xian Xianqin, and the others are challenging the third floor now. We will probably complete all the challenges on that floor in the next few days."
"I see." Xian Jinglan nodded in understanding. "What have you done in this realm while I was in seclusion? Why do I feel that the situation in this realm has changed significantly?"

"This realm has indeed changed, and all races are united now." Xian Jinglan was shocked to hear that, and Zhang Fei [1] immediately explained to her everything that had happened since she entered seclusion, which shocked her further. "I will send you to the Star Tower now, and I will return to seclusion."
"All right." After Zhang Fei [1] sent Xian Jinglan and Lang to the Star Tower, he immediately entered the training space, starting his training using level 5 of the gravity feature again.
Meanwhile, Huo Diqiu had arrived at the location of the Sky Flame, and he saw an old man standing guard at the entrance, which was a small cave.
"Hmm?" The old man immediately noticed Huo Diqiu’s presence and moved towards him. He immediately grabbed him. "A fire spirit, eh? How did you get here?"
"Hey, old man! Let go of me, or my master will kick your ass!" Huo Diqiu shouted as he punched the old man with both of his small fists.
"Hahaha!" The old man laughed at that. "Do you think your master would dare to mess around in my realm?"
"Humph!" Huo Diqiu snorted at the old man. "My master is no ordinary cultivator! Otherwise, I, the mighty Huo Diqiu, will not acknowledge him as my master!"
"Who is your master? Why did he send you here?" The old man asked.

"My master didn’t send me here! I came here because I sensed my brother’s presence, and I wanted to meet him! The old man was not surprised to hear that Huo Diqiu could sense the presence of the spirit of the Sky Flame. "Hey! Let me go! I want to meet my brother! As for my master, you can ask your leader directly; he even wants to recruit him into his Tian Clan!"

"Oh?" The old man grew curious about that, and he immediately contacted Tian Jingxuan, who explained to him about Zhang Xiaolong [3]. "Your master is really great, huh? He managed to pass all the tests in just a few days."
"Hahaha!" Huo Diqiu laughed at that. "Your leader still doesn’t know the full extent of my master’s greatness, and he is far greater than people think!"
"Oh?" The old man immediately checked Zhang Xiaolong [3]’s residence using his senses, but he hurriedly withdrew it because he was in the company of the two women. "What kind of fire spirit are you?"
Huo Diqiu put both fists to his waist and wore a proud look. "I am the spirit of the Earth Flame!"
"You—"

"Release him, Old Yan Huo." The old man turned to the young man with the body of fire, who was hovering above them. "I already knew this little guy would come to me, and I’ve been waiting for him for a long time."
Yan Huo let go of Huo Diqiu, who hurriedly hid behind the young man while sticking out his tongue at the old man. "Are you thinking of seeing his master, Tian Yan?"

"The Leng and Cao Clans." Yan Huo answered quietly.

"Hmm?" Yan Huo, who was sitting beside Tian Jingxuan, repeatedly rubbed his beard. The two of them rewatched Zhang Xiaolong [3]’s actions in all the tests, especially his battle test. "How can this kid subdue those beast ancestors? Moreover, he has clearly enslaved them, preventing them from going against his order. That mysterious woman was also not an ordinary cultivator; otherwise, she would not have been able to control that female heavenly fox."
"You’re right." Tian Jingxuan nodded in agreement. "What do you think about this kid after watching all this?"

"This kid is the most outstanding young generation I have ever met, but I think you should not involve him in our internal problems." Tian Jingxuan turned to Yan Huo directly. "He does have some great backers, but those people are older, more experienced, and stronger than them. If you drag him into our problems, he will probably die in their hands, and his talent will be wasted."

Tian Jingxuan let out a heavy sigh and leaned back in his chair. "How long will we be able to maintain peace in this realm? Cao Ren has yet to make a move, but we both know that he has been building up his strength, and nearly half of our realm’s population is on his side now. If they act now and those people emerge from their seclusion, we will be too overwhelmed to fight them, and this realm will fall into their hands. I see this kid has outstanding potential, so I thought about recruiting him to my Tian Clan, and he will definitely be useful in helping us."

"Old Tian." Yan Huo patted Tian Jingxuan’s shoulder. "I understand your wishes, but this kid is still too young to be involved in our fight against them. Therefore, I hope you are willing to cancel your intention and let him enjoy his youth, and he will become a great cultivator in the future."

"Unfortunately, this kid has already challenged Leng Hua, and it is impossible for Old Leng to just swallow his humiliation." Yan Huo had already heard about the situation involving Zhang Xiaolong [3] and Leng Hua, but he was confused about the details, so Tian Jingxuan explained everything to him. "The Leng Clan is no less powerful than the Cao Clan, and he will face a dangerous situation if they make a move on him."

Yan Huo nodded in agreement. "You are right; this kid will face a dangerous situation by fighting both Leng Hua and the Leng Clan, but I am sure he can handle them. However, the situation will be different if he has to face the Cao Clan, and he will definitely die if he fights them. Does Cao Ren know about his test results?"

"Not yet." Tian Jingxuan answered with a shake of his head. "Cao Ren and several of the Cao Clan’s higher-ups are currently not in this realm, and their members have locked themselves up in their clan residence."

"I see." Yan Huo then spoke again. "In that case, you must keep the results of this kid’s tests under wraps, and don’t let anyone from the Cao Clan find out. If they find out, they will definitely try to get close to him, and they will kill him if he refuses their request."
Tian Jingxuan immediately contacted someone and asked that person to delete all recordings of Zhang Xiaolong [3]’s tests. "What exactly happened? Why did you suddenly ask about him earlier?"

"Do you remember the Earth Flame?" Tian Jingxuan nodded to Yan Huo. "The spirit of the Earth Flame came to see Tian Yan earlier, and I heard about this kid from him. Since he is the spirit’s master, that flame fell into his possession."

Tian Jingxuan once again let out a heavy sigh. "If Leng Hua knew that this kid had obtained the Earth Flame, he would not hold himself back anymore, and he would attack him directly. Sigh! I have to discuss this matter with Jia Yuyan because she is clearly on his side, and she can help him get through this dangerous situation."

"I think that’s a great idea." Yan Huo replied with a nod of approval. "As long as Jia Yuyan protects this kid, Leng Hua won’t dare to do anything to him. It’s getting late, so I’ll head back now, and please inform Qing Huang and the others to maintain their distance from that kid."
"All right, I’ll tell them about it." After Yan Huo left, Tian Jingxuan also went to the eastern forest to meet Jia Yuyan.
As day turned to night, Mei informed Zhang Xiaolong [3] that Leng Xueyan had come to his residence, forcing him to stop his cultivation to meet his guest.

Zhang Xiaolong [3] was amused as soon as he saw Leng Xueyan, especially since she was wearing an almost unrecognizable disguise. If he didn’t have the system, he wouldn’t be able to recognize her either. "Do you want to talk inside?"
"Yes." Leng Xueyan hurriedly followed Zhang Xiaolong [3] into the back room, especially since she was afraid that her father’s people would find out about her coming there.
Upon arriving at the back area of the residence, Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately asked her. "Why did you look at me like that earlier? Does my face resemble an acquaintance of yours?"

"Hmm?" Leng Xueyan grabbed Zhang Xiaolong [3]’s head and observed him closely. "Your face does resemble someone, but he is not an acquaintance of mine. Actually, I met him in my dreams, and it started about two years ago. Since then, he has never stopped coming to my dreams, and your appearance in this realm has shocked me greatly, especially since your faces and demeanor are completely identical."

’Hahaha! My action of using my dream abilities on her has paid off!’ Zhang Xiaolong [3] then grabbed both of Leng Xueyan’s hands and rubbed them, causing her heart to flutter. "Did you look at me like that earlier just because of your dream? You should know that dreams aren’t real, right?"
"Yeah." Leng Xueyan nodded at him. "I know that dreams are not real, but you are standing in front of me now, and your resemblance to him makes me feel that all my dreams are real."

’Heh!’ Zhang Xiaolong [3] inwardly snorted. "Why do I feel that you want those dreams to be real? I’m sure there are many things that happened between you two in your dreams, or else you wouldn’t be acting like this now."
"I-" Leng Xueyan swallowed her words and hugged Zhang Xiaolong [3] directly. "You’re right; there are many things that happened between us in my dreams, and I always look forward to his arrival."

"Are you thinking about using me as a substitute because I’m real and look like him?" Leng Xueyan did not answer Zhang Xiaolong [3]’s question. He then hugged her, and his hands moved to squeeze her buttocks, which caused her to moan softly. "Honestly, I don’t have a problem with that because I’m a dual cultivator, and you’re not ugly. But do you really want that? After all, I’m a newcomer to this realm, and we don’t know each other. If others were to discover this, they would undoubtedly mock you, and your father would likely come here with the intent to kill me."

Leng Xueyan felt annoyed as soon as he mentioned her father, especially since Leng Hua ordered her to bring Zhang Xiaolong [3] to him no matter what. She then released him from her embrace and turned to leave. "You’re right, dreams aren’t real, and you’re not him, so I shouldn’t be acting like this with you. I’ll leave now, and you must be careful of my father, especially since he previously ordered me to bring you to him."

After she said that, Leng Xueyan immediately left the residence, but her feelings were filled with unease, and she felt that Zhang Xiaolong [3] was the man who came to see her in her dreams for the past two years.
[Why don’t you take action against her right away, Master? If you bring her to your side, you can use her to destroy her father and the Leng Clan.]

Zhang Xiaolong [3] shook his head in response. "Leng Xueyan will eventually fall to me, so I don’t need to rush with her. As for Leng Hua, I’m sure he won’t make a move anytime soon, especially after Tian Jingxuan and the others have expressed their interest in me. I’m curious about the strength of the Cao Clan because that old man seems afraid of them, so I have to be careful."

[I’ve been monitoring the clan, but the clan’s higher-ups don’t seem to be around, Master. Based on the system’s scan, the highest strength among them is at 1-Moon Divine Ascension Realm, so I’m sure that person isn’t the clan leader.]
’Eh? You can check that far freely now, huh?’

[Yes, Master. After the system upgrade, the scan feature becomes more extensive. By the way, I have checked this realm, and I found a lump of Heavenly Rejuvenation Jade not far from the eastern forest, and its size is bigger than Tian Yishen’s.]

Zhang Xiaolong [3]’s eyes lit up after hearing that. ’Actually, I want to take a rest first, but I’m curious about Jia Yuyan’s goal. Since she lives in the eastern forest, I will go there to get the jade and meet her at once.’

In a few minutes, Zhang Xiaolong [3] had arrived at the outskirts of the eastern forest, and Mei immediately pointed out the location of the jade. When he arrived there, he saw a male dwarf standing in front of the jade, carrying many tools. ’Tch! He seems to want to take the jade!’

"Who’s there?" The male dwarf suddenly shouted. Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately changed into his half-fox form and approached him, causing him to frown. "A heavenly fox? Are you the brat that Jia Yuyan talked about before?"
’Tch!’ Zhang Xiaolong [3]’s lips twitched in annoyance. "You’re right, I’m the one. I originally wanted to come here tomorrow, but I was curious about some things, so I decided to come here tonight."

"Hmm?" Qian Li clenched his fists tightly. 'Tch! Xiyi is mine! I won't hand her over to anyone!'

Jia Yuyan's revelation greatly shocked Zhang Xiaolong [3]. 'How strong was the old fox when he was alive? I know he's a primordial beast, but his ability to predict all those things over such a long period of time is truly frightening! If he was really that strong, he shouldn't have had to commit suicide by splitting himself into two heavenly foxes, and he should have been able to defeat those two primordial beasts.'

"Here." Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately caught a stone tablet that Jia Yuyan threw at him. "You just need to inject your qi into the tablet, and all the information inside will be directly transferred into your mind, so you won't doubt me anymore."

Zhang Xiaolong [3] hurriedly did so, and a white light shot into his forehead from the tablet. Suddenly, a plethora of information filled his mind, including details about the soul of a ten-tailed fox residing in the Floral Mirage Domain.
'Please record and organize everything for backup, Mei.' Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately closed his eyes and read all the information, making Ren Shuo and the others curious about it.

'A liar!' Zhu Ru and the others shouted in their hearts.

Before long, Zhang Xiaolong [3] had already opened his eyes and asked Jia Yuyan directly. "Why did your leader go all this way? What is his hidden intention? I don't believe that he did everything just because of that person, and I'm sure he had other plans for me."

"Phew." Jia Yuyan let out a soft sigh, stood up, and walked in front of Zhang Xiaolong [3]. "Here I am their leader, but my status is only ordinary in my domain, and I only carry out the tasks that my leader has entrusted to me. Therefore, I don't know whether he has other intentions toward you or not, and you will have to find out everything yourself when you ascend to the Paradise Realm. Additionally, one of them is located in my domain, so you will need to visit there to obtain it, correct?"

Zhang Xiaolong [3] nodded at her. "Since it's there, I have to go to your domain to get it. Moreover, I have an appointment with Long Wuzhao, and since both of your domains are in the same area, I'll visit him then."
"Eh?" Jia Yuyan was shocked to hear that. "How did you know the Golden Dragon Emperor? Did you know him through Feng Yao?"

"I met his avatar in one of the planets in the upper realms." Jia Yuyan immediately searched her memories for several possible realms, and she then nodded to Zhang Xiaolong [3]. "I need unlimited cultivation resources, so I need your help to open a shop in this realm. If I open it myself, Leng Hua or even Cao Ren will attack me, and I don't want to take that risk. In return, I will give some pills to some members of your races, and you should no longer have any doubts about the effects of my pills, right?"

paragraphs: "The Cao Clan?" Jia Yuyan was confused by that. "I know you have issues with Leng Hua and the Leng Clan, but you shouldn't have met Cao Ren or the people from his clan, right? How could you have issues with them?"

"Only twenty."

paragraphs: "The near extinction of the giant race is related to the disaster that happened in Ju Potian's era." Zhang Xiaolong [3] adopted a serious expression after Jia Yuyan mentioned the disaster, particularly because he had always been interested in events from the distant past. "In fact, the disaster affected all living races in this universe and nearly led to their extinction."
"Do you know anything about that disaster?"

"No." Zhang Xiaolong [3] was disappointed with Jia Yuyan's answer. "Hey! Ju Potian was the first giant race born in this universe, okay? The disaster happened a long time ago, and many eras have passed since then. As you already know, history changes with each era, and many old records are lost because of it, so no one knows for sure about that disaster."
Zhang Xiaolong [3] nodded in agreement with that. "So, how did the giant race almost become extinct?"

"Sigh." Jia Yuyan then continued. "After the disaster, all races began to gradually reorganize everything, and almost all races produced many new individuals with extraordinary talents, including the giant race. However, the history before the disaster was still fresh in their memories, and they remembered how terrifying the strength of Ju Potian and Ju Zhutian was. They saw the giant race as a threat and banded together to eliminate them before they became as powerful as their ancestors. "Yes."

"The people of that realm hated him because he destroyed their realm, and they shunned him. His wife and two children chose to leave him because they didn't want to suffer with him, and he has never had any contact with anyone since then."
"Do his wife and all his descendants live there?"

"No." Jia Yuyan then pointed in another direction. Since then, all of their descendants have become members of that clan, and they have significant influence in that clan."

"Even Uncle Qing's speed is not comparable to his current speed." Tian Jiantang realized something. "Isn't that the area where the isolated people live?
Qing Yun nodded at him. "Why did he go to that area? Did he want to meet them? Why did he do that?"
"I don't know." Tian Jiantang then walked away. "He won't like it if we interfere in his affairs, so we should go home now to train."
"Yeah."

'This kid! How could the speed be this fast? He hasn't even gone to the Paradise Realm, but his speed is already incredible, and he is the fastest cultivator in the Three Mortal Realms!' Jia Yuyan muttered in shock as soon as they arrived at the river not far from where Han Ling lived.

Zhang Xiaolong [3] looked at Han Ling as he spoke to Jia Yuyan. "You shouldn't be surprised by my speed, right? After all, your speed should be much higher than mine, especially since the gravity in the Paradise Realm is extremely heavy."
"How do you train your speed?"
"Secret." Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately brought her to land behind the old man, who was fishing in the river. 'I can't sense his aura and presence at all!'

The current Earth is already very advanced, and they don't need Qi to live their lives; instead, they use a lot of technology that doesn't exist in your era."

Jia Yuyan nodded in agreement. "Some techniques and artifacts can prevent you from using your gate abilities, but none can stop you from dispelling your clone, making your choice to send it there the best decision. Where is your main body?"
"My main body is challenging the Star Tower with all my wives, family, and friends."
"Oh."
"What's your element?" Zhang Xiaolong [3] looked at Han Ling. "I have a body technique with water element affinity, and I can teach it to you if you have the element."
"Hahaha!" Zhang Xiaolong [3] laughed loudly and used his water element directly. "What a coincidence that you possess the water body cultivation technique, Old Han!"
"How many elements do you actually have now?" Jia Yuyan curiously asked.

Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately answered her. "Light, darkness, and fire are my basic elements. However, I managed to find water, ice, lightning, and wind elemental seeds. Some people helped me get those four elements, so I have seven elements now."
"Sigh." Jia Yuyan sighed heavily. "I shouldn't have asked you that, and your absurdity makes me even more afraid of you."

Han Ling nodded in agreement with her. "I have met a cultivator who possessed three elements, and he was the leader of the Xianjin Realm, but this is the first time I have met a possessor of seven elements."
"The Nameless One, right?" Han Ling nodded to Zhang Xiaolong [3] before touching his forehead and sharing his technique. "The Ocean Flesh Scripture?"
"Yes." Han Ling then explained to Zhang Xiaolong [3] about the technique, including the basics for mastering it. "There is a secret pond in the eastern forest, and you can learn it faster there."
Zhang Xiaolong [3] turned to Jia Yuyan, who immediately told him. "It's the Life Pond, but it was used by someone to preserve his life, so you can't go there."

"I see." Zhang Xiaolong [3] nodded in understanding. "Old Ren has already told me about that person, so I won't force myself to go there, and I will train somewhere else. By the way, let's go back now, especially since the time flow on this planet is four times slower."
"Yeah, let's go back."

After they arrived at the riverbank in the Sovereign Heaven Realm, Han Ling immediately asked Zhang Xiaolong [3]. "Do you want to be my disciple? I'm not as strong as Senior Yuyan, but I can teach you some great techniques, including the one I used in the past."
"Eh?" Zhang Xiaolong [3] was momentarily taken aback. "What's the name of that technique?"

paragraphs: "The technique is part of the Forgotten Sword Technique that I learned from my master, and he learned it from a mysterious old demon." Jia Yuyan and Zhang Xiaolong [3] were both surprised to hear Han Ling mention a demon. "According to my master, the demon used to be a human, and he turned into a demon because of something, but he didn’t explain the details to him. I can feel the sword Qi in your body, but unfortunately, you have never refined it."

"You’re right, Old Han." Zhang Xiaolong [3] then took out the moonlit whisper sword. "I have mastered all the basics of swordsmanship, and I have some sword techniques. However, I am not really a swordmaster, and I mostly fight using long-range attacks or even sneak attacks."
Han Ling nodded in understanding. "Before I explain to you in more detail, please first show me all you know about basic swordsmanship, and I’ll help you improve your knowledge about them."
After Han Ling and Jia Yuyan moved aside, Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately demonstrated all the basic sword skills he had learned from the basic sword manual.
"What do you think about him, Little Han?" Jia Yuyan asked.

"Hmm?" Han Ling maintained a serious expression as he continued to watch Zhang Xiaolong [3]. "Those are just the basics of swordsmanship, but I’ve never seen a swordmaster who trained them to such perfection as this kid. Every movement he makes in slashing, thrusting, and swinging the sword is perfect. I think he won’t have any trouble learning my sword techniques."

Jia Yuyan responded with a slight nod. "I don’t understand swordsmanship, but I also think he has mastered the basics. He also has many other abilities, and he often uses them against his enemies, especially his speed."

"His speed has already surpassed all cultivators in this realm; not even those old fogies would be able to defeat him in a speed contest." "I won’t explain to you about the novice sword level, especially since anyone can become a swordmaster at that level." Han Ling then took out his black sword, but an ominous aura radiated from it. "The spirit sword realm is a little unique, and it would be better if you had a soul sword."
"A soul sword?"

"When you reach the sword spirit realm, you can manifest your sword Qi into a true sword that you can control with your consciousness to help you fight your enemies. If you have a soul weapon and have a close connection with the soul within it, you can manifest the spirit into the real world, and it will be your partner in every fight." Zhang Xiaolong [3] raised an eyebrow as several swords made of qi floated beside Han Ling. "These swords are made of my sword qi, and their power depends on our sword qi. The stronger your sword qi is, the more difficult it will be to destroy these qi swords.

"How to manifest the soul in the sword?" Zhang Xiaolong [3] really wanted to know about that because Jian Guang’an and Jian Hei’an had been trapped inside the demon extermination sword for too long, and he wanted to bring them out into the real world.

"Do you have a soul weapon?" Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately sheathed the moonlit whisper sword and summoned the demon extermination sword, which surprised Han Ling and Jia Yuyan. "A divine-grade soul weapon, huh?"
Zhang Xiaolong [3] nodded at him. "At first, this sword was a spirit-grade soul weapon, but two blacksmiths helped me upgrade it twice, and now it is a divine-grade."

"As I said before, you must have a strong connection with the soul within your sword; otherwise, it will not obey your request, and it will not manifest itself into the real world." Zhang Xiaolong [3] nodded in understanding to Han Ling, who immediately channeled his sword qi into his sword. A female demon materialized right by her side shortly after, her eyes as fierce as a lion ready to pounce on its prey. "Her name is Yong Heng, and she comes from the Eternal Night Demon Race."
Zhang Xiaolong [3] was momentarily stunned after Han Ling mentioned the demon race, especially since Yong Heng was of the same race as Tian Shuixiang’s wife, Ye Zhiye.

{Master, this kid’s body reeked with many demon scents, so I’m sure he’s a demon. Moreover, he wasn’t surprised to hear about my demon race, so he should have met someone from my race before.} Yong Heng spoke as she narrowed her eyes at Zhang Xiaolong [3].
"Are you really a demon, kid?"
"Yes." Zhang Xiaolong [3] admitted it directly. "I was born as an ordinary human, but I turned into a demon after I rose from my death, and I have evolved into a transcendent demon lord."
"Little Han, this kid has another identity as a heavenly fox." Jia Yuyan reminded him.
Han Lin nodded a few times in response. "Everything about you goes beyond common sense, from your three identities, your seven elements, and your other secrets."

Zhang Xiaolong [3] scratched the back of his head. "Honestly, I never expected to become like this when I was an ordinary human, but my two identities have become a part of me, and I chose to embrace and strengthen both of them. By the way, where did you get your sword? How did she become the sword’s soul? I’ve heard that the Eternal Night Demon is the seventh strongest among the ten demon races."

"My master’s master gave this Eternal Night Sword to him, and he passed it on to me before his death." Zhang Xiaolong [3] raised an eyebrow slightly before realizing the identity of the demon Han Ling had mentioned earlier. "You’re right, his master is part of the Eternal Night Demon Race, and he came from the Paradise Realm."

"Huh?" Zhang Xiaolong [3] was shocked by that, as he had not expected that the Eternal Demon Race had already ventured into the Three Mortal Realms in the past, let alone that he went all the way to Earth. "Is he still alive now?"
"He—"

"His master is Ye Futian, one of the elders of the Eternal Night Demon Race." Zhang Xiaolong [3] turned to Jia Yuyan directly, suspecting something. "He came to the three mortal realms specifically to look for his daughter, who ran away with a demon from the Asura Demon Clan. He searched for his daughter as far as your home realm, where he met Little Han’s master. He taught him the Forgotten Sword Technique and gifted the Eternal Night Sword to him.
’What a shitty coincidence! Why do I feel like the universe is so small?’ Zhang Xiaolong [3] inwardly grumbled. "How did you know all that? Were you also stalking Ye Futian?"
"I told you I’m not a stalker!" Jia Yuyan shouted in annoyance. "I’m just doing my job to monitor the people from the Paradise Realm who descended here."
Zhang Xiaolong [3] nodded slightly. "Even so, your actions are no different from a stalker’s."
"Humph!" Jia Yuyan softly snorted and didn’t speak further.

Yong Heng floated right in front of Zhang Xiaolong [3]’s face. {Hey! Have you met a member of my demon race before? You can’t deceive me because I smell the scent from your body, and I can’t possibly mistake it.}

Zhang Xiaolong [3] nodded at her. "I have indeed met a demon from the Eternal Night Demon Race, but I have promised not to reveal that person’s identity or hiding place. I’m a man of my word, so I won’t tell you anything about it."

{No!} Yong Heng screamed and went straight into Han Ling’s sword again, and it shook quite violently, forcing her master to calm her. {Master, that female demon is really evil, so please don’t summon me out in front of her.}
"Hahaha!" Nalan Yushu laughed excitedly before looking at Jia Yuyan. "You are the subordinate of that hypocritical elf, huh?"
"Hmm?" Jia Yuyan frowned and stared at her.

Nalan Yushu shook her head and spoke again, but her tone was quite mocking. "You really don’t know, or are you pretending not to know? That guy is famous for his hypocrisy and pettiness, so I’m sure you already understand his true character. Unfortunately, he is your leader, and you are too timid to oppose him."
"Stop it and go back inside, Yushu." Zhang Xiaolong [3] spoke sternly.

"Master, you must be careful with this female elf, and you must never trust her leader. Otherwise, you will not only harm yourself, but you will also harm everyone by your side." After she said that, Nalan Yushu immediately entered Zhang Xiaolong [3]’s tiny soul world again.
"She—"

"Even if Yuzhu didn’t say all that, I would never trust your leader, especially after I listened to all his previous messages. "No need." Jia Yuyan turned to Han Ling. "I have to go back to the eastern forest now, so I’ll leave you two alone."

Zhang Xiaolong [3] nodded, and he seriously paid attention to Han Ling’s explanation.

"No." Chi Yuexin tried to check inside the clan before continuing. "We don’t know when they will come out of their isolation, and we may end up waiting for them in vain, so I think we should return to our realm now."

"Then—"

"Who are you guys? Why are you looking for Shang Ziyuan?" The three women immediately turned their attention to Zhang Fei [1], who was speaking from inside the residence. ’Huh? Why does his face look so similar to that kid’s? "Are you the patriarch of this clan?"
"I am." Zhang Fei [1] casually nodded.
"Can we talk in your clan?" Chi Yuexin asked him.
"Come in." Zhang Fei [1] immediately turned to leave, and the three women hurriedly followed him.

After they arrived at the main hall and sat down together, Wenren Yue immediately asked a question. "Do you have a twin brother? I once saw a man with the same face as you in our realm, and your cultivation is also at the same level."

’Sigh! I didn’t know they came from that realm, so I didn’t use a disguise.’ Zhang Fei [1] immediately made up a story. "You’re right, I do have a twin brother, and his name is Zhang Xiaolong. I don’t know where he is now, especially since he goes wandering so often. Who exactly are you three? Where are you guys from?"

"Since Zhang Xiaolong is your twin brother, I won’t hide it from you because you will find out from him one day." Zhang Fei [1] laughed inwardly because Chi Yuexin believed his story so easily. "We came from the Sovereign Heaven Realm, and not everyone can enter our realm. However, your twin brother managed to complete all the entrance tests quickly, and he lives in our realm now."
Li Zuxin then added. "We came here to recruit Shang Ziyuan, especially after we heard about her ability to create new techniques."

Zhang Fei [1]’s answer made the three women frown. "I have long known her abilities to create techniques, and she has helped me create several special ones."

"You—"
Zhang Fei [1] hurriedly continued before Chi Yuexin interrupted him. "Are money and resources more important than your life and your family?"

Lin Zuxin and Wenren Yue almost laughed when they heard Zhang Fei [1]’s words, while Chi Yuexin’s face darkened. "You just felt the power of one of my many strong protectors, so you are mistaken if you think I’m afraid of you. Furthermore, we do not know each other, so I have no reason to threaten you, and you misinterpreted my previous words."
"What do you really mean by that?" Lin Zuxin asked him.

"Do you know the reason I destroyed the Shang Clan and took over their clan?" The three women shook their heads at Zhang Fei [1], who immediately explained it to them. "All members of the Shang Clan are my enemies because they killed my father-in-law, and his death made my mother-in-law and wife miserable for quite a while. Their actions also turned my brother-in-law into a demon, making it hard for him to reunite with my sister-in-law and their daughter. That’s why I ask you whether money and resources are more valuable than your life and your family’s, especially since their feelings are far more valuable to me than worldly things. I killed the majority of their members, and I only left a few of them, like Shang Ziyuan, who is now my prisoner."
Chi Yuexin and the others looked shocked by that. "Did you really kill them?"

"An eye for an eye, blood for blood, and life for life." They frowned at Zhang Fei [1], who smiled casually in response to that. "Whether they are men or women, whether they are strong or weak, they must die as long as they are my enemies, and I will eliminate all their roots so that they will not bring me trouble again in the future."
’This kid is truly a lunatic! How can he say such things so easily?’ The three women thought to themselves.

Zhang Fei [1] immediately got down from his chair. "I have to return to my seclusion, so the three of you can leave my residence now, and I will never hand Shang Ziyuan over to anyone. If you think you can suppress me, go ahead, but I will treat you as enemies, and you will face unimaginable consequences."
"Let’s go, Zuxin and Yue." Lin Zuxin and Wenren Yue immediately followed Chi Yuexin and left the Zhang Clan.

Shortly after they left, Ma Kuangyu and Nalan Yushu appeared at Zhang Fei [1]’s side. "The three women are not bad, Master. They know when to press and when to retreat, but I don’t think they’ll give up so easily, and they might target your clone in their realm."

"Talents like Shang Ziyuan are extremely rare, and her mirror reversal technique has proven that, so I believe she has a wide chance of becoming a technique master in the future." Zhang Fei [1] and Nalan Yushu nodded in agreement with Ma Kuangyu. "If she manages to create many high-level techniques, you and your family will be unrivaled even in the Paradise Realm."

"Haha." Zhang Fei [1] laughed at that. "Old Ma, is being unrivaled that interesting? Honestly, I have never considered becoming that kind of person; I only want to live a peaceful life with my loved ones. Unfortunately, the situation in the cultivation world will never allow us to have a peaceful life without strength, so I will continue to strive to become stronger and stronger. As long as I can ensure that no one can harm them, even if it means contaminating my body with the blood of countless living beings and losing my humanity in the process, I am willing to make the necessary sacrifices."

Nalan Yushu immediately spoke to him. "Master, you will become the most evil living being if you lose your humanity, especially with the cursed demon heart inside your body. Therefore, you must keep it intact, or you will become a disaster for those closest to you and the entire universe."

"She’s right, kid." Ma Kuangyu spoke as he nodded. "Your humanity is the most important part of you, especially since it’s the only thing that can balance your beast and demon sides. If you lose it, your cursed demon heart will instantly consume you, and you will change completely."
Zhang Fei [1] embraced the two of them. "You guys don’t need to be this serious, okay? I will keep my humanity alive within me, but I might let it go if a major circumstance comes my way."
"I hope such a situation will never come." Ma Kuangyu spoke as he sighed.
Nalan Yushu shared the same sentiment as Ma Kuangyu. "It’s time for you to return to your seclusion, master."
"Yeah." After they entered his tiny soul world again, Zhang Fei [1] immediately returned to the training space and joined the other three clones.

On the flying artifact, the three women looked gloomy because they failed to recruit Shang Ziyuan. Lin Zuxin and Chi Yuexin thought that Zhang Fei [1] was wasting her talent, and her development would be much faster if she joined them in the Sovereign Heaven Realm, which was full of invaluable resources.

"Master, I have never met anyone as cruel as him; he even killed most of the Shang Clan members just for revenge." Wenren Yue suddenly spoke. "Besides, I feel that he is different from his twin brother in our realm, especially since that kid is more easygoing and cheerful."

Chi Yuexin shook her head in disagreement. "We still don’t fully understand Zhang Xiaolong, and we’ve only seen him for a day, so I won’t hastily draw the conclusion that he’s a good person. Moreover, his twin brother is so evil, so there’s a possibility that he’s also wicked. Therefore, we have to be careful of him, and we have to make sure that he won’t wreak havoc in our realm."

"I think Tian Jingxuan has already considered that; otherwise, he and Qing Huang would not have sent their two clansmen to Zhang Xiaolong’s side." Chi Yuexin agreed with Lin Zuxin, but she still had bad feelings about him, especially after their conversation with Zhang Fei [1] earlier.

Unfortunately, Chi Yuexin still didn’t realize that the two were Zhang Fei’s clones, especially since his clones were completely identical to his real body and were undetectable by even the strongest artifacts.

Chi Yuexin then spoke. "Zuxin, use as many golden jewels as possible to speed up your flying artifact so we can be in our realm five days earlier. I have an uneasy feeling about Zhang Xiaolong, so I want to personally monitor him."
"What do you think about him?" Lin Zuxin asked as she put many golden jewels into the flying artifact’s source, making it fly much faster than before.

"I can’t confirm that until I monitor him." Chi Yuexin sighed heavily and looked back. "However, I feel that kid and his twin brother are much more terrifying than Leng Hua and Cao Ren, and their cruelty may surpass those old fogeys behind the Cao Clan."

Lin Zuxin nodded in agreement. "Speaking of Cao Ren and the Cao Clan, where did they go exactly? They left not long after Yuan Tiancheng and the others departed two years ago, and they have not shown any signs of returning; even the clan members have kept their activities tightly sealed."

"I have no information about their departure, but I am sure they are planning something bad out there, and they will probably attack us once they return." Lin Zuxin sighed heavily once Chi Yuexin mentioned that. "Unfortunately, the Cao Clan’s protection is too powerful, and those old fogeys will come out immediately if we attack them while Cao Ren and the others are away; otherwise, Tian Jingxuan will lead us to attack them since their leaders are gone. Forget it! Since we cannot take any action against them right now, we should stop worrying about them and continue preparing our countermeasures; instead, we will concentrate on Zhang Xiaolong for the time being."
"Yeah."

Zhang Fei and his group were resting at the edge of the forest, but he himself was not resting; instead, he tried to manifest his sword qi according to the instructions given by Han Ling to his third clone.

Noticing this, Xian Xianqin immediately approached Zhang Fei and asked him a question. "Why did you suddenly focus on the swordsmanship? You know that some of us are swordmasters, including me. However, you never asked us to help you learn swordsmanship more seriously, and you prefer close combat."

"Haha." Zhang Fei laughed at her question, and he immediately explained to her about Han Ling and his past. "His technique not only single-handedly stopped the war between the four races, but it almost led to the destruction of my home realm. Fortunately, that disaster never occurred; otherwise, I wouldn’t exist now, and you would never have met me."
Xian Xianqin massaged her forehead. "So, you want to start learning swordsmanship just because you want to learn Han Ling’s techniques, huh?"

"Yeah." Xian Xianqin punched Zhang Fei’s chest because of his innocent answer. "Hehe! I would rather not waste my time learning ordinary techniques; instead, I want to learn techniques similar to those of Han Ling. His sword technique is the Forgotten Sword Technique, and he got it from his master, who was a disciple of an Eternal Night Demon named Ye Futian."
"Eternal Night Demon? Ye Futian?"

Zhang Fei nodded at her. "Speaking of Ye Futian, he is the father of Tian Shuixiang’s wife, Ye Zhiye. He met Han Ling’s master on Earth when he was looking for his daughter in the past, but he didn’t find her because she hid in her husband’s body, and their disguise was extraordinary."
"Why do I feel like everything that happens in our lives isn’t just a coincidence?" Xian Xianqin asked with a strange feeling.

"Right? I also had such thoughts, and I feel that something deliberately arranged all the events that happened in our lives recently." Xian Xianqin nodded to Zhang Fei with a thoughtful expression. "Forget it, don’t think too much about it, and we just need to focus on our lives, living everything step by step. Instead, teach me how to manifest my sword qi."

"Humph." Xian Xianqin snorted softly and activated her qi sword, and several green qi swords immediately appeared around her. "Easy, right? Before you can manifest your qi sword, you must first understand the sword intent. Once your sword intent is strong and refined enough, it will transform into tangible sword qi. In fact, sword intent and killing intent are quite similar; however, the latter is more challenging to control, which leads me to believe that you will find the former easier to understand."

Zhang Fei nodded in understanding. "Actually, Qingyu and Lian’er once explained about the sword intent to me, but I didn’t take them seriously because I wasn’t really interested in swordsmanship at that time. If I recall correctly, the sword qi itself has several levels, right?"
"Yes." Xian Xianqin nodded at him. "Sword qi is the most basic, and sword intent is the second. Next are sword will, sword condensation, sword heart, sword domain, and sword dao."

"All right, I won’t think about anything else first, and I will form my sword intent first so I can manifest my sword qi." Xian Xianqin immediately moved away from Zhang Fei as she was afraid that his sword intent would affect her, similar to when he used his killing intent.
Zhang Fei immediately closed his eyes and began to imagine his sword intent, just like he had imagined his killing intent the first time.
Xian Xianqin, who was waiting in the distance, could only shake her head once a transparent sword intent appeared at Zhang Fei’s side. "Our husband is really annoying, Xinyue."

"Hehe." Yun Xinyue giggled as she and Xian Changyue walked to Xian Xianqin’s side. "Our husband is actually smart, and the comprehension feature makes him even smarter in learning new things. Unfortunately, he won’t learn something that doesn’t interest him yet, but he will persist in learning something new if he is genuinely interested in it, such as the body and soul cultivation paths."

"Our husband is truly a maniac when it comes to body cultivation." Xian Xianqin and Yun Xinyue laughed at hearing Xian Changyue call Zhang Fei a husband, especially since she used to always reject him. She ignored their laughter and continued. "He has already mastered four body cultivation techniques, and he has just started to learn the Indestructible Vajra Immortal Body, which he obtained from the entrance test at the Sovereign Heaven Realm. Now, he has already obtained another body technique called the Ocean Flesh Scripture. If he continues to learn new body techniques, his body might truly become immortal, and no weapons or anything else will be able to penetrate it."

"I’ve been thinking about this matter for a long time, and our husband seems to be constantly strengthening his body to torture us while we serve him in bed." Xian Xianqin and Xian Changyue were speechless in reply to Yun Xinyue. "Hey! He has succeeded in forming his sword intent!"
Xian Xianqin nodded in response. "Now he just needs to strengthen it and form his qi sword, and it’s not difficult for him."

A few moments later, seven qi swords of different colors circled Zhang Fei, each of which came from his seven elements. He immediately opened his eyes, but there was no satisfaction in his expression, and he looked more serious as he stared at them.

"Having seven swords and seven elements is advantageous if I encounter opponents with opposing elements, but I think the attack power will not be maximized, and I have to think of something to maximize the attack power." The three women, who wanted to approach Zhang Fei, immediately stopped in their tracks. They quickly understood that their husband intended to conduct a wild experiment by sending the seven sword qi into the sky, where they were circulating as if pulling each other. "Let’s try combining them, and I’m sure the attack power will be much greater if they merge into one."

Fortunately, Zhang Fei has long been able to combine all his elements; he could even create the Hellflame Frost Lotus, which combined his fire and ice elements. Therefore, it was not difficult for him to combine his seven qi swords, and they quickly merged into one, forming a huge qi sword with mixed colors of the seven elements.
"Hahahaha!" Zhang Fei laughed with satisfaction after he saw the qi sword, and he immediately tried to slash it towards the ground.
*Boom*

A loud explosion was heard as Zhang Fei’s qi sword slashed the ground, leaving a long and deep slash hole there. "As expected! Its attack power has indeed become much greater, but its speed has slowed down due to its size. Therefore, I have to shape it into the most appropriate form, which will increase its attack power without decreasing its speed."

"You’re crazy, husband!" Xian Xianqin, Yun Xinyue, and Xian Changyue shouted as they moved to his side. Not long after them, Ximen Chuixue and the others also arrived there, and they were stunned by the slash hole there.
