chapters.title: Chapter 976: Sword Spirit Manifestation
paragraphs: Zhang Fei turned to them with a wide grin, causing them to shake their heads repeatedly. He then summoned the demon extermination sword out of his body. "Since I have successfully manifested my sword qi, I want to try manifesting both sword spirits."
"I don’t have a sword spirit, so I can’t help you with that." Xian Xianqin replied in a disappointed tone.

"Hehe." Yun Xinyue chuckled and patted her shoulder. "Why should you be so disappointed? Our husband has been dual-soul cultivating with Jian Hei’an and Jian Guang’an for several years, remember? This way, their bond is already so deep, and the two of them are no different from us, so I’m sure he can manifest them easily."
"I think the same as you, Xinyue." Xian Changyue then spoke to Zhang Fei. "Give it a try, and the process should be no different from manifesting your sword qi."

"You’re right, the process is the same, but I can make it easier." Zhang Fei immediately sat cross-legged and placed the demon extermination sword on his lap. Then, he released his three cultivation souls and merged them into one, confusing everyone present. ’Can you two hear me?’
Zing... Zing... Zing...

The demon extermination sword answered Zhang Fei with a strong vibration. ’We are younger than them, but I believe our bond is much deeper than that of Old Han and his sword spirit, and our souls have been bound together for a long time now. I hope my method will work, and the two of you can get out of the sword’s soul space. Let’s do it now, Hei’an and Guang’an.’
Zing... Zing... Zing...
"Hmm?" Xian Xianqin and the others raised their eyebrows as Zhang Fei and the demon extermination sword emitted the same aura, and both glowed repeatedly in sync. "What did he actually use?"
"Could he be using another sub-technique from the forbidden lotus codex?" Bai Tian’er suddenly asked.
Xian Changyue nodded her head. "I think you’re right, Tian’er. He told us that there are still some sub-techniques of the forbidden lotus codex, but he has never told us in detail."
"Oh?" Bai Tian’er was momentarily surprised. "He channeled his soul power into his sword, and he probably wanted to use it to support the two spirit women."

After they waited for some time, they saw two lotus buds appear on either side of Zhang Fei, one black and one white. They also saw that there were several transparent things circling him, making Xian Xianqin fall into a daze.
"What’s wrong with you? What’s wrong with those transparent things?" Xian Changyue asked her niece.
Xian Xianqin took a deep breath first. "Those transparent things are his sword will."
"Sword will?"

"Yes." Xian Xianqin nodded at them. "Sword Will is a sword cultivator’s determination, mentality, and spirituality that a sword cultivator possesses. It is the sword cultivator’s purest desire and thought to wield the sword, to cut through obstacles, and to live and die by the sword. Although Sword Will seems intangible, it is more deadly than tangible sword intent, and not all cultivators can perceive it."
Yuan Luo suddenly spoke. "I can’t see Zhang Fei’s sword will, Princess."
"Me too." Ye Zhiqiu then asked the others. "What about you guys? Can you see them?"
"No." Xin Xianzi, Long Chen, Long Tian, and several others shook their heads.

"I can see them, and they are not as transparent as you say." Xian Xianqin and the others turned to Xime Chuixue directly. "In my eyes, they are clear, and they exude his killing intent. If he attacked me using them, I’m sure I would die on the spot before I even realized it."
"How could he master it so quickly?" Guo Jihai asked.
"What else?" Xian Xianqin shrugged. "He must have used all his clones to master the sword will."
Guo Jihai’s wife, Su Zhen, pointed at Zhang Fei. "Both lotuses are starting to bloom."
"They are beautiful!" Not only women, but men also admire the beauty of the two lotuses.
A few minutes later, the two lotuses had fully bloomed, and they saw two female spirits emerge from each of them. "Master."

Zhang Fei immediately opened his eyes and looked at the two spirit women. "Phew! I’m relieved that it worked! This way, you guys don’t have to stay inside the sword anymore, and you can live in my tiny soul world now."
"No." Jian Guang’an and Jian Hei’an immediately refused. "Master, the demon extermination sword is just an ordinary sword without us, so we must stay inside it."
"My sister is right, Master." Jian Hei’an said with a nod. "Even though we live inside the sword, we can come and go freely now, so you don’t need to worry about us."
Zhang Fei sighed softly. "All right, I won’t force you two, and you guys can come out whenever you want if you get bored of staying inside the sword."
"Yes, Master." After that, Jian Guang’an and Jian Hei’an entered the sword again, especially since they were not used to the outside world after living in it for so many years.

Xian Xianqin immediately asked Zhang Fei. "What did you use just now to summon them out of the sword? Is that one of the sub-techniques in the Forbidden Lotus Codex? Although I have never summoned a sword spirit, I am sure that it is not a spirit manifestation."

"You’re correct; it was indeed not a spirit manifestation." Zhang Fei then returned the sword to his body and stood up. "By the way, I did not use one but two sub-techniques from the forbidden lotus codex, and one of them has the same principle as a spirit manifestation."
"What kind of technique is that?"

Zhang Fei continued his explanation directly. "The Soul Lotus Spirit Summon summons spirits or souls, but I can’t use it without the Lotus Soul Pact. I can’t use the second one if my bond with them is still too shallow, especially since making the pact requires a deep bond."
"What are the benefits of the Lotus Soul Pact?" After all, Bai Tian’er was a soul cultivator, so she was curious about it.

"The Lotus Soul Pact is actually similar to my act of replicating another person’s soul and merging it with mine, but that technique is different because their souls are truly merged with mine." They stared at Zhang Fei in shock. "Actually, we have long since merged our souls since I first entered the sword’s soul space, and the technique gives them another advantage from the merging of our souls. Their soul strength becomes equal to mine, and their soul strength will continue to increase along with the increase in my soul strength, which makes the demon extermination sword even more effective for demons."
"How about you use it with us?"

"No." Zhang Fei immediately rejected Yun Xinyue’s idea. "The weakness of the Lotus Soul Pact is that they will die if I die, and I don’t want any of you to die with me, so I won’t use it on any of you."
"Do you think we can live if you die?" Yun Xinyue asked in a bitter tone.
Zhang Fei immediately rubbed her cheek. "That is why I am striving to become stronger, particularly because I do not wish for you all to experience sadness due to my death."
"Hey! Stop being lovey-dovey in front of us!" Xin Xianzi protested.
Zhang Fei immediately turned to the female fairy, pulled her to him, and kissed her directly, stunning her. "Haha! Why are you stunned now?"
"Ahh!" Xia Xianzi screamed and immediately flew in another direction, making Zhang Fei and the others laugh out loud at her antics.
"She’s still so innocent even though she’s lived with us for years." Zhang Fei then spoke to the others. "Let’s continue; I want to reach the fourth floor as soon as possible."
Everyone became excited as they couldn’t wait to go to the fourth floor. "Let’s go! We will clear all the tests on the third floor today!"
On the top floor of the star tower, the old man could only sigh as he watched all of Zhang Fei’s women go to the secret room of the enlightenment challenge.

Hua Mei’er immediately spoke to Wan Jiang. "Master, I told you not to let that annoying kid go to that place, but you insisted on doing so, and you see the consequences now! He tells all his women about that place, and they will get lots of good techniques there! If the higher-ups find out about this problem, they will definitely punish us severely."

"Why are you so timid?" Helian Xun’er asked with a shake of her head, causing Hua Mei’er to frown. "The higher-ups would not possibly check in such detail, so I’m sure they won’t know about this matter. Even if they do, we can ask Sect Master Luo to talk to them; I’m sure we’ll be fine."
"You—"

"Enough." Wan Jiang sighed softly. "Even if they could enter that place and obtain excellent techniques, they wouldn’t necessarily succeed in learning them. If they fail, those techniques will vanish from their minds, so your worries are unfounded."
"But—"

"I said enough, Mei’er." Hua Mei’er immediately covered her mouth with her hands after seeing Wan Jiang’s angry expression. "Xun’er is right, and I’m sure Sect Master Luo won’t mind helping us, especially since all these women will be Luo Yunxiao’s sisters."

’Tch! I still don’t understand how that annoying kid could win Luo Yunxiao’s heart! A perverted man like him is not worthy of a god like him!’ Hua Mei’er immediately left the place afterward, as did Helian Xun’er.

Sima Yun immediately asked the old man a question. "What will happen if they succeed in mastering the techniques of their choice, Master? All the techniques in that room are extraordinary, and there are many immortal-grade techniques there."

"If they manage to obtain and master those immortal-grade techniques, then so be it." Wang Jian suddenly received a voice transmission from several people who were on duty at the other towers. "A group of people managed to reach the top of the Dark Tower. The same thing happened at the Moon Tower, and their numbers are even greater."
"Have they reached the 5-Moon Divine Ascension Realm, Master? Are the people who managed to reach the top of the Dark Tower demons?"

Wan Jian nodded. "All of those people are humans, and they came from the Sovereign Heaven Realm, the planet that used to border our realm. Most of them have reached that stage, so they can directly ascend to our realm."
"Isn’t Zhang Fei’s clone in that realm now, Master?"

"Yes." Wan Jiang then contacted the people in both towers to ask about the identities of those who managed to reach the peak. "The people in the Dark Tower said that they don’t want to ascend now, and they asked that old man to help them instead."
Sima Yun turned to Wan Jiang with a frown. "Did he agree to help them, Master?"

"Haha." Wan Jiang laughed at that. "Do you think he dares to do that? I know he has some ties with the Nine Nether Demon race, but I’m sure he won’t be stupid enough to help those people and interfere in the affairs of the three mortal realms."
"What about those in the Moon Tower? Do they all intend to ascend to our realm?"

"No." Wan Jiang replied with a shake of his head. "Some of them have not reached the 5-Moon Divine Ascension Realm, so they cannot ascend there. The number of candidates exceeds the quota of ten, which means not everyone can ascend to our realm. According to Yue Liangyu, only seven out of ten intend to ascend directly, and the rest have decided to return to their realms with their younger generations."

Sima Yun then looked at the qi screen, which showed the activity in the enlightenment challenge. "Why is no one interested in this tower besides them, Master? Is it because this realm is too far from the upper realms? Look at them; there are only two of them who have reached the 5-Moon Divine Ascension Realm, but they are clearly Zhang Fei’s women, so I’m sure he won’t let them ascend to our realm if they manage to reach this floor."

"You’re right." Wan Jiang nodded in agreement. "Among them, only Huli Zhishen and Feng Xueying have met the qualifications to ascend to our realm, but the others are not bad, especially the Nameless One and Hun Di. Although their cultivation has not reached that stage, I think they are already worthy to ascend, but I have to discuss this matter with those two people."
"Who are the two people you mean, Master?"

"Kong Bai and Hun Lingwu." Sima Yun immediately understood what Wan Jiang meant. "Old Hun will be interested in Hun Di, as well as Old Kong, who I’m sure will be interested in the Nameless One. However, I will not contact them now, and I will wait for these two to arrive on this first floor."
Sima Yun suddenly remembered someone. "Are you going to contact Senior Feng Bingxin? She is an ice phoenix, and her race is no longer numerous, so I’m sure she will be thrilled to meet Feng Xueying."

"Didn’t you say yourself that Zhang Fei would not allow them to ascend before him?" Wan Jiang asked with a shake of his head. "If Feng Bingxin comes here and meets Feng Xueying, I’m sure she will forcefully take him to our realm, and it will make that kid furious."
"Why do I feel that you are afraid of Zhang Fei, Master? You—
*Bam*
Sima Yun suddenly slammed the wall. "Fuck! That hurts, Master!"
"Don’t talk nonsense, then." Wan Jiang narrowed his eyes, causing him to shudder. "I’ve never been afraid of Zhang Fei, but I’m afraid of the people by his side."
"Sect Master Luo?"

"Ma Kuangyu." Sima Yun just remembered that the person was with Zhang Fei now. "Have you forgotten his status? He’s dead now, but he’ll be alive again after he reshapes his body, and those traitors will be the first to die. Not only him, but Nalan Yushu is also not an ordinary member of the soul-devouring demon race, so we shouldn’t anger that kid."
Sima Yun nodded his head repeatedly, but he saw the old man’s expression suddenly change. "What happened, Master?"
"My previous guess was wrong!! I will meet the higher-ups now." Wan Jiang immediately disappeared from his spot after saying that.
Sima Yun became panicked by that. "That crazy old fart! Has he gone mad? Why would he help them?"

"I’m really speechless about you, kid." Han Ling spoke to Zhang Xiaolong [3] as soon as he opened his eyes. "You only learned the sword intent today, but you’ve already mastered the sword will, and you’ll probably master the sword condensation soon. You’ve even managed to summon your sword spirits, but I didn’t expect them to be twins."
"Please tell me about the sword condensation, Old Han."

"Why are you so impatient?" Zhang Xiaolong [3] rubbed his nose in response to Han Ling. The old man then took a small tree branch beside him. "Sword condensation is an advanced version of the sword intent, and it is several times stronger because a sword cultivator uses their understanding of the sword to create a single powerful force. Moreover, as a soul cultivator, you can combine your sword intent with your soul power to create a sword from nothing using various objects."
Zhang Xiaolong [3] listened as he looked at the tree branch in Han Ling’s hand, and it suddenly turned into a sword, but it was not a real sword and was only made from his sword intent.

"This is the sword condensation, and you only need to channel your sword intent into any object. Controlling your sword intent is the most challenging aspect of this stage, particularly since a mishandled sword can destroy the object." Zhang Xiaolong [3] looked left and right before picking up a fairly large tree branch, and he began to try to study the sword condensation. ’This kid’s tenacity reminds me of my younger self, but he’s more tenacious than me.’

chapters.title: Chapter 977: Visit The Shangguan Clan
paragraphs: Han Ling inwardly sighed as she saw a transparent sword appear on the tree branch in Zhang Xiaolong [3]’s hand, indicating that he had already mastered the sword condensation. ’He only learned to control his sword qi today, but he can already use sword intent, sword will, and sword condensation. If he seriously learns the way of the sword, he might be able to reach the sword god level in the future.’
"Phew." Zhang Xiaolong [3] breathed a sigh of relief as he canceled his sword intent. "What do you think, Old Han?"

"Don’t you realize that your talent is so terrifying?" Han Ling asked back. "I know you have five clones, but your comprehension in learning new things is clearly much faster than anyone else’s. The first time I learned the sword technique, it took me a month to control my sword qi, a year to use my sword intent, and five years to use sword condensation. You do understand the basics, but for you to achieve all three in less than a day is too amazing."
"Haha." Zhang Xiaolong [3] simply laughed.

Han Ling then asked him. "So, are you willing to become my disciple? If you are willing, I will pass on my Forgotten Sword Technique to you, and I believe you will become a peerless sword master in the future."
"Yes, I am willing to be your disciple, Old Han." Zhang Xiaolong [3] wanted to stand up and pay his respects, but Han Ling stopped him and imparted the technique into his mind.
[Ding]
[Obtained the Forgotten Sword Technique. Grade: Immortal.]
’Holy shit! An immortal-grade sword technique!’ Zhang Xiaolong [3] screamed in shock in his heart, but he hurriedly read the technique.
[Silent Edge: A quiet slash that leaves no trace, yet always finds its targets.]
[Whisper Thrust: A silent thrust that bypasses defenses, echoing a blade’s forgotten sorrow.]
[Dust Slash: A strike hidden in drifting dust, old yet deadly.]
[Echo Fang: A counterstrike that mirrors and counters any sword move.]

"Hahaha! My master’s master is a sword demon cultivator from the Paradise Realm, so you shouldn’t be surprised by his grade, right?" Han Ling then told him. "The Ashen Bloom is the technique I used back then, and one lotus will wipe out all the enemies in front of you. Unfortunately, I lost control of my technique and caused the deaths of millions of people from all four races; even more than half of our home realm was destroyed because of it. "One bottle contains my basic pills, and the other contains several types of pills, such as healing pills, recovery pills, and several other types. As for the last two pills, I don’t sell them anywhere, and I only give them to certain people. Since you are my master, I give them to you as a token of my gratitude. You can swallow them in sequence, and you will like their effects."
Han Ling nodded and swallowed the Beauty Restoring Pill first, and he swallowed the Youthful Retaining Pill after the effects of the previous pill restored his youth.

Han Ling looked at his reflection in the river with his eyes wide open, making Zhang Xiaolong [3] smile in amusement. The old man touched his face and rubbed his eyes several times to make sure he didn’t see wrongly. "This! How is this possible? How can your pill bring back your youth?"

"No one has such a pill except for me in this universe, Old Han. I got the pill recipe when I challenged the Star Tower, which originated from the Paradise Realm." Zhang Xiaolong [3] then told Han Ling about the tower and the challenges within. "The second pill is the Youthful Retaining Pill, and you will never age after you take it, so your appearance will remain like this forever."

I like their effects so much, especially since staying young is one of the reasons we cultivate. However, I prefer to use my old form, or I will cause you a lot of trouble in this realm."
"I see." Zhang Xiaolong [3] nodded in understanding. "Old Han, I heard about your family. What—"

"No need to mention them, kid." Zhang Xiaolong [3] stopped talking as soon as Han Ling said that. "Jiang Liushu and our sons have already chosen their paths, and I have long since let them go, so they no longer have anything to do with me."

Zhang Xiaolong [3] did not mention them anymore and talked about something else. "Old Han, you isolated yourself here because of your past mistakes, right? Since the burden in your heart is gone, I think it’s time for you to move on with your life, and you can build a new family from scratch."

"Hahaha." Han Ling laughed before patting his shoulder. "You are still young and a dual cultivator, so I am not surprised if you still follow your lust. Now that I’m older and accustomed to solitude, I no longer harbor such worldly emotions. My dream now is to reach the sword god level, which has been delayed for so long because of the burden of regret in my heart. Since the burden in my heart is gone, I will fully focus on my way of the sword, and you can come to me anytime if you need guidance."
"Yeah." Zhang Xiaolong [3] nodded at him. "So, what is your sword cultivation level? What about me?"

"My sword cultivation level has long been stuck at the sword saint level, and your level should be at the sword emperor level because you can already use sword condensation. Once you master the sword heart, you will become a sword ancestor, and a sword saint when you can use your sword domain." Han Ling immediately rose to his feet, followed by Zhang Xiaolong [3]. "I’ll show you the true sword domain."

After Zhang Xiaolong [3] was far enough away from him, Han Ling activated his sword domain. In an instant, his body was surrounded by a transparent dome, but countless sword intents formed the dome, and they kept spinning around him, causing the falling leaves to instantly disintegrate without a trace.
"Amazing!" Zhang Xiaolong [3] claimed from afar. "How did you create your sword domain, Old Han?"

"Are you thinking about learning the sword domain today?" Zhang Xiaolong [3] rubbed his nose in response to Han Ling. "Unfortunately, you can’t learn the sword domain yet, and you have to refine your sword intent first until they are a hundred times stronger than they are now. Additionally, you also need to master the sword heart first, and you can start learning how to create your sword domain after that."
Zhang Xiaolong [3] returned to Han Ling’s side once he dispelled his sword domain. "Old Han, do you know how to create a domain other than the sword domain?"

"No." Han Ling’s answer disappointed him. "Each domain has different characteristics, and you have to follow its path first. If you are so eager to learn how to create a domain, you should go to the Shangguan Clan and ask them, especially since they are domain masters."
"Domain masters?"

"Yes." Han Ling immediately explained. "Domain masters are those who focus on creating domains from various cultivation paths. "Oh? What kind of domain is that?"

"She is not a dual cultivator, and she only did it with her late husband, but that doesn’t mean she can’t create such a domain. "H... hundreds of women?" Qian Shuang stammered.
"He admitted it to me himself."
"I see." Qian Shuang was disappointed by that. "Sigh! You’re right, I don’t want to get to know a womanizer like him, so I should just forget about him."
Ren Xiyi pulled Qian Shuang to her feet. "Let’s pick up Qian Bing, and the three of us will go to that place."
Qian Shuang nodded at her, and the two immediately went to pick up Qian Bing before going anywhere else.

The next morning, Zhang Xiaolong [3] had already arrived in front of the Shangguan Clan, but the guards forbade him from staying. Therefore, he decided to contact Shangguan Yan, especially since she had once invited him to visit her clan.
In a few minutes, Shangguan Yan had already picked up Zhang Xiaolong [3] at the gate of her clan, surprising the guards. "If this kid comes here again, you can directly bring him to the main hall."
"Yes, Matriarch."
"Let’s go in." Shangguan Yan immediately led Zhang Xiaolong [3] into her clan. "What brought you here so early? Are you willing to accept my previous offer?"

"Haha." Zhang Xiaolong [3] laughed at that. "I’ve considered your offer, but I still haven’t made a decision regarding it. After all, I’ve only been here for two days, and I still don’t have a clear understanding of the situation in this realm."
Shangguan Yan wore a disappointed look after hearing that. "So, what’s your purpose in coming here?"

"I heard that you and your clan are domain masters, and I have long wanted to learn about a domain. Unfortunately, I don’t have any acquaintances who can teach me about it, so I decided to come to you." Shangguan Yan stopped at her spot and looked at Zhang Xiaolong [3]. "I heard about it from Jia Yuyan when I visited the eastern forest yesterday."

"I see." Shangguan Yan nodded in understanding. "Actually, creating a domain is not difficult, but it is not easy either, and you need a deep understanding of one of the cultivation paths. Which cultivation path do you understand best of all the cultivation paths you have taken?"
"The dual cultivation path."

chapters.title: Chapter 978: Learn The Domain
paragraphs: Shangguan Yan had already brought Zhang Xiaolong [3] into an empty room that was covered by several formations, making it impossible for sounds from outside to be heard from inside and vice versa. "We use this place to seek enlightenment, inspiration, and various other things. Therefore, my ancestors installed these formation arrays in the past, and no sound will disturb our concentration here. So, what do you understand about the true dual cultivation?"

"The true dual cultivation is not just a physical relationship, but it is more about the balance of yin and yang, body and soul, desire and transcendence, and many more." Zhang Xiaolong [3] was confused by Shangguan Yan’s strange look after he said that. "Why are you looking at me like this?"

"No." Shangguan Yan shook her head. "You are still too young, and young people like you will usually follow your desires. I initially believed you would claim that true dual cultivation revolves around sex, and your response surprised me."

"Hahaha." Zhang Xiaolong [3] laughed at that. "Even though I am this young, I have already understood so many things that even other senior cultivators cannot understand. Moreover, I am not an ordinary dual cultivator, and I have too many women by my side. Most of them are much more senior than me, and they help me grow mentally."

"How many women do you have?" Zhang Xiaolong [3] gestured with his fingers, which left Shangguan Yan stunned for quite a while. "No wonder your cultivation is so fast, but they are not the only reason behind your cultivation speed, and you use many other things to improve it. By the way, you are right about the true dual cultivation, and it is indeed a mutualistic relationship. Dual cultivation is Yin and Yang, and you will not be able to become a true dual cultivator if you cannot understand both."

"Yin and Yang not only apply in dual cultivation, but they are the basis of everything, including life and death. Without them, this universe would disappear, as would everything in it, whether living or inanimate objects." Shangguan Yan nodded her head repeatedly as she listened to Zhang Xiaolong [3]. "I heard that you can use a domain related to dual cultivation; can you show it to me?"
Shangguan Yan immediately rejected his request. "Unfortunately, I can’t show my domain to you because it will affect your lust, and I don’t want that to happen."
"Hehe." Zhang Xiaolong [3] chuckled in response. "Your domain may be able to influence other people’s lust, but it can’t possibly influence me."
"Hmm?"
"Try it first, and you will know the results."

Shangguan Yan hesitated about using her domain and thought about it seriously for a while, but she still used it in the end. In no time, a black and white dome enveloped them, and two fish swam around it.
"Hmm? They are Yin and Yang fish, right?" Zhang Xiaolong [3] asked as he observed the movements of the two fish.
"Oh?" Shangguan Yan was surprised to see that Zhang Xiaolong [3] was still calm, and there was not the slightest lust in his eyes. "Do you really not feel anything?"
"No." Zhang Xiaolong [3] shook his head. "What other effects does this domain have besides affecting our lust?"

"My dual cultivation domain has many other functions, and one of them is to increase our Yin and Yang Qi, which can speed up our cultivation." Zhang Xiaolong [3] was surprised by Shangguan Yan’s answer, especially since it was similar to the Qi amplifier. "The third function is to help us achieve balance in Yin and Yang, which allows us to synchronize our qi more easily. The fourth function is to trap my opponent in sexual fantasies, and that person will die from the depletion of Yin and Yang Qi if I don’t free him or her. Even so, some cultivators with high mental and soul strengths can free themselves, but not many can do it because I myself am a soul cultivator."
"The fourth function of your domain is certainly cruel, but I like its effect." Zhang Xiaolong [3] then asked her. "Have you ever tried dual-soul cultivation in your domain?"
"My husband died long ago due to his carelessness, and I haven’t had a partner since then, making this domain useless." Shangguan Yan released a soft sigh, remembering the past.
"But you did dual-soul cultivation in this domain in the past, right?"

Shangguan Yan nodded at him. "My late husband was also a soul cultivator, and we usually do both at the same time in this domain; otherwise, my soul cultivation level would not have reached this stage."

"Do you want to dual-soul cultivate with me?" Shangguan Yan narrowed her eyes at Zhang Xiaolong [3]. "I don’t have any bad intentions, and I just want to try the effect of your domain in dual-soul cultivation."

"All right, release your soul now." Shangguan Yan said as she released her soul, but she went into shock as soon as Zhang Xiaolong [3] released his, mainly because his soul was filled with countless white lotuses, each of which had seventy-two petals. "What are those white lotuses? How can there be so many lotuses inside your soul? What are their functions?"

"These lotuses are my bonds with all my women, and their number is equal to the number of women by my side." Zhang Xiaolong [3]’s answer was confusing. Shangguan Yan appeared confused because she had never encountered such a concept in dual cultivation. "Actually, the lotus comes from one of my techniques, but it is difficult to create one. This white lotus grows in my soul because I am a man, and the black lotus is in the souls of all my women."
"Is your technique a soul technique?"

"Yes." Zhang Xiaolong [3] nodded at her. "I got the technique at the Star Tower, and I shared it with all my women. To create this lotus, we must unite our bodies, minds, and souls. Additionally, we need a profound bond, absolute trust, and an unwavering heart toward each other. Once we succeed in creating the lotus, our soul power and Qi capacity will increase quite a bit, and it will also increase and strengthen the Yin and Yang Qi in our bodies."
"Hmm?" Shangguan Yan looked at those white lotuses and counted their numbers. "Doesn’t this mean that the Qi capacity in your body is almost unlimited?"
Zhang Xiaolong [3] smiled in response. "Even if I dual cultivate with all of them for several days non-stop, my Yang Qi will not experience depletion, and I even share it with some of my family."

Shangguan Yan fell silent as she continued to stare at those white lotuses inside Zhang Xiaolong [3]’s soul, and her mind thought of something unusual, but she quickly threw the idea out of her mind. "Let’s try dual-soul cultivation."

"Yeah." After the two of them sat on the floor, Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately grabbed Shangguan Yan’s hand, and his soul quickly connected with hers. "Don’t hold back your soul power and Yin Qi, especially since my body and soul are capable of accommodating both."
Shangguan Yan closed her eyes, and she began to channel her soul power and Yin Qi into his body and soul, followed by Zhang Xiaolong [3], who immediately did the same.

With the effect of Shangguan Yan’s domain, their Yin and Yang quickly reached balance, and their Qi continued to flow in a circular manner between their bodies and souls, which became faster with each passing moment.

’This kid’s control over his soul power and Yang Qi is truly amazing, and I can barely keep up with him. Fortunately, he immediately adjusted himself to my rhythm, or we would have had difficulty achieving harmony.’ Something else entered Shangguan Yan’s body, startling her, but she immediately recognized it as Zhang Xiaolong [3]’s beast aura. ’Did Jia Yuyan tell him that I was a swan beast? Otherwise, he wouldn’t do this, right?’

Shangguan Yan was unaware that Zhang Xiaolong [3] had already used his dream lordship ability on her, especially since he had been eyeing her since they met in the test. However, he knew that he would not be able to approach her directly, and she would be furious if he used his sexual abilities on her. Therefore, he decided to use a different approach, believing that approaching her through her dreams would be the most suitable option.
Three hours later, they withdrew their soul power and Qi from each other’s bodies and souls, and they returned their souls to their respective bodies afterward.
"Phew." Zhang Xiaolong [3] exhaled with a sense of relief. "What do you think about our dual-soul cultivation just now?"

"Our dual soul cultivation is the best I have ever done." Shangguan Yan replied in amazement. "I am truly amazed by your control over soul power and Yang Qi, and your soul power is also higher than your current soul level. As for your Yang Qi, I cannot measure its strength precisely because I have not done such a thing with many men, but I know it is extremely high, and the cultivation of all your women must be able to advance rapidly if they continue to dual cultivate with you."

"Their cultivation is already quite high now, but it is still not enough, and I will continue to help them become strong." Shangguan Yan nodded happily hearing that from Zhang Xiaolong [3], especially since most dual cultivators are very selfish and self-centered. "So, how do I create my domain?"
"Do you understand the laws?"
"I have reached the peak stage in several elemental laws."

Shangguan Yan nodded slightly. "First, we must comprehend the core of dual cultivation, which you have already completed. Second, we also need to comprehend the laws, and you have achieved it. Third, we must form your domain core, which is a condensation of your will, intent, and understanding. Fourth, after you have formed your core, channel your Qi to merge it with the law or concept that you have grasped. You can create your domain after that, but the initial effect may not meet your expectations, so you have the option to destroy it and start over."
"Which laws?"
"Any laws."

"I see." Zhang Xiaolong [3] closed his eyes and started trying to form his domain’s core. The other clones in the training space also did the same thing as him, accelerating the process. ’My will, intent, and understanding in dual cultivation, huh? Let me try it then.’

chapters.title: Chapter 979: Yuan Tianling’s Return
paragraphs: Shangguan Yan bent her legs, hugged them both, and laid his head on her. ’Since he was able to learn that body cultivation technique in less than a day, I believe he will succeed in creating his domain core faster.’

Shangguan Yan suddenly received a voice message from someone outside the room, and she invited that person to enter. Soon, a young man with a tall, thin body entered the room, but he was surprised by the presence of Zhang Xiaolong [3] there.
The young man immediately sat next to Shangguan Yan and asked her a question. ’Who is this man, Mother? Why did you bring him here?’

’Han’er, this kid is Zhang Xiaolong, and you should have heard about his entrance examination results, right?’ Shangguan Han was surprised for a moment before nodding to Shangguan Yan. ’I wanted to recruit him into our clan, but unfortunately, he still hasn’t accepted my offer. Since he wants to learn about domains, I brought him here to teach him, and he is trying to form his domain core now.’

Shangguan Han nodded as he looked at Zhang Xiaolong [3] with a serious gaze. ’He’s only in his twenties, but his cultivation has absurdly reached the 1-Moon Divine Transcend Realm. All his test results are also beyond common sense, especially in the Dao test. If you can persuade him to join our clan, our clan will improve significantly with his help, and we might be able to surpass the Tian and Cao Clans.’

’You are right, but I wanted to recruit him into our clan, not to surpass those two clans.’ Shangguan Han turned to Shangguan Yan in confusion. ’Surpassing those two clans is just a small matter, and I want to reach higher, which is the realm beyond.’
’Are you saying this kid can help us go to the realm beyond?’ Shangguan Han asked in disbelief.

Shangguan Yan smiled at her son’s expression. ’Believe it or not, this kid is the only person who can take us to the realm beyond. That’s why I will do anything to pull him into our clan, and I will ask your sister to approach him if I fail to convince him.’

’Hmm?’ Shangguan Han raised an eyebrow for a moment before looking at Zhang Xiaolong [3] again. ’Although I don’t know his character, he is handsome and talented, so he might be a suitable match for my sister. However, Miyuan is too often childish and hot-headed; I’m not sure he will be interested in her.’
Shangguan Yan let out a soft sigh as she recalled the character of her daughter, Shangguan Miyuan.

’Why did you come here?’ Shangguan Han immediately explained a few things to Shangguan Yan. ’You can go to the Xianjin Realm to buy those things, and you can bring your sister with you so she can stop complaining about being bored.’
’All right, I’ll bring Miyuan with me.’

After her son left, Shangguan Yan returned her focus to Zhang Xiaolong [3], but he still showed no signs of successfully forming his domain core. ’Come on, kid. Don’t disappoint me; I know you can do it.’

At the top of the Moon Tower, Yue Liangyu stood leisurely as she watched the group from the Sovereign Heaven Realm, who were having a serious discussion about ascending to the Paradise Realm. ’All of these people except their younger generation are qualified to ascend, but unfortunately, there are only ten quotas available, so some of them have to withdraw.’
"Do you really not want to ascend to the Paradise Realm, Brother?" Yuan Tiancheng asked his brother.

Yuan Tianquan embraced Yuan Tianling’s shoulder. "If Ziwei and I ascend now, there will be no one to protect our daughter. You and your wife have chosen to ascend, and if we leave, no one will manage our clan, so we stay."
"Brother-in-law, you and sister-in-law can ascend with peace of mind, and the two of us will guard the Yuan Clan." Ren Ziwei spoke to him.

Yuan Tianling immediately joined in. "You don’t have to think about us and ascending today, Uncle. I will bring my parents to the Paradise Realm in the future, and we will gather together again there at that time."
"How are you going to do it?"
"Hehehe." Yuan Tianling stuck out his tongue. "I won’t say anything now, but I have my own way. We will reunite there, so you two don’t have to hesitate to ascend anymore."
Yuan Tiancheng sighed softly. "All right, we will ascend today, and we will wait for you there."

"All right." Yuan Tianling then turned to Yuan Tianhua, who looked sad. She went over to her and hugged her. "Tianhua, you should let your father and Aunt Xiaoqi go, and I will always accompany you in their stead."
"Uhm." Yuan Tianhua immediately hugged her parents. "I will feel sad and miss both of you, but I won’t try to stop you, and I will catch up with you along with Tianling and the others in the future."

Ruan Xiaoqi hugged her daughter tightly. "Forgive us for being too selfish to leave you here, but we really want to ascend to strengthen ourselves. Don’t worry, we will find a way back here, and we will pick you up."
"Yeah." Yuan Tianhua nodded at her mother.
A short distance away, Yuan Tianxie, Yuan Tianjie, and Yuan Tiankong were also bidding farewell to their parents.
Apart from them, Nalan Qingge from the Nalan Clan and Beihuang Fan from the Beihuang Clan also finally decided to ascend.

"Are you all ready?" They nodded to Yue Liangyu, who had been waiting for them since yesterday. "In that case, I will activate the portal now, and you can enter it to go to the Paradise Realm. Some people will meet you all when you get there, and they will offer you to join one of their sects, so the choice is yours."

Yue Liangyu opened the portal, allowing them to enter one by one until all ten had vanished. She then informed Yuan Tianling and the others who were still present. "I don’t know what happened in your realm, but some people on the first floor are clearly targeting you all. I will now send you out of the tower, and you should leave this realm at once."
"Wait, Senior." Yue Liangyu raised an eyebrow at Yuan Tianling. "Can you help me with a small thing?"
"What do you want?"

"Can you ask your friends at the Star Tower about my friend?" Yue Liangyu wanted to refuse, but Yuan Tianling hurriedly explained to her about Zhang Fei, causing her to frown. "I’m not lying to you, Senior. My friend really knows the old man over there and his three disciples, so I hope you can help me ask him whether he is in that tower or not."

’Is that old man crazy? Why is Wan Jiang communicating with people in that realm? Does he not fear punishment?’ Yue Liangyu immediately contacted Wan Jiang and asked him about Zhang Fei. "Your friend is challenging the third floor of the Star Tower with his wives, friends, and families."
"I see." Yuan Tianling nodded in understanding. "Thank you for your help, Senior."

Yue Liangyu simply nodded and waved her hand, sending Yuan Tianling and the other people out of the tower. ’What happened in the Dark Tower? That old man is crazier than Wan Jiang, and his decision will cause big trouble. Sigh! I will go there to meet them, and I will learn more about the situation.’

After they arrived outside the tower, Yuan Tianquan immediately took out a flying artifact and brought them all out of the realm, but they were curious about the identities of the people targeting them, especially since Yue Liangyu didn’t tell them about it.
Above the flying artifact, Ren Ziwei sighed softly as he looked back. "Our group will be quiet with the departure of Sister Xiaoqi and the other one, Sister Luolan."
"Haha." Duanmo Luolan laughed softly. "You were supposed to go with them to the Paradise Realm, but instead you decided to stay."
Ren Ziwei looked at Yuan Tianling, who was comforting Yuan Tianhua. "You know my daughter’s character; I’m sure she will cause trouble if I leave her alone, so I decided to stay and watch over her."
"Hey, who exactly is Zhang Fei? Since when did Tianling know him?" Duanmu Luolan curiously asked.

"Do you remember the incident in the Scorching Earth Realm?" Duanmu Luolan nodded to Ren Ziwei. "My daughter was trapped in the lava with Zhang Fei, but I didn’t expect that they would meet again after that, and I realized it when we picked her up in the Vermilion Realm."
"Oh?"
Ren Ziwei shook her head. "My daughter still hasn’t told me anything about Zhang Fei, but she said that she has already chosen him as her husband."
"Huh?" Duanmu Luolan was shocked by that, but she then turned to Zhu Jian. "Why don’t you ask that male vermilion about Zhang Fei?"

"Actually, I have asked Zhu Jian about Zhang Fei, but he doesn’t know much about him, and all he knows about him comes from his vermilion clan." Ren Ziwei paused for a while as he thought. "However, he said that kid is the leader of the Phoenix Clan now, and it happened because of his relationship with the mysterious woman we met in that realm."
"What exactly is the identity of that mysterious woman?"

"Her name is Feng Yao, the princess of the Phoenix Race." Ren Ziwei’s answer caused Duanmu Luolan to frown. "By the way, we don’t need to think about her, especially since she has already ascended to the Paradise Realm."

Duanmu Luolan nodded slightly. "If your information is correct that she has already ascended to the Paradise Realm with her cultivation still in the Divine Manifestation Realm, I think she is a reincarnator of a powerful cultivator; otherwise, she would not know much about us, and she even knows my ancestor."

"Yeah, you’re right." Ren Ziwei looked into the distance with a troubled gaze. "What do you think will happen if we return to our realm? If the Leng and Cao Clans know that they ascended to the Paradise Realm, they might do something to us."
Duanmu Luolan could only shake her head, especially since she herself did not yet have an answer to that problem.
"Mother! Aunt!" Both women turned to Yuan Tianling. "Ask my father to turn around, and we will go to the Shrouded Sky Realm because that realm is much closer than back to our realm."
Both women frowned. "What do you mean? Why do you want to go to that realm?"
"Don’t you want to meet Zhang Fei?" Ren Ziwei nodded at Yuan Tianling. "He is in that realm now, and he can send us back to our realm faster, so we will meet him there."
"How—"
"Just listen to me and ask my father to turn around." Yuan Tianling left them directly.

"I think Tianling’s idea is good, and we will have plenty of time to deal with future situations if we take a detour to that realm." Ren Ziwei agreed with Duanmu Luolan, and she immediately asked Yuan Tianquan to fly the flying artifact to the Shrouded Sky Realm. "I can’t wait to meet Zhang Fei."
"Me too."

"Brother-in-law, you and sister-in-law can ascend with peace of mind, and the two of us will guard the Yuan Clan." Ren Ziwei spoke to him.
Yuan Tianling immediately joined in.
"You don’t have to think about us and ascending today, Uncle.
I will bring my parents to the Paradise Realm in the future, and we will gather together again there at that time."
"How are you going to do it?"
"Hehehe." Yuan Tianling stuck out his tongue.
"I won’t say anything now, but I have my own way.
We will reunite there, so you two don’t have to hesitate to ascend anymore."
Yuan Tiancheng sighed softly.
"All right, we will ascend today, and we will wait for you there."
"All right." Yuan Tianling then turned to Yuan Tianhua, who looked sad.
She went over to her and hugged her.
"Tianhua, you should let your father and Aunt Xiaoqi go, and I will always accompany you in their stead."
"Uhm." Yuan Tianhua immediately hugged her parents.
"I will feel sad and miss both of you, but I won’t try to stop you, and I will catch up with you along with Tianling and the others in the future."
Ruan Xiaoqi hugged her daughter tightly.
"Forgive us for being too selfish to leave you here, but we really want to ascend to strengthen ourselves.
Don’t worry, we will find a way back here, and we will pick you up."
"Yeah." Yuan Tianhua nodded at her mother.
A short distance away, Yuan Tianxie, Yuan Tianjie, and Yuan Tiankong were also bidding farewell to their parents.
Apart from them, Nalan Qingge from the Nalan Clan and Beihuang Fan from the Beihuang Clan also finally decided to ascend.
"Are you all ready?" They nodded to Yue Liangyu, who had been waiting for them since yesterday.
"In that case, I will activate the portal now, and you can enter it to go to the Paradise Realm.
Some people will meet you all when you get there, and they will offer you to join one of their sects, so the choice is yours."
Yue Liangyu opened the portal, allowing them to enter one by one until all ten had vanished.
She then informed Yuan Tianling and the others who were still present.
"I don’t know what happened in your realm, but some people on the first floor are clearly targeting you all.
I will now send you out of the tower, and you should leave this realm at once."
"Wait, Senior." Yue Liangyu raised an eyebrow at Yuan Tianling.
"Can you help me with a small thing?"
"What do you want?"
"Can you ask your friends at the Star Tower about my friend?" Yue Liangyu wanted to refuse, but Yuan Tianling hurriedly explained to her about Zhang Fei, causing her to frown.
"I’m not lying to you, Senior.
My friend really knows the old man over there and his three disciples, so I hope you can help me ask him whether he is in that tower or not."
’Is that old man crazy?
Why is Wan Jiang communicating with people in that realm?
Does he not fear punishment?’ Yue Liangyu immediately contacted Wan Jiang and asked him about Zhang Fei.
"Your friend is challenging the third floor of the Star Tower with his wives, friends, and families."
"I see." Yuan Tianling nodded in understanding.
"Thank you for your help, Senior."
Yue Liangyu simply nodded and waved her hand, sending Yuan Tianling and the other people out of the tower. ’What happened in the Dark Tower?
That old man is crazier than Wan Jiang, and his decision will cause big trouble.
Sigh!
I will go there to meet them, and I will learn more about the situation.’

After they arrived outside the tower, Yuan Tianquan immediately took out a flying artifact and brought them all out of the realm, but they were curious about the identities of the people targeting them, especially since Yue Liangyu didn’t tell them about it.
Above the flying artifact, Ren Ziwei sighed softly as he looked back.
"Our group will be quiet with the departure of Sister Xiaoqi and the other one, Sister Luolan."
"Haha." Duanmo Luolan laughed softly.
"You were supposed to go with them to the Paradise Realm, but instead you decided to stay."
Ren Ziwei looked at Yuan Tianling, who was comforting Yuan Tianhua.
"You know my daughter’s character; I’m sure she will cause trouble if I leave her alone, so I decided to stay and watch over her."
"Hey, who exactly is Zhang Fei?
Since when did Tianling know him?" Duanmu Luolan curiously asked.
"Do you remember the incident in the Scorching Earth Realm?" Duanmu Luolan nodded to Ren Ziwei.
"My daughter was trapped in the lava with Zhang Fei, but I didn’t expect that they would meet again after that, and I realized it when we picked her up in the Vermilion Realm."
"Oh?"
Ren Ziwei shook her head.
"My daughter still hasn’t told me anything about Zhang Fei, but she said that she has already chosen him as her husband."
"Huh?" Duanmu Luolan was shocked by that, but she then turned to Zhu Jian.
"Why don’t you ask that male vermilion about Zhang Fei?"
"Actually, I have asked Zhu Jian about Zhang Fei, but he doesn’t know much about him, and all he knows about him comes from his vermilion clan." Ren Ziwei paused for a while as he thought.
"However, he said that kid is the leader of the Phoenix Clan now, and it happened because of his relationship with the mysterious woman we met in that realm."
"What exactly is the identity of that mysterious woman?"
"Her name is Feng Yao, the princess of the Phoenix Race." Ren Ziwei’s answer caused Duanmu Luolan to frown.
"By the way, we don’t need to think about her, especially since she has already ascended to the Paradise Realm."
Duanmu Luolan nodded slightly.

"If your information is correct that she has already ascended to the Paradise Realm with her cultivation still in the Divine Manifestation Realm, I think she is a reincarnator of a powerful cultivator; otherwise, she would not know much about us, and she even knows my ancestor."
"Yeah, you’re right." Ren Ziwei looked into the distance with a troubled gaze.
"What do you think will happen if we return to our realm?
If the Leng and Cao Clans know that they ascended to the Paradise Realm, they might do something to us."
Duanmu Luolan could only shake her head, especially since she herself did not yet have an answer to that problem.
"Mother!
Aunt!" Both women turned to Yuan Tianling.
"Ask my father to turn around, and we will go to the Shrouded Sky Realm because that realm is much closer than back to our realm."
Both women frowned.
"What do you mean?
Why do you want to go to that realm?"
"Don’t you want to meet Zhang Fei?" Ren Ziwei nodded at Yuan Tianling.
"He is in that realm now, and he can send us back to our realm faster, so we will meet him there."
"How—"
"Just listen to me and ask my father to turn around." Yuan Tianling left them directly.

"I think Tianling’s idea is good, and we will have plenty of time to deal with future situations if we take a detour to that realm." Ren Ziwei agreed with Duanmu Luolan, and she immediately asked Yuan Tianquan to fly the flying artifact to the Shrouded Sky Realm.
"I can’t wait to meet Zhang Fei."
"Me too."

chapters.title: Chapter 980: Create His Domains
paragraphs: At night, Shangguan Yan’s smile bloomed when a thin light enveloped Zhang Xiaolong [3]’s body, indicating that he had successfully formed his domain core. However, she was a little confused, especially since the light was multicolored. ’What is he doing? Is he thinking of forming multiple domains at once? I know he’s a genius, but he’s too reckless if he thinks of doing something like this.’

As Shangguan Yan contemplated the situation, a light sphere suddenly expanded and filled the entire room. She raised her eyebrows slightly as she felt the changes in her body, and her old injuries slowly began to recover. ’A light domain with a healing effect? Moreover, he not only used his light element, but he also imbued his light elemental law into his domain, and it made the healing effect of his domain increase significantly.’

However, Zhang Xiaolong [3] quickly canceled the light sphere, replacing it with a blue one. Shangguan Yan immediately enveloped her body with her qi, especially since his domain was full of water, making it difficult for her to breathe.

’This kid! How many elements does he have? He previously used light element, but he uses water element and elemental law now.’ Shangguan Yan was shocked by something that appeared next, and it was mixed with the water domain. ’Hmm? How did he inject his light element into his water element? I understand that certain elements can merge into a single one, yet not everyone has the ability to achieve this. Moreover, the combination of water and light elements is quite good, and he can help heal others without having to approach them directly.’
Shangguan Yan withdrew her Qi back as soon as the water domain disappeared, but it was immediately replaced by a green sphere, and a gentle breeze of wind made her long hair flutter.

’He also has the wind element!’ Shangguan Yan screamed in his heart. ’This kid never ceases to amaze me! His speed was already impressive during the speed race with Qing Yun, but he did not utilize his wind element at that time. If he used it at that time, that Qing brat would fall even further behind him.’

The wind within Zhang Xiaolong [3]’s wind domain suddenly became as strong as a whirlwind, and it caused many scratches to appear on the walls of the room, but it did not harm Shangguan Yan in the slightest.
A minute later, the wind disappeared along with the wind domain, but the temperature in the room rapidly dropped, and every corner began to freeze with frost flowers appearing on some sides.
Shangguan Yan was completely speechless as he stared at Zhang Xiaolong [3], who had just activated his ice domain. ’Light, water, wind, and now ice.’

Zhang Xiaolong [3] did not use his ice domain for long and replaced it with a fire domain, leaving Shangguan Yan even more speechless. Quickly, the ice in the room melted, and the air temperature inside became much warmer.

Shangguan Yan raised her eyebrows as she wondered about Zhang Xiaolong [3]’s fire domain. ’What’s going on? Why do I feel several kinds of flames from his fire element? His flame can be wild, fierce, and calm at the same time. I can also feel that his flame is affecting my blood and soul, and I have never experienced such a feeling from any flame before.’

Shangguan Yan did not yet know that Zhang Xiaolong [3] had already obtained the soul and blood flames, and both affected his blood and soul, especially since he injected both of them into his fire domain, making the effects vary based on the effects of all his flames.
When Zhang Xiaolong [3]’s fire domain vanished, the room plunged into complete darkness, causing Shangguan Yan to experience an eerie sensation from his darkness domain.

’What the hell? He also has the darkness element, and his darkness element is much more terrifying than the usual ones.’ Shangguan Yan suddenly saw two eyes appear above Zhang Xiaolong [3], but she couldn’t see the owner, and the gaze caused her to feel a chill down her spine. ’Where did those two eyes come from?’

The eyes suddenly disappeared, as did Zhang Xiaolong [3]’s darkness domain, making the room bright again. Shangguan Yan was just about to exhale in relief when Lei abruptly emerged from his body, shocking her.

Lei immediately sat on Zhang Xiaolong [3]’s head and injected lightning Qi into him, causing a purple sphere to quickly spread throughout the room while numerous purple lightning bolts struck repeatedly.

’A lightning element and elemental law! Most importantly, he has a lightning spirit by his side!’ Shangguan Yan screamed in her heart, but she immediately realized the identity of the owner of the two eyes in the darkness just now. ’If my guess is correct, the owner of those two eyes is a darkness spirit! If I weren’t a cultivator, I would probably die from shock because of his actions.’

Once Zhang Xiaolong [3]’s lightning domain disappeared, Lei immediately entered his body again. However, he still hasn’t opened his eyes and prepared his last domain, which would be of utmost importance to him as a dual cultivator and transcendent lust demon.

For the next few hours, Shangguan Yan did not disturb Zhang Xiaolong [3] and quietly waited in front of him. When it was past midnight, she noticed a slight change in him, but he still didn’t open his eyes; instead, he repeatedly broke and recreated his last domain core. ’What’s going on? Why would he do something like this? Why didn’t he use his dual cultivation domain first? Could it be that he already knew the effects before using it?’

Time continued to pass quickly, and Shangguan Yan fell asleep in front of Zhang Xiaolong [3]. A few hours later, the sounds of beasts emanated from various areas, signaling the imminent rise of the sun.

Hearing that, Shangguan Yan opened her eyes and looked at Zhang Xiaolong [3]. This time, she saw a sphere covering her body, and the sphere was almost the same as hers, which was black and white like Yin and Yang.
However, Zhang Xiaolong [3]’s domain had striking differences from Shangguan Yan’s, especially since the pink color covered the outside.

’Pink color? Where does the pink color come from? Did he use other things to form his dual cultivation domain?’ Shangguan Yan guessed correctly because Zhang Xiaolong [3] had indeed merged some things into his dual cultivation domain, which were his lust demon abilities, and he also merged several other things into it. That was why he had repeatedly destroyed his core domain before, and he did it to achieve it, especially since merging his lust demon abilities into his domain was not an effortless matter. ’Hmm? I hope he will finish soon, especially since I’m curious about the effects of his dual cultivation domain.’
As the sun rose high in the sky, Zhang Xiaolong [3] felt a sense of relief and opened his eyes. "Did I keep you waiting long?"
"Not really." Shangguan Yan replied with a shake of her head. "Why did you previously repeatedly destroy and recreate your domain core?"

"Haha." Zhang Xiaolong [3] chuckled. "As you already know, my primary focus is on the dual cultivation path, so I aimed to create the ideal domain for that purpose. I was able to create it quickly, but I was not satisfied with the results, so I repeatedly did that. After doing it for so long, my dual cultivation domain was finally perfect, and I was completely satisfied with its effects."
"Do you really know the effects of your domain without using it first?" Shangguan Yan asked in amazement.
Zhang Xiaolong [3] asked her back instead. "Shouldn’t everyone know about their domain’s effects without needing to use them?"

"Only you can do that!" Shangguan Yan replied with a slight shout. "My clan members and I only know the effects of our domains after we use them, and we will decide whether to use or recreate them afterwards."
"Oh."
"Oh, your ass!"

"Hahaha." Zhang Xiaolong [3] laughed at hearing Shangguan Yan cursing like that. "I want to show you the effects of my dual cultivation domain, but I won’t do it, especially since the effects are too strong, and you won’t be able to resist them even with your current mental and soul strengths."

"Hmm?" Shangguan Yan narrowed her eyes, but she did not doubt Zhang Xiaolong [3], mainly because of the pink layer outside his domain, the effects of which she did not know. However, he was too curious about it, so he decided to try it anyway. "You don’t need to worry about me; just use your dual cultivation domain."
"Are you sure?" Zhang Xiaolong [3] asked with a mysterious smile.
’What is he thinking? Why is he smiling like that?’ Shangguan Yan nodded at him before rising to her feet. "I’m sure! So, please use your domain now."
Zhang Xiaolong [3] also rose to his feet. "You asked for it yourself, so don’t blame me if you get affected by the effects, okay?"
"I won’t blame you."
"All right, then." Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately activated his domain. "I named it lust domain, and all of its effects are naturally related to lust."
"Hmm?" Shangguan Yan’s confidence wavered slightly as he said that. "It’s okay. How many effects does your domain have?"
"Hmm?" Shangguan Yan’s confidence wavered slightly as he said that. "How many effects does your domain have?"
"Ten."
"Huh?" Shangguan Yan blinked his eyes repeatedly. "How can your domain have that many effects?"
Zhang Xiaolong [3] shrugged his shoulders. "I just followed your words by combining the laws and concepts I understand about dual cultivation, and I used some of my abilities to form it."
"I see." Shangguan Yan expressed her understanding. "What is the first effect of your domain?"

"Like your domain, the first effect of my domain increases the Yin and Yang Qi in our body because it is the most vital part in dual cultivation, and it will also make it easier for us to achieve balance between Yin and Yang. However, the effect of my domain is higher than yours, about sixfold." Zhang Xiaolong [3]’s answer shocked her. "Furthermore, I can combine my domain with formations that can increase our Qi, such as the Boundless Yin-Yang Array and various other formations. Using one of them will increase my domain’s effect, and all the women who dual cultivate with me will rapidly increase their cultivation."
Shangguan Yan propped his chin in thought. "I have an idea about my dual cultivation domain, but no one else in my clan has one, so I have never tried it."
"What idea do you have?"

"Do you think we can combine the effects of our domains?" Zhang Xiaolong [3] was surprised by Shangguan Yan’s question. "If we can combine their effects, it will make the effect even more significant, correct? Moreover, you have many women around you, right? If all your women create their dual cultivation domain and combine it with yours, you’ll all progress much faster than before."

Zhang Xiaolong [3] nodded in agreement with her. "Honestly, I haven’t thought about it, but your words made me curious to try it. Unfortunately, all my women are busy in the Star Tower right now, so I can’t help them create their domains. We might be able to try combining our domains, but we won’t be able to feel the difference in effects without dual cultivating directly."

"That’s true." Shangguan Yan had another idea and immediately activated her dual cultivation domain. "What if we try it by doing dual-soul cultivation? If we combine the effects of our domains, I think the effects will still impact our Yin and Yang Qi, right?"
"I think so." Zhang Xiaolong [3] and Shangguan Yan immediately fell to the floor and released their souls. "Let’s try it then."
"Yeah."
- To Be Continued -

chapters.title: Chapter 981: Lust Domain
paragraphs: Sometime later, they had finished their dual-soul cultivating, but they were both disappointed because the effect of Shangguan Yuan’s domain could not be combined with the effect of Zhang Xiaolong [3]’s domain, and only his domain effect was active. "Sigh! Unfortunately, we can’t combine their effects."

"Haha." Zhang Xiaolong [3] laughed and lifted Shangguan Yan to her feet. "There is no perfect technique, right? Even if we can’t combine the effects of our domains, we can always find better ways to replace them, so you don’t have to feel disappointed like this."
"Yeah, you’re right." Shangguan Yan then asked him. "What is the second effect of your domain?"

"The second effect will arouse everyone’s lust, both men and women. The effect does not work slowly, and people will instantly fall under the control of their lust, which will make them no different from lustful beasts." Shangguan Yan looked afraid after Zhang Xiaolong [3] said that, and she was afraid that the effects of his domain would affect her. If that happens, she won’t be able to control herself, and she will give herself to him. "Don’t worry; I won’t use it on you."
Shangguan Yan felt a sense of relief upon hearing this. "What is the third effect?"

"Haha." Before touching Shangguan Yan’s hand, Zhang Xiaolong [3] activated the third effect of his domain, which caused her body to writhe strongly from his single touch. She almost fell to the floor, but he quickly supported her, and she could feel her orgasm just around the corner. "What do you think of the effect?"
"The effects of your three domains will make your opponent’s body extremely sensitive, right?" Shangguan Yan spoke as she calmed herself down.

"That’s right." Zhang Xiaolong [3] used his transcendent demon touch as a guide to create the third effect of his domain. "Once I activate the third effect, people’s body sensitivity will increase by tenfold, and you’ll reach your orgasm right away if I use it for a little while longer."

’Tch! I don’t understand where he got such an idea, but it would be too embarrassing if I reached my orgasm just because he touched me once!’ Zhang Xiaolong [3] only smiled as he realized Shangguan Yan’s thoughts. "What is the fourth effect?"

"Try this." Sangguan Yan frowned when she noticed that Zhang Xiaolong [3]’s domain absorbed her Yin Qi and transferred it into his body. "I know its effects are evil, but I need it to face those who are truly wicked. Anyone who chooses to be my enemy and attempts to harm those closest to me will face death as I absorb their Yin or Yang Qi completely, using it to enhance my cultivation."
"What a crazy effect!" Shangguan Yan exhaled heavily. "Hey, you shouldn’t use the fourth effect of your domain too often, especially since using shortcuts too often will harm yourself."

"I know." Zhang Xiaolong [3] understood this matter well, as he had frequently absorbed other people’s cultivation in the past; however, he still chose to add the effects of his absorbing technique into his domain. Since the effects became wider, and he didn’t need to get close to his enemies to absorb their Yin and Yang Qi, it gave him more security. "The fifth effect of my domain is quite similar to yours, as it creates a lustful illusion. If they are trapped in it, they will continue to have orgasms until they die."

Shangguan Yan nodded in understanding. "By combining the fourth and fifth effects of your domain, you can more effectively eliminate your trapped enemies. However, old cultivators like me will not fall into your trap easily, and they will definitely move away from you as soon as they notice your domain. Therefore, you must use it at the right time and place, and you can prevent them from escaping from you."

"You’re right." Zhang Xiaolong [3] had also understood that from the start. "This is my first time creating my domain, so I have to get used to using it in battle. Luckily, I have several domains at once, so I can use one of them for diversion before I trap them in my lust domain."
"What’s the sixth?"
"Hahaha." Zhang Xiaolong [3] laughed at that before activating the sixth effect.

A woman who resembled Shangguan Yan appeared by Zhang Xiaolong [3]’s side, leaving Shangguan Yan stunned. She then approached the woman, observing her body from top to bottom. "How did you create this woman?"

"I created this woman using the concept of the clone technique, but she can only exist within this domain, and she will disappear if you leave here. As you can see for yourself, everything about her is completely similar to you." Shangguan Yan nodded in agreement with that, but she suddenly felt him embrace her shoulder like he did to the woman. "Can you feel it?"
Shangguan Yan raised her eyebrows slightly. "Is this woman connected to me directly? Why can I feel your arm around my shoulder even though you did it to her?"

"Yes." Shangguan Yan’s face turned red as soon as Zhang Xiaolong [3] moved his hands to the woman’s buttocks and squeezed them. "You will experience everything I do to her, including if I dual cultivate with her."

Shangguan Yan frowned after hearing that, but she felt relieved when she recalled Zhang Xiaolong [3]’s earlier words that the woman would disappear if she was outside his domain, meaning he would not be able to do anything to her. "Please erase her."

"Sure." The woman disappeared as soon as Zhang Xiaolong [3] canceled the sixth effect of his domain, relieving Shangguan Yan. "By the way, I can’t show you the last three effects of my domain because they will only work in dual cultivation, and there’s no way we’re going to do it, right?"

"I will never dual cultivate with anyone." Shangguan Yan gave him a light nod. "I don’t mean to chase you away, but since you’ve successfully created your domain, you can leave now because I have some other things to take care of."

Zhang Xiaolong [3] took out two of his beauty pills and gave them to her. "You will love their effects, but you must not tell anyone else about these pills, especially since I will never sell them to the public. I am giving them to you as a token of my gratitude, especially since I would not have been able to create my domain without your guidance."
"What is their effect?"
"Go back to your room and swallow them." Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately disappeared from the room, leaving Shangguan Yan wondering about the effects of the two pills.

Shangguan Yan was already in her room, and she immediately swallowed the two pills. A few moments later, her body was filled with a black liquid that made her nauseous, and she immediately purged it from her body.

"What kind of pills are those two? Why don’t I feel any changes in myself?" Shangguan Yan paused to think for a moment before running towards the mirror, but she fell to the floor in shock when she saw her appearance.
*Bam*

"What... what happened to my face and body?" Shangguan Yan frantically touched her face before looking at her hands, which had become firmer and smoother, as well as her legs. "Have I really become young again?"

Shangguan Yan hurriedly stood up and looked at her face in the mirror, leaving her stunned for quite some time. She hurriedly took off her dress to check her entire body, and the results left her completely stunned.

"Oh gosh! His pills not only made my face look young again, but they also rejuvenated my entire body, and I feel much fresher than usual." Shangguan Yan immediately realized something bad, especially if the people in the realm saw her new appearance. "Crap! I can’t show my new appearance to others! Otherwise, they will give me and Zhang Xiaolong big trouble, so I have to hide it with a disguise. But why did he give me such miraculous pills? I did teach him to create his domain, but his pills are much more valuable than that."
Since she still had other matters to attend to, Shangguan Yan immediately ignored it, hurriedly cleaned herself up, and left her residence afterwards.

After he left the Shangguan Clan, Zhang Xiaolong [3] did not return to his residence because he found Tian Jiantang and Qing Yun there, and he was not in the mood to waste time with them. Instead, he went to Han Ling’s hut, but he couldn’t find his master there.

Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately searched for Han Ling’s location on his map, finding him in the city where the Yang Clan lived. "As expected! Although he previously said that he no longer cared about his two sons, he actually still cared about them and their descendants, and he went to that city just to see them from afar."
[Unlike you, your master still has a heart, Master.] Zhang Xiaolong [3] frowned after Mei said that. [You killed Zhang He and Chen Xin, and you snatched Qing Yi from your father, remember?]

"Haha." Zhang Xiaolong [3] laughed at that. "You’re right, I’m heartless if we compare myself with Old Han, but I would rather not be in his position. That’s why I will kill anyone who dares to betray and harm me, even if they are my family, so I will never experience such a situation."
[Master, I detected that someone has been monitoring your movements since three days ago.]

Zhang Xiaolong [3] nodded at her. "I have noticed that person’s presence since he started monitoring me, and I believe he is a member of the Leng Clan. By the way, Leng Hua seemed to suspect that Leng Xueyan had a relationship with me, so he deliberately sent her to the Grand Royal Realm."

[How could Leng Hua suspect that, Master? Since you arrived in this realm, you have only met Leng Xueyan twice. Your first meeting with her was with many people, and she has only come to your residence once.]

"I don’t understand why Leng Hua would suspect his daughter, but his actions made me realize that that old man was truly selfish, and he did not hesitate to sacrifice anyone, including Leng Xueyan." Zhang Xiaolong [3] then thought of something. "If that old man is like that, my efforts to approach his daughter are useless, and she won’t be able to help me destroy her father."
[So, are you thinking of stopping approaching Leng Xueyan, Master?"

"I will still approach Leng Xueyan, and I will speed up my plans for her." Since Han Ling was not there, Zhang Xiaolong [3] decided to leave that place, and he used his nine cloud steps to go to the eastern forest. He actually wanted to save the locations of the natural races for his warp portal, but all the formations there prevented him from doing so, so he could only go there manually.
When he arrived at the eastern forest, Zhang Xiaolong [3] tried to contact Ren Shou, but the male dwarf did not respond to him, so he immediately contacted Jia Yuyan.
Sometime later, the tree formation covering the underground path opened, and Ren Xiyi walked out of it. "Hey—"

"Ugh! You have to restore my father’s original appearance!" Zhang Xiaolong [3] looked at Ren Xiyi in confusion. "Since you left, my parents have been having fun without restraint, and they haven’t finished until today! Their activities bother me a lot, so I’ve had to stay at Qian Shuang’s house ever since."
Zhang Xiaolong [3] nodded in understanding. "Let’s go there first, and I will talk to your parents."
"Yeah." Ren Xiyi immediately led Zhang Xiaolong [3] into the underground and closed the formation again. "Hey, did you do something to Qian Shuang?"
