chapters.title: Chapter 982: Ju Xing - The Ancestor
paragraphs: Zhang Xiaolong [3] turned to Ren Xiyi. "Why do you ask that?"

"Two days ago, I found Qian Shuang daydreaming alone in the garden, and she said that she was thinking about you. Although she didn’t say anything, I could see that she was sad after I told her the number of your women." Ren Xiyi looked at him. "So, did you do something to her?"
Zhang Xiaolong [3] admitted it to her. "That woman was quite interesting, so I did something to her. Actually, I didn’t do it just because of her, but I also did it because of Qian Li."

"Phew." Ren Xiyi let out a soft sigh after she mentioned Qian Li. "That guy is too stubborn because several people have already told him that I don’t have a romantic relationship with you, but he still came to me two days ago and wanted to talk to me about you. I turned him down because he would never accept my explanation, so I would rather not waste my time with him."

"Hahaha." Zhang Xialong [3] laughed at that. "That guy is so old, yet he behaves like a snotty brat. Does he think a woman will be interested in him if he is so possessive and overly jealous? Actually, I am overly possessive myself, but I have never forbidden any of my women from having normal communication with other men. In fact, many other men live with us, but they understand the situation and never think anything strange about my women."

Ren Xiyi nodded in response. "There are so many single men in our races, but none of them act like Qian Li. I liked him at first, but his behavior made me rethink everything, and my interest in him waned with each passing moment."

"I don’t want to pry into your business, but I think you should stay away from him. A man like him will only make your relationship toxic, and you will suffer if you marry him." Zhang Xiaolong [3] then touched her head and shared some of his memories with her, particularly the moments when he was relaxing with all his women in the pavilion. "You can watch my relationship with them."

Ren Xiyi nodded slightly before closing her eyes, and she began to look at Zhang Xiaolong [3]’s memories one by one. She was amazed, jealous, and envious when she saw the beauty of Hu Yue and the others. However, she liked the closeness and togetherness between them, especially since they were like one big family and there was no seniority between them, allowing them to blend together peacefully.
"How is it? I didn’t lie to you, right?"

Ren Xiyi nodded to Zhang Xiaolong [3]. "I originally thought they would often fight with each other since there were so many of them, but they were actually very close and harmonious, and their relationship was even closer than blood sisters. But how can they all be equally beautiful? Their beauty makes me jealous and envious, and I wish I could be as beautiful as them."

"They were already beautiful by nature, and I made them even more beautiful." Ren Xiyi looked at Zhang Xiaolong [3] with a pleading look, but he smiled and pinched her cheeks, causing her to blush. "I can help you become more beautiful, but I won’t do it now. If your appearance suddenly changes, Qian Li will become even more possessive, and he might do something crazy to get you."

Ren Xiyi pouted her lips, but she understood what Zhang Xiaolong [3] meant, so she didn’t force her desire to become beautiful. "Why did you come here all of a sudden? Do you want to meet our leader?"

"Actually, I came today to meet your ancestor, but I can’t possibly meet him by myself, so I will meet Jia Yuyan first." Ren Xiyi was surprised to hear about the purpose of Zhang Xiaolong [3]’s arrival. "I know about him from your father, especially about his condition. I might be able to do something for him, and he could help me if those strong people attack me."

Ren Xiyi nodded in understanding. "For now, only our leader and the other elders can go to the Life Pond, especially since our ancestor’s condition continues to worsen. Our elder said that he won’t be able to survive much longer, and he will probably die in another five to ten years."
"I don’t know if I can really help him, but I want to try first." They then continued their journey, discussing light topics.
Sometime later, Zhang Xiaolong [3] had arrived at Jia Yuyan’s hut, but Ren Xiyi didn’t join him, and she went to Qian Shuang’s place instead.
"Why are you here?" Jia Yuyan asked as she walked out.

"Bring me to the life pond." Jia Yuyan frowned because of Zhang Xiaolong [3]’s request. "Don’t you want to cure that person? I don’t know whether my method will work or not, but there’s no harm in trying it first, right? If I can cure him, he’ll be a valuable reinforcement if those old fogeys suddenly come out of their seclusion."
"All right, I’ll take you to see that person." Jia Yuyan then contacted the other elders to meet them at the Life Pond, especially since she needed everyone to open the place. "Let’s go now."
Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately followed Jia Yuyan. "Hey, can I bring my natural race friends from the Sky Jade Realm here?"
"Oh?" Jia Yuyan naturally remembered the fairy forest in that realm. "Do you really want to bring them all here?"

"Yes." Zhang Xiaolong [3] nodded at her. "Even though I don’t have a close relationship with most of them, they have already recognized me as their leader, so I have to be responsible for them, right? I didn’t bring them to the Nine Stars Realm because that realm is very dangerous, but the situation here should be safer with you here, so I want to bring them here. Moreover, all the formations in this forest separate it from the outside, so Tian Jingxuan and the others shouldn’t be aware of their presence, right?"
"That’s right." Jia Yuyan replied with a nod. "I think it’s fine if you bring them here, and you can also bring their leaders that you left behind in the Evergreen Spirit Haven Realm here."
Zhang Xiaolong [3] was relieved by that. "I’ll use one of my clones to meet them first, and I’ll bring them all here after we finish our business."
"All right."

A while later, they had arrived at the location of the Life Pond, where Ju Tan and the others were waiting for them. However, some of them seemed reluctant for Zhang Xiaolong [3] to enter their sacred area, especially the old elf, Qian Chaoying.

Jia Yuyan immediately spoke to him. "Chaoying, you should understand your ancestor’s situation, right? I came from the Paradise Realm, but I can’t heal him with my healing abilities. I don’t know if Zhang Xiaolong’s method will work, but we should still try everything possible to heal him, and our strength will increase if he really succeeds in healing him."

"I understand." Qian Chaoying and the other elders immediately took out their respective devices and activated them. In a few moments, the barrier that covered the area disappeared quickly, revealing a stunning landscape with the Life Pond at its center.

’The natural energy in this pond is incredibly powerful! No wonder it’s called the Life Pond.’ Zhang Xiaolong [3] tried to absorb the natural energy in that place, but Jia Yuyan immediately asked him to stop because it would disturb the ancestor. "Let’s meet him now, and I’ll try some ways to cure him."

"Hmm?" Zhang Xiaolong [3] was slightly surprised as he looked at the old man meditating within the Life Pond. His appearance was like an elf, but his body was big and sturdy like a giant. ’Scan him, Mei.’
[Yes]
Name: Ju Xing
Race: Half Giant-Half Elf
Gender: Male
Cultivation: 5-Moon Divine Ascension Realm
Elements:
- Light [Peak Stage]
- Earth [Peak Stage]
Elemental laws:
- Light [Perfection Stage]
- Earth [Perfection Stage]
Cores:
- Light [Peak Rank]
- Earth [Peak Rank]
Physique: Gigantic Elf
Special Physique: None
Special Bloodline: None
Partner: None

’A mixed breed between an elf and a giant, huh?’ Zhang Xiaolong [3] muttered to himself. ’What exactly happened to him, Mei? Old Ren previously said that his lifespan was almost exhausted, but it was still quite long. However, his condition is awful, and he keeps getting weaker like this.’

Qian Chaoying wanted to ask Zhang Xiaolong [3], but Jia Yuyan stopped him, especially since he was seriously observing Ju Xing. The other elders were also curious whether he could cure their ancestor or not, but they still waited patiently.

Sensing their presence, Ju Xing finally opened his dull eyes, and his gaze fell directly on Zhang Xiaolong [3]. "You’re a human, a heavenly fox, and a demon. You are the man we have been waiting for all this time. Young man, you should not waste your time thinking about me; instead, focus on yourself, as many living beings have been waiting for your arrival for a long time."

"Can’t do it, Old Xing." Jia Yuyan and the others were surprised to hear that Zhang Xiaolong [3] knew the man’s name, especially since they had not told him about it. "What happened in the first place for your condition to decline like this? Based on your situation, it is clear that the cause is not natural; I am certain that something or someone has caused your condition to deteriorate like this."
"Is that true, Ancestor? What exactly happened to you?" Ju Tan asked Ju Xing.

Qian Chaoying also spoke to him. "Ancestor, please tell us the truth, and we will find a way to heal you. The situation in this realm is not as favorable as it was in the past, and many greedy cultivators want to destroy us. Therefore, we need you to help us, and we will protect our young generation together."
Zhu Ru, Jing Shenlin, and the other elders joined forces to persuade Ju Xing to reveal the truth, as he appeared reluctant to do so.

Jia Yuyan also joined them. "Old man, you are too selfish if you think about dying, especially since there are still so many young people from our natural races in this realm. You should already know about those old fogies, and you know that we have no ability to protect them. Therefore, we hope that you can tell us the truth, and we will together think of the best way to cure you."
"Hmm?" All of them turned to Zhang Xiaolong [3] once the light female winged-race figure appeared behind him. "A winged race?"
Instead of answering their questions, Ju Xing directed his inquiry to Zhang Xiaolong [3]. "How did you create such a thing, young man? Did you use your light element to create this woman?"
’Did you manage to find something strange inside his body, Mei?’
[Master, there is something inside his dantian, Master. I can’t examine it too deeply, but I think it is the cause of his weakened condition, so you should get rid of it first.]

"Yeah." The female figure enveloped Ju Xing’s body, and Zhang Xiaolong [3] channeled his light element into his body to improve his condition. "Old Xing, tell me what kind of thing is in your dantian, especially since it makes you keep weakening like this."
Jia Yuyan and the others stared at Ju Xing in shock, but he paid them no attention. "How did you know about that, young man?"
"That’s not important now." Zhang Xiaolong [3] looked at him. "I’m confident that I can cure you and restore your condition to normal, but I want to know more details about that thing first."

sentences.text: Zhang Xiaolong [3] turned to Ren Xiyi.
"Why do you ask that?"
"Two days ago, I found Qian Shuang daydreaming alone in the garden, and she said that she was thinking about you.
Although she didn’t say anything, I could see that she was sad after I told her the number of your women." Ren Xiyi looked at him.
"So, did you do something to her?"
Zhang Xiaolong [3] admitted it to her.
"That woman was quite interesting, so I did something to her.
Actually, I didn’t do it just because of her, but I also did it because of Qian Li."
"Phew." Ren Xiyi let out a soft sigh after she mentioned Qian Li.
"That guy is too stubborn because several people have already told him that I don’t have a romantic relationship with you, but he still came to me two days ago and wanted to talk to me about you.
I turned him down because he would never accept my explanation, so I would rather not waste my time with him."
"Hahaha." Zhang Xialong [3] laughed at that.
"That guy is so old, yet he behaves like a snotty brat.
Does he think a woman will be interested in him if he is so possessive and overly jealous?
Actually, I am overly possessive myself, but I have never forbidden any of my women from having normal communication with other men.
In fact, many other men live with us, but they understand the situation and never think anything strange about my women."
Ren Xiyi nodded in response.
"There are so many single men in our races, but none of them act like Qian Li.
I liked him at first, but his behavior made me rethink everything, and my interest in him waned with each passing moment."
"I don’t want to pry into your business, but I think you should stay away from him.

A man like him will only make your relationship toxic, and you will suffer if you marry him." Zhang Xiaolong [3] then touched her head and shared some of his memories with her, particularly the moments when he was relaxing with all his women in the pavilion.
"You can watch my relationship with them."
Ren Xiyi nodded slightly before closing her eyes, and she began to look at Zhang Xiaolong [3]’s memories one by one.
She was amazed, jealous, and envious when she saw the beauty of Hu Yue and the others.
However, she liked the closeness and togetherness between them, especially since they were like one big family and there was no seniority between them, allowing them to blend together peacefully.
"How is it?
I didn’t lie to you, right?"
Ren Xiyi nodded to Zhang Xiaolong [3].

"I originally thought they would often fight with each other since there were so many of them, but they were actually very close and harmonious, and their relationship was even closer than blood sisters.
But how can they all be equally beautiful?
Their beauty makes me jealous and envious, and I wish I could be as beautiful as them."
"They were already beautiful by nature, and I made them even more beautiful." Ren Xiyi looked at Zhang Xiaolong [3] with a pleading look, but he smiled and pinched her cheeks, causing her to blush.
"I can help you become more beautiful, but I won’t do it now.
If your appearance suddenly changes, Qian Li will become even more possessive, and he might do something crazy to get you."
Ren Xiyi pouted her lips, but she understood what Zhang Xiaolong [3] meant, so she didn’t force her desire to become beautiful.
"Why did you come here all of a sudden?
Do you want to meet our leader?"

"Actually, I came today to meet your ancestor, but I can’t possibly meet him by myself, so I will meet Jia Yuyan first." Ren Xiyi was surprised to hear about the purpose of Zhang Xiaolong [3]’s arrival.
"I know about him from your father, especially about his condition.
I might be able to do something for him, and he could help me if those strong people attack me."
Ren Xiyi nodded in understanding.
"For now, only our leader and the other elders can go to the Life Pond, especially since our ancestor’s condition continues to worsen.
Our elder said that he won’t be able to survive much longer, and he will probably die in another five to ten years."
"I don’t know if I can really help him, but I want to try first." They then continued their journey, discussing light topics.
Sometime later, Zhang Xiaolong [3] had arrived at Jia Yuyan’s hut, but Ren Xiyi didn’t join him, and she went to Qian Shuang’s place instead.
"Why are you here?" Jia Yuyan asked as she walked out.
"Bring me to the life pond." Jia Yuyan frowned because of Zhang Xiaolong [3]’s request.
"Don’t you want to cure that person?
I don’t know whether my method will work or not, but there’s no harm in trying it first, right?
If I can cure him, he’ll be a valuable reinforcement if those old fogeys suddenly come out of their seclusion."
"All right, I’ll take you to see that person." Jia Yuyan then contacted the other elders to meet them at the Life Pond, especially since she needed everyone to open the place.
"Let’s go now."
Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately followed Jia Yuyan.
"Hey, can I bring my natural race friends from the Sky Jade Realm here?"
"Oh?" Jia Yuyan naturally remembered the fairy forest in that realm.
"Do you really want to bring them all here?"
"Yes." Zhang Xiaolong [3] nodded at her.
"Even though I don’t have a close relationship with most of them, they have already recognized me as their leader, so I have to be responsible for them, right?
I didn’t bring them to the Nine Stars Realm because that realm is very dangerous, but the situation here should be safer with you here, so I want to bring them here.
Moreover, all the formations in this forest separate it from the outside, so Tian Jingxuan and the others shouldn’t be aware of their presence, right?"
"That’s right." Jia Yuyan replied with a nod.
"I think it’s fine if you bring them here, and you can also bring their leaders that you left behind in the Evergreen Spirit Haven Realm here."
Zhang Xiaolong [3] was relieved by that.
"I’ll use one of my clones to meet them first, and I’ll bring them all here after we finish our business."
"All right."
A while later, they had arrived at the location of the Life Pond, where Ju Tan and the others were waiting for them.
However, some of them seemed reluctant for Zhang Xiaolong [3] to enter their sacred area, especially the old elf, Qian Chaoying.
Jia Yuyan immediately spoke to him.
"Chaoying, you should understand your ancestor’s situation, right?
I came from the Paradise Realm, but I can’t heal him with my healing abilities.
I don’t know if Zhang Xiaolong’s method will work, but we should still try everything possible to heal him, and our strength will increase if he really succeeds in healing him."
"I understand." Qian Chaoying and the other elders immediately took out their respective devices and activated them.
In a few moments, the barrier that covered the area disappeared quickly, revealing a stunning landscape with the Life Pond at its center.
’The natural energy in this pond is incredibly powerful!
No wonder it’s called the Life Pond.’ Zhang Xiaolong [3] tried to absorb the natural energy in that place, but Jia Yuyan immediately asked him to stop because it would disturb the ancestor.
"Let’s meet him now, and I’ll try some ways to cure him."
"Hmm?" Zhang Xiaolong [3] was slightly surprised as he looked at the old man meditating within the Life Pond.
His appearance was like an elf, but his body was big and sturdy like a giant. ’Scan him, Mei.’
[Yes]
Name: Ju Xing
Race: Half Giant-Half Elf
Gender: Male
Cultivation: 5-Moon Divine Ascension Realm
Elements:
- Light [Peak Stage]
- Earth [Peak Stage]
Elemental laws:
- Light [Perfection Stage]
- Earth [Perfection Stage]
Cores:
- Light [Peak Rank]
- Earth [Peak Rank]
Physique: Gigantic Elf
Special Physique: None
Special Bloodline: None
Partner: None
’A mixed breed between an elf and a giant, huh?’ Zhang Xiaolong [3] muttered to himself. ’What exactly happened to him, Mei?
Old Ren previously said that his lifespan was almost exhausted, but it was still quite long.
However, his condition is awful, and he keeps getting weaker like this.’
Qian Chaoying wanted to ask Zhang Xiaolong [3], but Jia Yuyan stopped him, especially since he was seriously observing Ju Xing.
The other elders were also curious whether he could cure their ancestor or not, but they still waited patiently.
Sensing their presence, Ju Xing finally opened his dull eyes, and his gaze fell directly on Zhang Xiaolong [3].
"You’re a human, a heavenly fox, and a demon.
You are the man we have been waiting for all this time.
Young man, you should not waste your time thinking about me; instead, focus on yourself, as many living beings have been waiting for your arrival for a long time."
"Can’t do it, Old Xing." Jia Yuyan and the others were surprised to hear that Zhang Xiaolong [3] knew the man’s name, especially since they had not told him about it.
"What happened in the first place for your condition to decline like this?
Based on your situation, it is clear that the cause is not natural; I am certain that something or someone has caused your condition to deteriorate like this."
"Is that true, Ancestor?
What exactly happened to you?" Ju Tan asked Ju Xing.
Qian Chaoying also spoke to him.
"Ancestor, please tell us the truth, and we will find a way to heal you.
The situation in this realm is not as favorable as it was in the past, and many greedy cultivators want to destroy us.
Therefore, we need you to help us, and we will protect our young generation together."
Zhu Ru, Jing Shenlin, and the other elders joined forces to persuade Ju Xing to reveal the truth, as he appeared reluctant to do so.
Jia Yuyan also joined them.
"Old man, you are too selfish if you think about dying, especially since there are still so many young people from our natural races in this realm.
You should already know about those old fogies, and you know that we have no ability to protect them.
Therefore, we hope that you can tell us the truth, and we will together think of the best way to cure you."
"Hmm?" All of them turned to Zhang Xiaolong [3] once the light female winged-race figure appeared behind him.
"A winged race?"
Instead of answering their questions, Ju Xing directed his inquiry to Zhang Xiaolong [3].
"How did you create such a thing, young man?
Did you use your light element to create this woman?"
’Did you manage to find something strange inside his body, Mei?’
[Master, there is something inside his dantian, Master.
I can’t examine it too deeply, but I think it is the cause of his weakened condition, so you should get rid of it first.]
"Yeah." The female figure enveloped Ju Xing’s body, and Zhang Xiaolong [3] channeled his light element into his body to improve his condition.
"Old Xing, tell me what kind of thing is in your dantian, especially since it makes you keep weakening like this."
Jia Yuyan and the others stared at Ju Xing in shock, but he paid them no attention.
"How did you know about that, young man?"
"That’s not important now." Zhang Xiaolong [3] looked at him.
"I’m confident that I can cure you and restore your condition to normal, but I want to know more details about that thing first."
- To Be Continued -

chapters.title: Chapter 983: The Cause
paragraphs: Ju Xing let out a soft sigh before telling them. "I myself don’t know what kind of thing it is, but that guy said that it’s a Gu insect."

"As expected." Zhang Xiaolong [3] clasped his hands. "I can’t check inside your dantian directly, but I suspect that it’s a Gu insect, especially since its effect is almost the same as the one I encountered before."
"Who was the one who used the Gu insect on you, Ancestor?" Ju Tan asked.

"Gu Changsheng." Ju Tan and the others gasped as soon as Ju Xing mentioned the name. "Back then, I was looking for something, but he and Cao Yunbai suddenly surrounded me. I managed to defeat and push them back, but that guy suddenly used his Gu insect, and I couldn’t stop it from entering my body. Since then, the insect stayed in my dantian, and it continued to absorb my strength and lifespan, which made my condition become like this now."
"Who is Gu Changsheng?"

Jia Yun immediately explained to Zhang Xiaolong [3]. "Gu Changsheng is the ancestor of the Gu Clan, one of the Cao Clan’s in-laws. Beside that clan, there are still the Bao and Sima Clans, and those two clans are no less powerful than the Gu and Cao Clans."
"I see." Zhang Xiaolong [3] nodded in understanding before saying to Ju Xing. "Since the thing in your dantian is a Gu insect, I need someone’s help to remove it from your body."
"But—"

"Do you want your ancestor to die? Is this sacred place more important than his life and the future of your younger generation?" Zhang Xiaolong [3] interrupted Qian Chaoying with harsh questions. "If you feel that this place is more important than them, so be it. I will not cure him and let him die, but the lives of everyone in this place will be your responsibility, and you will have to bear the consequences if those people attack here and massacre them."

Zhang Xiaolong [3]’s words filled Qian Chaoying’s face with rage, but he was no fool either. He was fully aware of the risks if the Cao and other clans attacked them, and they would not be able to face the combination of the four clans with their current strengths, let alone the Leng Clan, which was also eyeing them. "All right, you can bring that person here."
"Can I use my gate here?" Zhang Xiaolong [3] questioned Jia Yuyan.
Jia Yuyan nodded at him. "You can open your gate, but you can’t use your warp portal."

"I see." Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately opened the gate to the Nine Stars Realm before disappearing into it. A few seconds later, he had returned to that place with Li Nantian. "Check this old man’s body, and I want you to take out the Gu insect inside his dantian."
"Huh?" Li Nantian was shocked to hear that. "Is there really a Gu insect in his dantian?"

"Yes." Li Nantian took out a bottle and opened it. A small black and red insect came out of it, shocking Qian Chaoying and the others. Zhang Xiaolong [3] directly explained it to them. "He is a Gu Master from the Grand Royal Realm, but he is my slave now, so you guys don’t need to worry about him harming Old Xing."
"How did you manage to capture him?" Zhu Ru asked.

Instead, Jia Yuyan answered him. "This man was a subordinate of the Huangfu Clan from the Grand Royal Realm, and they ordered him to help their descendant in the Nine Stars Realm. This kid was quite vicious towards his enemies, and he enslaved this man because of their enmity."
"Hehe." Zhang Xiaolong [3] chuckled and pulled Jia Yuyan into his arms. "You really understand me, my lovely stalker."
"Back off!" Jia Yuyan pushed Zhang Xiaolong [3] , causing him to stumble backwards. "Don’t touch me again! Otherwise, I’ll beat you black and blue!"

Jing Shenlin and the others seemed confused by Jia Yuyan’s reaction, especially since the female elf was always calm and relaxed in any situation, but she suddenly reacted like that. However, they didn’t know that the effects of Zhang Xiaolong [3]’s transcendent demon touch lingered within her body, and his actions just now caused it to react again.
’Damn it! Even though he used his abilities on me three days ago, I can still feel the effects of it to this day.’ Jia Yuyan inwardly grumbled as she calmed herself down.

’Hahaha! You were too confident in your abilities, and you’re feeling the effects now. Moreover, the effects won’t wear off before you reach orgasm several times, and you’ll continue to react every time I touch you.’ Zhang Xiaolong [3] then ordered his slave. "Tiannan, remove that Gu insect from Old Xing’s body now."

"Yes, Master." Li Tiannan then placed his Gu insect into Ju Xing’s hand, and it quickly entered his body through his nostril. He controlled it and moved it toward his dantian to lure the other insects out of there. "Senior, you will probably experience uncomfortable symptoms, so please endure it for a while."
Ju Xing nodded at him. "All right, you don’t need to worry about me."
"Yes."
While they were waiting, Zhang Xiaolong [3] asked Jia Yuyan again. "Did Tian Jingxuan send Chi Yuexin, Lin Zuxin, and Wenren Yue to the Red Sun Realm?"

"Not really." Jia Yuyan replied with a shake of her head. "When you were undergoing the battle test, Wenren Yue told us that your mirror technique was similar to Shang Ziyuan’s, and she also told us some things about her. Therefore, we decided to send people to the Red Sun Realm specifically to recruit her, but I have warned them not to use force against her, mainly because of you."

"How did Wenren Yue know about Shang Ziyuan’s abilities?" Jia Yuyan immediately told Zhang Xiaolong [3], according to the woman’s explanation to them at that time. "Lin Jingxia, huh? All the events that have happened recently have made me feel that this universe is too small despite its vastness, and many people I know recently have connections with each other, including Old Han’s master."
"Did you do anything to Chi Yuexin and the others?" Jia Yuyan curiously asked.

Zhang Xiaolong [3] smiled at her question. "Do you think I will let those who are eyeing my property go so easily? They didn’t use force or anything, but I still have to do something to them just in case something unpleasant happens, right?"
’This kid is always cautious, huh?’ Zhu Ru and the other elders said in their hearts.
"You’re right." Jia Yuyan nodded in agreement. "I hope you will never use it on them, or your situation will turn bad in this realm if you do something to them."
"Hahaha." Zhang Xiaolong [3] laughed at that. "Even if I did something to them, I certainly wouldn’t do it openly, and I would do it without them or anyone else knowing."
Jia Yuyan simply shook her head, especially since she could already guess what Zhang Xiaolong [3] would do to Chi Yuexin, Lin Zuxin, and Wenren Yue if they looked for trouble with him.

"Kid." Zhang Xiaolong [3] turned to Ju Tan directly. "I have already given your pills to my race members, and I have also discussed my decision with them. They want to meet you, so I hope you can make time to meet them."
Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately agreed to that. "After Li Tiannan removes his Gu insect from Old Xing’s body, we will go directly to your race’s residence to meet them."
"Thank you."
"It’s just a trivial matter, so you don’t need to thank me."

Sometime later, Li Tiannan pulled his Gu insect out of Ju Xing’s body and informed Zhang Xiaolong [3]. "Master, the insect is too strong for my insect, so I can’t remove it from this senior’s body. My father or grandfather should be able to do it, but they are living in the Grand Royal Realm now, and they are helping the Huangfu Kingdom to deal with the attack from the Qiang Kingdom."

"Oh?" Zhang Xiaolong [3] was shocked to hear that, and he immediately contacted his two slaves to confirm the situation in that realm. "The situation is really dire, huh? The Qiang Kingdom has already taken over a third of the Huangfu Kingdom’s territory, and they are continuously pushing the troops from that kingdom back."
"Yes." Li Tiannan nodded at him. "Actually, my father asked me to return to our realm, but I refused his request because I still have to complete the Gu heart for you."

"You don’t need to think about them and focus on the Gu heart because one of my clones is on his way to that realm, and he will arrive in a few days. Besides, Leng Hua also sent Leng Xueyan there to help the Huangfu Kingdom, and she is much stronger than everyone in that realm, so the situation will definitely be under control." Zhang Xiaolong [3] directly sent Li Tiannan back to the Nine Stars Realm before speaking to Ju Xing. "Old Xing, just be patient for a few more days; I will definitely cure you by then."
"All right, I will wait for you."
After that, they immediately left the place and sealed the area again, and Zhang Xiaolong [3] followed Ju Tan to meet the other members of the giant race.
"Senior Xishui, please stop flying."
Feng Xishui immediately stopped and asked Zhang Fei [5], who was sitting casually on his back. "What is it?"

"We won’t go to the Shandian Realm now, and we’ll go to the Grand Royal Realm first." Seeing Zhang Fei [5] take out Feng Jiu’s flying artifact, Feng Xishui immediately returned to his human form, and the two of them flew away from that location. "I need someone from that realm to heal my new friend, but that person is helping the Huangfu Kingdom, which is at war with the Qiang Kingdom. If that person dies, it will be difficult for me to save him, so we must arrive at that realm as soon as possible."
Feng Xishui nodded in understanding. "If you burn enough purple jewels, we can arrive at the Grand Royal Realm in three days."

"How much do I need to speed it up?" Zhang Fei [5] had never used Feng Jiu’s flying artifact because he felt it was a waste to use his jewels, and Feng Xishui’s speed was much faster than the normal speed of the flying artifact.
"A million at least."
Zhang Fei [5] let out a heavy sigh before taking out that many purple jewels, and he hurriedly inserted them into the source of the flying artifact, causing its speed to increase significantly.
"Are you going to get involved in their war?"

"No." Zhang Fei [5] shook his head at Feng Xishui and looked into the distance. "I don’t care if the Huangfu Kingdom is destroyed, but I can’t let the people of the Li Clan die, especially since the one who can help me is from that clan. Moreover, someone from the Sovereign Heaven Realm is heading to that realm right now, and she is more than enough to save that kingdom. However, I have plans to find suitable locations in all those kingdoms to open my shops, but I don’t have the right people to manage them yet."
"Didn’t one of your slaves come from that clan? Why don’t you bring him back to his realm?"

"Hmm?" Zhang Fei [5] thought for a moment. "You are right, I will bring Li Tiannan and Gu Jinling to that realm, and they should be able to create the Gu heart faster. However, I have to make sure the situation in the Huangfu Kingdom is calm first, or the other kingdoms will disturb them."
Feng Xishui patted his shoulder. "The only way to prevent that is to show your strength, and those people will definitely think twice about disturbing them."
"Yeah, you are right. Let’s wait until we get there first."

"Even though your Shangguan Clan is one of the founders of this clan, the strength of your clan is no longer the same as in the past, and I can easily destroy you guys."
"You—"

"If you dare to ignore my warning, I will immediately destroy this clan, and I will make you experience suffering that you have never experienced before."
Shangguan Yan immediately sat down on an empty chair once Leng Hua left, and she squeezed the armrest hard, causing both of them to shatter.

"That bastard! How dare he threaten me! Does he really think he can fight against us, the domain masters? Even my domain can trap him and kill him! Tch! Shangguan Yan immediately contacted the others and asked them to gather to discuss the matter, but she remembered Zhang Xiaolong [3] and sent him a voice transmission right away. "I don’t want to involve him in my problem with Leng Hua, but I somehow feel like he’s the only one who can help me solve this problem."

"Do you need my help?"

"No need." Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately opened the gate. "Even though Leng Hua and the Leng Clan are strong, I am confident that I can deal with them step by step, and I will make that old man regret his threats to Shangguan Yan."
’He’s furious.’ Ju Tan muttered in his heart as he watched Zhang Xiaolong [3] disappear. "It seems that he likes Shangguan Yan; otherwise, he wouldn’t be so furious."
Tap... Tap...

"Has he left, Uncle Ju?"

chapters.title: Chapter 986: Meet The Seniors
paragraphs: "What do you think I should do now?" Shangguan Yan asked the others. "Honestly, I am not afraid of Leng Hua, but my Shangguan Clan will lose if we go to war with the Leng Clan, especially since their numbers are much greater."

Shi Yan immediately expressed his idea. "Since Leng Hua has started to act like that, I think it’s time for us to settle things with them. Moreover, Cao Ren and the others are still away, so I think this is our best chance to get rid of the Leng Clan, and we can focus on preparing to face the Cao Clan and its allies."

"I agree with you, Old Shi." Qing Huang responded by nodding. "Leng Hua’s actions of threatening Shangguan Yan were excessive and outrageous, especially since his problem was not with the Shangguan Clan but Zhang Xiaolong."

Tian Jingxuan shared their thoughts, but he was also considering the more complex implications of fighting Leng Hua and the Leng Clan. Although Cao Ren and many members of the Cao Clan were absent, the Gu, Bao, and Sima Clans were present, and they were ready to take advantage of the situation. "Are Chi Yuexin and Lin Zuxin still not back?"
"We’re here." They immediately turned to look at Chi Yuexin, Lin Zuxin, and Wenren Yue, who had just arrived. "We failed to recruit Shang Ziyuan, and we dare not force our will."
"How did you two fail to recruit Shang Ziyuan? Have you offered her the best opportunity?" Shi Yan asked them
Both women immediately sat down on the empty chairs, with Wenren Yue standing behind Chi Yuexin. "The Shang Clan has been destroyed, and the Zhang Clan took over their clan."
"The Zhang Clan?"

"Can you guys guess the identity of the leader of the Zhang Clan?" All of them shook their heads at Lin Zuxin. "The leader of the clan is Zhang Fei, and he is Zhang Xiaolong’s identical twin brother."
"What?" Qing Huang and the others screamed in shock.

Lin Zuxin immediately told them. "At first, we thought Zhang Fei was Zhang Xiaolong’s clone, but I can confirm that he is a real person. But I find some things difficult to believe, like their similar auras and cultivation. There are several twins in my Lin Clan, but none of them have the same aura and cultivation, which makes me feel strange about those two."
"Are the two of them really identical?"

"Not really." Chu Yuexin created a qi screen in front of them, and she inserted a little of her memories into it. "Zhang Fei’s face, physique, aura, and cultivation are indeed identical to those of Zhang Xiaolong. However, I feel that their characters are entirely different, and this person is much more cruel than his twin brother. He killed many members of the Shang Clan, and he imprisoned Shang Ziyuan in a special place. At first, I thought of using a little force, but I gave up my intention because there were several powerful cultivators by his side, and their cultivation was on par with ours."

Jia Yuyan smiled faintly as she listened to the two women because she already knew about Zhang Fei’s five clones, and she was sure that the one they met in the Red Sun Realm was one of her clones. ’That brat is such an expert con artist! He deliberately made the characters of his two clones different to confuse them, but they are basically the same person with such a vile character.’

Tian Jingxuan immediately spoke to them. "Even though I want Shang Ziyuan to join us, there is nothing we can do now. Therefore, we should forget about him and focus on the problem at hand, especially about Leng Hua’s threat to Shangguan Yan."
"Huh?" Chi Yuexin and Lin Zuxin were shocked to hear that. "Did Leng Hua really threaten you?"
"When did he do it?"

"This morning he came to my clan and threatened me." Shangguan Yan then told the two women the beginning of his problem with Leng Hua. "That kid came to me because he wanted to learn about domains, so I taught him about it, and he managed to create his domain after a long night. However, that old bastard thought that we had another relationship, so he came to me and threatened me like that."
"Leng Hua is too paranoid, and it’s driving him crazy." Chi Yuexin shook her head as she spoke. "If he was really sane, he wouldn’t think that you would like a young man like Zhang Xiaolong."
"Haha." Lin Zuxin laughed at that. "If Leng Hua heard you, he would threaten you too, Yuexin."

Chi Yuexin shrugged her shoulders. "If Leng Hua dares to come to me and threaten me, I will fight him straight away regardless of the risk. Although the Leng Clan is strong, my Chi Clan is not inferior to them, and the worst-case scenario is that our two clans will be destroyed together."
"If that happens, our position will become even more difficult against the Cao Clan, so I hope that something like that will never happen." Tian Jingxuan let out a heavy sigh after saying that.

"It all depends on that old bastard." Chi Yuexin then asked them. "So, what are your plans for Leng Hua? Are we going to deal with him now? If we all work together, that old bastard will be helpless in the face of our attacks, and we can finish off the Leng Clan before Cao Ren and the others return."
"I think so too, but Jingxuan seems to still be hesitant about it." Shi Yan answered her.
Qing Huang also spoke to her. "If we persist in allowing Leng Hua and the Leng Clan to behave in such a manner, they will persist in causing trouble, and the peace will never return to our realm."
All of them looked at Tian Jingxuan for an answer, but instead, he looked at Jia Yuyan and asked her. "What do you think about this situation? Should we get rid of Leng Hua and the Leng Clan now?"

"Just get rid of them." They were startled to hear that, but Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately walked into the room, and his presence made Shangguan Yan’s heart beat fast, remembering their time together in the dream.

Chi Yuexin and Lin Zuxin exchanged glances for a moment before looking back at Zhang Xiaolong [3], still puzzled by his resemblance to Zhang Fei, especially since they appeared so similar. ’Are they really twins?’

"I apologize if I came uninvited, but this matter has something to do with me, so I can’t just sit back and do nothing." Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately walked behind Shangguan Yan and spoke to them. "If you want to regain peace, you must get rid of those who are a thorn in the flesh for this realm; otherwise, peace will only be an empty hope, and this realm will always face difficult situations. Since Leng Hua threatened the Shangguan because of me, I will do something about them. However, I need your help to do something about the formations protecting the Leng Clan’s residence, and I will take care of the rest."
"What are your plans for them, kid?" Qing Huang asked him with a serious expression.
Shi Yan was also curious about that. "Please share your plans with us, and we will consider them first."

"We don’t need to kill them, as it would be a great loss to this realm, and we’ll do something else." Zhang Xiaolong [3] then took out two pills and showed them to the people present. "After Leng Hua and the others swallow these pills, they will continue to weaken for a period of time. They won’t notice my pills because they are odorless and colorless, and they will eventually be unable to use their cultivation. At that time, we will attack them, and they will not have the ability to attack us back. After that, you can do whatever you want to them, including using them as sacrifices against the Cao Clan."
Shangguan Yan took two pills from his hand. "What kind of pills are these? Can you explain their exact effects to us?"

"The white one is the Vein-Sealing Pill, and its effect will seal their meridians, preventing them from circulating their Qi. The red one is the Bone-Softening Pill, and you should be able to guess its effect from its name, right?" Shangguan Yan and the others nodded to Zhang Xiaolong [3]. "I’ve checked the Leng Clan before, and I found a sensor formation there, so I didn’t dare to barge in there because it would immediately detect my presence, and I would have to fight them if that happened."
Qing Huang asked immediately. "Don’t you have those beast ancestors by your side? They should be able to help you fight them, right?"

"You’re right about that." Zhang Xiaolong [3] gave a nod of approval. "However, I am a newcomer to this realm, and news about my test has already spread widely to the public. Therefore, I prefer not to act openly, as it may attract unwanted attention from those people. If you do something to the Leng Clan, those people will not dare to question your actions. I will immediately infiltrate there to scatter my two pills into their drinking water and food sources, and I will leave afterward."

"I think that’s the best choice for now." Chi Yuexin then asked the others. "What do you guys think about that? As long as Leng Hua and the Leng Clan still exist, Cao Ren and the Cao Clan will probably still postpone their plans."

"I think we can use this kid’s plans." Jia Yuyan finally spoke. "Actually, what is holding back the Cao Clan from moving is not the Leng Clan but my natural races and beast races, but we won’t make our move before they make their move, so everyone is waiting for each other. Therefore, I think it is fine if we take action against Leng Hua and his clan members, and this kid should have something else to use against them."

’This woman! I have clearly said that I don’t want to get involved with them directly, but she is provoking them instead!’ Jia Yuyan smirked slightly as if she understood Zhang Xiaolong [3]’s thoughts. "We shouldn’t think about that for now, and we should weaken Leng Hua and his clan members first."

"So, what’s your decision, Jingxuan? If you agree to this kid’s plans, we’ll make a move on Leng Hua and the Leng Clan." All of them were waiting for Tian Jingxuan’s decision because he was the main leader of their realm.
*Tap... Tap...*

As he tapped his fingers on the table, Tian Jingxuan seriously thought about it. "I think we can do that, but we can’t do it now because none of us understand formation arrays. Therefore, we have to wait for Duanmu Luolan to return, especially since she is one of the best array masters in our realm."
"Have they left the Moon Tower?" Shangguan Yan asked in surprise.

Tian Jingxuan nodded at her. "Yuan Tianquan sent me a voice transmission two days ago, and he told me that they managed to reach the top of the tower. Based on his information, the tower is indeed the key to going to the Paradise Realm, and some of them decided to ascend to that realm."
"Damn it! I should have joined them!" Chi Yuexin cursed in annoyance. "Who among them decided to ascend to the Paradise Realm?"

"Yuan Tiancheng, Ruan Xiaoqi, Nalan Qingge, Beihuang Fan, and six others." They were not surprised to hear the decisions of the other eight people. However, they were shocked that the two women from the Nalan and Beihuang Clans had decided to ascend to the Paradise Realm, as they were crucial members of their respective clans, and their clans would fall into chaos if they did not return. "They will probably return to this realm in a month or so, so we will wait for their return before making a move against Leng Hua and the Leng Clan."
"I don’t think we need to wait that long, right?" Jia Yuyan directed her question to Zhang Xiaolong [3].

"Not really." Chu Yuexin created a qi screen in front of them, and she inserted a little of her memories into it.
"Zhang Fei’s face, physique, aura, and cultivation are indeed identical to those of Zhang Xiaolong.
However, I feel that their characters are entirely different, and this person is much more cruel than his twin brother.
He killed many members of the Shang Clan, and he imprisoned Shang Ziyuan in a special place.
At first, I thought of using a little force, but I gave up my intention because there were several powerful cultivators by his side, and their cultivation was on par with ours."

Jia Yuyan smiled faintly as she listened to the two women because she already knew about Zhang Fei’s five clones, and she was sure that the one they met in the Red Sun Realm was one of her clones. ’That brat is such an expert con artist!
He deliberately made the characters of his two clones different to confuse them, but they are basically the same person with such a vile character.’
Tian Jingxuan immediately spoke to them.
"Even though I want Shang Ziyuan to join us, there is nothing we can do now.
Therefore, we should forget about him and focus on the problem at hand, especially about Leng Hua’s threat to Shangguan Yan."
"Huh?" Chi Yuexin and Lin Zuxin were shocked to hear that.
"Did Leng Hua really threaten you?"
"When did he do it?"
"This morning he came to my clan and threatened me." Shangguan Yan then told the two women the beginning of his problem with Leng Hua.
"That kid came to me because he wanted to learn about domains, so I taught him about it, and he managed to create his domain after a long night.
However, that old bastard thought that we had another relationship, so he came to me and threatened me like that."
"Leng Hua is too paranoid, and it’s driving him crazy." Chi Yuexin shook her head as she spoke.
"If he was really sane, he wouldn’t think that you would like a young man like Zhang Xiaolong."
"Haha." Lin Zuxin laughed at that.
"If Leng Hua heard you, he would threaten you too, Yuexin."
Chi Yuexin shrugged her shoulders.
"If Leng Hua dares to come to me and threaten me, I will fight him straight away regardless of the risk.
Although the Leng Clan is strong, my Chi Clan is not inferior to them, and the worst-case scenario is that our two clans will be destroyed together."
"If that happens, our position will become even more difficult against the Cao Clan, so I hope that something like that will never happen." Tian Jingxuan let out a heavy sigh after saying that.
"It all depends on that old bastard." Chi Yuexin then asked them.
"So, what are your plans for Leng Hua?
Are we going to deal with him now?
If we all work together, that old bastard will be helpless in the face of our attacks, and we can finish off the Leng Clan before Cao Ren and the others return."
"I think so too, but Jingxuan seems to still be hesitant about it." Shi Yan answered her.
Qing Huang also spoke to her.
"If we persist in allowing Leng Hua and the Leng Clan to behave in such a manner, they will persist in causing trouble, and the peace will never return to our realm."
All of them looked at Tian Jingxuan for an answer, but instead, he looked at Jia Yuyan and asked her.
"What do you think about this situation?
Should we get rid of Leng Hua and the Leng Clan now?"

"Just get rid of them." They were startled to hear that, but Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately walked into the room, and his presence made Shangguan Yan’s heart beat fast, remembering their time together in the dream.

Chi Yuexin and Lin Zuxin exchanged glances for a moment before looking back at Zhang Xiaolong [3], still puzzled by his resemblance to Zhang Fei, especially since they appeared so similar. ’Are they really twins?’
"I apologize if I came uninvited, but this matter has something to do with me, so I can’t just sit back and do nothing." Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately walked behind Shangguan Yan and spoke to them.
"If you want to regain peace, you must get rid of those who are a thorn in the flesh for this realm; otherwise, peace will only be an empty hope, and this realm will always face difficult situations.
Since Leng Hua threatened the Shangguan because of me, I will do something about them.
However, I need your help to do something about the formations protecting the Leng Clan’s residence, and I will take care of the rest."
"What are your plans for them, kid?" Qing Huang asked him with a serious expression.
Shi Yan was also curious about that.
"Please share your plans with us, and we will consider them first."
"We don’t need to kill them, as it would be a great loss to this realm, and we’ll do something else." Zhang Xiaolong [3] then took out two pills and showed them to the people present.
"After Leng Hua and the others swallow these pills, they will continue to weaken for a period of time.
They won’t notice my pills because they are odorless and colorless, and they will eventually be unable to use their cultivation.
At that time, we will attack them, and they will not have the ability to attack us back.
After that, you can do whatever you want to them, including using them as sacrifices against the Cao Clan."
Shangguan Yan took two pills from his hand.
"What kind of pills are these?
Can you explain their exact effects to us?"
"The white one is the Vein-Sealing Pill, and its effect will seal their meridians, preventing them from circulating their Qi.
The red one is the Bone-Softening Pill, and you should be able to guess its effect from its name, right?" Shangguan Yan and the others nodded to Zhang Xiaolong [3].

"I’ve checked the Leng Clan before, and I found a sensor formation there, so I didn’t dare to barge in there because it would immediately detect my presence, and I would have to fight them if that happened."
Qing Huang asked immediately.
"Don’t you have those beast ancestors by your side?
They should be able to help you fight them, right?"
"You’re right about that." Zhang Xiaolong [3] gave a nod of approval.
"However, I am a newcomer to this realm, and news about my test has already spread widely to the public.
Therefore, I prefer not to act openly, as it may attract unwanted attention from those people.
If you do something to the Leng Clan, those people will not dare to question your actions.
I will immediately infiltrate there to scatter my two pills into their drinking water and food sources, and I will leave afterward."
"I think that’s the best choice for now." Chi Yuexin then asked the others.
"What do you guys think about that?
As long as Leng Hua and the Leng Clan still exist, Cao Ren and the Cao Clan will probably still postpone their plans."
"I think we can use this kid’s plans." Jia Yuyan finally spoke.

"Actually, what is holding back the Cao Clan from moving is not the Leng Clan but my natural races and beast races, but we won’t make our move before they make their move, so everyone is waiting for each other.
Therefore, I think it is fine if we take action against Leng Hua and his clan members, and this kid should have something else to use against them."
’This woman!
I have clearly said that I don’t want to get involved with them directly, but she is provoking them instead!’ Jia Yuyan smirked slightly as if she understood Zhang Xiaolong [3]’s thoughts.
"We shouldn’t think about that for now, and we should weaken Leng Hua and his clan members first."
"So, what’s your decision, Jingxuan?
If you agree to this kid’s plans, we’ll make a move on Leng Hua and the Leng Clan." All of them were waiting for Tian Jingxuan’s decision because he was the main leader of their realm.
*Tap...
Tap...*
As he tapped his fingers on the table, Tian Jingxuan seriously thought about it.
"I think we can do that, but we can’t do it now because none of us understand formation arrays.
Therefore, we have to wait for Duanmu Luolan to return, especially since she is one of the best array masters in our realm."
"Have they left the Moon Tower?" Shangguan Yan asked in surprise.
Tian Jingxuan nodded at her.
"Yuan Tianquan sent me a voice transmission two days ago, and he told me that they managed to reach the top of the tower.
Based on his information, the tower is indeed the key to going to the Paradise Realm, and some of them decided to ascend to that realm."
"Damn it!
I should have joined them!" Chi Yuexin cursed in annoyance.
"Who among them decided to ascend to the Paradise Realm?"
"Yuan Tiancheng, Ruan Xiaoqi, Nalan Qingge, Beihuang Fan, and six others." They were not surprised to hear the decisions of the other eight people.

However, they were shocked that the two women from the Nalan and Beihuang Clans had decided to ascend to the Paradise Realm, as they were crucial members of their respective clans, and their clans would fall into chaos if they did not return.
"They will probably return to this realm in a month or so, so we will wait for their return before making a move against Leng Hua and the Leng Clan."
"I don’t think we need to wait that long, right?" Jia Yuyan directed her question to Zhang Xiaolong [3].

chapters.title: Chapter 987: Spring City
paragraphs: ’This woman is deliberately making things difficult for me! I will teach her a harsh lesson later!’ Zhang Xiaolong [3] cursed inwardly.
"What do you mean by that, Yuyan? Does this kid know Duanmu Luolan and the others?" Chi Yuexin asked as she glanced at Zhang Xiaolong [3].
Jia Yuyan pointed at him. "The person is right in front of you, so you can ask him yourself, right?"
Everyone looked at Zhang Xiaolong [3], as did Shangguan Yan, who immediately questioned him. "Do you really know them? How can you know them?"

"Sigh." Zhang Xiaolong [3] let out a heavy sigh and opened his right palm. The Earth Flame materialized on his palm, shocking everyone. They knew that the flame fell into someone else’s hand, but Ren Ziwei and the others did not know his identity at that time, and the appearance of the flame in his palm really shocked them. "Honestly, I don’t know Duanmu Luolan or the others because they were gone when I came out of the lava, but I know Tian Yualing because we spent a month together in the lava, and she told me a lot about this realm."
"Then, what about Leng Xueyan? Did you know her before you came to this realm?" Lin Zuxin curiously asked.

Chi Yuexin nodded as a sign of agreement. "Leng Xueyan has always had an antipathy toward men, but she showed a strange reaction once she saw you taking the test, and she kept daydreaming while waiting for you to finish them."

"Do you remember that Leng Xueyan once left this realm?" They thought for a moment before nodding to Zhang Xiaolong [3]. "Back then, she came to the Phoenix Realm to find out information about Feng Yao and her parents, and she wanted to cause trouble there. Therefore, I asked Feng Shen and Feng Xueying to stop her because they were stronger than her, and I altered some of her memories so she didn’t remember the purpose of her visit."

"Why don’t you tell them that you did something else to Leng Xueyan?" Zhang Xiaolong [3] fiercely glared at Ji Yuyan, but she responded with a relaxed smile. However, she frowned as soon as she threatened her in her mind, making her realize her mistake. ’Shit! I shouldn’t have provoked him!’
"Hey! Tell us! What else did you do to Leng Xueyan?" Shi Yan urged him.

Zhang Xiaolong [3] shook his head. "I can’t possibly reveal all my abilities to all of you, right? I did do something else to Leng Xueyan, and I plan to use it on Leng Hua later. However, I won’t explain the details to all of you, and you guys just need to wait for the results later. As for Tian Yueling and the others, I asked them to go to the Shrouded Sky Realm, and they will arrive there in three days."

"The Shrouded Sky Realm? Isn’t that the realm of the alchemists who once messed around in the upper realms?" Wenren Yue finally spoke. "I once met the alchemy goddess, and I talked to her about many things, so I know about them."

Zhang Xiaolong [3] nodded in understanding. "You’ve seen my beast form before, so you should already know more or less about my beast abilities. I can open a gate to that realm, and I asked them to go there because it’s closer from the Frozen Moon Realm. Once they get there, I’ll bring them here, and we’ll immediately make our move against Leng Hua and the Leng Clan."

"All right, we’ll make our move as soon as Duanmu Luolan and the others arrive in this realm." Tian Jingxuan then stood up from his seat. "Let’s disperse now, or Leng Hua will get suspicious if we gather together for too long, and he’ll be on guard against us."

Without waiting any longer, Jia Yuyan immediately fled from that place, confusing Shangguan Yan and the others because she looked so scared. They immediately suspected that she was afraid of Zhang Xiaolong [3], especially after her actions toward him just now.
"I will return to my clan to rest." Shangguan Yan hurriedly left because she felt confused after her encounter with Zhang Xiaolong [3] in the dream last night.
Tian Jingxuan, Shi Yan, and Qing Huang didn’t say anything else and left the place.

"Wait." Chi Yuexin stopped Zhang Xiaolong [3] as he was about to leave. "Is Zhang Fei really your twin brother? How can you two look so much alike? Your face, aura, demeanor, and cultivation are all remarkably similar."

Lin Zuxin also spoke to him. "There are several twins in my clan, but none of them are as similar as you and Zhang Fei. Somehow, I feel that you two are half of each other, like clones, but I can confirm that he is a real person, and so are you."

"Haha." Zhang Xiaolong [3] responded to them with a soft laugh. "Even though you have never met twins like us, that doesn’t mean we can’t exist, right? This universe is too vast with many mysteries in it, and so are the two of us. Although everyone finds our similarities strange, Zhang Fei is actually my twin brother. However, he is far more ruthless than I am; he will never hesitate to eliminate all his enemies, just as he eliminated the Shang Clan. Therefore, the two of you must be careful in dealing with him, or you will suffer a suffering experience that you never imagined before."

Chi Yuexin frowned at him, but she herself felt that Zhang Fei was indeed too cruel, and that was what made her not dare to stay in the Red Sun Realm for long, despite her high experience as a cultivator.
"What about you?"

"Me?" Zhang Xiaolong [3] gestured to his own face, to which Wenren Yue nodded at him. "You must not think that I am gentle because I am not, and I am no less cruel than my twin brother. However, my way of handling matters is different from his, and I am not particularly fond of dirtying my hands with blood. Instead, I prefer to use gentler means toward my enemies, and they will never realize that they have fallen into my hands."
"What’s an example?"
"My pills and a few others." Zhang Xiaolong [3] then asked Wenren Yue. "Do you want to try one of my abilities?"
"Hmm?" Wenren Yue raised an eyebrow before turning to Chi Yuexin, who immediately nodded at her. She then extended her hand to Zhang Xiaolong [3]. "Try using one of your abilities on me."
"Don’t regret it, okay?" Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately touched her hand and used the transcendent demon touch on her.
"Hyan!" After letting out a loud moan, Wenren Yue fell to the floor and convulsed a few times, and her lower body spurted out her sexual fluids, shocking both Chi Yuexin and Lin Zuxin.
Chi Yuexin immediately squatted down, touched Wen Yuexin, and tried to help her. However, her disciple continued to convulse due to her strong orgasm, making her sexual fluids wet the floor.
"What kind of technique did you use on Little Yue just now? Why is she reacting like this?" Lin Zuxin asked in shock as she watched Wenren Yue’s expression.

Zhang Xiaolong [3] crouched down and helped Wenren Yue ease the effects of his touch. "I am an expert dual cultivator, and I used one of my dual cultivation techniques on her. As you both can see, she immediately reached her orgasm as soon as I touched her, and she will continue like this for at least a few minutes."

"I see." Lin Zuxin herself already knew that Zhang Xiaolong [3] was a dual cultivator, especially with the amount of Yin Qi in his body. "Are you interested in joining a dual cultivation sect in this realm? If you go west, you will find the Midnight Jade Sect in Spring City, and they are the only dual cultivation sect in this realm. The founder of the sect belongs to one of the founding clans of this realm; however, the Yin Clan rarely interferes in other matters and primarily focuses on its own interests."

Zhang Xiaolong [3] helped the exhausted Wenren Yue to her feet and let Chi Yuexin support her. "Honestly, I am interested in that sect, but I have no thoughts of joining it. My main focus now is to gather as many cultivation resources as possible, and I also want to find a way to open the portal to the Paradise Realm hidden in this realm. Unfortunately, you guys don’t seem to know how to open it, and only Feng Yao can do it."
"I’ll take Yue’er to rest first." Chi Yuexin immediately took her disciple away.

On the other hand, Lin Zuxin led Zhang Xiaolong [3] to leave the place. "We’ve heard about your relationship with Feng Yao and the Phoenix Clan from Jia Yuyan, and we were surprised to learn that you are their leader now."

"Haha." Zhang Xiaolong [3] laughed in response. "My brother and I met Feng Yao when we started our cultivation path in the lower realms, and she helped us a lot in our cultivation, especially in alchemy. Thanks to her, we are quite capable alchemists now, and we will continue to develop in the future."
"I see." Lin Zuxin nodded in understanding. "Jia Yuyan has given us your basic pills, and their effects are truly extraordinary. Do you have plans to open an alchemy shop in this realm?"

"I have requested Jia Yuyan’s assistance, but I will not personally manage my shop; instead, I will entrust my shop to the natural races." Zhang Xiaolong [3]’s answer puzzled Lin Zuxin about how he could so quickly build a relationship with the natural races, but he then remembered his identity as a heavenly fox. "I’ll go now."

"All right." Lin Zuxin fell into a daze after Zhang Xiaolong [3] disappeared, as she didn’t even have the chance to lock her senses on him. "His speed is truly remarkable, and Old Man Zhongli will definitely be interested in meeting him. Unfortunately, he doesn’t want to be too conspicuous in this realm, so I can’t tell him for now. However, I’m sure they will meet soon, especially once we make our move against Leng Hua and the Leng Clan."

Zhang Xiaolong [3] had already arrived at Han Ling’s residence, but his master had not returned there yet. He wanted to go to the eastern forest again, but he had spent the night there before, so he gave up on his wish.
[Master, why don’t you try checking out the Midnight Jade Sect? Perhaps you will find something interesting there, or you can find new partners in that sect to speed up your cultivation.]

"Mei, I am actually no longer interested in searching for partners from a dual cultivation sect, and I am more interested in looking for a woman like Shangguan Yan." Zhang Xiaolong [3] turned his head to the east. "That female fairy is deliberately looking for trouble with me, so I will teach her a lesson at night. By the way, your idea is not bad, and I will go to the sect now."
[You are a hypocrite, Master!]
"Hahaha!" Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately used his nine cloud steps and went towards the west.

In just a few minutes, Zhang Xiaolong [3] arrived at Spring City, but he deliberately put on a disguise and modified his bone age, especially since he did not want to be recognized by the people there. He was surprised by the city’s situation, which resembled Lust City in the Netherworld Realm due to the many brothels lining each side of the street.

’Tch! No wonder they built this city so far away from the main city, especially since the situation in the city is like this.’ Zhang Xiaolong [3]’s gaze suddenly fell on a shop selling various kinds of dual cultivation equipment. ’Let’s check the quality of their equipment first.’
When Zhang Xiaolong [3] entered the shop, a middle-aged woman with quite a pretty face and voluptuous body, wearing a thin, revealing dress, greeted him immediately. "Are you new in town, Sir?"

paragraphs: Nong Qinhua sat down weakly on the side of the bed after they left. "I didn’t expect you to bring a monster here, Xinlei."
"I didn’t expect that myself, especially since he hasn’t shown his strength to me before." Yin Xinlei then asked her. "Do you think he’ll keep your secret from those people, Big Sis?"

"I can’t be sure of that, but I hope he won’t reveal it to anyone; otherwise, the Yin Clan will be in great danger because of me." Nong Qinhua then turned to Yi Ping. "That kid should be aware that he is a soulless doll, but he didn’t say anything about him."

Since Zhang Xiaolong [3] had so many powerful beasts by his side, Yin Xinlei also believed that he had already noticed Yin Ping’s situation. "He doesn’t seem to be a nosy person, so he didn’t ask anything about his condition. Do you think my cousin will be able to return to normal?"

"I don’t know." Nong Qinhua replied with a heavy sigh. "The only way to cure him is to find that female demon and take back his soul from her, but we have been searching for her for thousands of years, and we have never managed to find a trace of her."
Yin Xinlei observed Yi Ping’s face before asking again. "What exactly is the female demon’s reason for stealing his soul and turning you into a yin demon?"

"Only she knows her purpose for doing something like this to us." Nong Qinhua tried to recall the day when the terrible incident befell her and Yin Ping. "If I recall correctly, she also brought some other people, and one of them was a corpse of a woman."
"Don’t you remember her face?"

"No." Nong Qinhua shook her head. "I only remember that female demon wore a mask like a tengu, and she also had huge crow wings on her back. Additionally, she did not speak our language, and I had never heard a language like hers before, which led me to believe that she was speaking an ancient language.
"Ancient language?"

Nong Qinhua immediately explained. "According to the history that I have researched with Yin Ping in the past, there were various languages in the universe, but they disappeared along with the appearance of the barrier that separated the three mortal realms and the realm beyond, leaving behind the language we use now."

"If that’s true, that female demon should have come from the realm beyond, and she is very powerful, or she wouldn’t have succeeded in capturing you and my cousin back then." Yin Xinlei then took out a dildo with two heads. "How about we try this thing together, Big Sis?"
Nong Qinhua examined the dildo before nodding. "Let’s do it then; I’m feeling stressed out by that kid’s arrival, so I want to have some fun."

After spending some time in Spring City, Zhang Xiaolong went to the northern region and visited its largest city, Orchid City. As the name suggests, the city was filled with many wild orchid plants of various colors, which emitted rich floral scents.
[Why are you going to this city, Master?]

’Actually, I want to visit all the big cities in this realm to look for some things, but not all of them are interesting, and this city is one of the interesting ones, especially this floral scent.’ Zhang Xiaolong [3] quickly walked along the streets of the city, and he went to the biggest alchemy shop in the city, where he found several types of herb seeds that were not yet available in the Sealed World Pearl.

Since Janette, Lillea, and Shi Wu were still in the Star Tower, Zhang Xiaolong [3] first put away all the seeds. He then went to a blacksmith shop and bought a lot of materials to forge celestial-grade equipment. He made sure to visit a formation array shop afterwards, particularly considering that his array master rank had been stagnant for an extended period.
[Master, I think you should wait for Duanmu Luolan to come back, and you can learn more about formation arrays from her.]

Zhang Xiaolong [3] nodded in agreement. ’Fa Zhen is indeed an expert in arrays, but his knowledge is still limited. Meanwhile, Duanmu Luolan is much more senior than him, and this realm has more knowledge, so she is the best choice to help me study the formation array more deeply.’
After he bought everything, Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately left the Orchid City because Han Ling had already returned to his hut, and he immediately went there to meet him.
"You’re finally back, Old Han."
"Hahaha." Han Ling laughed before asking. "Have you mastered the first stage of the Forgotten Sword Technique?"
Zhang Xiaolong [3] answered him by summoning the demon extermination sword, making a sword stance, and closing his eyes.
"Oh?" Han Ling was surprised to see that.

Zhang Xiaolong [3] slashed his sword at a high speed, which was difficult for Han Ling to follow. Although nothing appeared from his sword, a large rock far away from their location split itself as a result of his slash.
Boom
"What do you think about that, Old Han?"

Han Ling nodded in satisfaction. "Incredible! It took me two weeks to master the first stage, but you only needed three days to master it. This way, you can start practicing the second stage, and the Whisper Thrust is useful against those with high defenses, especially since it can bypass their defenses."
"Yes." Zhang Xiaolong [3] then returned his sword into his body and activated his sword Qi.
Han Ling raised his eyebrows slightly. "Don’t tell me that you’ve successfully used your sword domain."

"Hehehe." Zhang Xiaolong [3] chuckled, and his sword Qi quickly spread out, forming a sword dome, leaving Han Ling speechless. "I succeeded in creating this domain thanks to Shangguan Yan’s advice, but my sword domain is still too weak compared to yours, Old Han. For now, I still have to continue strengthening my sword Qi and sword intent, and my sword domain will strengthen by itself."

"That’s right." Han Ling nodded in agreement with that. "Sword Qi and sword intent are essential for our sword domain, and if you keep strengthening them, our domain will become extremely powerful; therefore, you must not stop this process. What else did you learn from Shangguan Yan? Did you succeed in forming domains with all your elements?"

"Yes." Zhang Xiaolong [3] then showed Han Ling all the domains from each of his elements, causing her to smile in satisfaction. "Even though I managed to create all my domains, I feel that they are too weak if I use them separately, so I have thought of something to strengthen them."
"For example?"
"This." Zhang Xiaolong [3] activated his light and darkness domains simultaneously, and he merged the two domains just like what he did when he merged his two elements.

Han Ling took a deep breath after he saw Zhang Xiaolong [3]’s new domain, which revolved around his body like Yin and Yang. "Such a crazy kid! Not only do you have light and darkness elements, which is impossible for other people, but you also managed to combine both elements and their domains."

"As you said before, I have to keep strengthening myself. However, I will be no different from them if I do everything the normal way, so I try many things that other people might not be able to do." Zhang Xiaolong [3] then activated his other domains, and he merged all of them into one, making it enormous, thick, and sturdy. "This way, my enemy won’t be able to guess my next move, especially since there are seven elements in this domain."

’Who gave birth to this monster? Did she ever think that her son would become like this?’ Han Ling muttered inwardly with a bitter laugh. "Stop showing off, kid. If you use anything else absurd, I might die of a heart attack."
"Hahaha." Zhang Xiaolong [3] laughed as he canceled his domain. "Old Han, have you ever thought about leaving this realm and ascending to the realm beyond?"

"I never thought of that before, but I do now." Han Ling then looked up at the sky. "Honestly, the Paradise Realm is my old dream, especially after I listened to my master’s story about his master. I don’t have any burden in my heart now, so I want to pursue my dream of going to that realm, and I will look for my grandmaster there. Unfortunately, I can’t do that now because Senior Yuyan still has a lot of business in the three mortal realms, and I will go with him after he finishes all his business here."
Zhang Xiaolong was surprised by that. "Does Jia Yuyan really want to take you to the Paradise Realm?"

"Yes." Han Ling looked at him again. "Senior Jia offered it to me a long time ago, but the burden in my heart continues to weigh me down. If you hadn’t appeared in that realm and brought me back to the Earth, I wouldn’t have been able to let go of all my burdens."
"Did Jia Yuyan tell you the location of the portal to go to the Paradise Realm?" Zhang Xiaolong [3] curiously asked.
"Over there." Han Ling pointed toward the Tiantang Mountain. "Senior Jia came to this realm through that mountain, and your phoenix friends also went there through that place."

’That woman really has a big mouth! She revealed many of my secrets to the people in this realm.’ Zhang Xiaolong [3] felt increasingly annoyed with Jia Yuyan. "I’ll go check out that mountain, Old Han."
"I’ll go with you."
"Where exactly is the portal?" Zhang Xiaolong [3] asked once they arrived at the Tiantang Mountain.
Han Ling jumped onto the stone monument in front of them and pointed to the sky. "According to Senior Jia, the portal is up there, but we need a key to open it."
"A key?" Han Ling nodded at Zhang Xiaolong [3], who immediately disappeared from the spot.
Han Ling shook his head at that. "He must have picked up Senior Jia."
As Han Ling expected, Zhang Xiaolong [3] returned with Jia Yuyan half an hour later.
"Why did you bring me here?" Jia Yuyan asked as she moved away from Zhang Xiaolong [3].
"How to open the portal to the Paradise Realm?"

"Hmm?" Jia Yuyan turned to Han Ling first before taking out a large key-like device similar to the one Feng Yao used to open the portal when she brought her parents to the Paradise Realm. "Only certain people have this key to prevent those evil cultivators from coming down here, and you need celestial qi to activate it. Once I channel my qi into it, the portal will open, and it will take us a month of travel to arrive at the main gate. I know you’re eager to go to that realm, but you wouldn’t be that crazy to go now, right?"

"You’re wrong." Jia Yuyan frowned as soon as Zhang Xiaolong [3] said that. "Actually, I thought about going there sooner, but I haven’t thought about exploring that realm, especially with my current strength."

Jia Yuyan immediately understood the meaning behind Zhang Xiaolong [3]’s answer. "I don’t know if you can do that, especially since the barrier separates the three mortal realms and the Paradise Realm. If you go there now, you’ll have to come back here straightaway, which will just waste two months of your time."
"Only two months?" Zhang Xiaolong [3] was confused by that because Ma Kuangyu and Feng Yao had said that the flow of time in the Paradise Realm was much faster than in the three mortal realms.
Seeing his confusion, Jia Yuyan immediately explained to him. "The flow of time during the journey will not change, but you will experience a time difference once you arrive there."

"I see." Zhang Xiaolong [3] nodded in understanding. "If only certain people have the key, then how did Taotie come down here in the past and bring Xereth there? He also sent that demon back to the three mortal realms after he finished his training."

Jia Yuyan let out a soft sigh. "In fact, there are hundreds or even thousands of paths connecting the two realms, but we will pass through dangerous routes if we go through them, and the portal in this realm is one of the safest."
"Hmm?" Zhang Xiaolong [3] fell into thought after hearing that. ’I have to meet that woman again, especially since she’s the only one who can give me answers.’
