"Only she knows her purpose for doing something like this to us." Nong Qinhua tried to recall the day when the terrible incident befell her and Yin Ping.
"If I recall correctly, she also brought some other people, and one of them was a corpse of a woman."
"Don’t you remember her face?"
"No." Nong Qinhua shook her head.
"I only remember that female demon wore a mask like a tengu, and she also had huge crow wings on her back.
Additionally, she did not speak our language, and I had never heard a language like hers before, which led me to believe that she was speaking an ancient language.
"Ancient language?"
Nong Qinhua immediately explained.

"According to the history that I have researched with Yin Ping in the past, there were various languages in the universe, but they disappeared along with the appearance of the barrier that separated the three mortal realms and the realm beyond, leaving behind the language we use now."

"If that’s true, that female demon should have come from the realm beyond, and she is very powerful, or she wouldn’t have succeeded in capturing you and my cousin back then." Yin Xinlei then took out a dildo with two heads.
"How about we try this thing together, Big Sis?"
Nong Qinhua examined the dildo before nodding.
"Let’s do it then; I’m feeling stressed out by that kid’s arrival, so I want to have some fun."
After spending some time in Spring City, Zhang Xiaolong went to the northern region and visited its largest city, Orchid City.
As the name suggests, the city was filled with many wild orchid plants of various colors, which emitted rich floral scents.
[Why are you going to this city, Master?]

’Actually, I want to visit all the big cities in this realm to look for some things, but not all of them are interesting, and this city is one of the interesting ones, especially this floral scent.’ Zhang Xiaolong [3] quickly walked along the streets of the city, and he went to the biggest alchemy shop in the city, where he found several types of herb seeds that were not yet available in the Sealed World Pearl.
Since Janette, Lillea, and Shi Wu were still in the Star Tower, Zhang Xiaolong [3] first put away all the seeds.
He then went to a blacksmith shop and bought a lot of materials to forge celestial-grade equipment.
He made sure to visit a formation array shop afterwards, particularly considering that his array master rank had been stagnant for an extended period.
[Master, I think you should wait for Duanmu Luolan to come back, and you can learn more about formation arrays from her.]
Zhang Xiaolong [3] nodded in agreement. ’Fa Zhen is indeed an expert in arrays, but his knowledge is still limited.
Meanwhile, Duanmu Luolan is much more senior than him, and this realm has more knowledge, so she is the best choice to help me study the formation array more deeply.’
After he bought everything, Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately left the Orchid City because Han Ling had already returned to his hut, and he immediately went there to meet him.
"You’re finally back, Old Han."
"Hahaha." Han Ling laughed before asking.
"Have you mastered the first stage of the Forgotten Sword Technique?"
Zhang Xiaolong [3] answered him by summoning the demon extermination sword, making a sword stance, and closing his eyes.
"Oh?" Han Ling was surprised to see that.
Zhang Xiaolong [3] slashed his sword at a high speed, which was difficult for Han Ling to follow.
Although nothing appeared from his sword, a large rock far away from their location split itself as a result of his slash.
Boom
"What do you think about that, Old Han?"
Han Ling nodded in satisfaction.
"Incredible!
It took me two weeks to master the first stage, but you only needed three days to master it.
This way, you can start practicing the second stage, and the Whisper Thrust is useful against those with high defenses, especially since it can bypass their defenses."
"Yes." Zhang Xiaolong [3] then returned his sword into his body and activated his sword Qi.
Han Ling raised his eyebrows slightly.
"Don’t tell me that you’ve successfully used your sword domain."
"Hehehe." Zhang Xiaolong [3] chuckled, and his sword Qi quickly spread out, forming a sword dome, leaving Han Ling speechless.
"I succeeded in creating this domain thanks to Shangguan Yan’s advice, but my sword domain is still too weak compared to yours, Old Han.
For now, I still have to continue strengthening my sword Qi and sword intent, and my sword domain will strengthen by itself."
"That’s right." Han Ling nodded in agreement with that.
"Sword Qi and sword intent are essential for our sword domain, and if you keep strengthening them, our domain will become extremely powerful; therefore, you must not stop this process.
What else did you learn from Shangguan Yan?
Did you succeed in forming domains with all your elements?"
"Yes." Zhang Xiaolong [3] then showed Han Ling all the domains from each of his elements, causing her to smile in satisfaction.
"Even though I managed to create all my domains, I feel that they are too weak if I use them separately, so I have thought of something to strengthen them."
"For example?"
"This." Zhang Xiaolong [3] activated his light and darkness domains simultaneously, and he merged the two domains just like what he did when he merged his two elements.
Han Ling took a deep breath after he saw Zhang Xiaolong [3]’s new domain, which revolved around his body like Yin and Yang.
"Such a crazy kid!
Not only do you have light and darkness elements, which is impossible for other people, but you also managed to combine both elements and their domains."
"As you said before, I have to keep strengthening myself.

However, I will be no different from them if I do everything the normal way, so I try many things that other people might not be able to do." Zhang Xiaolong [3] then activated his other domains, and he merged all of them into one, making it enormous, thick, and sturdy.
"This way, my enemy won’t be able to guess my next move, especially since there are seven elements in this domain."
’Who gave birth to this monster?
Did she ever think that her son would become like this?’ Han Ling muttered inwardly with a bitter laugh.
"Stop showing off, kid.
If you use anything else absurd, I might die of a heart attack."
"Hahaha." Zhang Xiaolong [3] laughed as he canceled his domain.
"Old Han, have you ever thought about leaving this realm and ascending to the realm beyond?"
"I never thought of that before, but I do now." Han Ling then looked up at the sky.
"Honestly, the Paradise Realm is my old dream, especially after I listened to my master’s story about his master.
I don’t have any burden in my heart now, so I want to pursue my dream of going to that realm, and I will look for my grandmaster there.
Unfortunately, I can’t do that now because Senior Yuyan still has a lot of business in the three mortal realms, and I will go with him after he finishes all his business here."
Zhang Xiaolong was surprised by that.
"Does Jia Yuyan really want to take you to the Paradise Realm?"
"Yes." Han Ling looked at him again.
"Senior Jia offered it to me a long time ago, but the burden in my heart continues to weigh me down.
If you hadn’t appeared in that realm and brought me back to the Earth, I wouldn’t have been able to let go of all my burdens."
"Did Jia Yuyan tell you the location of the portal to go to the Paradise Realm?" Zhang Xiaolong [3] curiously asked.
"Over there." Han Ling pointed toward the Tiantang Mountain.
"Senior Jia came to this realm through that mountain, and your phoenix friends also went there through that place."
’That woman really has a big mouth!
She revealed many of my secrets to the people in this realm.’ Zhang Xiaolong [3] felt increasingly annoyed with Jia Yuyan.
"I’ll go check out that mountain, Old Han."
"I’ll go with you."
"Where exactly is the portal?" Zhang Xiaolong [3] asked once they arrived at the Tiantang Mountain.
Han Ling jumped onto the stone monument in front of them and pointed to the sky.
"According to Senior Jia, the portal is up there, but we need a key to open it."
"A key?" Han Ling nodded at Zhang Xiaolong [3], who immediately disappeared from the spot.
Han Ling shook his head at that.
"He must have picked up Senior Jia."
As Han Ling expected, Zhang Xiaolong [3] returned with Jia Yuyan half an hour later.
"Why did you bring me here?" Jia Yuyan asked as she moved away from Zhang Xiaolong [3].
"How to open the portal to the Paradise Realm?"
"Hmm?" Jia Yuyan turned to Han Ling first before taking out a large key-like device similar to the one Feng Yao used to open the portal when she brought her parents to the Paradise Realm.
"Only certain people have this key to prevent those evil cultivators from coming down here, and you need celestial qi to activate it.
Once I channel my qi into it, the portal will open, and it will take us a month of travel to arrive at the main gate.
I know you’re eager to go to that realm, but you wouldn’t be that crazy to go now, right?"
"You’re wrong." Jia Yuyan frowned as soon as Zhang Xiaolong [3] said that.
"Actually, I thought about going there sooner, but I haven’t thought about exploring that realm, especially with my current strength."
Jia Yuyan immediately understood the meaning behind Zhang Xiaolong [3]’s answer.
"I don’t know if you can do that, especially since the barrier separates the three mortal realms and the Paradise Realm.
If you go there now, you’ll have to come back here straightaway, which will just waste two months of your time."
"Only two months?" Zhang Xiaolong [3] was confused by that because Ma Kuangyu and Feng Yao had said that the flow of time in the Paradise Realm was much faster than in the three mortal realms.
Seeing his confusion, Jia Yuyan immediately explained to him.
"The flow of time during the journey will not change, but you will experience a time difference once you arrive there."
"I see." Zhang Xiaolong [3] nodded in understanding.
"If only certain people have the key, then how did Taotie come down here in the past and bring Xereth there?
He also sent that demon back to the three mortal realms after he finished his training."
Jia Yuyan let out a soft sigh.
"In fact, there are hundreds or even thousands of paths connecting the two realms, but we will pass through dangerous routes if we go through them, and the portal in this realm is one of the safest."
"Hmm?" Zhang Xiaolong [3] fell into thought after hearing that. ’I have to meet that woman again, especially since she’s the only one who can give me answers.’

chapters.title: Chapter 991: Bad News
paragraphs: "Are you thinking of sending one of your clones there now?"
Zhang Xiaolong [3] answered Jia Yuyan with a shake of his head. "I want to confirm something first, and I will send one of my clones there after I find my answer."
"I see." Jia Yuyan nodded in understanding. "You must make a decision before Cao Ren and the Cao Clan return, and I will open the portal for you."
"All right." Thereafter, Zhang Xiaolong [3] left the location and returned to his residence, where he ordered the guards to prevent anyone from entering.
Jia Yuyan then spoke to Han Ling. "That kid seems to be going to the Paradise Realm soon, so I think you can join him then."

"Yes." Han Ling looked towards the location of the Yang Clan. "I am satisfied with seeing my descendants happy in that clan, so I will go to hunt down my dream, which has long been neglected because of my regret. If that kid really goes to the Paradise Realm, I will join him, and I will look for my grandmaster after I break through to the Five Celestial Realms."

"Take this." Han Ling immediately accepted the token that Jia Yuyan gave him. "Show this token to the gate guards when you arrive, and they will send you to the Floral Mirage Domain. Hand over this token to a fairy named Jia Hanyu when you arrive at my domain, and she will prepare a lodging for you. However, I forbid you from going to other domains before your cultivation reaches the Celestial King Realm, and you must focus on cultivating there."
Han Ling nodded in understanding and kept the token. "Alright, I will follow your advice, Senior Jia."
"I have to go back to my forest." Jia Yuyan took Han Ling back to his hut before returning to the eastern forest.
Zhang Fei [1] had already arrived at the Xianjin Realm, and he immediately went to see Zhe Wuming, who had just rested from his cultivation. "What brought you here today?"
"I need your help to enter the space rift." Zhe Wuming did not ask anything else and split the air, and Zhang Fei [1] immediately disappeared into it.
Once he arrived there, Zhang Fei [1] tried to summon the will of the universe, and he was suddenly transported to the final space of that mysterious place.
{Do you have any questions for me, Zhang Fei?}
Without beating around the bush, Zhang Fei [1] directly conveyed his question. "Can I use my gate ability to move between the Three Mortal Realms and the Paradise Realm?"
{Yes, you can do it. However, I do not recommend you go to the Paradise Realm now, especially since you are still too weak to face the cultivators in that realm.}
"I know that." Zhang Fei [1] gazed at the woman thoughtfully for quite a while. "Can you send Xereth away from the Three Mortal Realms?"
{I can do that, but Taotie will send his stronger subordinates to the Three Mortal Realms, and you guys will face much tougher enemies.}

Zhang Fei [1] was unwilling to give up on that. "Why don’t you seal off most of the paths between the two realms? You only need to leave a route that Taotie can’t reach, so he won’t be able to send his other subordinates to the Three Mortal Realms anymore."

{Not all cultivators in the Three Mortal Realms have many advantages like yours, and not all of them have powerful backers. I understand your wishes; however, if I seal off most of the paths between the two realms, they will no longer be able to ascend to the Paradise Realm. Therefore, I won’t help you do that, and you have to think of another way to get rid of Xereth.}
"Phew." Zhang Fei [1] let out a heavy breath. "All right, I won’t force my will. By the way, thank you for your information, and I’ll be going now."

A while later, Zhang Fei [1] had arrived on Earth, and the other two clones also came out of the training space. The three of them immediately spread out to purchase numerous sex toys and collect various Earth goods from all the warehouses.

Once they were done, the two clones went back inside to continue their training, and Zhang Fei [1] went to the Evergreen Spirit Haven Realm before taking Oliver and the others to the Fairy Forest in the Sky Jade Realm.
Zhang Fei [1] immediately explained his plan to bring all members of the natural races in that realm to the eastern forest in the Sovereign Heaven Realm.
"Are you sure we won’t encounter any problems in that realm?" Oliver asked with doubt because they were still too weak compared to the natural races in the Sovereign Heaven Realm.

"Yes." Zhang Fei [1] nodded at him. "There are twenty-one giants there, and they are my subordinates now. Moreover, Jia Yuyan has promised me that he will protect all of you, so I am sure that all of you will be fine there."

Gravier, the dwarf, spoke immediately. "You are our leader, and since you have decided so, we will follow your plan. However, we must first persuade them, and they may need a few days to pack, so we will contact you when they are ready."
"Zhang Fei, please bring Elmyra here, especially since she is the elf race’s leader." Sabina, the dryad, spoke.

"Unfortunately, Elmyra is with the others at the Star Tower, so I can’t bring her back here now." Zhang Fei [1] then asked Oliver. "Can you convince the members of the elf race regarding this matter, Grandpa?"
Oliver nodded at him. "Don’t worry about them; I will persuade and convince them."
"That’s good then." After Oliver led the others to the Fairy Forest, Zhang Fei [1] immediately returned to the training space.

[Quest: Clear the fourth floor of the Star Tower.]

"Seven more floors!" Yun Xinyue shouted as they left the final test room. "Back then, we had a hard time getting through all the challenges on the first floor, but we’ve already passed the third floor now, and we did it in just two and a half years!"
"Hahaha." Yuan Luo laughed at that. "Our success is thanks to Zhang Fei, or else we would have continued to fail on the first floor."
"I agree with you." Ye Zhiqiu nodded in agreement. "If he hadn’t brought us to train in his training space, our progress definitely wouldn’t have been this rapid."
Ximen Chuixue then spoke to them. "Even though we have passed three floors, we still can’t relax now, and the challenges on the fourth floor will definitely be even more difficult."

"All the challenges on the fourth floor are not as difficult as you imagine." They turned to Xian Changyue directly, especially since she had reached the sixth floor. "All the challenges on that floor are more riddles; some are simple, but some are difficult, so we just need to be patient to find the answers. However, some of the riddles are targeted at individuals, and we can’t tell other people about the questions, so you have to solve them."

"I hate riddles!" Yuan Luo shouted in frustration, making Bai Tian’er and the others laugh. "The first time I challenged this tower, I was trapped in a room full of puzzles, and it took me a long time to solve them."
"Stop complaining, and let’s proceed to the fourth floor." Yun Xinyue said this as she led the group away.
"Kid." Zhang Fei turned to Wan Jiang, who suddenly appeared behind him. "One of your clones is at the Sovereign Heaven Realm, right?"
Zhang Fei nodded at him. "Why do you ask that?"

Wan Jiang let out a heavy sigh before telling him. "The Cao Clan from that realm managed to clear the Dark Tower, but they did not ascend to my realm; instead, Cao Ren asked the tower guardian to help him sort out his problems in that realm, and he agreed to help them."
"Hmm?" Zhang Fei frowned deeply. "Why is that person willing to help them? Doesn’t that mean he’s breaking your rules?"

"Yes." Wan Jiang then told Zhang Fei about the results of his meeting with the higher-ups. "They tried to capture him, but he managed to escape, and he should be on his way to that realm with Cao Ren and the Cao Clan. That person’s cultivation level is at the 3-Sun Celestial Emperor Realm, and you have no chance of defeating him. Therefore, you should leave that realm as soon as possible, especially since the situation will be chaotic soon."
Zhang Fei nodded in understanding after hearing that. "I will inform my acquaintances in that realm first, so they can discuss their future. Are you going to that realm to stop that person?"

"Yes." Wan Jiang immediately summoned his three disciples. "We will go there and wait there, but that realm will be destroyed if I fight him directly. Therefore, you should help me to send us to another realm, and I will fight him in that realm."

Zhang Fei immediately opened the gate to the Heaven Sovereign Realm, and he closed it again after Wan Jiang and his three disciples disappeared into it. He then contacted Tian Kui and Serpentera, and he asked them to be prepared if the four people could not defeat that person. After that, he followed the women to the fourth floor, where they began taking on other challenges.

On the first floor, all of Zhang Fei’s women, family, and friends had completed the Enlightenment challenge, which was the final challenge. However, many of them failed to understand the techniques they had chosen, making them unable to continue.
Those who managed to pass it immediately rushed to the second floor, and they found Xian Jinglan waiting there with Lang.
"Since when have you two been in this tower?" Xian Lianghua asked her daughter.

Xian Jinglan immediately explained. "Around ten days ago, Zhang Fei came to our kingdom just as I was coming out of my seclusion, and he sent me here to wait for you all. Since you are all here, we should start the challenges of the second floor."
"Let’s go." Hun Di, Xian Tian, and Lin Jingxia immediately led them. Unlike on the first floor, they entered the same challenge this time, which made it easier for them to face the challenges.
"Are you sure about that?" Leng Hua asked the man kneeling behind him.
"Yes, Patriarch."
"Leave and continue to monitor her." After the man left, Leng Kuan appeared behind Leng Hua. "Has Leng Xiulan arrived at the Grand Royal Realm?"
"She just arrived at that realm, and your daughter will arrive there in three days."

Leng Kuan nodded in understanding. "Shangguan Yan seems to want to rally their support to fight us, and that kid is also involved in it, so I want you to prepare our members to face their surprise attack."
"Do you think they dare attack us openly, brother?"
"Whether they dare attack us or not, we still have to prepare our people to face them."

"I will take care of them after this." Leng Kuan then reported something to him. "Brother, our spies reported to me earlier that Cao Ren and the others have already come out of the Dark Tower, and they are on their way back now. We don’t know their next plan, but I have a feeling that they will make a move soon, and their target should be the Tian Clan."
Leng Hua frowned with a serious expression after hearing this. "What do you think if we work together with Cao Ren to get rid of the Tian Clan and the others?"

"Do you really want to do that?" Leng Hua did not answer Leng Kua because he still had doubts in his heart. "If we work together with the Cao Clan, I think it’s no different from us acknowledging them, and this realm will fall into their hands."
Leng Hua gave a light nod. "For now, it’s just a passing idea, and I haven’t made a decision yet. By the way, tell Leng Xiulan to do her job well, or I’ll expel her family from our clan."
"Yes, Brother."

When the night fell, Zhang Xiaolong [3] checked on Shangguan Yan and found her still awake. She seemed busy with something, so he let her be first. He then checked on Wan Jiang and his three disciples through the map, and he found they were in the southern region.
Zhang Xiaolong [3] smirked evilly as he remembered Ji Yuyan. "Time to teach that female fairy a lesson for annoying me over and over again."

Zhang Fei [5] immediately spoke to her. "Miss, my name is not Zhang Xiaolong but Zhang Fei, and you have mistaken me for my twin brother."

"Huh?" Leng Xueyan was momentarily stunned before flying toward Zhang Fei [5] and landing right in front of him. "Are you really not Zhang Xiaolong? How can the two of you have such perfectly identical faces?"

Zhang Fei [5] shrugged his shoulders. "Zhang Xiaolong is my twin brother, so it’s natural that we have the same face, right? Actually, he already told me about the Sovereign Heaven Realm, and he invited me to join him. However, I’m not interested in going there yet, and I’m more interested in exploring the universe with my cultivation brother, Feng Xishui."
"Hmm?" Leng Xueyan turned to Feng Xishui, who simply nodded at her. "Then, what is your business in coming to this realm? Did your twin brother ask you to follow me here?"

"Eh?" Zhang Fei [5] pretended to be surprised before laughing. "Hahaha! Miss, do you realize how ridiculous your question is? I came to this realm not for you, but I needed help from the Li Clan, so Li Tiannan brought me here. If you don’t believe me, you can ask him directly."
"Miss, I did bring him to this realm because he needed my clan’s help, and since my family is in this palace, I brought him here." Li Tiannan explained to Leng Xueyan.

Even so, Leng Xueyan felt doubtful about that because Zhang Fei [5] and Zhang Xiaolong [3]’s faces were too identical as twins. Moreover, their cultivation was also at the same level, and he also detected a lot of Yin Qi in her body.

"Emperor, I just got information from our spies on the front lines that tens of thousands of the Qiang Kingdom’s soldiers suddenly died without any clear cause. Qiang Yun and another general also died, forcing the troops under them to flee from our kingdom’s territory."

Zhang Fei [5] didn’t say anything; instead, he spoke to Li Tiannan. "Brother Xishui and I will go to the inn now, and you can bring your family to meet us there later."
"Yes." Li Tiannan replied with a nod, confusing his clan members. "Grandfather! Father! I will explain everything to you two later."
"All right."

Leng Xueyan stared at the exit for quite some time, as she could not believe that Zhang Fei [5] and Zhang Xiaolong [3] were different people. ’Sigh! I will settle the matters here first, and I will go see him after.’
After that, Leng Xueyan returned to the Huangfu Emperor’s side and listened to the reports from everyone present there, especially the general who was overseeing the front line.

sentences.text: Zhang Fei [5] and Feng Xishui had already arrived at the outer periphery of the Grand Royal Realm, and he immediately flew Feng Jiu’s flying artifact into the realm.
However, Zhang Fei [5] saw another artifact entering the realm at high speed, and he smiled faintly after recognizing its owner.
"Do you know the owner of that flying artifact?"
Zhang Fei [5] nodded.
"The owner is Leng Xueyan from the Sovereign Heaven Realm, and she came specifically to help the Huangfu Kingdom."
"How could that small kingdom have any relationship with people from that realm?" Zhang Fei [5] directly told Feng Xishui about the relationship between the Huangfu and the Leng Clans.
"The two of them have a relationship with each other, and both of them are also your enemies."
"Haha!
What an unusual coincidence, right?" Zhang Fei [5] then opened the gate leading to the Nine Stars Realm, picked up Li Tiannan, and brought him to the flying artifact.
"Show us the way to your clan."
"Master, they should be at the Hungfu Royal Palace now, so we should go there to meet them." Li Tiannan then pointed toward the Huangfu Kingdom.
"Over there, master."
"Hmm?" Zhang Fei [5] immediately flew the flying artifact into the Grand Royal Realm to reach that kingdom.
[Ding.]
[The system has already recorded the Grand Royal Realm, and the host can access it through the gate in the future.]
[Starts mapping the entire area of the Grand Royal Realm.]

In a few minutes, they were already above the airspace of the Huangfu Kingdom, but most of the outer areas of the kingdom were severely damaged by the attacks of the Qiang Kingdom, and black smoke was rising from all of those areas.
They could see the troops from the Qiang Kingdom slaughtering the citizens of the Huangfu Kingdom, both troops and ordinary citizens.
Many of them also did heinous things, such as forcibly violating the women of the kingdom and many other heinous things.
Zhang Fei [5]’s face darkened after witnessing the barbaric actions of the Qiang Kingdom troops, and he immediately activated the soul link to borrow the power of all the beasts in his beast space.
He then activated his light element and created countless thin light arrows.
"I don’t like to meddle in other people’s business, but these animal soldiers are disgusting and infuriating me.

They shouldn’t do such things to helpless women and girls like that." After he said that, Zhang Fei [5] launched those light arrows downwards, heading straight for most of the troops of the Qiang Kingdom at high speed.

In a few minutes, those light arrows penetrated the heads of tens of thousands of Qiang Kingdom troops, especially those who did heinous things, and killed them, causing panic among the remaining troops.
The Qiang Kingdom’s remaining troops immediately scattered and abandoned their posts, as they were afraid that the unknown attacker would kill them as well.
"Hmm?" Zhang Fei [5] raised an eyebrow as soon as he saw two men dressed as generals flying towards him, but he did not think much of them and let them come.
*Swoosh...
Swoosh...*
The two people immediately recognized Li Tiannan as a member of the Li Clan from the Huangfu Kingdom, but they could not recognize Zhang Fei [5] and Feng Xishui.
However, they guessed that the two were not ordinary people, especially with the luxury of Feng Jiu’s flying artifact.
"Hey—"
"Stop it." One of the male generals stopped his friend after he realized Zhang Fei [5]’s strength.
He then cupped his hands to him.
"My name is Qiang Yun from the Qiang Kingdom.
May I ask your name?
Why did you kill so many of our troops?"
"Is your mentality that corrupt?" Zhang Fei [5] coldly asked, making Qiang Yun and the others frown.
"My identity is not important, and I’m not on any side.
I don’t care about your war with the Huangfu Kingdom, and I came to this realm only to look for someone.
However, I truly despised the behavior of your soldiers, who forcefully violated those defenseless girls and women.
You guys were their leaders, but you allowed them to commit such heinous acts."
"Wait—" Qiang Yun had no time to say anything when his and his friend’s heads flew off, separated from their bodies, and their blood sprayed upwards.
Splurt...
Splurt...
"Your speed is getting more and more terrifying." Feng Xishui shook his head as he spoke.
"What kind of technique did you use to behead them just now?"

"I didn’t use any techniques, and I only used my sword will." Since he wasn’t a swordmaster, Feng Xishui didn’t know anything about it, so Zhang Fei [5] directly demonstrated his sword Qi, sword intent, and sword will to him.
"You may not be able to see my sword will, but it’s all around us now, and I can control it with ease."
"Oh." Feng Xishui nodded slightly.
"Who taught you swordsmanship?
As far as I can remember, you’ve never fought using sword techniques before, and you usually use closed-range or long-range attacks.

"I was fortunate to meet my master in the Sovereign Heaven Realm, and I think he is the best sword expert in the Three Mortal Realms." Thereafter, Zhang Fei [5] searched for an empty place and landed there, and he brought the other two to the Huangfu Royal Palace using his nine cloud steps, especially since Feng Jiu’s flying artifact attracted too much attention.

When they arrived there, Zhang Fei [5] found that Leng Xueyan had also just arrived, but she did not go there through the front door; instead, she landed her flying artifact above the Huangfu Royal Palace, similar to the one in the Nine Stars Realm.
"Lead us inside."
"Follow me, master." Since his Li Clan was one of the Huangfu Emperor’s confidants, it was not difficult for Li Tiannan to bring Zhang Fei [5] and Feng Xishui into the royal palace.
He immediately took the two of them to the meeting, especially since members of his clan were there along with members of the other clans.
When they arrived at the throne room, Zhang Fei [5] saw Huangfu Emperor standing opposite Leng Xueyan, who explained her identity and purpose of coming.

chapters.title: Chapter 995: Picking Up Yuan Tianling
paragraphs: Zhang Fei [5] did not go straight to the inn, and he chose to check out the situation in the royal capital, especially since he wanted to open a shop there. However, the city was under tight security due to the prolonged war, making many shops closed because few people were active.
"Hey, why did you lie to that woman?" Zhang Fei [5] immediately informed Feng Xishui about Leng Xueyan’s arrival in the Phoenix Realm some time ago. "So, you’ve done something to her, right?"

Zhang Fei [5] smiled and opened his right palm. "Leng Xueyan is already in my grasp, and I can control her at any time. However, I would rather not do that now, and I still want to play around with her. Once I’m satisfied, I will bring her to my side, and she won’t be able to refuse."

"Hmm?" Feng Xishui observed him in thought. "Do you realize that you are becoming more and more vicious? We arrived today, but you already killed tens of thousands of troops from the Qiang Kingdom, and I don’t see the slightest pity on your face."

Zhang Fei [5] nodded at him. "Senior Xishui, my enemies are getting stronger, and they have no mercy. I have to be responsible for many people, and many evil cultivators can target them at any time. We will also go to the Paradise Realm, where we will face many more vicious cultivators. If I don’t become more vicious than them, we will be the ones to suffer one day. Therefore, I must continue to improve my mentality, and I will do whatever it takes to protect myself and them, including dirtying my hands with more blood."

Feng Xishui didn’t say anything in response to Zhang Fei [5], but he also understood their situation, and he was disappointed with himself because he couldn’t think like him. "You can look around the city, and I’ll go to the inn to find a room."

After Feng Xishui left, Zhang Fei [5] strolled around the city by himself, and he went to several shops that remained open despite the tense situation. Unfortunately, none of the items caught his interest, mainly because they were too outdated compared to the items in the Sovereign Heaven Realm.
Zhang Fei [5] suddenly detected the movement of several people from a distance, but he pretended not to notice their presence. ’Heh! They must be Huangfu Hongjun’s subordinates.’
[Master, why don’t you check the other kingdoms first? Those people won’t be finished anytime soon, so you don’t need to waste time in this deserted kingdom.]

’This kingdom became like this because of war, and it seems like many of its residents fled to other kingdoms.’ Zhang Fei [5] glanced at those people before disappearing from their sight, and he went to other kingdoms in that realm. His first destination was the Qiang Kingdom, which was not far from the Huangfu Kingdom.

With his nine cloud steps, Zhang Fei [5] could arrive at the kingdom in just a few minutes. Compared to the capital of the Huangfu Kingdom, the capital of the Qiang Kingdom was more lively, and the citizens did not show the slightest worry about the war between the two kingdoms.

Since he also wanted to open a shop in the Qiang Kingdom, Zhang Fei [5] immediately went to check every alchemy and blacksmith shop in the kingdom, and he also searched for information about the best building for him to use as his shop.
[Are you planning to open a restaurant in this realm, Master?]

’No.’ Zhang Fei [5] replied with a shake of his head. ’The income from all my restaurants is good, but it is too time-consuming because I have to teach the new chefs how to cook earth dishes. Moreover, my grandmother and the others are still busy in the Star Tower, so I will only open a few shops in this realm, and I will bring some people from the demon fox group here to take care of them.’

Zhang Fei [5] suddenly received a long-distance message from Yuan Tianling, informing him that they had arrived at the Shrouded Sky Realm. He immediately sent one of his clones to that realm to meet them, while he continued his search in the Qiang Kingdom and listened to the situation there, especially about Qiang Yun’s death.
Yuan Tianling and her entourage had already arrived at the city where the alchemy union was located, but they knew nothing about the realm.
"Where are we going now, Yueling?"
"There." Yuan Tianling pointed toward the Alchemy Union. "Zhang Fei is waiting for us up there, Mother."
"Do you know what building that is, Tianling?"

"Let’s go there." Yuan Tianling led them as she explained about the Alchemy Union, which now belongs to Zhang Fei. She also told them that he was a Venerable Rank alchemist, which shocked them. "There are quite a few alchemists in our realm, especially members of the Medicine Sect. However, none of them can match his alchemy skills, and he has many extraordinary pills that we can’t find anywhere else; even the alchemy goddess acknowledges his abilities."
"Did your cultivation foundation become stronger and more solid because of his pills?"

"He gave me his basic pills and some other pills." Yuan Tianling then pointed to a shop quite close to the tower. "See that shop? The Sky Jade Shop is his, and he opened his shops on many planets from the lower to the upper realms. Actually, he arrived in our realm a long time ago, and he managed to pass all the tests in just a week."
"Are you serious about that?" Yuan Tianxie asked in shock.

Yuan Tiankong, Yuan Tianjie, and Yuan Tianhua were also shocked by that, especially since they had met Zhang Fei before in the Scorching Earth Realm more than two years ago, and his cultivation was still in the Heaven Realm at that time.

Yuan Tianling shrugged his shoulders. "If you don’t believe me, you can ask the people in our realm once we get back. In fact, he managed to defeat Tian Jiantang and Qing Yun, and both of them eagerly sparred with him."
"How about we take a look at that shop first, Sister Ziwei?"
"Let’s go, we—"

"No need." Yuan Tianling immediately stopped them. "You don’t need to take a look at his shop in this realm, especially since he will be opening another shop in our realm soon. Therefore, we have to meet him now and return to our realm directly, and you can buy his pills once he opens his shop there."
"All right."

Before long, they had arrived at the Alchemy Union, and someone was waiting for them in front of the tower. The person immediately led them to the top of the tower, where Zhang Fei [4] was speaking with Huoyun Zhiyan about the true foundation pill.
"Fei!" Yuan Tianling ran over and hugged Zhang Fei [4], but he stopped her when she wanted to kiss him. "Oh! I was too excited to meet you, so I forgot about that."
"Haha." Zhang Fei [4] laughed and rubbed her cheek. "Do you want me to send you to the Star Tower?"

Yuan Tianling shook her head vigorously. "I spent two years in the Moon Tower, so I have no interest in going to the Star Tower. I will hold myself back for now and wait for your real body to come out of there, and we will have fun again then."

"Don’t worry, I will accompany you then." Zhang Fei [4] then looked at the group, and he smiled faintly seeing the shocked expressions of Yuan Tianxie, Yuan Tiankong, Yuan Tianjie, and Yuan Tianhua, which was because of his cultivation level. "Long time no see."
"How... how can your cultivation reach the Seven Divine Realms in just two years?" Yuan Tianxie asked stammeringly.

"This." Zhang Fei [4] showed them the true foundation pill and explained its effects to them. "I have several skilled alchemists by my side, and they continue to concoct this pill non-stop, which allowed my cultivation to stabilize and improve rapidly."

Yuan Tianquan, Duanmu Luolan, Ren Ziwei, and several others exchanged shocked glances. ’Even if he has such a pill, it’s impossible for his cultivation to break through four major stages in two years, right?’
"Is that pill also useful for cultivators at the Seven Divine Realms, like us?" Yuan Tianhua asked him a question as he approached him.

Zhang Fei [4] nodded at her. "This pill is still useful for cultivators at our level, but I won’t sell it to the public. First, the ingredients are quite rare and difficult to find. Second, concocting this pill takes six months, and the chances are not high. Third, I have many people by my side, and I will give this pill to them so that they can break through to the Seven Divine Realms as quickly as possible."
"I see." Yuan Tianhua nodded in understanding.

Ren Ziwei wanted to talk to him, but Zhang Fei [4] had already opened the gate leading to the Sovereign Heaven Realm first. "Once you pass through this gate, you will immediately arrive at your realm. However, the situation is critical right now because of the Cao Clan, and you can ask Tian Jingxuan and the others about the exact situation, especially since Jia Yuyan and Shangguan Yan have already informed them."
’This kid! How dare he call them by their names directly?’ Yuan Tianxie, Yuan Tiankong, Yuan Tianjie, Yuan Tianhua, and the other young cultivators wondered in their hearts.
"What about my master?" Yuan Tianling anxiously asked.

"Hehe." Zhang Fei [4] chuckled. "Leng Xueyan just arrived at the Grand Royal Realm today, and she won’t be back anytime soon. Moreover, I already did something against her in the Phoenix Realm, remember? Therefore, you don’t have to worry about her, right?"

"Oh! I forgot about that! You’re right, I don’t have to worry about her, and you will take care of her for me." Yuan Tianling then ran toward her mother and pulled her into the gate. "We’ll return to our realm now, Fei!"
Duanmu Luolan and the others immediately followed them, but Yuan Tianquan stopped in front of Zhang Fei [4]. "Please visit our Yuan Clan; I would like to discuss your relationship with my daughter."
"Don’t worry, I’ll see you soon." Yuan Tianquan nodded and crossed the gate, and Zhang Fei [4] went straight back to the training space after he left some instructions for Huoyun Zhiyan.
Upon their arrival at the Sovereign Heaven Realm, all of them were in a state of shock, questioning Zhang Fei’s ability to transport them from the middle realm to the upper realm in an instant.
"Mother! Father! I’ll go somewhere else first." Without waiting for their approval, Yuan Tianling immediately flew away toward Zhang Xiaolong [3]’s residence.
Yuan Tianxie and the others immediately returned to the Yuan Clan, as did the rest of the people, who immediately returned to their respective clans.
Meanwhile, Ren Ziwei, Duanmu Luolan, Yuan Tianquan, and several seniors went to meet Tian Jingxuan and the others, who were discussing the Cao Clan’s plans against them.
"Oh? When did you guys come back? Why didn’t I notice your return?" Tian Jingxuan questioned them as soon as they arrived there.

After they sat down with the others, Yuan Tianquan immediately explained to them about their encounter with Zhang Fei [4] just now. They also told Tian Jingxuan and the others about everything they had gone through at the Moon Tower in the past two months, including about Yue Liangyu and the conditions for going to the Paradise Realm.

"Only ten people at a time, huh?" Tian Jingxuan and others muttered under their breaths. "If that’s the case, we should challenge different towers, so we can all ascend at the same time. However, we should put that aside for now, and we should focus on the matter at hand."

"What really happened?" Duanmu Luolan asked them. "Zhang Fei previously told us that the situation in our realm was critical because of Cao Ren and the Cao Clan, but he didn’t explain the details to us and asked us to ask you guys."

Jia Yuyan immediately explained to them about Cao Ren and the Cao Clan’s success in reaching the top of the top tower, including their request to Qi Lai to help them, causing all of them to frown. "Luolan, I want you to meet that kid now. He wants to do something to Leng Hua and the Leng Clan, but he can’t avoid their sensor formation, so he needs your help to infiltrate there."
"Isn’t he still in another realm?" Duanmu Luolan asked in confusion.

Jia Yuyan nodded at her. "You’re not wrong about that, but the person you met before was just his clone, and he lives here. Therefore, I want you to go to his residence now, and we have to deal with Leng Hua and the Leng Clan before Cao Ren returns."
"All right, I will meet him now." Duanmu Luolan left again as soon as Jia Yuyan pointed out the location of Zhang Xiaolong [3]’s residence.
"What about us?"

"See that shop?
The Sky Jade Shop is his, and he opened his shops on many planets from the lower to the upper realms.
Actually, he arrived in our realm a long time ago, and he managed to pass all the tests in just a week."
"Are you serious about that?" Yuan Tianxie asked in shock.

Yuan Tiankong, Yuan Tianjie, and Yuan Tianhua were also shocked by that, especially since they had met Zhang Fei before in the Scorching Earth Realm more than two years ago, and his cultivation was still in the Heaven Realm at that time.
Yuan Tianling shrugged his shoulders.
"If you don’t believe me, you can ask the people in our realm once we get back.
In fact, he managed to defeat Tian Jiantang and Qing Yun, and both of them eagerly sparred with him."
"How about we take a look at that shop first, Sister Ziwei?"
"Let’s go, we—"
"No need." Yuan Tianling immediately stopped them.
"You don’t need to take a look at his shop in this realm, especially since he will be opening another shop in our realm soon.
Therefore, we have to meet him now and return to our realm directly, and you can buy his pills once he opens his shop there."
"All right."
Before long, they had arrived at the Alchemy Union, and someone was waiting for them in front of the tower.
The person immediately led them to the top of the tower, where Zhang Fei [4] was speaking with Huoyun Zhiyan about the true foundation pill.
"Fei!" Yuan Tianling ran over and hugged Zhang Fei [4], but he stopped her when she wanted to kiss him.
"Oh!
I was too excited to meet you, so I forgot about that."
"Haha." Zhang Fei [4] laughed and rubbed her cheek.
"Do you want me to send you to the Star Tower?"
Yuan Tianling shook her head vigorously.
"I spent two years in the Moon Tower, so I have no interest in going to the Star Tower.
I will hold myself back for now and wait for your real body to come out of there, and we will have fun again then."

"Don’t worry, I will accompany you then." Zhang Fei [4] then looked at the group, and he smiled faintly seeing the shocked expressions of Yuan Tianxie, Yuan Tiankong, Yuan Tianjie, and Yuan Tianhua, which was because of his cultivation level.
"Long time no see."
"How... how can your cultivation reach the Seven Divine Realms in just two years?" Yuan Tianxie asked stammeringly.
"This." Zhang Fei [4] showed them the true foundation pill and explained its effects to them.
"I have several skilled alchemists by my side, and they continue to concoct this pill non-stop, which allowed my cultivation to stabilize and improve rapidly."

Yuan Tianquan, Duanmu Luolan, Ren Ziwei, and several others exchanged shocked glances. ’Even if he has such a pill, it’s impossible for his cultivation to break through four major stages in two years, right?’
"Is that pill also useful for cultivators at the Seven Divine Realms, like us?" Yuan Tianhua asked him a question as he approached him.
Zhang Fei [4] nodded at her.
"This pill is still useful for cultivators at our level, but I won’t sell it to the public.
First, the ingredients are quite rare and difficult to find.
Second, concocting this pill takes six months, and the chances are not high.
Third, I have many people by my side, and I will give this pill to them so that they can break through to the Seven Divine Realms as quickly as possible."
"I see." Yuan Tianhua nodded in understanding.
Ren Ziwei wanted to talk to him, but Zhang Fei [4] had already opened the gate leading to the Sovereign Heaven Realm first.
"Once you pass through this gate, you will immediately arrive at your realm.

However, the situation is critical right now because of the Cao Clan, and you can ask Tian Jingxuan and the others about the exact situation, especially since Jia Yuyan and Shangguan Yan have already informed them."
’This kid!
How dare he call them by their names directly?’ Yuan Tianxie, Yuan Tiankong, Yuan Tianjie, Yuan Tianhua, and the other young cultivators wondered in their hearts.
"What about my master?" Yuan Tianling anxiously asked.
"Hehe." Zhang Fei [4] chuckled.
"Leng Xueyan just arrived at the Grand Royal Realm today, and she won’t be back anytime soon.
Moreover, I already did something against her in the Phoenix Realm, remember?
Therefore, you don’t have to worry about her, right?"
"Oh!
I forgot about that!
You’re right, I don’t have to worry about her, and you will take care of her for me." Yuan Tianling then ran toward her mother and pulled her into the gate.
"We’ll return to our realm now, Fei!"
Duanmu Luolan and the others immediately followed them, but Yuan Tianquan stopped in front of Zhang Fei [4].
"Please visit our Yuan Clan; I would like to discuss your relationship with my daughter."
"Don’t worry, I’ll see you soon." Yuan Tianquan nodded and crossed the gate, and Zhang Fei [4] went straight back to the training space after he left some instructions for Huoyun Zhiyan.
Upon their arrival at the Sovereign Heaven Realm, all of them were in a state of shock, questioning Zhang Fei’s ability to transport them from the middle realm to the upper realm in an instant.
"Mother!
Father!
I’ll go somewhere else first." Without waiting for their approval, Yuan Tianling immediately flew away toward Zhang Xiaolong [3]’s residence.
Yuan Tianxie and the others immediately returned to the Yuan Clan, as did the rest of the people, who immediately returned to their respective clans.
Meanwhile, Ren Ziwei, Duanmu Luolan, Yuan Tianquan, and several seniors went to meet Tian Jingxuan and the others, who were discussing the Cao Clan’s plans against them.
"Oh?
When did you guys come back?
Why didn’t I notice your return?" Tian Jingxuan questioned them as soon as they arrived there.
After they sat down with the others, Yuan Tianquan immediately explained to them about their encounter with Zhang Fei [4] just now.

They also told Tian Jingxuan and the others about everything they had gone through at the Moon Tower in the past two months, including about Yue Liangyu and the conditions for going to the Paradise Realm.
"Only ten people at a time, huh?" Tian Jingxuan and others muttered under their breaths.
"If that’s the case, we should challenge different towers, so we can all ascend at the same time.
However, we should put that aside for now, and we should focus on the matter at hand."
"What really happened?" Duanmu Luolan asked them.
"Zhang Fei previously told us that the situation in our realm was critical because of Cao Ren and the Cao Clan, but he didn’t explain the details to us and asked us to ask you guys."
Jia Yuyan immediately explained to them about Cao Ren and the Cao Clan’s success in reaching the top of the top tower, including their request to Qi Lai to help them, causing all of them to frown.
"Luolan, I want you to meet that kid now.
He wants to do something to Leng Hua and the Leng Clan, but he can’t avoid their sensor formation, so he needs your help to infiltrate there."
"Isn’t he still in another realm?" Duanmu Luolan asked in confusion.
Jia Yuyan nodded at her.
"You’re not wrong about that, but the person you met before was just his clone, and he lives here.
Therefore, I want you to go to his residence now, and we have to deal with Leng Hua and the Leng Clan before Cao Ren returns."
"All right, I will meet him now." Duanmu Luolan left again as soon as Jia Yuyan pointed out the location of Zhang Xiaolong [3]’s residence.
"What about us?"

chapters.title: Chapter 996: Jia Yuyan - Wan Jiang
paragraphs: After they discussed several things with Tian Jingxuan and the others, Yuan Tianquan and the others immediately returned to their respective clans to prepare. Ren Ziwei went to the Ren Clan to warn his family, as did the people from the Nalan and Beihuang Clans.

Jia Yuyan walked out of the room, but she did not return to the eastern forest; instead, she went to the southern region, especially after she detected a sense of someone watching them from that region.
"Hmm?" Jia Yuyan was surprised to see Wan Jiang and his three disciples. "How did the four of you end up in this realm?"

"A fairy from the Floral Mirage Domain, right?" Jia Yuyan nodded to Wan Jiang. "We are in charge of monitoring the Star Tower, and we asked Zhang Fei to send us to this realm, mainly because of Qi Lai."
Jia Yuyan was a little surprised to hear that. "Why did your higher-ups let that person go down to the three mortal realms and help the Cao Clan?"

"You’re wrong about that." Wan Jiang denied it with a shake of his head. "The higher-ups never allowed Qi Lai to come down here, let alone help those mortals. He came down here of his own accord, and I finally understood his purpose in helping the Cao Clan."
"Why?"

"You are his reason." Wan Jiang’s answer caused Jia Yuyan to frown. "I once heard that a special fairy was born into the fairy race, and she was born with a special physique that naturally harmonizes with the laws of wood, life, and regeneration. Besides, she managed to convince the ancient immortal treant spirit to give her bloodline, which allowed her to command nature."
Jia Yuyan became tense after Wan Jiang mentioned that. "How did you know that person was me?"

Wan Jiang created a barrier around them, and he transformed into a young man a few moments later. However, his appearance was no longer that of an ordinary human; instead, he became a fairy with long white hair and six white wings on his back. "People call me Wan Jiang, but my real name is Jia Xianzu."
"Jia Xianzu the traitor." Jia Yuyan muttered in shock.
"Hey—"

"Enough." Wan Jiang immediately stopped the hot-headed Hua Mei’er. "You’re right, I am the traitor Jia Xianzu. At least, that is the nickname given to me by Jia Zishen, even though I have never betrayed our race. Instead, he was the real traitor, and he did it to become the fairy king."
Jia Yuyan looked at him with a darkened face. "What do you mean by the fairy king is the traitor?"

"I won’t say anything about this matter." Wan Jiang refused with a shake of his head. "I have decided not to interfere in our fairy race’s affairs anymore, and you can ask your grandparents, Jia Lingzhu and Jia Shengyu, if you want to know the truth."

Jia Yuyan was not surprised to hear the name of her grandparents from Wan Jiang’s mouth, especially since they were from the same generation. However, she was confused by his statement that the fairy king was the real traitor of their fairy race, and he did it to be their king.

Wan Jiang returned to his old man form and spoke to her. "Pretend we have never met, and please do not mention my current identity to anyone, especially to members of our race. I was already quite down when they expelled me from our race, but I have forgotten all that, and the current me is Wan Jiang of the Peach Garden Domain."

"The Peach Garden Domain? I didn’t expect you to choose that domain, but that domain is indeed quite similar to the Floral Mirage Domain, and many natural races live there." Jia Yuyan then looked at Wang Jiang’s three disciples. "Are they also natural races like us?"
Wan Jiang shook his head in response. "Sima Yun, Hua Mei’er, and Helian Xun’er are ordinary humans. I met them when they joined my sect, and they have been my disciples since then."

"I see." Jia Yuyan nodded in understanding. "I’m relieved that Zhang Fei brought you guys to this realm because I can’t use my true power in the Three Mortal Realms, and I can’t possibly stop Qi Lai by myself. In that case, I will return to my forest, and you guys can join me if you wish."
"No need." Wan Jiang immediately refused. "Your forest is filled with complicated formations, so we will wait for Qi Lai here."
"All right."
After Jia Yuyan left the area, Hua Mei’er immediately asked the old man a question. "Is it okay if you tell her your true identity, Master?"

"Don’t worry, that female elf is not stupid, and I’m sure she already knows that the fairy king is not a good person." Wan Jiang then looked far away. ’Who are those two beasts? How could they be in the three mortal realms? They seem to be Zhang Fei’s friends, so I don’t need to think about them.’
Meanwhile, Duanmu Luolan was already at Zhang Xiaolong [3]’s residence and discussing the sensor formation in the Leng Clan. "How long will it take you to create a formation to disrupt it?"
"I can create it in a few hours."
Zhang Xiaolong [3] nodded in understanding. "In that case, I want you to prepare it as soon as possible, and I will infiltrate the clan once you are ready."
"All right, I will immediately prepare it once I return to my clan."
"Can you tell me your array master rank?"

"Are you also an array master?" Zhang Xiaolong [3] told Duanmuo Luolan about his rank, which surprised her. "I didn’t expect that you studied so many cultivation paths. You are a dual cultivator, an alchemist, a blacksmith, an array master, and a swordsman, right?"
"That’s right." Zhang Xiaolong [3] then asked again. "So, what about your array master rank?"
"Hehe." Duanmu Luolan giggled before answering. "I am a rank 10 array master."

"Eh?" Zhang Xiaolong [3] was shocked to hear that, especially since rank 10 was the highest among array masters. "Can you teach me more about formation arrays? Actually, I learned it by myself, but I also got some pointers from my two friends. However, they are only rank 4 and rank 7 array masters, so I want to learn from you about it."

"If you want to learn more about formation arrays, you can find me at my Duanmu Clan, and I will teach you as much as you want." Duanmu Luolan then stood up. "I will return to my clan to prepare the formation, and I will bring it here tonight."

After Duanmu Luolan left, Yuan Tianling immediately approached Zhang Xiaolong [3] and lay down on a chair with her head in his lap. "What have you been doing since you arrived in this realm? Have you found some women that caught your interest?"
"Haha." Zhang Xiaolong [3] laughed at that. "So far, only four women have caught my attention, and two of them are quite close to me now."
"Who are they?"

"Jia Yuyan and Shangguan Yan." Yuan Tianling was momentarily stunned after Zhang Xiaolong [3] mentioned the two names, prompting him to explain to him about his relationship with them. "The other two are Ju Zhu from the giant race and Duanmu Luolan."
"Hmm?" Yuan Tianling squinted her eyes because Zhang Xiaolong [3] had only met Duanmu Luolan today, but he was already attracted to her. "What made you interested in Aunt Luolan?"

Zhang Xiaolong [3] smiled at that. "She is mature, pretty, powerful, and a peak rank array master. Therefore, it is only natural that I have an interest in her, right? If I had her by my side, I could utilize her abilities in formation arrays for all of us, and we would progress much faster with her help."

"You are really strange." Yuan Tianling said with a shake of his head. "I agree with you approaching Aunt Luolan, and she is indeed suitable to be by your side. Moreover, she has been a widow for a long time, like Aunt Yan. I think she will be happy if she becomes your wife, so you should move quickly to approach her. However, I find it strange to hear that you are interested in a female giant, particularly considering her reputedly enormous body."

Zhang Xiaolong [3] nodded at her. "Ju Zhu’s body is indeed big and sturdy, but she is really attractive, and I want her to be a member of my harem. Actually, she and her family have already agreed to follow me, but I haven’t started courting her yet, and I’m still waiting for the right time to do it."
"So, what other things have you done in this realm? I also want to hear your other stories, especially after our separation more than two years ago."
"Hahaha." Zhang Xiaolong [3] rubbed her head and told her many things.
"Brother, Duanmu Luolan and the others have returned."

"I already knew about their return, but their presence won’t change anything." Leng Hua then gave several orders to Leng Kuan. "Send people to monitor the Yuan and Ren Clans, and I also want you to send people to the Nalan and Beihuang Clans. Since Nalan Qingge and Beihuang Fan have not returned, it is time for us to take over their two clans. However, you must do it secretly, and do not let Tian Jingxuan be aware of your actions."
"Yes, Brother." Leng Kuan immediately summoned several people to carry out Leng Hua’s order.

"As I suspected before, that brat wants to interfere in our matter. They shouldn’t have returned yet, but they suddenly returned, and I’m sure he’s the one who brought them back this quickly." Leng Hua immediately walked to the side of the window and looked into the distance. "Why did Duanmu Luolan go to that brat’s residence? What are they planning? Could it be that they want to attack us?"

After thinking about it, Leng Hua immediately left his room and activated all the formations within the Leng Clan residence, and he also ordered all his clan members to prepare for any sudden attacks.
Meanwhile, Zhang Fei [5] was inside a building in the Qian Kingdom, and an old man accompanied him. "Are you interested in this building, young master?"
"How much is this building worth, Senior?"
"Only 500,000 blue jewels." The old man then explained. "However, this building belongs to the royal family, so you have to go to the royal palace if you want to buy it."
Zhang Fei [5] nodded in understanding. "Can you take me to the royal palace? I want to buy this building today, and I will open my shop as soon as possible."
"Please follow me, Young Master."

Sometime later, they were already at the Qiang Royal Palace, and Zhang Fei [5] could hear the people there talking about the deaths of Qiang Yun and tens of thousands of their soldiers, which made the Qiang Emperor furious. ’What a fool! They will never know that I killed them all.’
The old man brought Zhang Fei [5] into an office building located a little away from the main palace, where a young woman and several other women were busy taking care of many documents.
"Why did you bring a stranger here, Old Meng?" The young woman gently asked.
"Princess Qiang Yin, this young master wants to buy the building in the business sector, so I brought him here to see you."
"Hmm?" Princess Qiang Yin immediately looked at Zhang Fei [5]. "Forgive me for being presumptuous, but what is your purpose in wanting to buy that building, young master?"

’Why does a princess like her have to deal with trivial matters like this? Couldn’t they leave this kind of business to someone else?’ Zhang Fei [5] immediately approached her and placed several bottles of pills on the table. "I am a venerable rank alchemist, and I want to open my shop in this kingdom. You can see my pills first, and you will not doubt my ability."

Princess Qiang Yin immediately checked the pills inside each bottle, and her eyes widened after seeing so many superior-grade pills inside. "Although this planet is in the upper realms, I have never seen so many superior-grade pills before, so I don’t need to doubt your abilities. Are you a native of this realm, Young Master?"

"No." Zhang Fei [5] took all the bottles and put them away. "Actually, I come from the Xianjin Realm, and I am an ambitious alchemist. In fact, I already have several shops on several planets, but I want to open my alchemy shop on all the planets in the upper realms, including this planet. Since Senior Meng said that the building belongs to the royal family, I came here to buy it, and I will open my shop in a few days."
Princess Qiang Yin was surprised to hear about the Xianjin Realm from her. "Young master, alchemists like you are very rare in this realm, so I would like to offer you a collaboration."
"Please tell me, Princess."
